text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Boom Bots for each Bomb in your opponent's deck.
flavor: He's gonna fly through the air with the greatest of grease.

name: Bronze Herald
text: Deathrattle: Add two 4/4 Dragons to your hand.
flavor: This is why you shouldn’t shoot the messenger.

name: Dragon Speaker
text: Battlecry: Give all Dragons in your hand +3/+3.
flavor: All of his speeches really drag on.

name: Crystal Power
text: Choose One - Deal 2 damage to a minion; or Restore 5 Health.
flavor: Often used as healing crystals, but also good for throwing at people.

name: Blessing of the Ancients
text: Twinspell Give your minions +1/+1.
flavor: Arguably the cutest blessing.

name: Crystalsong Portal
text: Discover a Druid minion. If your hand has no minions, keep all 3 instead.
flavor: Experience the draw of the wild!

name: Acornbearer
text: Deathrattle: Add two 1/1 Squirrels to your hand.
flavor: You’d be nuts to mess with the squirrel squad.

name: Lifeweaver
text: Whenever you restore Health, add a random Druid spell to your hand.
flavor: Lifeweaving is all well and good until it's time to cut the thread.

name: Lucentbark
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Go Dormant. Restore 5 Health to awaken this minion.
flavor: Always feels refreshed after a little dirt nap.

name: Crowd Roaster
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 7 damage to an enemy minion.
flavor: Every major show has an opening act to warm up the crowd.

name: Unidentified Contract
text: Destroy a minion. Gains a bonus effect in your hand.
flavor: The terms of service are constantly changing.

name: Unsleeping Soul
text: Silence a friendly minion, then summon a copy of it.
flavor: It's 3 am. Do you know where your soul is?

name: Messenger Raven
text: Battlecry: Discover a Mage minion.
flavor: You can make a collect CAW!

name: Darkest Hour
text: Destroy all friendly minions. For each one, summon a random minion from your deck.
flavor: It's always darkest just before you find the light switch.

name: Conjurer's Calling
text: Twinspell Destroy a minion. Summon 2 minions of the same Cost to replace it.
flavor: If only you’d let it go to voicemail…

name: Magic Dart Frog
text: After you cast a spell, deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: There's a powerful throat in this frog.

name: Aranasi Broodmother
text: Taunt When you draw this, restore 4 Health to your hero.
flavor: She's got a big brood and a big mood.

name: Marked Shot
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Discover a spell.
flavor: Obviously it's marked for greatness.

name: Arcane Fletcher
text: Whenever you play a 1-Cost minion, draw a spell from your deck.
flavor: Stop trying to make fletch happen. It's not going to happen.

name: Rapid Fire
text: Twinspell Deal 2 damage.
flavor: Pew! Pew!

name: Oblivitron
text: Deathrattle: Summon a Mech from your hand and trigger its Deathrattle.
flavor: Reduce, reuse, re-rattle!

name: Nine Lives
text: Discover a friendly Deathrattle minion that died this game. Also trigger its Deathrattle.
flavor: Beware the night of the living pets!

name: The Boom Reaver
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of a minion in your deck. Give it Rush.
flavor: “What’s better than reaving? BOOM reaving!”

name: Unleash the Beast
text: Twinspell Summon a 5/5 Wyvern with Rush.
flavor: The Kirin Tor have always been lax in enforcing leash laws.

name: Vereesa Windrunner
text: Battlecry: Equip Thori'dal, the Stars' Fury.
flavor: Good things come in threes: Windrunner sisters and arrows of Thori'dal.

name: EVIL Conscripter
text: Deathrattle: Add a Lackey to your hand.
flavor: Kobold! There’s a place you can handle I said kobold! When you’re short in the candle Cast a spell with the E! V! I! L!

name: EVIL Miscreant
text: Combo: Add two random Lackeys to your hand.
flavor: Because there are no G.O.O.D. Miscreants.

name: Hench-Clan Burglar
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell from another class.
flavor: She’s more of a rat burglar.

name: Heistbaron Togwaggle
text: Battlecry: If you control a Lackey, choose a fantastic treasure.
flavor: A staunch ally of Rafaam, at least while the shinies keep flowing.

name: Arch-Villain Rafaam
text: Taunt Battlecry: Replace your hand and deck with Legendary minions.
flavor: Minions must wash hands before being LIQUIDATED AND REPLACED BY SOMEONE BETTER.

name: Mutate
text: Transform a friendly minion into a random one that costs (1) more.
flavor: You'll get the transformation you want when murlocs fly.

name: Spirit of the Rhino
text: Stealth for 1 turn. Your Rush minions are Immune the turn they're summoned.
flavor: Where did they get this preposterous hypothesis?

name: Icicle
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it's Frozen, draw a card.
flavor: This may appear weak at frost glance, but it's actually a very ice spell.

name: Tome of Intellect
text: Add a random Mage spell to your hand.
flavor: Just a compilation of napkins of intellect.

name: Call of the Void
text: Add a random Demon to your hand.
flavor: "Marco!" "Polo!" "Marco!" "Who dares summon me?!"

name: Pilfer
text: Add a random card from another class to your hand.
flavor: The class is always greener on the other side of the board.

name: Toxfin
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Murloc Poisonous.
flavor: I'm addicted to him, but I know that he's Toxfin.

name: Traveling Healer
text: Divine Shield Battlecry: Restore 3 Health.
flavor: Some heroes have soft hearts and hard shells.

name: Spellward Jeweler
text: Battlecry: Your hero is Elusive until next turn.
flavor: The fanciest possible way of distracting enemies with shiny things.

name: Dalaran Crusader
text: Divine Shield
flavor: Stops for nothing—except donuts.

name: Sunreaver Spy
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, gain +1/+1.
flavor: She's watching. Always watching.

name: Hench-Clan Hag
text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Amalgams with all minion types.
flavor: The Hench Clan is an equal opportunity employer, no matter which parts of you came from where.

name: Safeguard
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 0/5 Vault Safe with Taunt.
flavor: Keep it secret. Keep it safeguarded!

name: Spellbook Binder
text: Battlecry: If you have Spell Damage, draw a card.
flavor: You're bound to love his work!

name: Hench-Clan Sneak
text: Stealth
flavor: He’d be a lot sneakier if he wasn’t trailing 300 yards of power cable…

name: Arcane Servant
flavor: "Would sir like me to punch something?"

name: Violet Spellsword
text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Attack for each spell in your hand.
flavor: If you have to wield a spell and a sword, then neither is performing to expectation.

name: Violet Warden
text: Taunt Spell Damage +1
flavor: He's got magic, a shield, and an unwavering obsession with the color purple.

name: Unseen Saboteur
text: Battlecry: Your opponent casts a random spell from their hand (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: Far more effective than the flamboyant saboteur.

name: Sunreaver Warmage
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, deal 4 damage.
flavor: What, did you expect the Sunreavers to be coldages?

name: Potion Vendor
text: Battlecry: Restore 2 Health to all friendly characters.
flavor: Everyone gets two because that’s all she can hold.

name: Swampqueen Hagatha
text: Battlecry: Add a 5/5 Horror to your hand. Teach it two Shaman spells.
flavor: Rafaam mainly enjoys working with Hagatha because she never laughs at Dr. Boom's jokes.

name: Barista Lynchen
text: Battlecry: Add a copy of each of your other Battlecry minions to your hand.
flavor: "Thanks a latte!"

name: Azerite Elemental
text: At the start of your turn, gain Spell Damage +2.
flavor: This is some bad blood.

name: Underbelly Ooze
text: After this minion survives damage, summon a copy of it.
flavor: It's always accepting of the less successful adventurers.

name: Proud Defender
text: Taunt Has +2 Attack while you have no other minions.
flavor: It'll take a humble offender to defeat him.

name: Big Bad Archmage
text: At the end of your turn, summon a random 6-Cost minion.
flavor: "My, my, what big minions I have!"

name: Witch's Brew
text: Restore 4 Health. Repeatable this turn.
flavor: The swill has eyes!

name: Sludge Slurper
text: Battlecry: Add a Lackey to your hand. Overload: (1)
flavor: You can't stop slurping this delicious sludge!

name: Chef Nomi
text: Battlecry: If your deck is empty, summon six 6/6 Greasefire Elementals.
flavor: His cooking is always very well done.

name: Archmage Vargoth
text: At the end of your turn, cast a spell you've cast this turn (targets are random).
flavor: He's an archmage, but he might want to brush up on the basics... like aiming.

name: Soul of the Murloc
text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Murloc."
flavor: Previously thought nonexistent.

name: Heroic Innkeeper
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Gain +2/+2 for each other friendly minion.
flavor: We reserve the right to refuse service to any 1/1.

name: Jumbo Imp
text: Costs (1) less whenever a friendly Demon dies while this is in your hand.
flavor: Jumbo in size! Huge in E.V.I.L.!

name: Eager Underling
text: Deathrattle: Give two random friendly minions +2/+2.
flavor: Eager to please, even if it kills him.

name: Portal Overfiend
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 3 Portals into your deck. When drawn, summon a 2/2 Demon with Rush.
flavor: It’s like an interdimensional game of demon tag.

name: Eccentric Scribe
text: Deathrattle: Summon four 1/1 Vengeful Scrolls.
flavor: Them’s fightin’ words!

name: Lightforged Blessing
text: Twinspell Give a friendly minion Lifesteal.
flavor: Some might call this a lightforgery.

name: Never Surrender!
text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, give your minions +2 Health.
flavor: But sometimes concede.

name: Mysterious Blade
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: It knows every secret you have left.

name: Commander Rhyssa
text: Your Secrets trigger twice.
flavor: Two people can keep a secret as long as neither of them are Commander Rhyssa.

name: Khadgar
text: Your cards that summon minions summon twice as many.
flavor: "What do you call two minions summoned at once? Twinions, haha! Wait... where are you going?"

name: Underbelly Fence
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a card from another class, gain +1/+1 and Rush.
flavor: She’ll take anything you have—except scruples and a good work ethic.

name: Vendetta
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Costs (0) if you're holding a card from another class.
flavor: A vengeful and vicarious vanguard against violent villains or vexed victims.

name: Tak Nozwhisker
text: Whenever you shuffle a card into your deck, add a copy to your hand.
flavor: "One for me and one for future me!"

name: Waggle Pick
text: Deathrattle: Return a random friendly minion to your hand. It costs (2) less.
flavor: Kobolds informally refer to its effect as a deathwaggle.

name: Catrina Muerte
text: At the end of your turn, resurrect another friendly Undead minion.
flavor: She always manages to lift your spirits.

name: Forbidden Words
text: Spend all your Mana. Destroy a minion with that much Attack or less.
flavor: Please confirm your age before reading this flavor text.

name: Mass Resurrection
text: Summon 3 friendly minions that died this game.
flavor: One's company, two's a crowd, and three's a “mass” resurrection, apparently.

name: Scargil
text: Your Murlocs cost (1).
flavor: Wanna know how he got those scars? So does he.

name: Kirin Tor Tricaster
text: Spell Damage +3 Your spells cost (1) more.
flavor: The math checks out!

name: Ray of Frost
text: Twinspell Freeze a minion. If it's already Frozen, deal 2 damage to it.
flavor: If you have zero chill, this can help.

name: Power of Creation
text: Discover a 6-Cost minion. Summon two copies of it.
flavor: Mostly used for party tricks, to be honest.

name: Arcane Watcher
text: Can't attack unless you have Spell Damage.
flavor: Now his watch has ended… until you have Spell Damage.

name: Call to Adventure
text: Draw the lowest Cost minion from your deck. Give it +2/+2.
flavor: Even the smallest minion can change the outcome of the game.

name: Daring Escape
text: Return all friendly minions to your hand.
flavor: Impossible to cast without cackling evilly.

name: Nozari
text: Battlecry: Restore both heroes to full Health.
flavor: In another timeline, she was called Yeszari.

name: Plot Twist
text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw that many cards.
flavor: It’s coming from inside the deck!

name: Mana Cyclone
text: Battlecry: For each spell you've cast this turn, add a random Mage spell to your hand.
flavor: It'll put a good spin on your spells.

name: Portal Keeper
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 3 Portals into your deck. When drawn, summon a 2/2 Demon with Rush.
flavor: No longer allowed to be “it” when playing demon tag.

name: Madame Lazul
text: Battlecry: Discover a copy of a card in your opponent's hand.
flavor: Of course she knows the future, she’s been looking at your cards the WHOLE TIME!

name: Duel!
text: Summon a minion from each player's deck. They fight!
flavor: If you don’t fight to the death, it’s Duel Yielding.

name: Ursatron
text: Deathrattle: Draw a Mech from your deck.
flavor: It's been programmed to include all the bear necessities.

name: Keeper Stalladris
text: After you cast a Choose One spell, add copies of both choices to your hand.
flavor: Keeps your choices handy.

name: Dreamway Guardians
text: Summon two 1/2 Dryads with Lifesteal.
flavor: They're a nightmare to deal with.

name: The Forest's Aid
text: Twinspell Summon five 2/2 Treants.
flavor: Delicious Forest’s Aid! Made from real forests.

name: Dalaran Librarian
text: Battlecry: Silence adjacent minions.
flavor: Don't make her raise her "shush"!

name: Archivist Elysiana
text: Battlecry: Discover 5 cards. Replace your deck with 2 copies of each.
flavor: Your deck is just another organizational challenge to her.

name: Impferno
text: Give your Demons +1 Attack. Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Imps don't get mad when you set them on fire. They think it's cozy.

name: EVIL Genius
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly minion to add 2 random Lackeys to your hand.
flavor: You do not want to be on the business end of this intellect!

name: Fel Lord Betrug
text: Whenever you draw a minion, summon a copy with Rush that dies at end of turn.
flavor: Nobody else likes rush hour.

name: Shimmerfly
text: Deathrattle: Add a random Hunter spell to your hand.
flavor: Plenty of buzz around this card.

name: Whirlwind Tempest
text: Your minions with Windfury have Mega-Windfury.
flavor: And your minions with mega-windfury get... dizzy.

name: Soup Vendor
text: Whenever you restore 3 or more Health to your hero, draw a card.
flavor: Fresh from the floor of the arena!

name: Hench-Clan Hogsteed
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Murloc.
flavor: This is CLEARLY their first rodeo.

name: Faceless Rager
text: Battlecry: Copy a friendly minion's Health.
flavor: When you need to rage anonymously.

name: Flight Master
text: Battlecry: Summon a 2/2 Gryphon for each player.
flavor: Your gryphon will be summoned following a brief safety demonstration.

name: Mana Reservoir
text: Spell Damage +1
flavor: If it soaks too long, it becomes a reservoir hog.

name: Recurring Villain
text: Deathrattle: If this minion has 4 or more Attack, resummon it.
flavor: Mwahahaha! You'll never catch him this time!

name: Mad Summoner
text: Battlecry: Fill each player's board with 1/1 Imps.
flavor: Does he summon because of his madness, or is he mad from all the summoning?

name: Jepetto Joybuzz
text: Battlecry: Draw 2 minions from your deck. Set their Attack, Health, and Cost to 1.
flavor: “I’m a real toy now!”

name: Magic Trick
text: Discover a spell that costs (3) or less.
flavor: The world is not ready for an illusion of this depth and intricacy!

name: Kalecgos
text: Your first spell each turn costs (0). Battlecry: Discover a spell.
flavor: He was once the Aspect of Magic but gave it up to focus on cheap tricks.

name: Burly Shovelfist
text: Rush
flavor: Shovel beats paper and rock!

name: Hunting Party
text: Copy all Beasts in your hand.
flavor: Not sure I’d call it a good party if everyone ends up beside themselves.

name: Vicious Scraphound
text: Whenever this minion deals damage, gain that much Armor.
flavor: It begs for scraps.

name: Improve Morale
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion. If it survives, add a Lackey to your hand.
flavor: "The beatings will continue until MY morale improves."

name: Omega Devastator
text: Battlecry: If you have 10 Mana Crystals, deal 10 damage to a minion.
flavor: The Alpha Devastator didn’t devastate enough. The Beta Devastator devastated too much. But the Omega was just right!

name: Soldier of Fortune
text: Whenever this minion attacks, give your opponent a Coin.
flavor: His allies call him invaluable.

name: Magic Carpet
text: After you play a 1-Cost minion, give it +1 Attack and Rush.
flavor: Its small yet fierce riders are affectionately known as rug rats.

name: Crystal Stag
text: Rush. Battlecry: If you've restored 5 Health this game, summon a copy of this. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Arrives alone, but usually leaves with a friend just like him.

name: Exotic Mountseller
text: Whenever you cast a spell, summon a random 3-Cost Beast.
flavor: *Taps roof of mammoth* “You can fit so many squirrels in this thing!”

name: Tunnel Blaster
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to all minions.
flavor: And you always thought they wore the candles just for fun.

name: Batterhead
text: Rush. After this attacks and kills a minion, it may attack again.
flavor: When it comes to problem-solving, he always uses his head.

name: King Phaoris
text: Battlecry: For each spell in your hand, summon a random minion of the same Cost.
flavor: When you're the king of the cats, the whole desert is your litterbox.

name: Dwarven Archaeologist
text: Battlecry: Discover a card. Reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: She's making great progress on paying off that advanced degree.

name: Sir Finley of the Sands
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, Discover an upgraded Hero Power.
flavor: "The sands shall be my sea! And this scarab shall be my, er, strange and wriggly boat!"

name: Candletaker
text: Reborn
flavor: "You no waaaake caaaandle!"

name: Restless Mummy
text: Rush Reborn
flavor: Life-separation anxiety syndrome.

name: Ancestral Guardian
text: Lifesteal Reborn
flavor: No one knows whose ancestor he is, but he's still upset that you never call.

name: Khartut Defender
text: Taunt, Reborn Deathrattle: Restore 3 Health to your hero.
flavor: Gesundheit!

name: Vulpera Scoundrel
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell or pick a mystery choice.
flavor: A spell is a spell, but the mystery choice could be anything! (It's also a spell.)

name: Wild Bloodstinger
text: Battlecry: Summon a minion from your opponent's hand. Attack it.
flavor: Tame Bloodstingers would politely invite your minion to tea.

name: Generous Mummy
text: Reborn Your opponent's cards cost (1) less.
flavor: Yeah, she's mummified, but her money hasn’t dried up!

name: Wrapped Golem
text: Reborn At the end of your turn, summon a 1/1 Scarab with Taunt.
flavor: The end result of one of the greatest wrap battles of all time.

name: Puzzle Box of Yogg-Saron
text: Cast 10 random spells (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: "PUT THE BOX DOWN, RENO!"

name: Micro Mummy
text: Reborn At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +1 Attack.
flavor: The dramatically detailed terrifically trimmed replica of the real thing!

name: Untapped Potential
text: Quest: End 4 turns with any unspent Mana. Reward: Ossirian Tear.
flavor: The official term is "strategic laziness."

name: Crystal Merchant
text: If you have any unspent Mana at the end of your turn, draw a card.
flavor: I won't ask about your mana curve if you don't ask where I got these.

name: BEEEES!!!
text: Choose a minion. Summon four 1/1 Bees that attack it.
flavor: Right before CEEEES!!!

name: Hidden Oasis
text: Choose One - Summon a 6/6 Ancient with Taunt; or Restore 12 Health.
flavor: Amazing that it's been hidden, given the twenty-foot treant splashing around in it.

name: Mischief Maker
text: Battlecry: Swap the top card of your deck with your opponent's.
flavor: Fair trade is for noble-minded suckers with dignity and honor.

name: Worthy Expedition
text: Discover a Choose One card.
flavor: This isn't where I parked my mount.

name: Scarlet Webweaver
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of a random Beast in your hand by (5).
flavor: Isn't that nice? The spider made the explorer a sleeping bag!

name: Garden Gnome
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, summon two 2/2 Treants.
flavor: "Greetings, my little shrubs... It's whittlin' time."

name: Anubisath Defender
text: Taunt. Costs (0) if you've cast a spell that costs (5) or more this turn.
flavor: Also comes running when he hears a can opener.

name: Elise the Enlightened
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, duplicate your hand.
flavor: From cartographer to combatant, Elise has taken the road less traveled—because no one else could find it on a map.

name: Whirlkick Master
text: Whenever you play a Combo card, add a random Combo card to your hand.
flavor: C-c-combo!

name: Splitting Axe
text: Battlecry: Summon copies of your Totems.
flavor: The ancient shaman chant, "Control Axe, Control Vee."

name: Supreme Archaeology
text: Quest: Draw 20 cards. Reward: Tome of Origination.
flavor: Archaeology is the discovery of rare and powerful artifacts. Supreme Archaeology is TAKING THEM!

name: Zephrys the Great
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, wish for the perfect card.
flavor: "Of course it's perfect, you're just not seeing how to use it."

name: Tortollan Pilgrim
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell in your deck and cast it with random targets.
flavor: A tortollan made it to the desert!

name: Reno the Relicologist
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemy minions.
flavor: All his life, Reno Jackson was only a gatling wand away from becoming the greatest and most terrifying mage who ever existed.

name: Infested Goblin
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Add two 1/1 Scarabs with Taunt to your hand.
flavor: Trust us. DON'T go cheap on the scarab repellent.

name: Tomb Warden
text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon a copy of this minion.
flavor: Also known as an ancient copy machine.

name: Into the Fray
text: Give all Taunt minions in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: "You are in my FRAY!"

name: Armagedillo
text: Taunt At the end of your turn, give all Taunt minions in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: We may never know what provoked it, but we will never forget the consequences.

name: Arcane Flakmage
text: After you play a Secret, deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Ancient pandaren proverb: He who is without secrets lacks flak.

name: Flame Ward
text: Secret: After a minion attacks your hero, deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Not to be confused with the burn ward.

name: Pharaoh's Blessing
text: Give a minion +4/+4, Divine Shield, and Taunt.
flavor: Life hack: Sneeze near a pharaoh.

name: Brazen Zealot
text: Whenever you summon a minion, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: Some paladins really Light it up.

name: Desert Spear
text: After your hero attacks, summon a 1/1 Locust with Rush.
flavor: Goes on the right, next to the desert spoon.

name: Hunter's Pack
text: Add a random Hunter Beast, Secret, and weapon to your hand.
flavor: Oh look! It's a trap!

name: Sinister Deal
text: Discover a Lackey.
flavor: "So, what's in the sack?" "Something... sinister." "Okay, it's a deal."

name: Neferset Thrasher
text: Whenever this attacks, deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: Tough to do skateboard tricks with four legs.

name: EVIL Recruiter
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly Lackey to summon a 5/5 Demon.
flavor: I'm starting to think the lackeys aren't evil, just taken advantage of.

name: Expired Merchant
text: Battlecry: Discard your highest Cost card. Deathrattle: Add 2 copies of it to your hand.
flavor: The "best by" date is more like a guideline.

name: Riftcleaver
text: Battlecry: Destroy a minion. Your hero takes damage equal to its Health.
flavor: Brings you face to face with your destructive impulses.

name: Diseased Vulture
text: Whenever your hero takes damage on your turn, summon a random 3-Cost minion.
flavor: He's off the twig! He's kicked the bucket! THIS IS AN EX-VULTURE!

name: Dark Pharaoh Tekahn
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Lackeys are 4/4.
flavor: He'll get that League of Explorers and their little murloc too!

name: Making Mummies
text: Quest: Play 5 Reborn minions. Reward: Emperor Wraps.
flavor: "I do say, this gives me the vapors every single time!"

name: Ramkahen Wildtamer
text: Battlecry: Copy a random Beast in your hand.
flavor: She gets to decide what cards go to the Hall of Fame.

name: Pressure Plate
text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: The appropriate dishware for stressful situations.

name: Hyena Alpha
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, summon two 2/2 Hyenas.
flavor: Everything the sun touches is ours—so long as it's already dead.

name: Unseal the Vault
text: Quest: Summon 20 minions. Reward: Pharaoh's Warmask.
flavor: "Huh... That's a nice card back."

name: Dinotamer Brann
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, summon King Krush.
flavor: Brann's new dino-taming hobby is going well—his pet can already make him sit, stand, and roll over!

name: High Priest Amet
text: Whenever you summon a minion, set its Health equal to this minion's.
flavor: All minions are equal, but some minions are more equal than others.

name: Embalming Ritual
text: Give a minion Reborn.
flavor: "Guess what! We're getting a new cat."

name: Grandmummy
text: Reborn Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion +1/+1.
flavor: A grandmummy’s love is eternal.

name: Psychopomp

text: Stealth Reborn

text: Taunt Reborn

name: Hooked Scimitar

name: Anubisath Warbringer
text: Deathrattle: Give all minions in your hand +3/+3.

name: Kobold Sandtrooper
text: Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero.

name: Temple Berserker

text: Battlecry: Discover a 4-Cost card.

text: Rush Battlecry: Add a random minion from another class to your hand.

text: Destroy all damaged minions.

name: Plague of Flames
text: Destroy all your minions. For each one, destroy a random enemy minion.

text: Silence and destroy all minions.

name: Vilefiend
text: Lifesteal

name: Ritual Chopper
text: Battlecry: Invoke Galakrond.

name: Emerald Explorer

name: Shrubadier
text: Battlecry: Summon a 2/2 Treant.

name: Amber Watcher
text: Battlecry: Restore 8 Health.

name: Breath of Dreams

name: Bronze Explorer

name: Candle Breath

name: Flik Skyshiv

name: Blazing Battlemage

name: Shield of Galakrond

name: Tasty Flyfish

name: Devoted Maniac

name: Phase Stalker
text: After you use your Hero Power, cast a Secret from your deck.
flavor: It's not just a phase! I don't have to tell you anything! GAWSH!

name: Dwarven Sharpshooter
text: Your Hero Power can target minions.
flavor: Scissors, knives, needles, you name it! He'll shoot it.

name: Primordial Explorer
text: Poisonous Battlecry: Discover a Dragon.
flavor: "We're letting the poisonous dude carry the bags?"

name: Toxic Reinforcements
text: Sidequest: Use your Hero Power three times. Reward: Summon three 2/1 Leper Gnomes.
flavor: In the event of a sudden loss of cabin pressure, a slingshot will be deployed for convenient evacuation.

name: Dragonbane
text: After you use your Hero Power, deal 5 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: *Thunk* "That wasn’t a dragon!" *Thunk* "THAT wasn’t a dragon!"

name: Frizz Kindleroost
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of Dragons in your deck by (2).
flavor: Frizz knows that baby dragons need warmth, care, and the highest possible level of goblin engineering.

name: Sanctuary
text: Sidequest: Take no damage for a turn. Reward: Summon a 3/6 minion with Taunt.
flavor: Few quests are completed by cowering under a table.

name: Big Ol' Whelp
text: Battlecry: Draw a card.
flavor: A chonker, a real absolute unit.

name: Hoard Pillager
text: Battlecry: Equip one of your destroyed weapons.
flavor: Better to have stabbed and lost. And then found again!

name: Parachute Brigand
text: After you play a Pirate, summon this minion from your hand.
flavor: She flies standby.

name: Hot Air Balloon
text: At the start of your turn, gain +1 Health.
flavor: The Gadgetzan Pilgrim's Bounty parade is missing a float this year.

name: Wing Commander
text: Has +2 Attack for each Dragon in your hand.
flavor: "Flap! Flap! FLAP!"

name: Goboglide Tech
text: Battlecry: If you control a Mech, gain +1/+1 and Rush.
flavor: The word "glide" is always in quotes in the manual.

name: Fire Hawk
text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Attack for each card in your opponent's hand.
flavor: It’s our fault for making all those card backs that look like food.

name: Gyrocopter
text: Rush Windfury
flavor: The hula doll is still absolutely required.

name: Wyrmrest Purifier
text: Battlecry: Transform all Neutral cards in your deck into random cards from your class.
flavor: She keeps your deck classy.

name: Dragonmaw Poacher
text: Battlecry: If your opponent controls a Dragon, gain +4/+4 and Rush.
flavor: I prefer my dragons over-easy.

name: Zul'Drak Ritualist
text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon three random 1-Cost minions for your opponent.
flavor: Generosity is a core value in cult culture.

name: Hippogryph
text: Rush Taunt
flavor: Known for its ferocious grace, the hippogryph is a truly majestic creature. Except when molting.

name: Evasive Chimaera
text: Poisonous Elusive
flavor: One head only tells the truth, while the other head only tells lies. But they both spit poison.

name: Troll Batrider
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: "Quiet! The bat can't hear where he's goin'!"

name: Living Dragonbreath
text: Your minions can't be Frozen.
flavor: If you want that muscular physique, you've really gotta feel the burn.

name: Platebreaker
text: Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's Armor.
flavor: Worst. Dinner guest. Ever.

name: Dragon Breeder
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Dragon. Add a copy of it to your hand.
flavor: Deathwing would have been more well-adjusted if he'd been raised by this guy.

name: Bad Luck Albatross
text: Deathrattle: Shuffle two 1/1 Albatross into your opponent's deck.
flavor: Legend holds that it's bad luck to harm it. So maybe just pat it on the head, okay?

name: Skyfin
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, summon 2 random Murlocs.
flavor: "Do you want to be a murloc or a dragon?" "Yes."

name: Evasive Feywing
text: Elusive
flavor: I've never heard of this fey-dragon called "Brightwing," but if I HAD, I’d say we’d be best friends.

name: Camouflaged Dirigible
text: Battlecry: Give your other Mechs Stealth until your next turn.
flavor: "What does that cloud look like to you?" "Trouble."

name: Cobalt Spellkin
text: Battlecry: Add two 1-Cost spells from your class to your hand.
flavor: Spews more spells than a sleep-talking wizard.

name: Faceless Corruptor
text: Rush. Battlecry: Transform one of your minions into a copy of this.
flavor: What does Madame Lazul have against faces?!

name: Utgarde Grapplesniper
text: Battlecry: Both players draw a card. If it's a Dragon, summon it.
flavor: Note: The dragon may be a little cranky upon arrival.

name: Depth Charge
text: At the start of your turn, deal 5 damage to ALL minions.
flavor: * Does not have Charge.

name: Evasive Wyrm
text: Rush Divine Shield Elusive
flavor: Deftly dodges spells like a real wiggle wyrm.

name: Scalerider
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 2 damage.
flavor: Do Re Me Fa So La Spear Throw!

name: Kobold Stickyfinger
text: Battlecry: Steal your opponent's weapon.
flavor: He no take candle. He take sword.

name: Transmogrifier
text: Whenever you draw a card, transform it into a random Legendary minion.
flavor: All it takes is some imagination and a cardboard box.

name: Murozond the Infinite
text: Battlecry: Play all cards your opponent played last turn.
flavor: "Well, I'm glad YOU knew what I should be doing this turn."

name: Dragonqueen Alexstrasza
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, add 2 other random Dragons to your hand. They cost (0).
flavor: Givin' lives and takin' names.

name: Dread Raven
text: Has +3 Attack for each other Dread Raven you control.
flavor: Fun Fact: A group of three Dread Ravens is an unkindness. Four is lethal!

name: Chromatic Egg
text: Battlecry: Secretly Discover a Dragon to hatch into. Deathrattle: Hatch!
flavor: Nefarian was known for creating two things: horrible monsters and excellent breakfasts.

name: Tentacled Menace
text: Battlecry: Each player draws a card. Swap their Costs.
flavor: He calls this one the "Calamari Special."

name: Shu'ma
text: At the end of your turn, fill your board with 1/1 Tentacles.
flavor: How to tell your mother to go away.

name: Veranus
text: Battlecry: Change the Health of all enemy minions to 1.
flavor: As an empty nester, she just misses her little ones.

name: Bandersmosh
text: Each turn this is in your hand, transform it into a 5/5 copy of a random Legendary minion.
flavor: The Shudderwock finds him particularly frumious.

name: Kronx Dragonhoof
text: Battlecry: Draw Galakrond. If you're already Galakrond, unleash a Devastation.
flavor: The only one who knows how to properly prepare Galakrond's coffee.

name: Molten Breath
text: Deal 5 damage to a minion. If you're holding a Dragon, gain 5 Armor.
flavor: Pizza so hot it burns OTHER PEOPLE’S MOUTHS.

name: Grizzled Wizard
text: Battlecry: Swap Hero Powers with your opponent until your next turn.
flavor: When he was young, he was an Outrageous Magus.

name: Zayle, Shadow Cloak
text: You start the game with one of Zayle's EVIL Decks!
flavor: E.V.I.L. is the new black.

name: Rising Winds
text: Twinspell Choose One - Draw a card; or Summon a 3/2 Eagle.
flavor: Do not talk to me or my chick ever again.

name: Winged Guardian
text: Taunt Reborn Elusive
flavor: Take these broken wings, be reborn, and learn to fly again.

name: Chopshop Copter
text: After a friendly Mech dies, add a random Mech to your hand.
flavor: Invention is the mother of entropy.

name: Fresh Scent
text: Twinspell Give a Beast +2/+2.
flavor: *Sniff, sniff* Elite troops... *sniff, sniff*...armed to the teeth and... *sniff, sniff*...BAAACON!

name: Escaped Manasaber
text: Stealth Whenever this attacks, gain 1 Mana Crystal this turn only.
flavor: Captive manasabers don't behave much better--they're always scratching your furniture and coughing up mana balls.

name: Animated Avalanche
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, summon a copy of this.
flavor: Always sliding down mountains because it can't stop talking with its hands.

name: Arcane Amplifier
text: Your Hero Power deals 2 extra damage.
flavor: Not on good terms with warlocks.

name: The Amazing Reno
text: Battlecry: Make all minions disappear. *Poof!*
flavor: "Reno!" "Please address me by my proper title." " Amazing Reno..."

name: Shotbot
text: Reborn
flavor: Impact detected. Assuming hero pose.

name: Air Raid
text: Twinspell Summon two X Silver Hand Recruits with Taunt.
flavor: It's difficult to get an air raid together. You have to get twenty-five people, and they all want to play a paladin!

name: Cleric of Scales
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, Discover a spell from your deck.
flavor: If she can't find a spell, it's a clerical error.

name: Aeon Reaver
text: Battlecry: Deal damage to a minion equal to its Attack.
flavor: Ripping centuries asunder helps him manage his busy schedule.

name: Dark Prophecy
text: Discover a 2-Cost minion. Summon it and give it +3 Health.
flavor: It's always a dark prophecy with Madame Lazul. Where's my happy, fluffy prophecy?!

name: Skyvateer
text: Stealth Deathrattle: Draw a card.
flavor: When you go without fruits in an airship, you get a nasty case of skyvy.

name: Shadow Sculptor
text: Combo: Draw a card for each card you've played this turn.
flavor: Carving out new territory in the realm of shadow puppetry.

name: Waxmancy
text: Discover a Battlecry minion. Reduce its Cost by (2).
flavor: The waxmancer works with flame and form, giving shape to figures warm. Some think he's a crazy creeper, but crafting minions is simply cheaper.

name: Explosive Evolution
text: Transform a minion into a random one that costs (3) more.
flavor: Let's give a big hand for goblin experimentation!

name: Risky Skipper
text: After you play a minion, deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: Sworn enemy of the Safety Matey.

name: Boom Squad
text: Discover a Lackey, Mech, or Dragon.
flavor: Discover the meaning of squad goals.

name: Bomb Wrangler
text: Whenever this minion takes damage, summon a 1/1 Boom Bot.
flavor: Bomb Wranglers tend to have short fuses and even shorter lifespans.

name: Twisted Knowledge
text: Discover 2 Warlock cards.
flavor: People eat eight spiders in their sleep per year. Centaurs have two rib cages. Dwarves are just counterfeit titans.

name: Fiendish Servant
text: Deathrattle: Give this minion's Attack to a random friendly minion.
flavor: Putting the "r" in fiend.

name: Chaos Gazer
text: Battlecry: Curse a playable card in your opponent's hand. They have 1 turn to play it!
flavor: No matter the game rules, it's always playing Go Fish.

name: Skydiving Instructor
text: Battlecry: Summon a 1-Cost minion from your deck.
flavor: "Is it dangerous?" "For me? Not at all. Now jump!"

name: Hailbringer
text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Ice Shards that Freeze.
flavor: Knows every way to greet someone.

name: Licensed Adventurer
text: Battlecry: If you control a Quest, add a Coin to your hand.
flavor: "Just point me in the vague direction of the things you want smashed, and you got yourself a deal!"

name: Frenzied Felwing
text: Costs (1) less for each damage dealt to your opponent this turn.
flavor: Not to be confused with the "friendsy” felwing.

name: Boompistol Bully
text: Battlecry: Enemy Battlecry cards cost (5) more next turn.
flavor: Preventing insults with injuries.

name: Grand Lackey Erkh
text: After you play a Lackey, add a Lackey to your hand.
flavor: Esteemed leader of Rafaam's Inhuman Resources department.

name: Malygos, Aspect of Magic
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, Discover an upgraded Mage spell.
flavor: It's official. We can say Malygeese.

name: Sathrovarr
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly minion. Add a copy of it to your hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: Just wait until you also find a copy in your pocket. And your desk! And your FRIDGE!!

name: SN1P-SN4P
text: Magnetic, Echo Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Microbots.
flavor: "It's gonna be snip this, snap that. Bada-snip, bada-snap!"

name: Blowtorch Saboteur
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's next Hero Power costs (2) more.
flavor: Before he came along, we went through a lot of duct tape.

name: Rotnest Drake
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Clean your room, or I'm taking your favorite minion away!

name: Steel Beetle
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, gain 5 Armor.
flavor: Steel you can trust—fashioned from the husk of an over-sized creepy-crawly.

name: Eye of the Storm
text: Summon three 5/6 Elementals with Taunt. Overload: (3)
flavor: If that's the eye, I would hate to see the rest of the storm.

name: The Fist of Ra-den
text: After you cast a spell, summon a Legendary minion of that Cost. Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: The mighty Ra-den was known as the Keeper of Storms. Unfortunately, he could not keep his fist.

name: Sky Gen'ral Kragg
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you've played a Quest this game, summon a 4/2 Parrot with Rush.
flavor: He's gunning for Sky Adm'ral.

name: Spymistress
text: Stealth
flavor: Spies in Outland must blend into the environment. That means hot-pink gear and bright green hair. It’s a weird place.

name: Ashtongue Slayer
text: Battlecry: Give a Stealthed minion +3 Attack and Immune this turn.
flavor: Her other hand attachments include a corkscrew and a bottle opener.

name: Cursed Vagrant
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 7/5 Shadow with Stealth.
flavor: Little did he know… it was really the talbuk leg that was cursed.

name: Incanter's Flow
text: Reduce the Cost of spells in your deck by (1).
flavor: "Gettin' them discounts in bulk amounts, spells can come, and spells can go, castin' costs drop with my sweet, sweet flow."

name: Netherwind Portal
text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a random 4-Cost minion.
flavor: More aromatic than a regular portal.

name: Imprisoned Observer
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Currently serving two turns on charges of aggravated minion slaughter.

name: Evocation
text: Fill your hand with random Mage spells. They are Temporary.
flavor: You too could be the winner of the national spelling spree!

name: Rustsworn Initiate
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Impcaster with Spell Damage +1.
flavor: The Rusted Legion's training leaves a little to be desired. He hasn't even had a tetanus shot yet!

name: Imprisoned Sungill
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, summon two 1/1 Murlocs.
flavor: Imprisoned for ten thousand years! Not because it's a demon. Because of the dancing.

name: Felfin Navigator
text: Battlecry: Give your other Murlocs +1/+1.
flavor: Return my fishes to me, and I myself shall carry you to the gates of Mrrhalla!

name: Libram of Justice
text: Equip a 1/4 weapon. Change the Health of all enemy minions to 1.
flavor: Proper justice. Throw the book at him!

name: Augmented Porcupine
text: Deathrattle: Deal this minion's Attack damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: Pokey-man. Gotta spike 'em all!

name: Serpentshrine Portal
text: Deal 3 damage. Summon a random 3-Cost minion. Overload: (1)
flavor: This is why you never flush a three-cost minion.

name: Vivid Spores
text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Resummon this minion."
flavor: Hey man, I just feel like... death is just a construct of our imaginations, ya know?

name: Boggspine Knuckles
text: After your hero attacks, transform your minions into random ones that cost (1) more.
flavor: I would NOT want to put my hand in there. It's... SQUISHY.

name: Bogstrok Clacker
text: Battlecry: Transform adjacent minions into random minions that cost (1) more.
flavor: This clacker's crackers for hacking slackers into whack attackers.

name: Lady Vashj
text: Spell Damage +1 Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Vashj Prime' into your deck.
flavor: Personal handmaiden to Queen Azshara turned lieutenant to Illidan Stormrage. Also quite the hair sssstylist.

name: Scalelord
text: Battlecry: Give your Murlocs Divine Shield.
flavor: It's about what they have in common, not what makes them different.

name: Starscryer
text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell.
flavor: Often grieves with the Starsweeper.

name: Underlight Angling Rod
text: After your Hero attacks, add a random Murloc to your hand.
flavor: "I said I wanted the ASHbringer not FISHbringer!"

name: Murgur Murgurgle
text: Divine Shield Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Murgurgle Prime' into your deck.
flavor: Murlocs are not native to Outland. When the Sungills arrived, one among them rose to the challenge of this dark world. They call him... Murgurgle. Murgur Murgurgle.

name: Aldor Attendant
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of your Librams by (1) this game.
flavor: Will check to make sure you have a valid libramary card.

name: Zixor, Apex Predator
text: Rush Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Zixor Prime' into your deck.
flavor: A living terror. Teleports at will. Feasts on tainted helboar meat. No head scritches unless you're Leoroxx.

name: Font of Power
text: Discover a Mage minion. If your deck has no minions, keep all 3 instead.
flavor: It's Comic Sans.

name: Apexis Smuggler
text: After you play a Secret, Discover a spell.
flavor: "S-secrets? I don't have any! Whoa, look, a spell!"

name: Torrent
text: Deal 8 damage to a minion. Costs (3) less if you cast a spell last turn.
flavor: Weeks of underwater cross-training have really built up her fourarms.

name: Totemic Reflection
text: Give a minion +2/+2. If it's a Totem, summon a copy of it.
flavor: "Upon reflection, I have decided that your board needs more ME."

name: Shattered Rumbler
text: Battlecry: If you cast a spell last turn, deal 2 damage to all other minions.
flavor: HAPPY BIRTHDAY TO THE GROUND!

name: Marshspawn
text: Battlecry: If you cast a spell last turn, Discover a spell.
flavor: Hopes to someday promote to Marshsqueen.

name: Imprisoned Felmaw
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, attack a random enemy.
flavor: It doesn't care who woke it up, someone's getting bitten.

name: Helboar
text: Deathrattle: Give a random Beast in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Beasts love Helbacon Strips!

name: Pack Tactics
text: Secret: When a friendly minion is attacked, summon a 3/3 copy.
flavor: "Just you wait, I’ll go get on my main!"

name: Hand of Gul'dan
text: When you play or discard this, draw 3 cards.
flavor: His skull also draws three cards. Imagine how many cards he could draw with HIS ENTIRE BODY!

name: Nightshade Matron
text: Rush Battlecry: Discard your highest Cost card.
flavor: Throws shade at those "high-cost" minions.

name: Bladestorm
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. Repeat until one dies.
flavor: Dear minions: Woosh, woosh, woosh, woosh, woosh. Best regards, Bladestorm

name: Warmaul Challenger
text: Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion. Battle it to the death!
flavor: Old gladiator rules: first one to die loses.

name: Imprisoned Gan'arg
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, equip a 3/2 Axe.
flavor: Factory Direct Fiery War Axe. Please allow two turns for delivery.

name: Kargath Bladefist
text: Rush Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Kargath Prime' into your deck.
flavor: He rules the Shattered Hand orc clan with an iron... bladefist.

name: The Dark Portal
text: Draw a minion. If you have at least 8 cards in hand, it costs (5) less.
flavor: Some say it's the source of Azeroth's greatest problems—aside from the gnomes.

name: Corsair Cache
text: Draw a weapon. Give it +1/+1.
flavor: Where's a corsair's favorite place to hide treasure? Under their deck!

name: Enhanced Dreadlord
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 5/5 Dreadlord with Lifesteal.
flavor: Photo actually taken across the street in the reflection of a doorknob.

name: Imprisoned Scrap Imp
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, give all minions in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: His impish imports imply impressively impetuous impropriety.

name: Shadow Council
text: Replace your hand with random Demons. Give them +2/+2.
flavor: Why is everybody in Outland replacing their hands?!

name: Darkglare
text: Battlecry: If your hero took damage this turn, refresh 3 Mana Crystals.
flavor: He's got a dark glare, but he sees crystal clear!

name: Ambush
text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, summon a 2/3 Ambusher with Poisonous.
flavor: Clip-clop clip-clop CLIP-CLOP STAB!

name: Dirty Tricks
text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, draw 2 cards.
flavor: "Ahh sand in my eyes! Also, I'm being stabbed."

name: Greyheart Sage
text: Battlecry: If you control a Stealthed minion, draw 2 cards.
flavor: "What am I drinking again?"

name: Blackjack Stunner
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, return a minion to its owner's hand. It costs (2) more.
flavor: "I'm about to ruin this 10-cost minion's whole career."

name: Akama
text: Stealth Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Akama Prime' into your deck.
flavor: "To many of my people, I am known as a traitor... as Illidan's lapdog. I will remain in the shadows, for now... Actually, maybe I'll just remain in the shadows forever."

name: Kanrethad Ebonlocke
text: Your Demons cost (1) less. Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Kanrethad Prime' into your deck.
flavor: After Illidan's downfall, Kanrethad formed the Council of the Black Harvest to study Illidan's fel magic. Some say he was... green with envy.

name: Libram of Hope
text: Restore 8 Health. Summon an 8/8 Guardian with Taunt and Divine Shield.
flavor: "Think you got lethal? Libram of NOPE!"

name: Libram of Wisdom
text: Give a minion +1/+1 and "Deathrattle: Add a 'Libram of Wisdom' spell to your hand."
flavor: The best wisdom is passed on.

name: Aldor Truthseeker
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of your Librams by (2) this game.
flavor: It’s under 'T.'

name: Aldrachi Warblades
text: Lifesteal
flavor: The ancient Aldrachi were the greatest warriors in the universe. Imagine their power if they'd put the handle at the END of the blade.

name: Umberwing
text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Felwings.
flavor: Demon Hunters refer to these glaives as "the ol’ flappy-attackys."

name: Renew
text: Restore 3 Health. Discover a spell.
flavor: I am rejuvenated, I am renewed, I am my own nightlight!

name: Psyche Split
text: Give a minion +1/+2. Summon a copy of it.
flavor: This is how the arakkoa make friends.

name: Sethekk Veilweaver
text: After you cast a spell on a minion, add a Priest spell to your hand.
flavor: The Sethekk weren't able to survive this long by being wasteful with their power. Or their wacky hats.

name: Kael'thas Sunstrider
text: Every third spell you cast each turn costs (1).
flavor: “Descent of Dragons was merely a set back!”

name: Apotheosis
text: Give a minion +2/+3 and Lifesteal.
flavor: Defined as the absolute pinnacle of existence. Plus Lifesteal.

name: Imprisoned Homunculus
text: Dormant for 2 turns. Taunt
flavor: He got a time out for excessive vulgarity.

name: Dragonmaw Sentinel
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, gain +1 Attack and Lifesteal.
flavor: On the side, she's training for the annual Dragonmaw hammer throw tournament.

name: Imprisoned Antaen
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: Can I get a pair of size XXXXXL manacles?

name: Altruis the Outcast
text: After you play the left- or right-most card in your hand, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Altruis betrayed Illidan to forge his own way in Outland. With Blackjack. And Netherdrakes.

name: Teron Gorefiend
text: Battlecry: Destroy all other friendly minions. Deathrattle: Resummon them with +1/+1.
flavor: "You’re fine, friendly minions! You're fine! Don’t tell Mom!"

name: Imprisoned Satyr
text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, reduce the Cost of a random minion in your hand by (5).
flavor: "C'mon down to Illhoof's bargain bin! When the satyr's free, he'll lower your fee!"

name: Fungal Fortunes
text: Draw 3 cards. Discard any minions drawn.
flavor: Far superior to a beanstalk boondoggle.

name: Germination
text: Summon a copy of a friendly minion. Give the copy Taunt.
flavor: I regret asking how sporelings are made.

name: Overgrowth
text: Gain two empty Mana Crystals.
flavor: Zangarmarsh: it's a fungal out there!

name: Dragonmaw Overseer
text: At the end of your turn, give another friendly minion +2/+2.
flavor: Ah, the Booterang... nothing cures peon laziness faster.

name: Ysiel Windsinger
text: Battlecry: Your spells cost (1) this turn.
flavor: Reach down into your lungs. The wind that resides there is your greatest treasure. It provides the gift of song, which is free. *But not less than (1)

name: Ironbark
text: Give a minion +1/+3 and Taunt. Costs (0) if you have at least 7 Mana Crystals.
flavor: "The important thing, son, is to protect your spores! I have spoken!"

name: Marsh Hydra
text: Rush After this attacks, add a random 8-Cost minion to your hand.
flavor: Three heads of marsh-mashing, bog-bashing, swamp-stomping fury!

name: Bogbeam
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Costs (0) if you have at least 7 Mana Crystals.
flavor: Some think the mysterious bright lights in the bog are alien invaders, others think they're just swamp gas. Turns out, it's just druids.

name: Glowfly Swarm
text: Summon a 2/2 Glowfly for each spell in your hand.
flavor: Glowflies are distant relations to spelling bees.

name: Archspore Msshi'fn
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Msshi'fn Prime' into your deck.
flavor: Brave leader of the Sporeggar. Guided by the philosophy that one should not mssh with matters that are not one's msshiness.

name: Mok'Nathal Lion
text: Rush. Battlecry: Choose a friendly minion. Gain a copy of its Deathrattle.
flavor: Never underestimate a lioness when her pride is on the line.

name: Scrap Shot
text: Deal 3 damage. Give a random Beast in your hand +3/+3.
flavor: Make your foe's armor your fauna's fashion!

name: Scavenger's Ingenuity
text: Draw a Beast. Give it +3/+3.
flavor: "A beast, barely alive. Gentlemen, we can rebuild it! Make it stronger, faster... spikier."

name: Astromancer Solarian
text: Spell Damage +1 Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Solarian Prime' into your deck.
flavor: Loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider, this blood elf mage sought arcane power in the Void. Did she find it... or did IT find her?

name: Bloodboil Brute
text: Rush Costs (1) less for each damaged minion.
flavor: Call Gurtogg a brute if you like, but no one else cares about the wounded like he does.

name: Bonechewer Raider
text: Battlecry: If there is a damaged minion, gain +1/+1 and Rush.
flavor: And if that minion has a frisbee, LOOK OUT!

name: Ur'zul Horror
text: Deathrattle: Add a 2/1 Lost Soul to your hand.
flavor: You face face face face face Jaraxxus!

name: Beastmaster Leoroxx
text: Battlecry: Summon 3 Beasts from your hand.
flavor: Father of Rexxar, Champion of the Horde, and Flexxar, Champion of the Gym.

name: Raging Felscreamer
text: Battlecry: The next Demon you play costs (2) less.
flavor: Screaming loudly will not reduce the cost of non-demonic goods.

name: Chaos Strike
text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. Draw a card.
flavor: "What do we want?" "CHAOS!" "When do we want it?" "WHEN LEAST EXPECTED!"

name: Coordinated Strike
text: Summon three 1/1 Illidari with Rush.
flavor: Undisputed champions of "Dancing with the Satyrs."

name: Shadowhoof Slayer
text: Battlecry: Give your hero +1 Attack this turn.
flavor: Was a humble Elven Archer before Sargeras got to him.

name: Scrapyard Colossus
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 7/7 Felcracked Colossus with Taunt.
flavor: Heap on heapin' on.

name: Imprisoned Vilefiend
text: Dormant for 2 turns. Rush
flavor: If you do the time, you gotta make up the time.

name: Terrorguard Escapee
text: Battlecry: Summon three 1/1 Huntresses for your opponent.
flavor: Poor guy is terrified, look at his faces.

name: Rustsworn Cultist
text: Battlecry: Give your other minions "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Demon."
flavor: "Rust… I love it. It's all coarse, and rough, and irritating. And it gets everywhere."

name: Nagrand Slam
text: Summon four 3/5 Clefthoofs that attack random enemies.
flavor: Come on and slam, and welcome to Nagrand!

name: Command the Illidari
text: Summon six 1/1 Illidari with Rush.
flavor: Give me an R! Give me a U! Give me an S! Give me an H! You two, you’re exclamation points!

name: Ashtongue Battlelord
text: Taunt Lifesteal
flavor: Demons have destroyed the lives of the Ashtongue draenei. Now he’s got a shoulder-axe to grind.

name: Feast of Souls
text: Draw a card for each friendly minion that died this turn.
flavor: Nothing fills you up like soul food!

name: Metamorphosis
text: Swap your Hero Power to "Deal 5 damage." After 2 uses, swap it back.
flavor: As the humble caterpillar becomes a beautiful butterfly, so too does a demon hunter become a hideous mass of writhing destruction and unfettered chaos.

name: Warglaives of Azzinoth
text: After attacking a minion, your hero may attack again.
flavor: The blades glow green from things unseen, dark dreams whirling in the felfire gleam.

name: Flamereaper
text: Also damages the minions next to whomever your hero attacks.
flavor: Honestly it sows more flame than it reaps.

name: Twin Slice
text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. Add 'Second Slice' to your hand.
flavor: The slice so nice, it'll cut you twice.

name: Sightless Watcher
text: Battlecry: Look at 3 cards in your deck. Choose one to put on top.
flavor: What he lacks in sight, he makes up for in sleight-of-tentacle tricks.

name: Netherwalker
text: Battlecry: Discover a Demon.
flavor: You got to Nethercrawl before you can Netherwalk.

name: Bamboozle
text: Secret: When one of your minions is attacked, transform it into a random one that costs (3) more.
flavor: "WE DO YOU A BAMBOOZLE, HOOMAN!"

name: Unstable Felbolt
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy minion and a random friendly one.
flavor: Warning! Your minions are seated in the splash zone.

name: Soul Mirror
text: Summon copies of enemy minions. They attack their copies.
flavor: It’s a doppelgang-war!

name: Scrap Golem
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Gain Armor equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: Abuse, reuse, recycle.

name: Reliquary of Souls
text: Lifesteal Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Reliquary Prime' into your deck.
flavor: These three represent Anger, Desire, and Suffering. Much like raid night guild chat.

name: Frozen Shadoweaver
text: Battlecry: Freeze an enemy.
flavor: She still wears her Frozen Shadoweave set despite the many, many nerfs. She just can't let it go!

name: Bonechewer Brawler
text: Taunt Whenever this minion takes damage, gain +2 Attack.
flavor: When you get this swole, arrows are basically free acupuncture.

name: Bonechewer Vanguard
text: Taunt Whenever this minion takes damage, gain +2 Attack.
flavor: She came here to taunt you and chew on bones, and she's all outta bones.

name: Burrowing Scorpid
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage. If that kills the target, gain Stealth.
flavor: It's a game of hide and go sting.

name: Ruststeed Raider
text: Taunt, Rush Battlecry: Gain +4 Attack this turn.
flavor: Three-time winner (and sole survivor) of the Crashes of Outland motocross!

name: Blistering Rot
text: At the end of your turn, summon a Rot with stats equal to this minion's.
flavor: Known as 'Fel Gel' to the Illidari, it's excellent protection against harsh Draenic sunshine.

name: Guardian Augmerchant
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it Divine Shield.
flavor: "What doesn't kill you makes me money!"

name: Rocket Augmerchant
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it Rush.
flavor: "Don't worry, this won't hurt me a bit."

name: Ethereal Augmerchant
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it Spell Damage +1.
flavor: According to him, undamaged minions just spell problems.

name: Dragonmaw Sky Stalker
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/4 Dragonrider.
flavor: "I will find you, sky!"

name: Soulbound Ashtongue
text: Whenever this minion takes damage, also deal that amount to your hero.
flavor: He claims to be "soulbound," but I just think he's clingy.

name: Disguised Wanderer
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 9/1 Inquisitor.
flavor: He wanders east... always into the east.

name: Waste Warden
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to a minion and all others of the same minion type.
flavor: Recycle that can, or you get the cuffs!

name: Overconfident Orc
text: Taunt While at full Health, this has +2 Attack.
flavor: "I am da powerful! You are da poop!"

name: Infectious Sporeling
text: After this damages a minion, turn it into an Infectious Sporeling.
flavor: "The best thing about being me—there’s so many 'me's."

name: Scavenging Shivarra
text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage randomly split among all other minions.
flavor: Say what you want but finding a matching set of six swords takes commitment.

name: Mo'arg Artificer
text: All minions take double damage from spells.
flavor: Double-damage. You know the drill.

name: Supreme Abyssal
text: Can't attack heroes.
flavor: Yet, you still feel attacked.

name: Al'ar
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 0/3 Ashes of Al'ar that resurrects this minion on your next turn.
flavor: Week 679: Still no mount...

name: Maiev Shadowsong
text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. It goes Dormant for 2 turns.
flavor: Go directly to Demon Jail. Do not attack minions, do not collect mana crystals.

name: Apexis Blast
text: Deal 5 damage. If your deck has no minions, summon a random 5-Cost minion.
flavor: Lonely mages can still have a blast!

name: Keli'dan the Breaker
text: Battlecry: Destroy a minion. If drawn this turn, instead destroy all minions except this one.
flavor: He calms down a lot if you just give him a turn.

name: Galakrond, the Wretched
text: Battlecry: Summon 1 random Demon.
flavor: Fel-flames slowly writhed around the skeleton, until the great bones knit themselves together into a demonic monstrosity. Rafaam shielded his face from the heat but could not hide his grin.

name: Galakrond, the Unbreakable
text: Battlecry: Draw 1 minion. Give it +4/+4.
flavor: The ground quaked beneath the behemoth as Dr. Boom continued: "…with over 400 TONS of solid Storm Silver plate." Then he beeped a small remote. "And luxury spikes!"

name: Galakrond, the Unspeakable
text: Battlecry: Destroy 1 random enemy minion.
flavor: Lazul called Galakrond’s name, her voice echoed by whispers from the deep. Both of Galakrond’s eyes opened… and then other eyes opened, as well.

name: Galakrond, the Nightmare
text: Battlecry: Draw 1 card. It costs (0).
flavor: The enormous creature unfurled terrifying claws dripping with poisonous ichor. King Togwaggle was pleased, but inwardly disappointed the great Nightmare refused to wear the candle.

name: Galakrond, the Tempest
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/2 Storms with Rush.
flavor: Hagatha cried out over the winds: "Truly, you are as powerful as the Maelstrom!" To which the Tempest answered: "I AM THE MAELSTROM."

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Battlecry: Add a copy of each spell you cast on friendly characters this game to your hand.
flavor: When it comes to spells, she loves 'em then she librams.

name: Hand of A'dal
text: Give a minion +2/+1. Draw a card.
flavor: When it meets the Hand of Gul'dan, they're SHAKING.

name: The Lurker Below
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to an enemy minion. If it dies, repeat on one of its neighbors.
flavor: "Throw it back! THROW IT BACK!"

name: Skeletal Dragon
text: Taunt At the end of your turn, add a Dragon to your hand.
flavor: I wish to complain about this dragon what I purchased not half an hour ago from this very boutique.

name: Sword and Board
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Gain 2 Armor.
flavor: Stab and Slab. Charge and Targe. Slash and Bash. You get the idea.

name: Bulwark of Azzinoth
text: Whenever your hero would take damage, this loses 1 Durability instead.
flavor: This plate turned shield you shall wield, praying its powers fel will serve you well.

name: Soul Cleave
text: Lifesteal Deal 2 damage to two random enemy minions.
flavor: The way to a demon's soul is through its stomach.

name: Chaos Nova
text: Deal 4 damage to all minions.
flavor: Illin' Illidan laying down the damage, flinging out the chaos as far as he can manage.

name: Replicat-o-tron
text: At the end of your turn, transform a neighbor into a copy of this.
flavor: According to the Boom Labs sales brochure, it "impractically makes itself!"

name: Deep Freeze
text: Freeze an enemy. Summon two 3/6 Water Elementals.
flavor: "Dancing with the Satyrs… on Ice!"

name: Shadowjeweler Hanar
text: After you play a Secret, Discover a Secret from a different class.
flavor: What is a shadowjeweler? A miserable little pile of secrets.

name: Crimson Sigil Runner
text: Outcast: Draw a card.
flavor: He's not the fastest of the bunch, but he'll take a stab at it anyway.

name: Nethrandamus
text: Battlecry: Summon two random 0-Cost minions. (Upgrades each time a friendly minion dies!)
flavor: Missed the big descent with the other dragons. But better late and nether!

name: Eye Beam
text: Lifesteal. Deal 3 damage to a minion. Outcast: This costs (1).
flavor: Sometimes looks CAN kill.

name: Skull of Gul'dan
text: Draw 3 cards. Outcast: Reduce their Cost by (3).
flavor: A fellow of evil possessed, of most devious shadow. He hath turned on his kin a thousand times, and now, how abhorred in all imagination he is!

name: Kayn Sunfury
text: Charge All friendly attacks ignore Taunt.
flavor: "Armor and heals may slow my zeal, but fel and glaives excite me!"

name: Pit Commander
text: Taunt At the end of your turn, summon a Demon from your deck.
flavor: "Pit! Do as I say!"

name: Hulking Overfiend
text: Rush. After this attacks and kills a minion, it may attack again.
flavor: To hulk, perhaps, to fiend: ay, there's the rub.

name: Soul Split
text: Choose a friendly Demon. Summon a copy of it.
flavor: Spoiler: they're both the evil twin.

name: Consume Magic
text: Silence an enemy minion. Outcast: Draw a card.
flavor: Please be mindful when consuming raw or undercooked magic.

name: Spectral Sight
text: Draw a card. Outcast: Draw another.
flavor: "Pick a card, any card! Preferably the left- or right-most card."

name: Priestess of Fury
text: At the end of your turn, deal 6 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: Furious that she only has six warglaives. The Sightless Watcher has eight! The fel is always greener on the other side.

name: Battlefiend
text: After your hero attacks, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: Say what you like about my hatchet-headed hooligan, he’s my battle-friend.

name: Satyr Overseer
text: After your hero attacks, summon a 2/2 Satyr.
flavor: What he lacks in communication skills, he makes up for with highly responsive staffing allocations.

name: Blade Dance
text: Deal damage equal to your hero's Attack to 3 random enemy minions.
flavor: The surest way to clear the dance floor.

name: Glaivebound Adept
text: Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, deal 4 damage.
flavor: "Initiate, this is your glaive. Think of it as an extension of yourself... Did you just throw it?!"

name: Furious Felfin
text: Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, gain +1 Attack and Rush.
flavor: Signature moves include Eye Bream, Feast of Soles, and Metamorphofish.

name: Illidari Felblade
text: Rush Outcast: Gain Immune this turn.
flavor: A whirling dervish of demonic devastation.

name: Magtheridon
text: Dormant. Battlecry: Summon three 1/3 enemy Warders. When they die, destroy all minions and awaken.
flavor: Came from another world to invade Outland and bend it to his will… only to be overthrown by an elf from another world who invaded Outland and bent it to his will.

name: Blur
text: Your hero can't take damage this turn.
flavor: "What are you trying to tell me? That I can dodge axes?" "I’m trying to tell you that when you’re a Demon Hunter, you won’t have to."

name: Mana Burn
text: Your opponent has 2 fewer Mana Crystals next turn.
flavor: One way to ensure that they are not prepared.

name: Mozaki, Master Duelist
text: After you cast a spell, gain Spell Damage +1.
flavor: Treats her students like her peers, which means defeating them in one-sided duels all day long.

name: Carrion Studies
text: Discover a Deathrattle minion. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: A good read but a little too much fluff.

name: Rune Dagger
text: After your hero attacks, gain Spell Damage +1 this turn.
flavor: Turns out being stabbed makes you more vulnerable to magic.

name: Gift of Luminance
text: Give a minion Divine Shield, then summon a 1/1 copy of it.
flavor: You get a small version of yourself in a snow globe to remember the moment.

name: Secret Passage
text: Replace your hand with 4 cards from your deck. Swap back next turn.
flavor: I use this to sneak out at night and do some villainous baking in the kitchen.

name: School Spirits
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. Shuffle 2 Soul Fragments into your deck.
flavor: "B-E A-G-G-R-E-S-S-I-V-E!"

name: Headmaster Kel'Thuzad
text: Spellburst: If the spell destroys any minions, summon them.
flavor: "You wish to know my secrets, hmm? I carry little bits of tuna in the sleeves of my robe, he loves that. Oh, you meant the risen dead? That was trivial, trivial."

name: Transfer Student
text: This has different effects based on which game board you're on.
flavor: Oh, the places you'll go! There is so much to fight! There are boards to be explored. There are dreams to take flight.

name: Onyx Magescribe
text: Spellburst: Add 2 random spells from your class to your hand.
flavor: Sometimes you gotta spend spells to earn spells.

name: Intrepid Initiate
text: Spellburst: Gain +2 Attack.
flavor: How you like them apples?

name: Crimson Hothead
text: Spellburst: Gain +1 Attack and Taunt.
flavor: Has a real passion for spelling.

name: Draconic Studies
text: Discover a Dragon. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: Our Draconic Studies program has a high rate of burnout.

name: Shifty Sophomore
text: Stealth Spellburst: Add a Combo card to your hand.
flavor: Experienced enough to do crimes, inexperienced enough to be super obvious about it.

name: Devolving Missiles
text: Shoot three missiles at random enemy minions that transform them into ones that cost (1) less.
flavor: Most intermural spell-dueling contests end with a field of wisps.

name: Diligent Notetaker
text: Spellburst: Return the spell to your hand.
flavor: You never know what cards are going to be on the test.

name: Athletic Studies
text: Discover a Rush minion. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: It's a quick read.

name: Reaper's Scythe
text: Spellburst: Also damages adjacent minions this turn.
flavor: Die. Die. Die.

name: Krolusk Barkstripper
text: Spellburst: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: My friend went krolusk tipping once… once!

name: Firebrand
text: Spellburst: Deal 4 damage randomly split among all enemy minions.
flavor: Too cool for school, too hot for thought.

name: Gibberling
text: Spellburst: Summon a Gibberling.
flavor: "As a Linguistics student I have studied the Gibberlings. I have determined they are speaking Gibberish."

name: Wyrm Weaver
text: Spellburst: Summon two 1/3 Mana Wyrms.
flavor: Studied basket weaving as an undergrad.

name: Lab Partner
text: Spell Damage +1
flavor: "Professor, a gnome burned my homework!"

name: Teacher's Pet
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a random 3-Cost Beast.
flavor: Really goes the extra mile to get the Hay+.

name: Steward of Scrolls
text: Spell Damage +1 Battlecry: Discover a spell.
flavor: Oh dang it, I spilled ink elemental all over my essay!

name: Animated Broomstick
text: Rush Battlecry: Give your other minions Rush.
flavor: "Blimey, that's a Stratocumulus 1000!"

name: Tour Guide
text: Battlecry: Your next Hero Power costs (0).
flavor: "Here is the original blueprint for the Academy grounds! Don't mind those so-called dark chambers… They'll be at the end of the tour."

name: Wretched Tutor
text: Spellburst: Deal 2 damage to all other minions.
flavor: "If you like my tutoring, you'll love my sister the art therapist, my father the driver, and my mother the housekeeper."

name: First Day of School
text: Add 2 random 1-Cost minions to your hand.
flavor: "Report to the bookstore to buy your books, the alchemist to buy your potions, and then get your wands at the… wandryroom?"

name: Pen Flinger
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a minion. Spellburst: Return this to your hand.
flavor: The pen is also a more aerodynamic short-range projectile than the sword.

name: Wave of Apathy
text: Set the Attack of all enemy minions to 1 until your next turn.
flavor: "Flavor text? Eh. Can’t be bothered."

name: Marrowslicer
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 2 Soul Fragments into your deck.
flavor: Perfect for killing the first boss in Icecrown Citadel.

name: Cycle of Hatred
text: Deal 3 damage to all minions. Summon a 3/3 Spirit for every minion killed.
flavor: If you run 2 of these, would that make it the bi-cycle of hatred?

name: Playmaker
text: After you play a Rush minion, summon a copy with 1 Health remaining.
flavor: "Here's the plan: you go left, I go right, and the wounded guy takes the hit."

name: Sphere of Sapience
text: At the start of your turn, look at your top card. You can put it on the bottom and lose 1 Durability.
flavor: This is what it sounds like when spheres scry.

name: Nature Studies
text: Discover a spell. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: "I have a first edition! Go ahead, count the rings."

name: Instructor Fireheart
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell that costs (1) or more. If you play it this turn, repeat this effect.
flavor: When you have fire in your heart, even death can't stop you.

name: Wolpertinger
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: Scholomance student Brewfest prank gone awry.

name: Troublemaker
text: At the end of your turn, summon two 3/3 Ruffians that attack random enemies.
flavor: "Prepare for trouble!" "Make it double!"

name: Bloated Python
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 4/4 Hapless Handler.
flavor: This is why Scholomance engineering students prefer C++.

name: Void Drinker
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Destroy a Soul Fragment in your deck to gain +3/+3.
flavor: It has no taste.

name: Brain Freeze
text: Freeze a minion. Combo: Also deal 3 damage to it.
flavor: "The professor called on me, and I totally froze!"

name: Primordial Studies
text: Discover a Spell Damage minion. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: A long forgotten tome whose very essence seeps of magic. 40 dust, used.

name: Molten Blast
text: Deal 2 damage. Summon that many 1/1 Elementals.
flavor: Well, how would YOU celebrate after finals week?!

name: Ras Frostwhisper
text: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all enemies (improved by Spell Damage).
flavor: Always the favorite of Headmaster Kel'Thuzad, Ras nonetheless received a chilly reception from the other faculty.

name: Initiation
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. If it dies, summon a new copy.
flavor: The things a murloc's gotta go through to graduate from Scholomance…

name: Brittlebone Destroyer
text: Battlecry: If your hero's Health changed this turn, destroy a minion.
flavor: Broke many a leg in drama class.

name: Raise Dead
text: Deal 3 damage to your hero. Return two friendly minions that died this game to your hand.
flavor: Technically, it’s just really late healing.

name: Magehunter
text: Rush Whenever this attacks a minion, Silence it.
flavor: Hates waiting. Abhors chit chat. Fond of the color purple.

name: Trueaim Crescent
text: After your Hero attacks a minion, your minions attack it too.
flavor: You could have just pointed.

name: Archwitch Willow
text: Battlecry: Summon a random Demon from your hand and deck.
flavor: One of the demons will do all the work while the other gets the same grade.

name: Speaker Gidra
text: Rush, Windfury Spellburst: Gain Attack and Health equal to the spell's Cost.
flavor: If a teacher lectures in a forest, does she even make a sound?

name: Manafeeder Panthara
text: Battlecry: If you've used your Hero Power this turn, draw a card.
flavor: Feeds on mana, crystal kibble, and whatever it was you were just snacking on.

name: Shadowlight Scholar
text: Battlecry: Destroy a Soul Fragment in your deck to deal 3 damage.
flavor: Imagine having the power of soul magic and using it as a reading light.

name: Demon Companion
text: Summon a random Demon Companion.
flavor: Owning a pet can be real hell at times.

name: Star Student Stelina
text: Outcast: Look at 3 cards in your opponent's hand. Shuffle one of them into their deck.
flavor: Cheating is just using your resources wisely.

name: Vulpera Toxinblade
text: Your weapon has +2 Attack.
flavor: The blade works well enough on its own… but this is just in case.

name: Coerce
text: Destroy a damaged minion. Combo: Destroy any minion.
flavor: "Give me your lunch money, or the sandwich gets it!"

name: Steeldancer
text: Battlecry: Summon a random minion with Cost equal to your weapon's Attack.
flavor: Pretty powerful if you blade your cards right.

name: Ceremonial Maul
text: Spellburst: Summon a Student with Taunt and stats equal to the spell's Cost.
flavor: For the most discerning of hall monitors.

name: Shield of Honor
text: Give a damaged minion +3 Attack and Divine Shield.
flavor: "Sir, this shield would've been more helpful last turn!"

name: In Formation!
text: Add 2 random Taunt minions to your hand.
flavor: None can doubt the strength of the Scholomance student body.

name: Lord Barov
text: Battlecry: Set the Health of all other minions to 1. Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: Alexei Barov stayed at Scholomance despite leasing it to Kel’Thuzad. He says it’s for "supervision."

name: Overwhelm
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Deal one more damage for each Beast you control.
flavor: Scholomance student Brewfest prank gone terribly, terribly awry.

name: Survival of the Fittest
text: Give +4/+4 to all minions in your hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: Sometimes the fittest is the one smart enough to not start a fight with seven 6/6 Treants.

name: Lake Thresher
text: Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: "There’s a monster in the lake?!" "That’s not a monster, that’s Gary."

name: Partner Assignment
text: Add a random 2-Cost and 3-Cost Beast to your hand.
flavor: In every group assignment, someone does all the legwork.

name: Shan'do Wildclaw
text: Choose One - Give Beasts in your deck +1/+1; or Transform into a copy of a friendly Beast.
flavor: She holds both an academic post and a scratching post.

name: Guardian Animals
text: Summon two Beasts that cost (5) or less from your deck. Give them Rush.
flavor: The guidelines specifically state: "Students may also bring an ironbeak owl OR an alleycat OR a toad." They never said how big.

name: Combustion
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Any excess damages both neighbors.
flavor: Sally is friends with three Silverhand Recruits conveniently standing in a line. After casting this spell, how many friends does she have left? (Show your work.)

name: Runic Carvings
text: Choose One - Summon four 2/2 Treant Totems; or Overload: (2) to summon them with Rush.
flavor: "That totem was beautiful… and you runed it!"

name: Groundskeeper
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, restore 5 Health.
flavor: It’s tricky for dryads to tend the garden without trampling the flowers.

name: Forest Warden Omu
text: Spellburst: Refresh your Mana Crystals.
flavor: She wishes all things could grow and flourish at Scholomance. If only she knew…

name: Wand Thief
text: Combo: Discover a Mage spell.
flavor: "What’re ya buyin’?”

name: Totem Goliath
text: Deathrattle: Summon all four basic Totems. Overload: (1)
flavor: It was an art project, and nobody knew when to stop.

name: Turalyon, the Tenured
text: Rush. Whenever this attacks a minion, set the defender's Attack and Health to 3.
flavor: "Let evil flee before righteousness; let the innocent live in peace. Let the day come when none need fear. For that day, I give my life gladly."

name: Power Word: Feast
text: Give a minion +2/+2. Restore it to full Health at the end of this turn.
flavor: Some people are here for the stellar, world-renowned academic program. Others are here for the buffet.

name: Sorcerous Substitute
text: Battlecry: If you have Spell Damage, summon a copy of this.
flavor: This substitute's substitution is a dangerous institution.

name: Frazzled Freshman
flavor: "Late to bed, early to rise, makes a student unable to open her eyes."

name: Blessing of Authority
text: Give a minion +8/+8. It can't attack heroes this turn.
flavor: A paladin fights with honor! We don't go face... until next turn!

name: Devout Pupil
text: Divine Shield, Taunt Costs (1) less for each spell you've cast on friendly characters this game.
flavor: He considers textbooks Light reading.

name: Flesh Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each time your hero's Health changed during your turns.
flavor: "A BIG mistake."

name: High Abbess Alura
text: Spellburst: Cast a spell from your deck (targets this if possible).
flavor: She's all about hitting the books. Literally.

name: Voracious Reader
