text: At the end of your turn, draw until you have 3 cards.
flavor: But how much of it is skimming?

name: Goody Two-Shields
text: Divine Shield Spellburst: Gain Divine Shield.
flavor: These are my shields. There are at least two like them, and both are mine.

name: Divine Rager
text: Divine Shield
flavor: For when you need to rage, rage against the dying of the Light.

name: Desk Imp
flavor: "I feel inky!"

name: Robes of Protection
text: Your minions have Elusive.
flavor: Warning: Robes of Protection are intended for targeted effects only and are not an effective defense against Flamestrike, Twisting Nether, or other AOE attacks.

name: Commencement
text: Summon a minion from your deck. Give it Taunt and Divine Shield.
flavor: "Remember, graduates—you carry a heavy weight on your shoulders now."

name: Boneweb Egg
text: Deathrattle: Summon two 2/1 Spiders. If you discard this, trigger its Deathrattle.
flavor: Noblegarden is going to be really exciting this year!

name: Double Jump
text: Draw an Outcast card from your deck.
flavor: The key to every speed run.

name: Jandice Barov
text: Battlecry: Summon two random 5-Cost minions. Secretly pick one that dies when it takes damage.
flavor: Her parents own Scholomance. Of course she's going to play tricks on the students!

name: Twilight Runner
text: Stealth Whenever this attacks, draw 2 cards.
flavor: Every morning you find two dead cards at your doorstep.

name: Argent Braggart
text: Battlecry: Set this minion's Attack and Health to the highest in the battlefield.
flavor: Not sure why he's bragging, he's got the same stats as the next guy.

name: Cabal Acolyte
text: Taunt Spellburst: Gain control of a random enemy minion with 2 or less Attack.
flavor: How did he get to the top of his class? He pulled a few strings!

name: Potion of Illusion
text: Add 1/1 copies of your minions to your hand. They cost (1).
flavor: Unfortunately, there's no potion that can make you unsee all the faces in that bottle.

name: Disciplinarian Gandling
text: After you play a minion, destroy it and summon a 4/4 Failed Student.
flavor: "He doesn’t grade on a curve, but on a sharp spike instead."

name: Enchanted Cauldron
text: Spellburst: Cast a random spell of the same Cost.
flavor: Do you smell what the cauldron is cooking? If so, we apologize.

name: Demonic Studies
text: Discover a Demon. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: "Do you wanna summon a demon? I wanna summon a demon!"

name: Cram Session
text: Draw 1 cards (improved by Spell Damage).
flavor: The font of the arcane gives nearly limitless access to power and energy! But it can't keep you awake, for that we still use coffee.

name: Mindrender Illucia
text: Battlecry: Replace your hand with a copy of your opponent's until end of turn.
flavor: "…and that's how I ended up with a Murloc Cultural Studies major."

name: Wandmaker
text: Battlecry: Add a 1-Cost spell from your class to your hand.
flavor: She creates incredibly affordable wands of all shapes and sizes. But not owls. The owl is all-natural.

name: Vectus
text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Whelps. Each gains a Deathrattle from your minions that died this game.
flavor: Don’t let that dark magic worry you. He’ll ensure they hatch without a scratch.

name: Doctor Krastinov
text: Rush Whenever this attacks, give your weapon +1/+1.
flavor: He is not a medical doctor.

name: Infiltrator Lilian
text: Stealth Deathrattle: Summon a 4/2 Forsaken Lilian that attacks a random enemy.
flavor: She'll get to the bottom of this even if it kills her. Twice!

name: Tidal Wave
text: Lifesteal Deal 3 damage to all minions.
flavor: "Hang Four, mon!"

name: Trick Totem
text: At the end of your turn, cast a random spell that costs (3) or less.
flavor: It knows how to sit still and do tricks. Still working on rolling over, though.

name: Adorable Infestation
text: Give a minion +1/+1. Summon a 1/1 Cub. Add a Cub to your hand.
flavor: Some cards are strong by sheer power; others draw strength from love.

name: Wrathscale Naga
text: After a friendly minion dies, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: If throwing glaives is what you crave; summon tokens and make 'em broken.

name: Blood Herald
text: Whenever a friendly minion dies while this is in your hand, gain +1/+1.
flavor: "Red Blood, it gives you wings."

name: Spirit Jailer
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 2 Soul Fragments into your deck.
flavor: "Sure, they're in your deck, but the mind is like, the REAL prison."

name: Soul Shear
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Shuffle 2 Soul Fragments into your deck.
flavor: "Just a little off the sides please."

name: Felosophy
text: Copy the lowest Cost Demon in your hand. Outcast: Give both +1/+1.
flavor: "Like, isn't evil subjective man?"

name: Soulciologist Malicia
text: Battlecry: For each Soul Fragment in your deck, summon a 3/3 Soul with Rush.
flavor: If you value your life, don't call it a "soft science."

name: Soulshard Lapidary
text: Battlecry: Destroy a Soul Fragment in your deck to give your hero +5 Attack this turn.
flavor: Also known as a soul sequincer.

name: Vilefiend Trainer
text: Outcast: Summon two 1/1 Demons.
flavor: My Vilefiend Trainers give me a much better sprint than my Air Gul'dans.

name: Fel Summoner
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random Demon from your hand.
flavor: All's well that ends fel when the fel summoner summons well.

name: Wrathspike Brute
text: Taunt After this is attacked, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: You scratch her back, her back scratches back.

name: Inner Demon
text: Give your hero +8 Attack this turn.
flavor: Critical component of any tragic backstory.

name: Immolation Aura
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions twice.
flavor: If you can't take the heat, stop standing in the fire.

name: Plagiarize
text: Secret: At the end of your opponent's turn, add copies of the cards they played to your hand.
flavor: Copying is just using your resources wisely.

name: Fishy Flyer
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Add a 4/3 Ghost with Rush to your hand.
flavor: Like a fish out of water.

name: Sneaky Delinquent
text: Stealth. Deathrattle: Add a 3/1 Ghost with Stealth to your hand.
flavor: All right, now open your lid and say "Ahh!"

name: Smug Senior
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Add a 5/7 Ghost with Taunt to your hand.
flavor: You want to see something funny? Go visit him in five years.

name: Ogremancer
text: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, summon a 2/2 Skeleton with Taunt.
flavor: After their third attempt, Tharg began to suspect that Krul was summoning the skeletons on purpose.

name: Rattlegore
text: Deathrattle: Resummon this with -1/-1.
flavor: He looks bad now, but he was pretty handsome in his 20/20s.

name: Plagued Protodrake
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random 7-Cost minion.
flavor: "What’s in the drake?! WHAT’S IN THE DRAKE?"

name: Judicious Junior
text: Lifesteal
flavor: She's judge, jury, and junior!

name: Self-Sharpening Sword
text: After your hero attacks, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: You no longer have to bring a stack of 2 swords to a test!

name: Ace Hunter Kreen
text: Your other characters are Immune while attacking.
flavor: This grandmaster marksman loves winning tournaments and eating a bit of ice cream.

name: Professor Slate
text: Your spells are Poisonous.
flavor: "Don’t worry, this will be over in a second. It might FEEL like an eternity, but I assure you, it’s quite quick!"

name: Lightning Bloom
text: Refresh 2 Mana Crystals. Overload: (2)
flavor: Curiously, this plant never blooms in the same place twice.

name: Cutting Class
text: Draw 2 cards. Costs (1) less per Attack of your weapon.
flavor: When you actually are the sharpest tool in the shed.

name: Cult Neophyte
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's spells cost (1) more next turn.
flavor: Make a new recruit's deficiencies your efficiencies.

name: Psychic Conjurer
text: Battlecry: Copy a card in your opponent’s deck and add it to your hand.
flavor: "I see... a WISP? Why do you have a wisp?!"

name: Power Infusion
text: Give a minion +2/+6.
flavor: It infuses, it enthuses, it amuses!

name: Kul Tiran Chaplain
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion +2 Health.
flavor: The maritime Kul Tiran clergy are unique among priests for using holy saltwater.

name: Scarlet Subjugator
text: Battlecry: Give an enemy minion -2 Attack until your next turn.
flavor: At the Scarlet Monastery, he learned the sacred art of kicking people when they're up.

name: Shadow Word: Ruin
text: Destroy all minions with 5 or more Attack.
flavor: Discovered by a worgen priest after a giant spilled a drink on her new white robes.

name: Natalie Seline
text: Battlecry: Destroy a minion and gain its Health.
flavor: She discovered Xal'atath, Blade of the Black Empire, a terrible weapon of shadow magic that could both swallow a soul and cut a mean julienne.

name: Educated Elekk
text: Whenever a spell is played, this minion remembers it. Deathrattle: Shuffle the spells into your deck.
flavor: "This reminds me of a saying. 'An elekk never…' something. I can't remember."

name: Ancient Void Hound
text: At the end of your turn, steal 1 Attack and Health from all enemy minions.
flavor: What happened to my 1/1 Void Pup? And the glee club?!

name: Shardshatter Mystic
text: Battlecry: Destroy a Soul Fragment in your deck to deal 3 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Enjoys a good soul-crushing defeat.

name: Glide
text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw 4 cards. Outcast: Your opponent does the same.
flavor: "Come with me, and you'll see, a whole new hand of possibly the same cards."

name: Fel Guardians
text: Summon three 1/2 Demons with Taunt. Costs (1) less whenever a friendly minion dies.
flavor: What happened after the guardians tripped? They Fel.

name: Lorekeeper Polkelt
text: Battlecry: Reorder your deck from the highest Cost card to the lowest Cost card.
flavor: quicksort [] = [] quicksort (x:xs) = quicksort small ++ (x: quicksort large) where small = [y | y <- xs, y <= x] large = [y | y <- xs, y > x]

name: Coilfang Warlord
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon a 5/9 Warlord with Taunt.
flavor: Prepare for the staunch conch launch!

name: N'Zoth, God of the Deep
text: Battlecry: Resurrect a friendly minion of each minion type.
flavor: It really just wants to cuddle all the creatures of Azeroth.

name: Yogg-Saron, Master of Fate
text: Battlecry: If you've cast 10 spells this game, spin the Wheel of Yogg-Saron. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Yogg take the wheel!

name: Derailed Coaster
text: Battlecry: Summon a 1/1 Rider with Rush for each minion in your hand.
flavor: So long as it doesn’t kill you, it's considered part of the ride "experience."

name: Rock Rager
text: Taunt
flavor: Still doesn't understand why he can't beat Paper Rager.

name: Carnival Clown
text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon 2 copies of this. Corrupt: Fill your board with copies.
flavor: Send in the clowns!

name: Circus Medic
text: Battlecry: Restore 4 Health. Corrupt: Deal 4 damage instead.
flavor: Just be careful not to mix this with any creepy eyeballs, tentacles, or dark whispers, and you'll be fine in the morning.

name: Line Hopper
text: Your Outcast cards cost (1) less.
flavor: There are two things Demon Hunters know: hopping, and cutting.

name: Relentless Pursuit
text: Give your hero +4 Attack and Immune this turn.
flavor: If you steal a Demon Hunter's corn dog, you'll get what's coming.

name: Felscream Blast
text: Lifesteal. Deal 1 damage to a minion and its neighbors.
flavor: All the souls start running when they see the felscream truck.

name: Redeemed Pariah
text: After you play an Outcast card, gain +1/+1.
flavor: "Look at this stick. Look at it!"

name: Renowned Performer
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Assistants with Taunt.
flavor: Cutting the assistant in half is the easy part.

name: Expendable Performers
text: Summon seven 1/1 Illidari with Rush. If they all die this turn, summon seven more.
flavor: When someone gets injured, it's considered performance art.

name: Throw Glaive
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it dies, add a Temporary copy of this to your hand.
flavor: "No, no, I said SHOW me the glaive!"

name: Bladed Lady
text: Rush Costs (1) if your hero has 6 or more Attack.
flavor: While you were busy learning magic, she studied the blade.

name: Dreadlord's Bite
text: Outcast: Deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: When it gets too dull, it's more of a nibble.

name: Stiltstepper
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. If you play it this turn, give your hero +4 Attack this turn.
flavor: Circus school was tough, sometimes you had to step on people to make it to the top.

name: Il'gynoth
text: Lifesteal Your Lifesteal damages the enemy hero instead of healing you.
flavor: Well, that just sounds like damage with extra steps.

name: Zai, the Incredible
text: Battlecry: Copy the left- and right-most cards in your hand.
flavor: Following this act will be her younger brother, Frank the Mediocre.

name: Foxy Fraud
text: Battlecry: Your next Combo card this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: His other street con involves a druid. He can't pull it off without a plant.

name: Cloak of Shadows
text: Give your hero Stealth until your next turn.
flavor: Only worthy emperors can see the cloak.

name: Shadow Clone
text: Secret: After a minion attacks your hero, summon a copy of it with Stealth.
flavor: "You thought you were attacking face, but it was me! You!"

name: Ticket Master
text: Deathrattle: Shuffle 3 Tickets into your deck. When drawn, summon a 3/3 Plush Bear.
flavor: You can exchange one ticket for a bear or save up thousands for a tacky light-up paperweight!

name: Swindle
text: Draw a spell. Combo: And a minion.
flavor: You know, it's probably just cheaper to find a place that sells the plushie…

name: Grand Empress Shek'zara
text: Battlecry: Discover a card in your deck and draw all copies of it.
flavor: So is a Grand Empress an empress that's grand or an empress's empress?

name: Sweet Tooth
text: Corrupt: Gain +2 Attack and Stealth.
flavor: He's been eyeballing that ice cream cone all day!

name: Malevolent Strike
text: Destroy a minion. Costs (1) less for each card in your deck that didn't start there.
flavor: "I don't know how those got in there, but I'm blaming you two."

name: Prize Plunderer
text: Combo: Deal 1 damage to a minion for each other card you've played this turn.
flavor: But he'll never be able to plunder the prize of a happy childhood.

name: Keymaster Alabaster
text: Whenever your opponent draws a card, add a copy to your hand that costs (1).
flavor: The key to his mastery is a solid stack of backup copies.

name: Confection Cyclone
text: Battlecry: Add two 1/2 Sugar Elementals to your hand.
flavor: "Oh, I thought it was a desert elemental?"

name: Firework Elemental
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Corrupt: Deal 12 instead.
flavor: The brightest spark can still go dark.

name: Game Master
text: The first Secret you play each turn costs (1).
flavor: "You hear the mrgrgls of angry murlocs approaching. Roll initiative!"

name: Mask of C'Thun
text: Deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: Hide in the mask, but it will wear you. Through its gleaming eye, you shall see true.

name: Grand Finale
text: Summon an 8/8 Elemental. Repeat for each Elemental you played last turn.
flavor: Considering all the other hazards at Darkmoon, overindulgent pyrotechnics seem downright pedestrian.

name: Balloon Merchant
text: Battlecry: Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1 Attack and Divine Shield.
flavor: It's a shiny yellow balloon! But it can be popped with a single point of damage.

name: Oh My Yogg!
text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, they instead cast a random one of the same Cost.
flavor: Many wonders lie within, but they are not mere toys when your mind is their plaything.

name: Carnival Barker
text: Whenever you summon a 1-Health minion, give it +1/+2.
flavor: The barking initially confused faire-goers, so he switched to words.

name: Hammer of the Naaru
text: Battlecry: Summon a 6/6 Holy Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: The naaru wasn't using it. It doesn't have arms.

name: Lothraxion the Redeemed
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, after you summon a Silver Hand Recruit, give it Divine Shield.
flavor: So infused with the Light, he has to wear double sleep masks at night.

name: High Exarch Yrel
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, gain Rush, Lifesteal, Taunt, and Divine Shield.
flavor: There can be no neutrality in the fight against darkness.

name: Fire Breather
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all minions except Demons.
flavor: "Phew! That skull has been stuck between my teeth for hours!"

name: Man'ari Mosher
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Demon +3 Attack and Lifesteal this turn.
flavor: "E.T.C. is sooo mainstream. Have you heard of Blight Boar?"

name: Free Admission
text: Draw 2 minions. If they're both Demons, reduce their Costs by (2).
flavor: "Quick, get in before someone sees you, or worse, someone sees me."

name: Midway Maniac
text: Taunt
flavor: Faire owners hate him! Learn his secrets with one simple spell!

name: Revenant Rascal
text: Battlecry: Destroy a Mana Crystal for each player.
flavor: Turns out his face really did get stuck that way.

name: The Nameless One
text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. Become a 4/4 copy of it, then Silence it.
flavor: Used to be called ", the Nameless," but everyone got confused.

name: Day at the Faire
text: Summon 3 Silver Hand Recruits. Corrupt: Summon 5.
flavor: Karl knew he would someday regret that turkey leg.

name: Revolve
text: Transform all minions into random ones with the same Cost.
flavor: "Please don't ride the carousel for thirty minutes after eating. After the carousel eats, I mean."

name: Dunk Tank
text: Deal 4 damage. Corrupt: Then deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: "When I said bring a tank to the dungeon, this is not what I had in mind!"

name: Stormstrike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Give your hero +3 Attack this turn.
flavor: When your phone is at 5%.

name: Pit Master
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/2 Duelist. Corrupt: Summon two.
flavor: If you win your duel, he'll throw in some of his famous Pit Master barbecue.

name: Cagematch Custodian
text: Battlecry: Draw a weapon.
flavor: Cleans up after a dust up.

name: Whack-A-Gnoll Hammer
text: After your hero attacks, give a random friendly minion +1/+1.
flavor: Hogger's most hated attraction.

name: Deathmatch Pavilion
text: Summon a 3/2 Duelist. If your hero attacked this turn, summon another.
flavor: Worth it for the stuffed toy at the end.

name: Magicfin
text: After a friendly Murloc dies, add a random Legendary minion to your hand.
flavor: The best part is when he pulls Deathwing out of a top hat!

name: Inara Stormcrash
text: On your turn, your hero has +2 Attack and Windfury.
flavor: A fan favorite, Inara is always met with thunderous applause.

name: Parade Leader
text: After you summon a Rush minion, give it +2 Attack.
flavor: He's always going to reign on his parade.

name: Sword Eater
text: Taunt Battlecry: Equip a 3/2 Sword.
flavor: How tough is he? He eats swords for breakfast! Without any milk.

name: Minefield
text: Deal 5 damage randomly split among all minions.
flavor: Dodge bombs like you're playing Tonksweeper!

name: Bumper Car
text: Rush Deathrattle: Add two 1/1 Riders with Rush to your hand.
flavor: Subject: Re: Unsafe Rides? bump

name: Ringmaster's Baton
text: After your hero attacks, give a Mech, Dragon, and Pirate in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: A mech, a dragon, and a pirate walk into an Old God's gaping maw. The mech was too crunchy, the dragon was too hot, but the pirate was just right.

name: Ringmaster Whatley
text: Battlecry: Draw a Mech, Dragon, and Pirate.
flavor: His main qualification is that he'll work with anyone. Or anything.

name: Stage Dive
text: Draw a Rush minion. Corrupt: Give it +2/+1.
flavor: The most metal trust fall.

name: Tent Trasher
text: Rush. Costs (1) less for each friendly minion with a unique minion type.
flavor: "I consider it redecorating."

name: Cascading Disaster
text: Destroy a random enemy minion. Corrupt: Destroy 2. Corrupt Again: Destroy 3.
flavor: Please keep all hands, arms, feet and legs inside the ride until the monster comes to a complete stop.

name: E.T.C., God of Metal
text: After a friendly Rush minion attacks, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: There are Old Gods and then there are Rock Gods.

name: Feat of Strength
text: Give a random Taunt minion in your hand +5/+5.
flavor: Generally happens right after the airing of grievances.

name: Fairground Fool
text: Taunt Corrupt: Gain +4 Health.
flavor: "What did Illidan say when his rocketeer broke down on the Darkmoon racetrack? YOU ARE NOT REPAIRED!"

name: Insatiable Felhound
text: Taunt Corrupt: Gain +1/+1 and Lifesteal.
flavor: Back-to-back winner of the annual hot dog eating contest... and the judge-eating contest.

name: Felsteel Executioner
text: Corrupt: Become a weapon.
flavor: "My mom said I could be anything I want."

name: Acrobatics
text: Draw 2 cards. If you play both this turn, draw 2 more.
flavor: He soars through the air with the greatest of fleas.

name: Palm Reading
text: Discover a spell. Reduce the Cost of spells in your hand by (1).
flavor: Actual palms not required.

name: Auspicious Spirits
text: Summon a random 4-Cost minion. Corrupt: Summon a 7-Cost minion instead.
flavor: "I'm not AWE-spicious, but I am a little spicious."

name: Ring Toss
text: Discover a Secret and cast it. Corrupt: Discover 2 instead.
flavor: If you liked it, then you shoulda put a ring on it!

name: Costumed Entertainer
text: Battlecry: Give a random minion in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: Just remember not to talk. It breaks character.

name: Fantastic Firebird
text: Windfury
flavor: The original flaming chicken.

name: Showstopper
text: Deathrattle: Silence all minions.
flavor: This act is killing it!

name: Redscale Dragontamer
text: Deathrattle: Draw a Dragon.
flavor: Sir Finley made this look a lot easier three expansions ago...

name: Snack Run
text: Discover a spell. Restore Health to your hero equal to its Cost.
flavor: "I'll have two monster churros, a combo box of Yogg-Saron, and one of those turkey legs that ate the Silver Hand Recruit."

name: Y'Shaarj, the Defiler
text: Battlecry: Add a copy of each Corrupted card you've played this game to your hand. They cost (0) this turn.
flavor: Y'Shaarj made an excellent office intern, doing the copying AND defiling.

name: Stage Hand
text: Battlecry: Give a random minion in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Holds everything himself because people wouldn't stop touching the prop table.

name: Circus Amalgam
text: Taunt This has all minion types.
flavor: Who needs a petting zoo when you have all the creatures right here?!

name: Blood of G'huun
text: Taunt At the end of your turn, summon a 5/5 copy of a minion in your deck.
flavor: An attempted cure becomes disease, blooming and thriving as rot and decay.

name: Insight
text: Draw a minion. Corrupt: Reduce its Cost by (2).
flavor: Shouldn't the eyes be facing backwards for insight?

name: Idol of Y'Shaarj
text: Summon a 10/10 copy of a minion in your deck.
flavor: Without a tongue, it speaks in seven. Without a voice, its echo lingers forever.

name: G'huun the Blood God
text: Battlecry: Draw 2 cards. They cost Health instead of Mana.
flavor: All of the other Old Gods used to laugh and call him names. They never let poor G'huun join in any Old God games.

name: Lunar Eclipse
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Your next spell this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: When the Azeroth is between the Sun and the Moon.

name: Solar Eclipse
text: The next spell you cast this turn casts twice.
flavor: When the Moon is between the Sun and the Azeroth.

name: Fizzy Elemental
text: Rush Taunt
flavor: Loved. Hated. Carbonated.

name: Umbral Owl
text: Rush Costs (1) less for each spell you've cast this game.
flavor: It sleeps with one eye open.

name: Faire Arborist
text: Choose One - Draw a card; or Summon a 2/2 Treant. Corrupt: Do both.
flavor: The bad apple never falls far from the treant.

name: C'Thun, the Shattered
text: Start of Game: Break into pieces. Battlecry: Deal 30 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: My grandfather's deck has no useless cards!

name: Gyreworm
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, deal 3 damage.
flavor: This game of ring toss just got really intense.

name: Carousel Gryphon
text: Divine Shield Corrupt: Gain +3/+3 and Taunt.
flavor: "When does this bird land in Stormwind? I've been flying for hours!"

name: Occult Conjurer
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, summon a copy of this.
flavor: Like mirror image, but more secretive and angsty.

name: Rigged Faire Game
text: Secret: If you didn't take any damage during your opponent's turn, draw 3 cards.
flavor: What's faire is fair.

name: Deck of Lunacy
text: Transform spells in your deck into ones that cost (3) more. (They keep their original Cost.)
flavor: Voted "Most Lunacy" in Madness Monthly magazine.

name: Sayge, Seer of Darkmoon
text: Battlecry: Draw 1 card. (Upgraded for each friendly Secret that has triggered this game!)
flavor: There are no secrets between us... or refunds.

name: Moontouched Amulet
text: Give your hero +4 Attack this turn. Corrupt: And gain 6 Armor.
flavor: The Suntouched Amulet melted.

name: Cenarion Ward
text: Gain 8 Armor. Summon a random 8-Cost minion.
flavor: Don't ask about his right hand. He's still growing into it.

name: Kiri, Chosen of Elune
text: Battlecry: Add a Solar Eclipse and Lunar Eclipse to your hand.
flavor: Now, when the Sun is between the Moon and the Azeroth... that's when you've got a problem.

name: Greybough
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion "Deathrattle: Summon Greybough."
flavor: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The next best time is when you lose a minion.

name: Banana Vendor
text: Battlecry: Add 2 Bananas to each player's hand.
flavor: There's always money in the banana stand.

name: Knife Vendor
text: Battlecry: Deal 4 damage to each hero.
flavor: "They're perfectly safe! These gloves totally aren't hiding any bandages."

name: Prize Vendor
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Each player draws a card.
flavor: He's just making sure they're real. Authentic tickets taste like strawberry.

name: Optimistic Ogre
text: 50% chance to attack the correct enemy.
flavor: "What if this goes wrong?" "But what if this goes right?"

name: Claw Machine
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Draw a minion and give it +3/+3.
flavor: "I have been mrglrlglr… chosen!"

name: Darkmoon Rabbit
text: Rush, Poisonous Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: That's no ordinary rabbit! That's the most foul, cruel, and bad-tempered rodent you ever set eyes on!

name: Tenwu of the Red Smoke
text: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion to your hand. It costs (1) this turn.
flavor: Red, the color of subtlety.

name: Darkmoon Dirigible
text: Divine Shield Corrupt: Gain Rush.
flavor: "It's dirigible? I don’t even know what diriging is!"

name: Silas Darkmoon
text: Battlecry: Choose a direction to rotate all minions.
flavor: "You might remember me from such attractions as 'Being Shot out of a Cannon' or 'That Carousel Ate My Friend.'"

name: Nazmani Bloodweaver
text: After you cast a spell, reduce the Cost of a random card in your hand by (1).
flavor: Her first stage name, Ketchupweaver, failed to excite the audience.

name: Fortune Teller
text: Taunt Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each spell in your hand.
flavor: "I see a giant piano in your future."

name: Tickatus
text: Battlecry: Remove the top 5 cards from your deck. Corrupt: Your opponent's deck instead.
flavor: "These are all.... EXPIRED!"

name: Wicked Whispers
text: Discard your lowest Cost card. Give your minions +1/+1.
flavor: When the Old Ones whisper, others will scream.

name: Guess the Weight
text: Draw a card. Guess if your next card costs more or less to draw it.
flavor: "And then at the last second, I'll shapeshift into cat form!"

name: Grand Totem Eys'or
text: At the end of your turn, give +1/+1 to all other Totems in your hand, deck and battlefield.
flavor: Some say it can see straight into the soul of any who dare to read its flavor text...

name: Strongman
text: Taunt Corrupt: This costs (0).
flavor: Sure, it looks impressive until you realize it's a barrel of helium.

name: Inconspicuous Rider
text: Battlecry: Cast a Secret from your deck.
flavor: Improvise, adapt, overcome.

name: Fleethoof Pearltusk
text: Rush Corrupt: Gain +4/+4.
flavor: Guest interactions may vary over the duration of the visit.

name: K'thir Ritualist
text: Taunt Battlecry: Add a random 4-Cost minion to your opponent's hand.
flavor: Something evil this way comes… and it's bringing friends over!

name: Darkmoon Statue
text: Your other minions have +1 Attack. Corrupt: This gains +4 Attack.
flavor: As far as workplace injuries go, Silas is protected by his statue of limitations.

name: Dancing Cobra
text: Corrupt: Gain Poisonous.
flavor: Snakes are just tentacles with fangs.

name: Mystery Winner
text: Battlecry: Discover a Secret.
flavor: Yeah, but the mystery prize could be anything! Even a boat!

name: Open the Cages
text: Secret: When your turn starts, if you control two minions, summon an Animal Companion.
flavor: "Coming out of my cage, and I'm dead by turn nine..."

name: Horrendous Growth
text: Corrupt: Gain +1/+1. Can be Corrupted endlessly.
flavor: Stop picking at it! You’re only making it worse.

name: Jewel of N'Zoth
text: Summon three friendly Deathrattle minions that died this game.
flavor: This coveted gem calls for you to free it… and unleash an inescapable prison.

name: Darkmoon Tonk
text: Deathrattle: Fire four missiles at random enemies that deal 2 damage each.
flavor: "Ready to roll out!"

name: Petting Zoo
text: Summon a 3/3 Strider. Repeat for each Secret you control.
flavor: Welcome to the petting zoo. DO NOT TOUCH THE ANIMALS.

name: Trampling Rhino
text: Rush. After this attacks and kills a minion, excess damage hits the enemy hero.
flavor: "Whew. I thought you said 'Trampoline Rhino.' Now that would have been scary."

name: Rinling's Rifle
text: After your hero attacks, Discover a Secret and cast it.
flavor: This rifle needs a muzzle for its muzzle.

name: Maxima Blastenheimer
text: Battlecry: Summon a minion from your deck. It attacks the enemy hero, then dies.
flavor: Believe it or not, this is only the faire's fourth most dangerous game.

name: Don't Feed the Animals
text: Give all Beasts in your hand +1/+1. Corrupt: Give them +2/+2 instead.
flavor: They're still cleaning up the mess from the last time someone fed the basilisk a deep fried candybar.

name: Ring Matron
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon two 3/2 Imps.
flavor: But where does she keep them?

name: Deck of Chaos
text: Swap the Cost and Attack of all minions in your deck.
flavor: Yeah, it's chaos, but it's organized chaos.

name: Wriggling Horror
text: Battlecry: Give adjacent minions +1/+1.
flavor: Created to scare. Born to wriggle.

name: Illidari Studies
text: Discover an Outcast card. Your next one costs (1) less.
flavor: "Don't read texts and drive."

name: Felsaber
text: Can only attack if your hero attacked this turn.
flavor: Some drivers rev their engines. This one growls all on its own.

name: Luckysoul Hoarder
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 2 Soul Fragments into your deck. Corrupt: Draw a card.
flavor: Always brings his own reusable shopping bag, satchel, barrel, trunk, tray, and fluffy pillow.

name: Envoy Rustwix
text: Deathrattle: Shuffle 3 random Prime Legendary minions into your deck.
flavor: "Time to roll. Rusted Legion, ho!"

name: Barricade
text: Summon a 2/4 Guard with Taunt. If it's your only minion, summon another.
flavor: The Alliance and Horde join forces to enforce the fire safety capacity.

name: Hysteria
text: Choose an enemy minion. It attacks random minions until it dies.
flavor: "My mount and I share a special connection. Just not a good one."

name: Dark Inquisitor Xanesh
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of all Corrupt and Corrupted cards in your hand and deck by (2).
flavor: Fear is the mind-killer, and also the name of my wurm.

name: Lightsteed
text: Your healing effects also give affected minions +2 Health.
flavor: All the steed, half the calories.

name: Rally!
text: Resurrect a friendly 1-Cost, 2-Cost, and 3-Cost minion.
flavor: One for the squire, two for the gnome, three for the glory, and GO, GO, GO!

name: Imprisoned Celestial
text: Dormant for 2 turns. Spellburst: Give your minions Divine Shield.
flavor: "Look at your deck, now back to me, now back at your deck, now back to me. Who am I? None of your—I'm on a horse."

name: Libram of Judgment
text: Corrupt: Gain Lifesteal.
flavor: You really can't judge a book by its cover.

name: Deathwarden
text: Deathrattles can't trigger.
flavor: Ride or die takes on a new meaning.

name: Spiked Wheel
text: Has +3 Attack while your hero has Armor.
flavor: Great for driving, terrible for steering.

name: Ironclad
text: Battlecry: If your hero has Armor, gain +2/+2.
flavor: With one inch of clearance, Ironclad proved ineffective against speedbumps.

name: Nitroboost Poison
text: Give a minion +2 Attack. Corrupt: And your weapon.
flavor: Pouring iced milk into your vehicle's fuel tank does NOT provide a Nitro boost, but it does go great with your victory cookies.

name: Sparkjoy Cheat
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Secret, cast it and draw a card.
flavor: "These do NOT spark joy!"

name: Shenanigans
text: Secret: When your opponent draws their second card in a turn, transform it into a Banana.
flavor: It's not personal, it's just monkey business.

name: Keywarden Ivory
text: Battlecry: Discover a Dual Class spell from any class. Spellburst: Get another copy.
flavor: She learned exactly one thing from her old man: copying.

name: Conjure Mana Biscuit
text: Add a Biscuit to your hand that refreshes 2 Mana Crystals.
flavor: So THIS is why she was AFK.

name: Glacier Racer
text: Spellburst: Deal 3 damage to all Frozen enemies.
flavor: It’s just not the same without a super suit.

name: Imprisoned Phoenix
text: Dormant for 2 turns. Spell Damage +2
flavor: It's actually pretty easy to escape chains when you can burst into flames.

name: Mistrunner
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion +3/+3. Overload: (1)
flavor: "Get IT off me!!!"

name: Landslide
text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions. If you're Overloaded, deal 1 damage again.
flavor: "And they win it by a landslide! Wait, where did all the other racers go?"

name: Guidance
text: Look at two spells. Add one to your hand or Overload: (1) to get both.
flavor: Plainsrunning will result in disqualification.

name: Dreaming Drake
text: Taunt Corrupt: Gain +2/+2.
flavor: Some dragons dream of conquering Azeroth, some just dream of being 5/6s.

name: Arbor Up
text: Summon two 2/2 Treants. Give your minions +2/+1.
flavor: If you can’t outrun a tree, you really shouldn’t be here anyway.

name: Bola Shot
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion and 2 damage to its neighbors.
flavor: On second thought, bolas aren't very good against flying worms.

name: Saddlemaster
text: After you play a Beast, add a random Beast to your hand.
flavor: Seat covers. Check. Racing stripes. Check. Cupholder. Check.

name: Resizing Pouch
text: Discover a card with Cost equal to your remaining Mana Crystals.
flavor: Just don't put a Resizing Pouch inside the Resizing Pouch.

name: Felfire Deadeye
text: Your Hero Power costs (1) less.
flavor: She only shoots people who pet her cat without asking first.

name: Crabrider
text: Rush Windfury
flavor: "Now I'm falling asleep and she's calling a crab…"

name: Armor Vendor
text: Battlecry: Give 4 Armor to each hero.
flavor: "You look like the kind of person that would buy three sets of armor. One to wear, a spare, and a spare for the spare."

name: Backfire
text: Draw 3 cards. Deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: "That's the last time I let an imp spit gasoline into my car."

name: Runaway Blackwing
text: At the end of your turn, deal 10 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: It has been 5 minutes since our last Azeroth Racing League violation.

name: Moonfang
text: Can only take 1 damage at a time.
flavor: Moonforehead just didn't have the same ring to it.

name: Safety Inspector
text: Battlecry: Shuffle the lowest-Cost card from your hand into your deck. Draw a card.
flavor: "All right, you're good. No sign of safety anywhere."

name: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin
text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. Swap it with a random one in its owner's hand.
flavor: You wouldn’t see this swap-meet on the Zandalari Roadshow.

name: Novice Zapper
text: Spell Damage +1 Overload: (1)
flavor: The novices would prefer that he did not.

name: Hog Rancher
text: Battlecry: Summon a 2/1 Hog with Rush.
flavor: Suspiciously close to a Quilboar village.

name: Ratchet Privateer
text: Battlecry: Give your weapon +1 Attack.
flavor: There's a fine line between privateering and pirating. It comes down to tax breaks.

name: Lushwater Murcenary
text: Battlecry: If you control a Murloc, gain +1/+1.
flavor: You can't just switch sides because they have more fish!

name: Lushwater Scout
text: After you summon a Murloc, give it +1 Attack and Rush.
flavor: Only knows how to play "Careless Murgl" and "Mrgl Mrgl Little Star."

name: Talented Arcanist
text: Battlecry: Your next spell this turn has Spell Damage +2.
flavor: "Ey mon, you don't get this good just on raw talent... but it helps."

name: Venomous Scorpid
text: Poisonous Battlecry: Discover a spell.
flavor: Despite what Guff says, he is NOT a "nice little guy."

name: South Coast Chieftain
text: Battlecry: If you control another Murloc, deal 2 damage.
flavor: It got the conch. You let it speak!

name: Injured Marauder
text: Taunt Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to this minion.
flavor: He’ll keep going despite the neighsayers.

name: Gruntled Patron
text: Frenzy: Summon another Gruntled Patron.
flavor: Gruntled and whelmed.

name: Taurajo Brave
text: Frenzy: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: "He's brave, but splinters will make any Tauren cry."

name: Burning Blade Acolyte
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 5/8 Demonspawn with Taunt.
flavor: Wields a disappointingly normal looking blade.

name: Barrens Blacksmith
text: Frenzy: Give your other minions +2/+2.
flavor: "Maybe someday you’ll make it to Gadgetzan, kid."

name: Far Watch Post
text: Can't attack. After your opponent draws a card, it costs (1) more (up to 10).
flavor: Dabu, man. Like, far out.

name: Crossroads Watch Post
text: Can't attack. Whenever your opponent casts a spell, give your minions +1/+1.
flavor: All of Barrens Chat is recorded and kept on thousands of scrolls stored beneath this tower.

name: Mor'shan Watch Post
text: Can't attack. After your opponent plays a minion, summon a 2/2 Grunt.
flavor: Pushing into Ashenvale made this post uneventful.

name: Kargal Battlescar
text: Battlecry: Summon a 5/5 Lookout for each Watch Post you've summoned this game.
flavor: One if by land, two if by tree.

name: Blademaster Samuro
text: Rush Frenzy: Deal damage equal to this minion's Attack to all enemy minions.
flavor: Artists paint their visions meticulously on canvas. Blademasters paint with, uh, broader strokes.

name: Kazakus, Golem Shaper
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no 4-Cost cards, build a custom Golem.
flavor: With a little love and some tenderness, we’ll CRUSH OUR FOES!

name: Razormane Raider
text: Frenzy: Attack a random enemy.
flavor: "Call me hedgehog one more time. I dare you."

name: Gold Road Grunt
text: Taunt Frenzy: Gain Armor equal to the damage taken.
flavor: No, no, no, Gold Roads are very different from Yellow Brick Roads.

name: Peon
text: Frenzy: Add a random spell from your class to your hand.
flavor: Joke's on the peon: the job's never done.

name: Oasis Thrasher
text: Frenzy: Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: Didn't get tickets for E.T.C.'s show.

name: Sunwell Initiate
text: Frenzy: Gain Divine Shield.
flavor: Initiates don’t study pronunciation until level 20.

name: Death's Head Cultist
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Restore 4 Health to your hero.
flavor: Nothing can stop death. Except a Taunt. With Healing.

name: Darkspear Berserker
text: Deathrattle: Deal 5 damage to your hero.
flavor: "If I die, I'm taking my hero down with me."

name: Pack Kodo
text: Battlecry: Discover a Beast, Secret, or weapon.
flavor: He looks simple, but there’s a lot to unpack.

name: Flurry (Rank 1)
text: Freeze a random enemy minion. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Flurry, Flurrier, Flurriest.

name: Sunscale Raptor
text: Frenzy: Shuffle a Sunscale Raptor into your deck with permanent +2/+1.
flavor: And they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming and they don't stop coming and they—

name: Piercing Shot
text: Deal 6 damage to a minion. Excess damage hits the enemy hero.
flavor: Goblins hate wasting money on unnecessary ammunition.

name: Prospector's Caravan
text: At the start of your turn, give all minions in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Prospectors came from all around in the Golden Legendary Rush of '49.

name: Sigil of Flame
text: At the start of your next turn, deal 3 damage to all minions.
flavor: "Huh, it reads F-I-R-E. Wonder what that means?"

name: Void Flayer
text: Battlecry: For each spell in your hand, deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: The Void, just like onions, has flayers.

name: Power Word: Fortitude
text: Give a minion +3/+5. Costs (1) less for each spell in your hand.
flavor: Part of a balanced breakfast.

name: Desperate Prayer
text: Restore 5 Health to each hero.
flavor: Woah, we're halfway there, woah oh...

name: Lightshower Elemental
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Restore 8 Health to all friendly characters.
flavor: The forecast calls for light showers, but you won’t need an umbrella.

name: Devouring Plague
text: Lifesteal. Deal 4 damage randomly split among all enemy minions.
flavor: "How’d we miss this one in Uldum?" —Rafaam

name: Soothsayer's Caravan
text: At the start of your turn, copy a spell from your opponent's deck to your hand.
flavor: With tusks like those, you might call her a "Toothsayer."

name: Priest of An'she
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you've restored Health this turn, gain +3/+3.
flavor: "An’she?" "Bless you!" "No, you, An'she…" "Bless you again!"

name: Condemn (Rank 1)
text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: "I wished you no harm, but for your cruelty, by the light, I condemn you all!" Xyrella shouted, unaware that irony was not her strong suit.

name: Serena Bloodfeather
text: Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion. Steal Attack and Health from it until this has more.
flavor: She’s really into networking! After all, she’s introduced countless low-level Horde players to the Spirit Healer.

name: Oil Rig Ambusher
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage. If this entered your hand this turn, deal 4 instead.
flavor: Days since last accident: 0

name: Field Contact
text: After you play a Battlecry or Combo card, draw a card.
flavor: That's not a knife... THIS is a knife!

name: Silverleaf Poison
text: Give your weapon "After your hero attacks, draw a card."
flavor: Kazakus has taken to a more direct approach in recent times.

name: Wicked Stab (Rank 1)
text: Deal 2 damage. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Always go for the glowing weak point.

name: Efficient Octo-bot
text: Frenzy: Reduce the Cost of cards in your hand by (1).
flavor: Pull the lever, Octo-bot... Wrong leverrrrr!

name: Paralytic Poison
text: Give your weapon +1 Attack and "Your hero is Immune while attacking."
flavor: The hammer is overkill.

name: Swinetusk Shank
text: After you play a Poison, gain +1 Durability.
flavor: Comes with a rack of ribs!

name: Yoink!
text: Discover a Hero Power and set its Cost to (0). Swap back after 2 uses.
flavor: Saying the spell’s name makes it work better.

name: Apothecary Helbrim
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Add a random Poison to your hand.
flavor: The best way to maintain your health is to poison everyone else.

name: Judgment of Justice
text: Secret: When an enemy minion attacks, set its Attack and Health to 1.
flavor: Look, we don't need a jury. We've got a paladin right here!

name: Knight of Anointment
text: Battlecry: Draw a Holy spell.
flavor: "I dub thee... injured."

name: Sword of the Fallen
text: After your hero attacks, cast a Secret from your deck.
flavor: Hoarding secrets is no fun, so play each and every one.

name: Northwatch Commander
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, draw a minion.
flavor: It was all going well until some Horde had the cunning idea of attacking from the south.

name: Veteran Warmedic
text: After you cast a Holy spell, summon a 2/2 Medic with Lifesteal.
flavor: In times of war, warmedics bring their own medics.

name: Conviction (Rank 1)
text: Give a random friendly minion +3 Attack. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: It was the strength of Cariel's faith that emboldened the defenders of Northwatch that day. Although the strength of her giant hammer didn’t exactly hurt either.

name: Cannonmaster Smythe
text: Battlecry: Transform your Secrets into 3/3 Soldiers. They transform back when they die.
flavor: "Smythe, it's been a real blast serving the Alliance with you."

name: Cariel Roame
text: Rush, Divine Shield Whenever this attacks, reduce the Cost of Holy spells in your hand by (1).
flavor: Cariel had pledged her honor to the Alliance, but when someone matching her long-lost sister's description was sighted at the Crossroads, Cariel did the unthinkable: she abandoned her post and set out across the Barrens.

name: Tame Beast (Rank 1)
text: Summon a 2/2 Beast with Rush. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: "Trust me laddie, I never eat seafood!"

name: Kolkar Pack Runner
text: After you cast a spell, summon a 1/1 Hyena with Rush.
flavor: Is he running or galloping?

name: Tavish Stormpike
text: After a friendly Beast attacks, summon a Beast from your deck that costs (1) less.
flavor: "Hurry up, laddie, we're getting overrun! Serpents everywhere! They may look cute, but do ye see the fury in their eyes?!" —Tavish Stormpike

name: Crossroads Gossiper
text: After a friendly Secret is revealed, gain +2/+2.
flavor: Not afraid to spill the tea.

name: Thorngrowth Sentries
text: Summon two 1/2 Turtles with Taunt.
flavor: Maybe we shouldn't drink from this Oasis…

name: Pride's Fury
text: Give your minions +1/+3.
flavor: Day 4: I think they're starting to suspect.

name: Thickhide Kodo
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Gain 5 Armor.
flavor: The introduction of professions was devastating for kodo populations.

name: Living Seed (Rank 1)
text: Draw a Beast. Reduce its Cost by (1). (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Every desert needs an oasis. And it's Guff's duty to make it happen.

name: Razormane Battleguard
text: The first Taunt minion you play each turn costs (2) less.
flavor: Where there's a quill, there's a way.

name: Druid of the Plains
text: Rush Frenzy: Transform into a 6/7 Kodo with Taunt.
flavor: Not to be confused with the aeronautically advanced Druid of the Planes.

name: Celestial Alignment
text: Set your Mana Crystals to 0. Set the Cost of cards in your hand and deck to (1).
flavor: "Is my deck any good?" "I mean, if the stars align."

name: Plaguemaw the Rotting
text: After a friendly minion with Taunt dies, summon a new copy of it without Taunt.
flavor: This is why you should brush your teeth three times a day!

name: Runed Orb
text: Deal 2 damage. Discover a spell.
flavor: The most dangerous Winter Veil ornament.

name: Refreshing Spring Water
text: Draw 2 cards. Refresh 2 Mana Crystals for each spell drawn.
flavor: "Mana" is just another name for "electrolytes."

name: Frostweave Dungeoneer
text: Battlecry: Draw a spell. If it's a Frost spell, summon two 1/1 Elementals that Freeze.
flavor: It's a woven blanket of ice but surprisingly comforting.

name: Reckless Apprentice
text: Battlecry: Fire your Hero Power at all enemies.
flavor: It’s all a great learning experience until someone accidentally aggros the boss.

name: Arcane Luminary
text: Cards that didn't start in your deck cost (2) less (but not less than 1).
flavor: They say true value is the cards you find along the way.

name: Wildfire
text: Your Hero Power deals 1 more damage this game.
flavor: The Barrens were a lush jungle. Then this happened.

name: Mordresh Fire Eye
text: Battlecry: If you've dealt 10 damage with your Hero Power this game, deal 10 damage to all enemies. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: You're not hardcore unless you died hardcore.

name: Chain Lightning (Rank 1)
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion and a random adjacent one. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Still better than receiving a chain letter.

name: Nofin Can Stop Us
text: Give your minions +1/+1. Give your Murlocs an extra +1/+1.
flavor: "I'm having a good time! I don't want to stop at all!"

name: Primordial Protector
text: Battlecry: Draw your highest Cost spell. Summon a random minion with the same Cost.
flavor: I thought the "shape of water" meant something else.

name: Tinyfin's Caravan
text: At the start of your turn, draw a Murloc.
flavor: Movin' right along, mrgl mrg mrgl mrg.

name: Arid Stormer
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, gain Rush and Windfury.
flavor: Some people chase storms, some storms chase elementals.

name: Wailing Vapor
text: After you play an Elemental, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: If you have The Vapors, your Humors might be imbalanced.

name: Bru'kan
text: Nature Spell Damage +3
flavor: Bru'kan, his body weathered and weary, felt his time nearing its end. Teaching brave champions like Rokara gives him hope for a greater future.

name: Invigorating Sermon
text: Give +1/+1 to all minions in your hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: Every underdog sports coach knows this one.

name: Warsong Wrangler
text: Battlecry: Discover a Beast from your deck. Give all copies of it +2/+1 (wherever they are).
flavor: "Me? Playing favorites? I love my beasts all the same!"

name: Perpetual Flame
text: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion. If it dies, recast this. Overload: (1)
flavor: Flame is perpetual.* *Perpetual only applies to current turn.

name: Seedcloud Buckler
text: Deathrattle: Give your minions Divine Shield.
flavor: A shield to some, a frisbee to others (mainly dogs).

name: Party Up!
text: Summon five 2/2 Adventurers with random bonus effects.
flavor: Random? But what if we don't get a tank?

name: Rimetongue
text: After you cast a Frost spell, summon a 1/1 Elemental that Freezes.
flavor: Warriors are red, Frost spells are blue, If you're being hit by a weapon, Rimetongue's got you.

name: Mark of the Spikeshell
text: Give a minion +2/+2. If it has Taunt, add a copy of it to your hand.
flavor: "I'm DEFINITELY turtle-y enough for the turtle club."

name: Warsong Envoy
text: Frenzy: Gain +1 Attack for each damaged character.
flavor: "What do you mean we didn’t give the flag to the Druid?"

name: Outrider's Axe
text: After your hero attacks and kills a minion, draw a card.
flavor: "I only have to get 4 Zhevra hooves? How hard could that be?"

name: Rancor
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. Gain 2 Armor for each destroyed.
flavor: Wise men say "Only fools rush in." Wise Orcs say the opposite.

name: Mor'shan Elite
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, summon a copy of this.
flavor: "Fear not the orc who has slain a million training dummies, but the orc who keeps CAMPING MY CORPSE!"

name: Rokara
text: Rush After a friendly minion attacks and survives, give it +1/+1.
flavor: "Tread carefully, but stand tall, and stand together. For strength and honor!" —Rokara

name: Whirling Combatant
text: Battlecry and Frenzy: Deal 1 damage to all other minions.
flavor: It's called capoeira! And yes, it is dangerous!

name: Conditioning (Rank 1)
text: Give minions in your hand +1/+1. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Now drop and give me 5 Mana.

name: Bulk Up
text: Give a random Taunt minion in your hand +1/+1 and copy it.
flavor: "For breakfast I usually go for a couple of kodo steaks, 5 Plainstrider eggs and an ice-cold milk to wash it down… all raw."

name: Razorboar
text: Deathrattle: Summon a Deathrattle minion that costs (3) or less from your hand.
flavor: And this little pig built his house out of VENGEANCE.

name: Razorfen Beastmaster
text: Deathrattle: Summon a Deathrattle minion that costs (4) or less from your hand.
flavor: It's a homebrew variant on my favorite role-playing game.

name: Vile Call
text: Summon two 2/2 Demons with Lifesteal.
flavor: "We're calling to inform you that your vehicle's insurance is about to expire."

name: Vengeful Spirit
text: Outcast: Draw 2 Deathrattle minions.
flavor: Sheesh, even the spirits are edgy when it comes to Demon Hunters.

name: Death Speaker Blackthorn
text: Battlecry: Summon 3 Deathrattle minions that cost (5) or less from your deck.
flavor: He can speak death but has a hard time reading it.

name: Xyrella
text: Battlecry: If you've restored Health this turn, deal that much damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: On the Night of Falling Stars, Xyrella had a vision of a shattered naaru. "Go to the Barrens," the being said. "Seek the shards of my broken body. Restore me, and I will restore your daughter."

name: Grimoire of Sacrifice
text: Destroy a friendly minion. Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: "What kind of bedtime story is this?"

name: Soul Rend
text: Deal 5 damage to all minions. Destroy a card in your deck for each killed.
flavor: About as close to feeling guilt as a warlock's ever going to get.

name: Apothecary's Caravan
text: At the start of your turn, summon a 1-Cost minion from your deck.
flavor: If you won't bring out your dead, we'll bring the dead to you.

name: Wound Prey
text: Deal 1 damage. Summon a 1/1 Hyena with Rush.
flavor: You steal the cranberry juice, you pay the price.

name: Altar of Fire
text: Destroy the top 3 cards of each deck.
flavor: "I now pronounce you, Crispy and Fried."

name: Kabal Outfitter
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Give another random friendly minion +1/+1.
flavor: Don’t ask her for feathers on your necklace though.

name: Blood Shard Bristleback
text: Lifesteal. Battlecry: If your deck contains 10 or fewer cards, deal 6 damage to a minion.
flavor: I'm bringin' bristle back (Yeah) Those other minions don't know how to act (Yeah) I think it's special how these crystals crack (Yeah) So turn around and I'll give you a smack (Yeah) (Take 'em to the Barrens)

name: Barrens Scavenger
text: Taunt Costs (1) while your deck has 10 or fewer cards.
flavor: When the hundredth centaur dropped, so did her bracers.

name: Tamsin Roame
text: Whenever you cast a Shadow spell that costs (1) or more, add a copy to your hand that costs (0).
flavor: In life, Tamsin Roame was one of the Alliance's most promising mages; now she is the Horde's most dangerous warlock.

name: Neeru Fireblade
text: Battlecry: If your deck is empty, open a portal that fills your board with 3/2 Imps each turn.
flavor: Look at this guy! He’s obviously evil! OBVIOUSLY!!!

name: Imp Swarm (Rank 1)
text: Summon a 3/2 Imp. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Not a cauldron, or a mischief, or a cackle, but a swarm.

name: Guff Runetotem
text: After you cast a Nature spell, give another friendly minion +2/+2.
flavor: "By the twins above and twins below, our companions will lead us through." —Guff Runetotem

name: Tuskpiercer
text: Deathrattle: Draw a Deathrattle minion.
flavor: It's the Barrens, everything has tusks! The Quilboar have tusks, the boars have tusks, the tusks have tusks.

name: Taintheart Tormenter
text: Taunt Your opponent's spells cost (2) more.
flavor: Oh boo hoo, did someone's World Tree burn down?

name: Toad of the Wilds
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you're holding a Nature spell, gain +2 Health.
flavor: "Someday we'll find it. The Oasis Connection. The peons, the caravans, and me."

name: Spirit Healer
text: After you cast a Holy spell, give a random friendly minion +2 Health.
flavor: "You again? What did I tell you about trying to fight ALL the quilboars."

name: Hecklefang Hyena
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: Even their teeth are laughing at you.

name: Kurtrus Ashfallen
text: Battlecry: Attack the left and right-most enemy minions. Outcast: Immune this turn.
flavor: Kurtrus fled the Black Temple, abandoning Illidan's cause, to seek revenge against the Dreadlord Anetheron.

name: Varden Dawngrasp
text: Battlecry: Freeze all enemy minions. If any are already Frozen, deal 4 damage to them instead.
flavor: Varden Dawngrasp could wield fire, summon hailstorms, and morph a night elf into a sheep with a snap of their fingers. Knowing how malleable reality could be, certain labels felt downright trivial.

name: Sigil of Summoning
text: At the start of your next turn, summon two 2/2 Demons with Taunt.
flavor: Look, summoning ain’t exactly a science. Sometimes it takes a turn.

name: Firemancer Flurgl
text: After you play a Murloc, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Diss tracks spitting straight fire.

name: Overlord Saurfang
text: Battlecry: Resurrect 2 friendly Frenzy minions. Deal 1 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Eats more than his fair share of sour candy.

name: Kindling Elemental
text: Battlecry: The next Elemental you play costs (1) less.
flavor: Burn baby burn. Little inferno!

name: Lilypad Lurker
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, transform an enemy minion into a 0/1 Frog with Taunt.
flavor: Honestly, the frog did nothing wrong.

name: Galloping Savior
text: Secret: After your opponent plays three cards in a turn, summon a 3/4 Steed with Taunt.
flavor: "Look to my coming on the first light of the third card."

name: Fangbound Druid
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of a Beast in your hand by (2).
flavor: Bound by the law of the fang, these druid floss their teeth twice a day.

name: Primal Dungeoneer
text: Battlecry: Draw a spell. If it's a Nature spell, also draw an Elemental.
flavor: They wanted a Mature Dungeoneer. Instead they got this.

name: Lady Anacondra
text: Your Nature spells cost (2) less.
flavor: Do you think she got her name before or after she turned into a snake?

name: Serpentbloom
text: Give a friendly Beast Poisonous.
flavor: "Awww, it's so cute!" —Famous last words

name: Sin'dorei Scentfinder
text: Frenzy: Summon four 1/1 Hyenas with Rush.
flavor: Loves candles. Hates deodorant.

name: Devout Dungeoneer
text: Battlecry: Draw a spell. If it's a Holy spell, reduce its Cost by (2).
flavor: "Please do smaller pulls, this is my first time healing."

name: Against All Odds
text: Destroy ALL odd-Attack minions.
flavor: Time to EVEN out the playing field.

name: Water Moccasin
text: Stealth Has Poisonous while you have no other minions.
flavor: You need to be specific when you're ordering waterproof shoewear.

name: Shroud of Concealment
text: Draw 2 minions. Any played this turn gain Stealth for 1 turn.
flavor: This page left intentionally blank.

name: Savory Deviate Delight
text: Transform a minion in both players' hands into a Pirate or Stealth minion.
flavor: "Savory" is a creative way to put it.

name: Unstable Shadow Blast
text: Deal 6 damage to a minion. Excess damage hits your hero.
flavor: "Unstable" usually means "awesome!"

name: Final Gasp
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion. If it dies, summon a 2/2 Adventurer with a random bonus effect.
flavor: And with a raspy whisper, he uttered his final words, "rez plz."

name: Stealer of Souls
text: The first card you draw each turn costs Health instead of Mana.
flavor: The tooth fairy gig didn't work out.

name: Man-at-Arms
text: Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, gain +1/+1.
flavor: Arch nemesis of the Man-at-Legs.

name: Whetstone Hatchet
text: After your hero attacks, give a minion in your hand +1 Attack.
flavor: A bad hatchet can make a good spear better.

name: Kresh, Lord of Turtling
text: Frenzy: Gain 8 Armor. Deathrattle: Equip a 2/5 Turtle Spike.
flavor: Never should have flushed him.

name: Southsea Scoundrel
text: Battlecry: Discover a card in your opponent's deck. They draw theirs as well.
flavor: "…and here we see the Southsea Scoundrel in their natural habitat: a den of scum and villainy."

name: Barrens Trapper
text: Your Deathrattle cards cost (1) less.
flavor: Just add a bit of murloc meat for bait. Beasts can’t resist that special seasoning…

name: Meeting Stone
text: At the end of your turn, add a 2/2 Adventurer with a random bonus effect to your hand.
flavor: "I'm clicking on it, but nothing's happening."

name: Selfless Sidekick
text: Battlecry: Equip a random weapon from your deck.
flavor: "I got a real sense of humility from her when she bashed that quilboar's head in."

name: Mutanus the Devourer
text: Battlecry: Eat a minion in your opponent's hand. Gain its stats.
flavor: As long as Naralex stays under the blanket, Mutanus can't get him.

name: Devouring Ectoplasm
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Adventurer with a random bonus effect.
flavor: When it's on keto, it only devours tauren.

name: Felrattler
text: Rush Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: It only rattles when YOU'RE in danger.

name: Archdruid Naralex
text: Dormant for 2 turns. While Dormant, add a Dream card to your hand at the end of your turn.
flavor: "Dormant? I think you mean naptime."

name: Barak Kodobane
text: Battlecry: Draw a 1, 2, and 3-Cost spell.
flavor: They say he's a pro at horseback archery.

name: Cleric of An'she
text: Battlecry: If you've restored Health this turn, Discover a spell from your deck.
flavor: When it's her turn to cook, she'll always go for a Light sear.

name: Sigil of Silence
text: At the start of your next turn, Silence all enemy minions.
flavor: A little heard-of spell.

name: Deviate Dreadfang
text: After you cast a Nature spell, summon a 4/2 Viper with Rush.
flavor: Even with wings, snakes STILL don't have legs.

name: Earth Revenant
text: Taunt Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Have you guys seen a pair of rock legs lying around anywhere?

name: Spawnpool Forager
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Tinyfin.
flavor: Putting food on the table requires persistence, enthusiasm, and the finest murloc Gloves of Foraging.

name: Shattering Blast
text: Destroy all Frozen minions.
flavor: Let's be honest, they weren't going to unfreeze anyway.

name: Scabbs Cutterbutter
text: Combo: The next two cards you play this turn cost (2) less.
flavor: "Never lie, steal, cheat, or drink. Unless you're compelled to, that is…" —Scabbs Cutterbutter

name: Floecaster
text: Costs (2) less for each Frozen enemy.
flavor: His real name is Melvin, but he prefers his friends call him......"Floecaster."

name: Oasis Ally
text: Secret: When a friendly minion is attacked, summon a 3/6 Water Elemental.
flavor: As gentle as a bellyflop.

name: Mankrik
text: Battlecry: Help Mankrik find his wife! She was last seen somewhere in your deck.
flavor: Relives his nightmare every day a new Horde player is created.

name: Venomstrike Bow
text: Poisonous
flavor: "You know you only have to coat the arrowhead in poison and not the entire bow, right?"

name: Celestial Ink Set
text: After you spend 5 Mana on spells, reduce the Cost of a spell in your hand by (5). Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: "Dear Mother, I have a lot of spells and burst in my hand. You should maybe run more armor and healing next time. Cordially, Your child"

name: Runed Mithril Rod
text: After you draw 4 cards, reduce the Cost of cards in your hand by (1). Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: "Please, I need these greens to disenchant them." —Every Enchanter Ever

name: Fury (Rank 1)
text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: Rank 3 is when your mom uses your middle name.

name: Soldier's Caravan
text: At the start of your turn, summon two X Silver Hand Recruits.
flavor: It’s a clown car… for JUSTICE!

name: Stonemaul Anchorman
text: Rush Frenzy: Draw a card.
flavor: "Brug will read anything you put on the parchment prompter. Anything."

name: Stubborn Suspect
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random 3-Cost minion.
flavor: He keeps saying "I'll never talk," but no one has actually asked him anything.

name: Horde Operative
text: Battlecry: Copy your opponent's Secrets and put them into play.
flavor: "We all have our secrets. I mean, your secrets."

name: Shadowcloth Needle
text: After you cast a Shadow spell, deal 1 damage to all enemies. Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: Makes light of the darkest repair jobs.

name: Entrapped Sorceress
text: Battlecry: If you control a Quest, Discover a spell.
flavor: "If you're a city guard, you have to tell me. Otherwise, it's entrapment."

name: Sketchy Information
text: Draw a Deathrattle card that costs (4) or less. Trigger its Deathrattle.
flavor: "I trust the Forsaken as far as I can smell them. Which, I guess is actually pretty far."

name: First Blade of Wrynn
text: Divine Shield Battlecry: Gain Rush if this has at least 4 Attack.
flavor: Valedictorian of knight school.

name: Encumbered Pack Mule
text: Taunt When you draw this, add a copy of it to your hand.
flavor: "Now I can pick up EVERY knick-knack."

name: Traveling Merchant
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other friendly minion you control.
flavor: Northrend's greatest export: funnel cakes.

name: Counterfeit Blade
text: Battlecry: Get a copy of a random friendly Deathrattle minion that died this game.
flavor: Don't worry, the blade retracts into the handle!

name: Garrote
text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero. Shuffle 3 Bleeds into your deck that deal 2 more when drawn.
flavor: "I don't have money… but what I do have is a particular set of skills."

name: SI:7 Informant
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other SI:7 card you've played this game.
flavor: Sitting in a tavern all day and looking scary is hard work, but somebody has to do it.

name: SI:7 Extortion
text: Tradeable Deal 3 damage to an undamaged character.
flavor: "It's a dangerous world out there. It'd be a shame if your protection insurance were to suddenly run out…"

name: SI:7 Operative
text: Rush After this attacks a minion, gain Stealth.
flavor: What do you mean you're out of ponies?

name: SI:7 Assassin
text: Costs (1) less for each SI:7 card you've played this game. Combo: Destroy an enemy minion.
flavor: You can't keep the streets clean if you're afraid to get your hands dirty.

name: SI:7 Skulker
text: Stealth Battlecry: The next card you draw costs (1) less.
flavor: Burying bones and calling it skullduggery.

name: Cowardly Grunt
text: Deathrattle: Summon a minion from your deck.
flavor: Cowardice is the wisest part of valor.

name: Blacksmithing Hammer
text: Tradeable After you Trade this, gain +2 Durability.
flavor: Passed through the hands of countless smiths, and eventually the skulls of their enemies.

name: Provoke
text: Tradeable Choose a friendly minion. Enemy minions attack it.
flavor: "Heh, Greetings. Heh, Greetings. Heh, Greetings. I will crush you!"

name: Lothar
text: At the end of your turn, attack a random enemy minion. If it dies, gain +3/+3.
flavor: Has been around since before there were paladins and those newfangled paladin mechs.

name: Oracle of Elune
text: After you play a minion that costs (2) or less, summon a copy of it.
flavor: Even the moon goddess needs to back up her databases.

name: Auctionhouse Gavel
text: After your hero attacks, reduce the Cost of a Battlecry minion in your hand by (1).
flavor: "I want to be a judge! Or an auctioneer! Look, all I want is one of those sweet, tiny hammers."

name: Spirit Alpha
text: After you play a card with Overload, summon a 2/3 Spirit Wolf with Taunt.
flavor: Just like in the natural world, the alpha of the species is bright purple.

name: Sow the Soil
text: Choose One - Give your minions +1 Attack; or Summon a 2/2 Treant.
flavor: "I'M NOT A TAILOR!"

name: Harbor Scamp
text: Battlecry: Draw a Pirate.
flavor: Hey, that gnome looks awfully fishy…

name: Cargo Guard
text: At the end of your turn, gain 3 Armor.
flavor: *Arrrrrmor

name: Shiver Their Timbers!
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If you control a Pirate, deal 5 instead.
flavor: Who knew there was overlap between pirates and lumberjacks?

name: Raid the Docks
text: Questline: Play 3 Pirates. Reward: Draw a weapon.
flavor: Winning the annual Ratchet Regatta really went to their heads.

name: Lost in the Park
text: Questline: Gain 4 Attack with your hero. Reward: Gain 5 Armor.
flavor: Mister, have you seen my Archdruid?

name: Best in Shell
text: Tradeable Summon two 2/7 Turtles with Taunt.
flavor: The agility course takes a while.

name: Rise to the Occasion
text: Questline: Play 3 different 1-Cost cards. Reward: Equip a 1/4 Light's Justice.
flavor: Faith is never lost, only repurposed.

name: Granite Forgeborn
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of Elementals in your hand and deck by (1).
flavor: If he stops being useful, just turn him into a kitchen countertop.

name: Canal Slogger
text: Rush, Lifesteal Overload: (1)
flavor: "Another Monday in the canals huh? What a slog."

name: Command the Elements
text: Questline: Play 3 cards with Overload. Reward: Unlock your Overloaded Mana Crystals.
flavor: What, you expected a shaman to have trouble with a place called STORMWIND?

name: Park Panther
text: Rush. Whenever this attacks, give your hero +3 Attack this turn.
flavor: Somebody called animal control once. It didn't work out very well for anybody.

name: Kodo Mount
text: Give a minion +4/+2 and Rush. When it dies, summon a Kodo.
flavor: No matter how big they are or how many times you tell them no, they STILL won't stay off the couch.

name: Seek Guidance
text: Questline: Play a 2, 3, and 4-Cost card. Reward: Discover a card from your deck.
flavor: Xyrella was looking for spiritual guidance but found deck-building tips instead.

name: Tiny Toys
text: Summon four random 5-Cost minions. Make them 2/2.
flavor: Mom, they're action figures!

name: Charged Call
text: Discover a 1-Cost minion and summon it. (Upgraded for each Overload card you played this game!)
flavor: You have a collect call from "AL'AKIR, LORD OF AIR AND THE FOUR WINDS." Do you accept these charges?

name: Two-Faced Investor
text: At the end of your turn, reduce the Cost of a card in your hand by (1). (50% chance to increase.)
flavor: Should never have opened that joint account...

name: Loan Shark
text: Battlecry: Give your opponent a Coin. Deathrattle: You get two.
flavor: Pay up or you'll be swimming with the fishes.

name: Lightbringer's Hammer
text: Lifesteal Can't attack heroes.
flavor: This entire city must be purged. Or at least just the minions.

name: Alliance Bannerman
text: Battlecry: Draw a minion. Give minions in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Back in my day, we had to carry our inspiration uphill both ways to war.

name: Catacomb Guard
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Deal damage equal to this minion's Attack to an enemy minion.
flavor: A little dark down here. So much for "serving the Light."

name: Peasant
text: At the start of your turn, draw a card.
flavor: Better pay them, or they'll join the Defias.

name: Irebound Brute
text: Taunt Costs (1) less for each card drawn this turn.
flavor: "You don't understand… ogres are an untapped market for vengeance and hatred!"

name: Final Showdown
text: Questline: Draw 5 cards in one turn. Reward: Reduce the Cost of the cards drawn by (1).
flavor: Finally. The last Hearthstone card.

name: Wickerclaw
text: After your hero gains Attack, this minion gains +2 Attack.
flavor: They say pets tend to look like their owners.

name: Composting
text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Draw a card."
flavor: The Treants really give their bodies to the cause.

name: Vibrant Squirrel
text: Deathrattle: Shuffle 4 Acorns into your deck. When drawn, summon a 2/1 Squirrel.
flavor: Oh, they're cute now. Just wait till they unleash a Savage Roar.

name: Call of the Grave
text: Discover a Deathrattle minion. If you have enough Mana to play it, trigger its Deathrattle.
flavor: Necromancy is motivational speaking for the dead.

name: Shard of the Naaru
text: Tradeable Silence all enemy minions.
flavor: Fell from the sky, huh? I'll give you ten gold.

name: Void Shard
text: Lifesteal Deal 4 damage.
flavor: Light's easy. Void's hard.

name: Fel Barrage
text: Deal 2 damage to the lowest Health enemy, twice.
flavor: Kurtrus leapt over a tombstone towards the demonic invaders, yelling "PEW! PEW!" as he shot them down with fel magic.

name: Sigil of Alacrity
text: At the start of your next turn, draw a card and reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: Red means stop. Purple means GO REALLY FAST.

name: Persistent Peddler
text: Tradeable Deathrattle: Summon a Persistent Peddler from your deck.
flavor: Loves pyramid schemes and bike rides.

name: Felgorger
text: Battlecry: Draw a Fel spell. Reduce its Cost by (2).
flavor: The 'everything green' diet.

name: Jace Darkweaver
text: Battlecry: Cast all Fel spells you've played this game (targets enemies if possible).
flavor: As a former mage, making the transition from fire to felfire was quite easy.

name: Elekk Mount
text: Give a minion +4/+7 and Taunt. When it dies, summon an Elekk.
flavor: Pink Elekks are on parade!

name: Twilight Deceptor
text: Battlecry: If any hero took damage this turn, draw a Shadow spell.
flavor: Nobody asks questions if you're carrying a clipboard.

name: Fire Sale
text: Tradeable Deal 3 damage to all minions.
flavor: Everything is 50% off now that our warehouse burned down.

name: Psyfiend
text: After you cast a Shadow spell, deal 2 damage to each hero.
flavor: Listens to a LOT of K-pop.

name: Voidtouched Attendant
text: Both heroes take one extra damage from all sources.
flavor: Don't TOUCH the Void. You don't know where it's been.

name: First Flame
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Add a Second Flame to your hand.
flavor: You never forget your first love: fire.

name: Clumsy Courier
text: Battlecry: Cast the highest Cost spell from your hand.
flavor: Not the nacho cheese!

name: Ignite
text: Deal 2 damage. Shuffle an Ignite into your deck that deals one more damage.
flavor: "So there I was in the Deadmines, I had VanCleef by the throat, and I was just about to let him have it when... What's that smell?"

name: Sanctum Chandler
text: After you cast a Fire spell, draw a spell.
flavor: Has been burning at both ends to keep the place illuminated.

name: Prestor's Pyromancer
text: Battlecry: Your next Fire spell has Spell Damage +2.
flavor: Ah, yeah. This guy. Definitely not an evil dragon in disguise either.

name: Grand Magus Antonidas
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Fire spell on each of your last three turns, cast 3 Fireballs at random enemies. (/3)
flavor: He's really disappointed Jaina became a frost mage.

name: Sheldras Moontree
text: Battlecry: The next 3 spells you draw are Cast When Drawn.
flavor: Sheldras really went to the park for his pilgrimage.

name: Darkbishop Benedictus
text: Start of Game: If the spells in your deck are all Shadow, enter Shadowform.
flavor: Dark Bishop takes Light Pawn, check.

name: Auctioneer Jaxon
text: Whenever you Trade, Discover a card from your deck to draw instead.
flavor: "Who's up for a brand-new wisp? This thing's in perfect condition, folks! Never been played..."

name: Sorcerer's Gambit
text: Questline: Cast a Fire, Frost, and Arcane spell. Reward: Draw a spell.
flavor: After "the incident," the Stockades really had to reevaluate their anti-mage protocols.

name: City Tax
text: Tradeable Lifesteal. Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: "Look pal, I don't care what kind of legion you saved the world from, pay up or else."

name: Noble Mount
text: Give a minion +1/+1 and Divine Shield. When it dies, summon a Warhorse.
flavor: The Horde rued the day that Cariel was allowed to take her pet to work.

name: Highlord Fordragon
text: Divine Shield After a friendly minion loses Divine Shield, give a minion in your hand +5/+5.
flavor: "Through my faith and my courage, I shall be protected. And through my honor and sacrifice, another will rise in my place."

name: Prismatic Jewel Kit
text: After a friendly minion loses Divine Shield, give minions in your hand +1/+1. Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: The divine trick to jewelcrafting is tumbling your own rocks.

name: Rats of Extraordinary Size
text: Summon seven 1/1 Rats. Any that can't fit on the battlefield go to your hand with +4/+4.
flavor: They don't care if you believe they exist.

name: Metamorfin
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you've cast a Fel spell this turn, gain +2/+2.
flavor: Always wanted to be the green ranger.

name: Aimed Shot
text: Deal 3 damage. Your next Hero Power deals 2 more damage.
flavor: Wait, you WEREN'T aiming before?!

name: Defend the Dwarven District
text: Questline: Deal damage with 3 spells. Reward: Your Hero Power can target minions.
flavor: Don't shoot until you see the purples of their eyes.

name: Blessed Goods
text: Discover a Secret, weapon, or Divine Shield minion.
flavor: Guaranteed to contain no haunted dolls, cursed rings, or corrupted runeblades, or your money back.

name: Chaos Leech
text: Lifesteal. Deal 3 damage to a minion. Outcast: Deal 5 instead.
flavor: Otherwise known as a nematode.

name: Maestra of the Masquerade
text: You start the game as a different class until you play a Rogue card.
flavor: She doesn't drop character until after the DVD commentary.

name: Find the Imposter
text: Questline: Play 2 SI:7 cards. Reward: Add a Spy Gizmo to your hand.
flavor: My money is on the evil advisor to the king.

name: Lion's Frenzy
text: Has Attack equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
flavor: Only as sharp as your draw.

name: Stormwind Guard
text: Taunt Battlecry: Give adjacent minions +1/+1.
flavor: 1% Guarding, 99% providing directions.

name: Impatient Shopkeep
text: Tradeable Rush
flavor: "Oi! This ain't a museum, lady."

name: Spice Bread Baker
text: Battlecry: Restore Health to your hero equal to your hand size.
flavor: The secret ingredient is love. And a LOT of butter.

name: Package Runner
text: Can only attack if you have at least 8 cards in hand.
flavor: He could go... all... the... way!

name: Deeprun Engineer
text: Battlecry: Discover a Mech. It costs (1) less.
flavor: Deeprun Tram instructions: 300,000 pieces, 600,000 steps.

name: Florist
text: At the end of your turn, reduce the Cost of a Nature spell in your hand by (1).
flavor: Trade district. Trade district a shop. Color Legendary. Color Legendary golden. Rose is a rose is a rose is a rose.

name: Guild Trader
text: Tradeable Spell Damage +2
flavor: Somehow, she manages six different professions.

name: Goldshire Gnoll
text: Rush Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
flavor: They're searching for one ring. They're pretty sure someone said Goldshire.

name: Battleground Battlemaster
text: Adjacent minions have Windfury.
flavor: Farm! No wait… Mine! No wait… 3 to Smith—they're taking Farm. Get there now!

name: Northshire Farmer
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Beast. Shuffle three 3/3 copies into your deck.
flavor: Dual-classed into Farmer/Rancher.

name: Pandaren Importer
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell that didn't start in your deck.
flavor: She carries everything you didn't want and more!

name: Royal Librarian
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Silence a minion.
flavor: Books on how to flip the Auction House are down that way.

name: Stockades Guard
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion Taunt.
flavor: "You there! Defend this prison with your life. It's my break."

name: Mo'arg Forgefiend
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Gain 8 Armor.
flavor: Enraged not by fel energies, but by an itchy nose he cannot scratch.

name: Enthusiastic Banker
