text: At the end of your turn, store a card from your deck. Deathrattle: Add the stored cards to your hand.
flavor: She offers 0% interest.

name: Mailbox Dancer
text: Battlecry: Add a Coin to your hand. Deathrattle: Give your opponent one.
flavor: He is the reason why we have 7 mailboxes in this district.

name: Lion's Guard
text: Battlecry: If you have 15 or less Health, gain +2/+4 and Taunt.
flavor: She takes the lion's share of the credit, too.

name: Rustrot Viper
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's weapon.
flavor: Poisonous to weapons.

name: Cheesemonger
text: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, add a random spell with the same Cost to your hand.
flavor: Secretly, the Big Cheese of SI:7.

name: Nobleman
text: Battlecry: Create a Golden copy of a random card in your hand.
flavor: What class are you? 'Upper.'

name: Elwynn Boar
text: Deathrattle: If you had 10 Elwynn Boars die this game, equip a 15/3 Sword of a Thousand Truths. (/10)
flavor: Be grateful we lowered the requirement from 65,340,285.

name: City Architect
text: Battlecry: Summon two 0/5 Castle Walls with Taunt.
flavor: "Oh, wait, I had this turned the wrong way. This was supposed to be a tower."

name: Stockades Prisoner
text: Starts Dormant. After you play 3 cards, this awakens.
flavor: She was arrested for lockpicking. Her imprisonment was not well thought out.

name: Lady Prestor
text: Battlecry: Transform minions in your deck into random Dragons. (They keep their original stats and Cost.)
flavor: To her credit, the best bodyguard for the king WOULD be a dragon in disguise.

name: Flightmaster Dungar
text: Battlecry: Choose a flightpath and go Dormant. Awaken with a bonus when you complete it!
flavor: Flight’s a little bumpy, but there’s plenty of legroom.

name: Cornelius Roame
text: At the start and end of each player's turn, draw a card.
flavor: Raised two perfectly normal daughters. Then one died and brought doom to Stormwind.

name: Varian, King of Stormwind
text: Battlecry: Draw a Rush minion to gain Rush. Repeat for Taunt and Divine Shield.
flavor: Man, this guy is so cool. Sure hope nothing happens to him.

name: Overdraft
text: Tradeable Unlock your Overloaded Mana Crystals to deal that much damage.
flavor: Wait. It costs mana to be out of mana?!

name: Bolner Hammerbeak
text: After you play a Battlecry minion, repeat the first Battlecry played this turn.
flavor: Show him how to do something once, and he can do it a thousand times. This turn.

name: Bloodbound Imp
text: Whenever this attacks, deal 2 damage to your hero.
flavor: ALWAYS read the terms and conditions.

name: Dark Alley Pact
text: Summon a Fiend with Taunt and stats equal to your hand size.
flavor: "With your help, I can finally install some proper lighting in this alley."

name: Shady Bartender
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Give your Demons +2/+2.
flavor: One sin and tonic, coming right up.

name: Dreaded Mount
text: Give a minion +1/+1. When it dies, summon an endless Dreadsteed.
flavor: This is the summoning that never ends, and it goes on and on my friends...

name: Demonic Assault
text: Deal 3 damage. Summon two 1/3 Voidwalkers with Taunt.
flavor: Right next to the demonic pepper.

name: Entitled Customer
text: Battlecry: Deal damage equal to your hand size to all other minions.
flavor: "Do you have any idea how much mana I've spent at your store? 6."

name: Touch of the Nathrezim
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it dies, restore 3 Health to your hero.
flavor: "You're giving your soul to me? I'm touched."

name: The Demon Seed
text: Questline: Take 12 damage on your turns. Reward: Lifesteal. Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: Just need some elbow grease to get this working. Oh, and your soul.

name: Anetheron
text: Costs (1) if your hand is full.
flavor: Leads every demonic invasion. Hopefully this one turns out better than the World Tree.

name: Rodent Nest
text: Deathrattle: Summon five 1/1 Rats.
flavor: Pig sty? No, this is a rat's nest.

name: Leatherworking Kit
text: After three friendly Beasts die, draw a Beast and give it +1/+1. Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: Combining taxidermy and tailoring.

name: Ramming Mount
text: Give a minion +2/+2 and Immune while attacking. When it dies, summon a Ram.
flavor: Tavish has some road rage issues to work through.

name: Stormwind Piper
text: After this minion attacks, give your Beasts +1/+1.
flavor: Throws crazy parties with the Rat King—except when it's raining.

name: The Rat King
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Go Dormant. Revive after 5 friendly minions die.
flavor: "I'm the giant rat that makes all of da rules!"

name: Stormwind Freebooter
text: Battlecry: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn.
flavor: "Just don't stab the ankles! I want his boots!"

name: Devouring Swarm
text: Choose an enemy minion. Your minions attack it, then return any that die to your hand.
flavor: Collect… essence.

name: Hot Streak
text: Your next Fire spell this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: It's easy to catch fire when you're on fire.

name: Imported Tarantula
text: Tradeable Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Spiders with Poisonous and Rush.
flavor: Which forbidden forest did you get this from?

name: Wealth Redistributor
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Swap the Attack of the highest and lowest Attack minion.
flavor: WOULD YE LIKE CASH BACK? [ ] YAR HAR [ ] YO HO

name: Druid of the Reef
text: Choose One - Transform into a 3/1 Shark with Rush; or a 1/3 Turtle with Taunt.
flavor: “Wow, there’s a whole sunken city down here!”

name: Moonlit Guidance
text: Discover a copy of a card in your deck. If you play it this turn, draw the original.
flavor: Guff always makes the best decisions after 2 AM.

name: Jerry Rig Carpenter
text: Battlecry: Draw a Choose One spell and split it.
flavor: Choose Two – Good; Cheap; or Fast.

name: Sunwing Squawker
text: Battlecry: Repeat the last spell you've cast on a friendly minion on this.
flavor: Most parrots repeat curses, not blessings.

name: Righteous Defense
text: Set a minion's stats to 1/1. Give the stats it lost to a random minion in your hand.
flavor: Paladins... Always stealing someone else’s thunder. And stats.

name: Blackwater Cutlass
text: Tradeable After you Trade this, reduce the Cost of a spell in your hand by (1).
flavor: Popular around Stormwind for slashing prices.

name: Parrrley
text: Swap this for a card in your opponent's deck.
flavor: Time to engage in some unfriendly negotiations.

name: Mr. Smite
text: Your Pirates have Charge.
flavor: “Please, Mr. Smite was my father. Call me Yorik.”

name: Defias Blastfisher
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. Repeat for each of your Beasts.
flavor: She's a dynamite fishing trainer.

name: Monstrous Parrot
text: Battlecry: Get a copy of the last friendly Deathrattle minion that died.
flavor: What kind of crackers are you feeding that thing?

name: Doggie Biscuit
text: Tradeable Give a minion +2/+3. After you Trade this, give a friendly minion Rush.
flavor: Reserved for Edwin’s favorite lapdogs.

name: Shadowblade Slinger
text: Battlecry: If you've taken damage this turn, deal that much to an enemy minion.
flavor: Throwing knives isn’t easy for a warlock. It’s quite painful, in fact.

name: Wicked Shipment
text: Tradeable Summon 2 1/1 Imps. (Upgrades by 2 when Traded!)
flavor: All horns on deck!

name: Hullbreaker
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Draw a spell. Your hero takes damage equal to its Cost.
flavor: Breaks through the hard shell to reach the ship's gooey interior.

name: Need for Greed
text: Tradeable Draw 3 cards. If drawn this turn, this costs (3).
flavor: Sorry guys, I TOTALLY meant to click greed.

name: Crow's Nest Lookout
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to the left and right-most enemy minions.
flavor: The extra eyes means he sees extra good.

name: Proving Grounds
text: Summon two minions from your deck. They fight!
flavor: 1v1 me on Proving Grounds, DH only, no items, 4 stocks.

name: Brilliant Macaw
text: Battlecry: Repeat the last Battlecry you played.
flavor: He's been repeating the same shanty for a month. Four pirates walked the plank last week. Middle of the ocean, just walked right off.

name: Edwin, Defias Kingpin
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. If you play it this turn, gain +2/+2 and repeat this effect.
flavor: He’s not going to tear down the walls of Stormwind sitting around in the Hall of Fame.

name: Suckerhook
text: At the end of your turn, transform your weapon into one that costs (1) more.
flavor: A moderately better dining companion than Suckerbeard.

name: Heavy Plate
text: Tradeable Gain 8 Armor.
flavor: "You asked for unbendable, unwavering armor–I don't see why you're upset."

name: Amulet of Undying
text: Tradeable Resurrect 1 friendly Deathrattle minion. (Upgrades when Traded!)
flavor: Didn't seem to work out too well for this guy.

name: Defias Leper
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Shadow spell, deal 2 damage.
flavor: Do NOT eat Cookie’s Seafood Surprise.

name: Copycat
text: Battlecry: Add a copy of the next card your opponent plays to your hand.
flavor: Whatever you do, DON’T let two of them meet.

name: Grey Sage Parrot
text: Battlecry: Repeat the last spell you've cast that costs (6) or more.
flavor: Nothing is more terrifying than a parrot squawking "Pyroblast!"

name: Deepwater Evoker
text: Battlecry: Draw a spell. Gain Armor equal to its Cost.
flavor: "Cap'n! We've hit an iceberg!...No, it’s not my fault!"

name: Arcane Overflow
text: Deal 8 damage to an enemy minion. Summon a Remnant with stats equal to the excess damage.
flavor: On this ship, when you can’t use an int, learn how to float.

name: Man the Cannons
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and 1 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Now THAT’S a lotta splash damage!

name: Defias Cannoneer
text: After your hero attacks, deal 2 damage to a random enemy twice.
flavor: "... three."

name: Remote-Controlled Golem
text: After this takes damage, shuffle two Golem Parts into your deck. When drawn, summon a 2/1 Mech.
flavor: Someone got a little too excited inventing a can opener.

name: Maddest Bomber
text: Battlecry: Deal 12 damage randomly split among all other characters.
flavor: Talk about a name that limits design space.

name: Cookie the Cook
text: Lifesteal Deathrattle: Equip a 2/3 Stirring Rod with Lifesteal.
flavor: Unsurprisingly, "Seafood Surprise" was no one's favorite dish.

name: Golakka Glutton
text: Battlecry: Destroy a Beast and gain +1/+1.
flavor: We lost our last cook to one of these.

name: Multicaster
text: Battlecry: Draw a card for each different spell school you've cast this game.
flavor: Has a questionable talent tree.

name: Goliath, Sneed's Masterpiece
text: Battlecry: Fire five rockets at enemy minions that deal 2 damage each. (You pick the targets!)
flavor: “Listen, this baby has blades, rockets, and rocket blades. Only thing it doesn’t have is good gas mileage.”

name: Illidari Inquisitor
text: Rush. After your hero attacks an enemy, this attacks it too.
flavor: Armed with fear, big eyes, ruthless efficiency, almost fanatical devotion to your hero, and nice brown robes.

name: Investment Opportunity
text: Draw an Overload card.
flavor: "It's a real fixer-upper. I mean a REAL fixer upper."

name: Magister Dawngrasp
text: Battlecry: Recast a spell from each spell school you've cast this game.
flavor: Magister is a humble title for one who united warring armies against the greatest threat to Azeroth.

name: Fogsail Freebooter
text: Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, deal 2 damage.
flavor: Goes cheap on wardrobe so he can spend on weaponry.

name: Taelan Fordring
text: Taunt, Divine Shield Deathrattle: Draw your highest Cost minion.
flavor: After growing up with the Scarlet Crusade for most of his life, Taelan finally realized they were maybe not the nicest people.

name: Overlord Runthak
text: Rush. Whenever this attacks, give +1/+1 to all minions in your hand.
flavor: Knows how to lift everyone up while tearing every enemy down.

name: Nozdormu the Eternal
text: Start of Game: If this is in BOTH players' decks, turns are only 15 seconds long.
flavor: Live life in the fast lane. As long as your opponent does too.

name: Coldtooth Yeti
text: Combo: Gain +3 Attack.
flavor: Its arrival heralds the Brain Freeze Yeti.

name: Drek'Thar
text: Battlecry: If this costs more than every minion in your deck, summon one of those minions.
flavor: Inside your deck there are two wolves. One is a frostwolf. The other is a frostwolf. You are a Frostwolf.

name: Rokara, the Valorous
text: Battlecry: Equip a 5/2 Unstoppable Force.
flavor: As strong-willed and stubborn as her first day in the Horde, Rokara now wielded a weapon that rivaled even her tenacity.

name: Herald of Lokholar
text: Battlecry: Draw a Frost spell.
flavor: “I don’t care how hot it is. I am not going over there to be your air conditioning."

name: Popsicooler
text: Deathrattle: Freeze two random enemy minions.
flavor: Just passing through Alterac on its way to apply for a job at the Ice Cream Citadel.

name: Shadowcrafter Scabbs
text: Battlecry: Return all minions to their owner's hands. Summon two 4/2 Shadows with Stealth.
flavor: Sneaking behind enemy lines isn't so different from being a line cook. People are hostile, something's on fire, and your only hope is to get out of there with all your fingers.

name: Kurtrus, Demon-Render
text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/4 Demons with Rush. (Improved by your hero attacks this game.)
flavor: "I dedicated my life to vanquishing demons, but I never thought to face the demons in me. Maybe, in time, I can help quell the demons in you." -Kurtrus, to Cariel

name: Wildheart Guff
text: Battlecry: Set your maximum Mana to 20. Gain an empty Mana Crystal. Draw a card.
flavor: Guff faced his biggest challenge yet: making friends on a battlefield.

name: Lightforged Cariel
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Equip a 2/5 Immovable Object.
flavor: Her faith, unshakable. Her shield, immovable. Her enemies, irredeemable.

name: Xyrella, the Devout
text: Battlecry: Trigger the Deathrattle of every friendly minion that died this game.
flavor: Xyrella thought she was only saving her daughter. Her actions may very well have saved the entire world.

name: Glaciate
text: Discover an 8-Cost minion. Summon and Freeze it.
flavor: We now have a more accurate answer to the age-old question "What's cooler than being cool?"

name: Shield Shatter
text: Deal 5 damage to all minions. Costs (1) less for each Armor you have.
flavor: "Is the shield being shattered or doing the shattering?" "Yes."

name: Frozen Buckler
text: Gain 10 Armor. At the start of your next turn, lose 5 Armor.
flavor: "Hey, I bet I could shatter this."

name: Dreadprison Glaive
text: Honorable Kill: Deal damage equal to your hero's Attack to the enemy hero.
flavor: Keep your allies close. Keep your evil demons in your weapon.

name: Pathmaker
text: Battlecry: Cast the other choice from the last Choose One spell you've cast.
flavor: You can never choose the wrong path if you make your own.

name: Dire Frostwolf
text: Stealth Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Wolf with Stealth.
flavor: Tips to survive a frostwolf attack: -Stay calm -Lay down -Drizzle steak sauce over your body Brought to you by the Frostwolf Council for Alliance Safety.

name: Siphon Mana
text: Deal 2 damage. Honorable Kill: Reduce the Cost of spells in your hand by (1).
flavor: Why spend mine when I can take yours?

name: Vitality Surge
text: Draw a minion. Restore Health to your hero equal to its Cost.
flavor: If your vitality lasts longer than four hours, consult a Priest.

name: Frantic Hippogryph
text: Rush. Honorable Kill: Gain Windfury.
flavor: It's killed and it'll kill again!

name: Mass Polymorph
text: Transform all minions into 1/1 Sheep.
flavor: Sheep in Frostwolves' clothing.

name: Ram Commander
text: Battlecry: Add two 1/1 Rams with Rush to your hand.
flavor: Get your RAM in pairs for better performance.

name: Spammy Arcanist
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to all other minions. If any die, repeat this.
flavor: You don't have to jump while spamming, but it’s more fun that way.

name: Vanndar Stormpike
text: Battlecry: If this costs less than every minion in your deck, reduce their Cost by (3).
flavor: His favorite modes of transportation? Van, car, board, bike.

name: Spring the Trap
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and cast a Secret from your deck. Honorable Kill: Cast 2.
flavor: Talk about starting off on the wrong foot.

name: Ice Trap
text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, return it to their hand instead. It costs (1) more.
flavor: I literally watched the Hunter place it down in front of me and I still stepped in it.

name: Snowblind Harpy
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Frost spell, gain 5 Armor.
flavor: Not snowblind; she can spot a level 51 noob over 40 yards away.

name: Gankster
text: Stealth After your opponent plays a minion, attack it.
flavor: UGH! IM GETTING MY MAIN!

name: Bloodseeker
text: Honorable Kill: Gain +1/+1.
flavor: What do you mean shooting them in the back isn’t honorable?!

name: Snowball Fight!
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion and Freeze it. If it survives, repeat this on another minion!
flavor: Woahwoahwoah, we said no friendly fire!

name: Piggyback Imp
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 4/1 Imp.
flavor: Imp my ride.

name: Sacrificial Summoner
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly minion. Summon a minion from your deck that costs (1) more.
flavor: Summoning will cost you an arm and a brother.

name: Hollow Abomination
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions. Honorable Kill: Gain the minion's Attack.
flavor: As soon as you land your first Honorable Kill, trust me, you'll be hooked!

name: Impfestation
text: Summon a 3/3 Dread Imp to attack each enemy minion.
flavor: Call the imp-sterminator!

name: Deliverance
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Honorable Kill: Summon a new 3/3 copy of it.
flavor: In 30 minutes or less, or else it’s free!

name: Dreadlich Tamsin
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to all minions. Shuffle 3 Rifts into your deck. Draw 3 cards.
flavor: At a certain point, you stop mocking death and start becoming it.

name: Cheaty Snobold
text: After an enemy is Frozen, deal 3 damage to it.
flavor: This one will knock you out cold.

name: Snowfall Guardian
text: Battlecry: Freeze all other minions.
flavor: You’re finally awake! That fall looked really bad. Demon Hunters? Mercenaries? What are you talking about? Come on, I just unpacked a Golden Moorabi, let’s go build a Freeze Shaman deck.

name: Bearon Gla'shear
text: Battlecry: For each Frost spell you've cast this game, summon a 3/4 Elemental that Freezes.
flavor: When you get hit by a royally bad pun, you just have to grin and bear it.

name: Bru'kan of the Elements
text: Battlecry: Call upon the power of two Elements!
flavor: The elements crackled through Bru'kan's veins and his life flashed before his eyes. He knew this moment would come, but he wondered, had he given them enough?

name: Beaststalker Tavish
text: Battlecry: Discover and cast 2 Improved Secrets.
flavor: Tavish left home to forge his own path. But it still led him back to Alterac to kick some Frostwolf butt.

name: Tamsin's Phylactery
text: Discover a friendly Deathrattle minion that died this game. Give your minions its Deathrattle.
flavor: Eau de Morte. Guaranteed to take your date’s breath away

name: Grave Defiler
text: Battlecry: Choose a Fel spell in your hand. Get a copy of it.
flavor: She keeps her Fel spells nice and organized in her defiling cabinet.

name: Frostbite
text: Deal 3 damage. Honorable Kill: Your opponent's next spell costs (2) more.
flavor: The sad reality of a raging toothpaste addiction.

name: Sleetbreaker
text: Battlecry: Add a Windchill to your hand.
flavor: Likes chilly, hates chili.

name: Shivering Sorceress
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of the highest Cost spell in your hand by (1).
flavor: Remember to use your sick days wisely.

name: Amplified Snowflurry
text: Battlecry: Your next Hero Power costs (0) and Freezes the target.
flavor: I bet it’s just exaggerating.

name: Arcane Brilliance
text: Add a copy of a 7, 8, 9, and 10-Cost spell in your deck to your hand.
flavor: They could probably do with a dash of Arcane Humility.

name: Flag Runner
text: Whenever a friendly minion dies, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: I see your argument, but…do you have a flag?

name: Warden of Chains
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you're holding a Demon that costs (5) or more, gain +1/+2.
flavor: Can’t stay out too late. I gotta head back home to the ol’ ball and chained demon.

name: Sigil of Reckoning
text: At the start of your next turn, summon a random Demon from your hand.
flavor: “It’s dangerous ‘round these parts, I reckon.”

name: Ur'zul Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each friendly minion that died this game.
flavor: Nothing personal, tiny human. I have many mouths to feed.

name: Humongous Owl
text: Deathrattle: Deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: "Humongous what?" -Torug's last words.

name: Windchill
text: Freeze a minion. Draw a card.
flavor: The thermometer says it’s 0° right now, but with the windchill it feels like -25°.

name: Caria Felsoul
text: Battlecry: Transform into a 6/6 copy of a Demon in your deck.
flavor: This is what happens when you keep taking the advice of the little demon on your shoulder.

name: Wildpaw Cavern
text: At the end of your turn, summon a 3/4 Elemental that Freezes. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Adventurers were quite confused when they saw how many boots were frozen to the ceiling.

name: Flanking Maneuver
text: Summon a 4/2 Demon with Rush. If it dies this turn, summon another.
flavor: So, do we have advantage? Can I sneak attack?

name: Glory Chaser
text: After you play a Taunt minion, draw a card.
flavor: When you've reached the peak of competition twice, how hard can winning one valley be?

name: Snowed In
text: Destroy a damaged minion. Freeze all other minions.
flavor: “What do you mean school isn’t cancelled?! It’s a snow day!”

name: Scrapsmith
text: Taunt Battlecry: Add two 2/4 Grunts with Taunt to your hand.
flavor: Takes the ugly scraps of armor from dead players and combines them into ridiculous looking PVP armor sets.

name: Razorglaive Sentinel
text: After you play the left or right-most card in your hand, draw a card.
flavor: For the worgen that has everything: more claws.

name: Battleworn Vanguard
text: After your hero attacks, summon two 1/1 Felwings.
flavor: "Welcome to Dun Baldar Felwings! Do you want 'em mild, spicy, or BURNING Legion?"

name: Seeds of Destruction
text: Shuffle four Rifts into your deck. They summon a 3/3 Dread Imp when drawn.
flavor: May your harvest be dreadful.

name: Felfire in the Hole!
text: Draw a spell and deal 2 damage to all enemies. If it's a Fel spell, deal 1 more.
flavor: Fear not, feebleminded friends, for failure to fell your foes with felfire is fundamentally farfetched!

name: Build a Snowman
text: Summon a 3/3 Snowman that Freezes. Add "Build a Snowbrute" to your hand.
flavor: This is the coolest spell once you get it rolling.

name: Rune of the Archmage
text: Cast 20 Mana worth of Mage spells at enemies.
flavor: “It’s not a slot machine! It took YEARS of rigorous studying the intricacies of the universe to unravel the strands of reality. The arcane knowledge alone would enfeeble even the most brilliant of minds. Give it the credence it deserves. It’s a magic slot machine.”

name: To the Front!
text: Your minions cost (2) less this turn (but not less than 1).
flavor: Except healers. You go to the back.

name: Balinda Stonehearth
text: Battlecry: Draw 2 spells. Swap their Costs with this minion's stats.
flavor: Imagine her surprise, ending up in a game called Hearthstone.

name: Shadow Word: Devour
text: Choose a minion. It steals 1 Health from ALL other minions.
flavor: Devouring souls is like a buffet. You have to take a little bit of everything.

name: Undying Disciple
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal damage equal to this minion's Attack to all enemy minions.
flavor: We get it, you're undead. But jumping out of a grave? That's a bit much.

name: Luminous Geode
text: After a friendly minion is healed, give it +2 Attack.
flavor: No take candle. BE CANDLE.

name: Spirit Guide
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Draw a Holy spell and a Shadow spell.
flavor: "Hey Jake." "Back again?" "Yup." "See you in 2 minutes."

name: Bless
text: Give a minion +2 Health, then set its Attack to be equal to its Health.
flavor: Bless is bmore.

name: Gift of the Naaru
text: Restore 3 Health to all characters. If any are still damaged, draw a card.
flavor: What do I look like, a charity?

name: Najak Hexxen
text: Battlecry: Take control of an enemy minion. Deathrattle: Give the minion back.
flavor: "I've got friends on the other side... of the battlefield."

name: Revive Pet
text: Discover a friendly Beast that died this game. Summon it.
flavor: Best friends never really leave.

name: Stormpike Battle Ram
text: Rush Deathrattle: Your next Beast costs (2) less.
flavor: Baa ram ewe! To your dwarves, your beard, Stormpike clan be true!

name: Ram Tamer
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, gain +1/+1 and Stealth.
flavor: Pump up the ram, pump it up. While your hooves are stompin’.

name: Wing Commander Ichman
text: Battlecry: Summon a Beast from your deck and give it Rush. If it kills a minion this turn, repeat.
flavor: “Mulverick, it’s not your flying, it’s your faction.”

name: Full-Blown Evil
text: Deal 5 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. Repeatable this turn.
flavor: This isn’t your average, everyday evil. This is ADVANCED evil.

name: Felwalker
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Cast the highest Cost Fel spell from your hand.
flavor: How it feels to chew Fel Gum.

name: Reconnaissance
text: Discover a Deathrattle minion from another class. It costs (2) less.
flavor: “But Commander, I already did the connaissance.”

name: Double Agent
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a card from another class, summon a copy of this.
flavor: And under the Alliance tabard? Another Horde tabard.

name: Iceblood Tower
text: At the end of your turn, cast another spell from your deck. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: “Why is it called Iceblood Tower?” “Not really sure. Anyways, try not to lose your footing on any of the frozen bodies as you make your way in.”

name: Gnome Private
text: Honorable Kill: Gain +2 Attack.
flavor: She's doing her part.

name: Corporal
text: Honorable Kill: Give your other minions Divine Shield.
flavor: When he’s sitting in the graveyard ready to rez, he’s incorporal.

name: Sneaky Scout
text: Stealth Honorable Kill: Your next Hero Power costs (0).
flavor: Do you know what they call Scouts that aren't sneaky? Target practice.

name: Direwolf Commander
text: Honorable Kill: Summon a 2/2 Wolf with Stealth.
flavor: When you’re riding a wolf, it’s in charge and you're allowed to make suggestions.

name: Tower Sergeant
text: Battlecry: If you control at least 2 other minions, gain +2/+2.
flavor: Best helmet in the valley.

name: Bunker Sergeant
text: Battlecry: If your opponent has 2 or more minions, deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Best hair in the valley.

name: Ice Revenant
text: Whenever you cast a Frost spell, gain +2/+2.
flavor: There must have been some magic in that old ice mace we found.

name: Frozen Mammoth
text: This is Frozen until you cast a Fire spell.
flavor: *record scratch* "So, you may be wondering how I got here."

name: Blood Guard
text: Whenever this minion takes damage, give your minions +1 Attack.
flavor: Has never donated blood and doesn’t plan on ever doing so.

name: Legionnaire
text: Deathrattle: Give all minions in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: *not related to the Burning Legion

name: Knight-Captain
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage. Honorable Kill: Gain +3/+3.
flavor: Very dangerous shoulder-to-ears situation here.

name: Troll Centurion
text: Rush. Honorable Kill: Deal 8 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: Centurion? Ha, come back when you’re a millennion.

name: Icehoof Protector
text: Taunt Freeze any character damaged by this minion.
flavor: I can't feel my axe!

name: Frostwolf Warmaster
text: Costs (1) less for each card you've played this turn.
flavor: “The spoils of war ain’t free… Unless you’re me!”

name: Stormpike Marshal
text: Taunt If you took 5 or more damage on your opponent's turn, this costs (1).
flavor: The Stormpike have a very direct take on life insurance.

name: Kobold Taskmaster
text: Battlecry: Add 2 Armor Scraps to your hand that give +2 Health to a minion.
flavor: Fabled questgiver of the “Get me candle”, “Get me another candle”, and “Get me 11 more candle” questline.

name: Irondeep Trogg
text: After your opponent casts a spell, summon another Irondeep Trogg.
flavor: STOP AGGROING MORE!

name: Grimtotem Bounty Hunter
text: Battlecry: Destroy an enemy Legendary minion.
flavor: He’ll take a big weight off your shoulders.

name: Abominable Lieutenant
text: At the end of your turn, eat a random enemy minion and gain its stats.
flavor: If you can't join 'em, eat 'em.

name: Mountain Bear
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon two 2/4 Cubs with Taunt.
flavor: If they want your picnic basket, I recommend giving it to them.

name: Frostsaber Matriarch
text: Taunt. Costs (1) less for each Beast you've summoned this game.
flavor: They say “don’t poke the bear”, but they NEVER said “don’t poke the frostsaber or her cubs”.

name: Heart of the Wild
text: Give a minion +2/+2, then give your Beasts +1/+1.
flavor: In each of us beats a wild heart. Except the Forsaken.

name: Lokholar the Ice Lord
text: Rush, Windfury Costs (5) less if you have 15 Health or less.
flavor: Suddenly the names of Iceblood Tower and Iceblood Garrison make a lot more sense.

name: Ivus, the Forest Lord
text: Battlecry: Spend the rest of your Mana and gain +2/+2, Rush, Divine Shield, or Taunt at random for each.
flavor: He's always welcome at the local tavern, unlike a certain Ancient.

name: Korrak the Bloodrager
text: Deathrattle: If this wasn't Honorably Killed, resummon Korrak.
flavor: “I live, I love, I slay, and I am undying.”

name: Hold the Bridge
text: Give a minion +2/+1 and Divine Shield. It gains Lifesteal until end of turn.
flavor: You! Shall not! Pass!

name: Brasswing
text: At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to all enemies. Honorable Kill: Restore 4 Health to your hero.
flavor: I’ve seen this before. You just have to time it right to avoid the dragon.

name: Templar Captain
text: Rush. After this attacks a minion, summon a 5/5 Defender with Taunt.
flavor: You can combine two of these into a Captain Archon.

name: Protect the Innocent
text: Summon a 5/5 Defender with Taunt. If your hero was healed this turn, summon another.
flavor: "Quick, strike a super hero pose!"

name: Cavalry Horn
text: Deathrattle: Summon the lowest Cost minion in your hand.
flavor: The clarion call of the Alliance skipping every objective and going straight to Drek’Thar.

name: Stonehearth Vindicator
text: Battlecry: Draw a spell that costs (3) or less. It costs (0) this turn.
flavor: “True strength comes from within your deck” is a whole lot less inspiring.

name: Captain Galvangar
text: Battlecry: If you have gained 15 or more Armor this game, gain +3/+3 and Charge. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: It wasn't the ravages of war that took Galvangar, it was hypothermia.

name: Wing Commander Mulverick
text: Rush. Your minions have "Honorable Kill: Summon a 2/2 Wyvern with Rush."
flavor: “A board full of 2-Health minions? This is what I call a target rich environment.”

name: Clawfury Adept
text: Battlecry: Give all other friendly characters +1 Attack this turn.
flavor: The Inept Clawfury is a danger only to themselves.

name: Capture Coldtooth Mine
text: Choose One - Draw your lowest Cost card; or Draw your highest Cost card.
flavor: We hit a huge haul! Or wait… no, it's just a coin.

name: Pride Seeker
text: Battlecry: Your next Choose One card costs (2) less.
flavor: When you're putting your head in the lion's mouth, you may as well dress the part.

name: Wildpaw Gnoll
text: Rush Costs (1) less for each non-Rogue Class card added to your hand this game.
flavor: A big fan of four-claw discounts.

name: Snowfall Graveyard
text: Your Deathrattles trigger twice. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Live fast, die twice.

name: Stormpike Quartermaster
text: After you cast a spell, give a random minion in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Frozen funnel cakes taste just like ice cream, if you pretend real hard.

name: The Lobotomizer
text: Honorable Kill: Get a copy of the top card of your opponent's deck.
flavor: This may hurt a little, but don't worry, you won't remember it.

name: Cera'thine Fleetrunner
text: Battlecry: Replace your minions in hand and deck with ones from other classes. They cost (2) less.
flavor: World Record CTF Champion 16 years running.

name: Contraband Stash
text: Replay 5 cards from other classes you've played this game.
flavor: “Coggsprocket! We happy?" "Yeah, we happy."

name: Onyxian Warder
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, summon two 2/1 Whelps with Rush.
flavor: Throwing more whelps at the problem might not help, but they certainly will hurt.

name: Gear Grubber
text: Taunt. If you end your turn with any unspent Mana, reduce this card's Cost by (1).
flavor: Yeah, “for off-spec,” suuuuure.

name: Whelp Bonker
text: Frenzy and Honorable Kill: Draw a card.
flavor: Bonk!

name: Deep Breath
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion and its neighbors. (Improved by number of other spells in your hand.)
flavor: I SAID "RELAX!"

name: Haleh, Matron Protectorate
text: After you cast a spell, deal 4 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: Oh, how do you solve a problem like Onyxia?

name: Furious Howl
text: Draw a card. Repeat until you have at least 3 cards.
flavor: Hunters make the worst neighbors.

name: Pet Collector
text: Battlecry: Summon a Beast from your deck that costs (5) or less.
flavor: "And I'll call you Mrs. Snugglepants, and you Bubblecuddle, and you Cutie Cakes, and you..."

name: Dragonbane Shot
text: Deal 2 damage. Honorable Kill: Add a Dragonbane Shot to your hand.
flavor: *Only effective against small dragons.

name: Don't Stand in the Fire!
text: Deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. Overload: (1)
flavor: Apparently the “Caution: Hot Surface” sign had burned up.

name: Spirit Mount
text: Give a minion +1/+2 and Spell Damage +1. When it dies, summon a Spirit Raptor.
flavor: Bru'kan said his spirit would always be with us. He failed to mention that his raptor’s would be too.

name: Bracing Cold
text: Restore 5 Health to your hero. Reduce the Cost of a random spell in your hand by (2).
flavor: Worst. Hug. Ever.

name: Keen Reflex
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. Honorable Kill: Gain +1 Attack this turn.
flavor: All of Onyxia's whelps were no match for Kurtrus' backflip.

name: Wings of Hate (Rank 1)
text: Summon two 1/1 Felwings. (Upgrades when you have 5 Mana.)
flavor: For one day each February, they become the Wings of Love.

name: Horn of Wrathion
text: Draw a minion. If it's a Dragon, summon two 2/1 Whelps with Rush.
flavor: You can count the rings and find out Wrathion's true age.

name: Boomkin
text: Choose One - Restore 8 Health to your hero; or Deal 4 damage.
flavor: Some Druids consider balance to be a state of harmony between the Natural and the Arcane. Others are more focused on the balance of the opponent’s life total versus their own.

name: Raid Negotiator
text: Battlecry: Discover a Choose One card. It has both effects combined.
flavor: "What do you mean by aggressive negotiation tactics?" "Negotiations in bear form."

name: Stormwind Avenger
text: After you cast a spell on this minion, it gains +2 Attack.
flavor: "I swear if you heal me I will DPS."

name: Scale of Onyxia
text: Fill your board with 2/1 Whelps with Rush.
flavor: Whelp for scale.

name: Battle Vicar
text: Battlecry: Discover a Holy spell.
flavor: She's the most down-to-earth paladin you'll ever meet... until she stands up.

name: Hit It Very Hard
text: Gain +10 Attack and "Can't attack heroes" this turn.
flavor: "...and very fast."

name: Onyxian Drake
text: Taunt Battlecry: Deal damage equal to your Armor to an enemy minion.
flavor: The best offense is a great defense.

name: Shoulder Check
text: Tradeable Give a minion +2/+1 and Rush.
flavor: One... two... yeah, all present and correct.

name: Lightmaw Netherdrake
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Holy and a Shadow spell, deal 3 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Do you think it's a glass half full kind of Netherdrake, or a glass half empty, inescapable void kind of Netherdrake?

name: Ring of Courage
text: Tradeable Give a minion +1/+1. Repeat for each enemy minion.
flavor: Now to find the Ring of Wisdom and Ring of Power.

name: Mi'da, Pure Light
text: Divine Shield, Lifesteal Deathrattle: Shuffle a Fragment into your deck that resummons Mi'da when drawn.
flavor: Unfortunately, Mi’da’s touch will not turn things to gold.

name: Tooth of Nefarian
text: Deal 3 damage. Honorable Kill: Discover a spell from another class.
flavor: Nefarian: Lord of Blackrock, creator of the chromatic dragonflight, victim of several root canals.

name: Drakefire Amulet
text: Tradeable Discover 2 Dragons. Summon them.
flavor: "...and I only had to climb up the mountains in Winterspring 50 times!"

name: Curse of Agony
text: Shuffle three Agonies into the opponent's deck. They deal Fatigue damage when drawn.
flavor: Now, fools, you shall all understand my back pain!

name: Smokescreen
text: Draw 5 cards. Trigger any Deathrattles drawn.
flavor: Pocket smoke!

name: SI:7 Smuggler
text: Battlecry: Summon a random 1-Cost minion. (Upgraded for each other SI:7 card you have played this game.)
flavor: After a while, Onyxia's regurgitated rats start to taste pretty good.

name: Spawn of Deathwing
text: Battlecry: Destroy a random enemy minion. Discard a random card.
flavor: Aww, who’s the most dangerous threat to the world? You are!

name: Dun Baldar Bunker
text: At the end of your turn, draw a Secret and set its Cost to (1). Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Brutalist architecture for brutal times.

name: Raid Boss Onyxia
text: Rush. Immune while you control a Whelp. Battlecry: Summon six 2/1 Whelps with Rush.
flavor: Onyxia chose her guises to manipulate mortals, but her true form? That was reserved for ending them.

name: Bubbler
text: After this minion takes exactly one damage, destroy it. (Pop!)
flavor: Prefers regular over diet shampoo.

name: Kazakusan
text: Battlecry: If you played 4 other Dragons this game, craft a custom deck of Treasures. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Kazakus had always seemed too clever a sort to bottle a brew that could do him any harm. Perhaps it should come as no surprise, then, that the originator of the Dragonfire Potion was a dragon himself.

name: Naval Mine
text: Deathrattle: Deal 4 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: A Naval Mine? I'd rather it be Naval Yours.

name: Pufferfist
text: After your hero attacks, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: "...and then I'll hit 'em with the ol' puffercut!"

name: Multi-Strike
text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. They may attack an additional enemy minion.
flavor: “I said you get two attack, not two attacks!”

name: Gangplank Diver
text: Dormant for 1 turn. Rush. Immune while attacking.
flavor: Cownonball!

name: Baba Naga
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, deal 3 damage.
flavor: A folktale told to Naga children to scare them from swimming too close to the surface.

name: Barbaric Sorceress
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Swap the Cost of a random spell in each player's hand.
flavor: Her four arms are for casting, and her forearms are for crushing.

name: Barbed Nets
text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If you played a Naga while holding this, choose a second target.
flavor: I caught'ya a dollar.

name: Colaque
text: Colossal +1 Immune while you control Colaque's Shell.
flavor: Ten thousand years ago, the city of Zin-Azshari fell to the bottom of the sea... and partially onto Colaque's shell.

name: Slimescale Diver
text: Dormant for 1 turn. Rush, Poisonous
flavor: You try putting on a wetsuit with scales.

name: Sir Finley, Sea Guide
text: Battlecry: Swap your hand with the bottom of your deck.
flavor: "No need to worry, ol' chums, I have the map right here. It says to continue going straight down!"

name: Gaia, the Techtonic
text: Colossal +2 After a friendly Mech attacks, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Always planning ahead, Ini knew she'd need this invention to protect all her other inventions.

name: Murkwater Scribe
text: Battlecry: The next spell you play costs (1) less.
flavor: The pen is mightier than the trident.

name: Glaiveshark
text: Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Can smell a drop of vengeance in the water up to a mile away.

name: Coilskar Commander
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, summon two copies of this. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Then thou shalt count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shall be three. Four shalt thou not count, neither count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out.

name: Abyssal Depths
text: Draw your two lowest Cost minions.
flavor: *Happy Wisp noises*

name: Voidgill
text: Deathrattle: Give all Murlocs in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: If you stare into the abyss, it’s said that it will stare back at you. What happens to those who’ve gazed at it their entire lives?

name: Crushclaw Enforcer
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, draw a Naga.
flavor: Yet another case of carcinization.

name: Vicious Slitherspear
text: After you cast a spell, gain +1 Attack until your next turn.
flavor: He goes by ‘Fun-Loving Slitherspear’ on his dating profile.

name: Priestess Valishj
text: Battlecry: Refresh an empty Mana Crystal for each spell you've cast this turn.
flavor: Some of the more stoic priestesses worry that she's living too lavishjly.

name: Naga Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each Mana you've spent on spells this game.
flavor: He might be giant, but he’s still a couple thousand protein shakes away from competing in the Colossal Wrestling Championship.

name: The Leviathan
text: Colossal +1 Rush, Divine Shield After this attacks, Dredge.
flavor: Built by Ini Stormcoil, this massive vessel can withstand almost anything you put it through... although she would prefer you didn't!

name: Spitelash Siren
text: After you play a Naga, refresh two Mana Crystals. (Then switch to spell!)
flavor: Refresh the rainbow.

name: Blademaster Okani
text: Battlecry: Secretly choose to Counter the next minion or spell your opponent plays while this is alive.
flavor: Yet ANOTHER sword fighter that spams counters.

name: Gorloc Ravager
text: Battlecry: Draw 3 Murlocs.
flavor: Be careful what you fish for.

name: Lady Naz'jar
text: While in your hand, this transforms after you cast a Fire, Frost, or Arcane spell.
flavor: Talk about an identity crisis.

name: Tuskarrrr Trawler
text: Battlecry: Dredge.
flavor: "Fish scales? Junk. A gravestone? Junk. This weird looking puzzle box? Junk. AHA! An Ancharrr!"

name: Excavation Specialist
text: Battlecry: Dredge. Reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: With the jungles of Un’goro mapped out and the ruins of Uldum fully uncovered, explorers have to go a little out of their depth in their search of the great unknown.

name: Azsharan Vessel
text: Summon two 3/3 Pirates with Stealth. Put a 'Sunken Vessel' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Not even the sturdiest Highborne ship could survive the churning waters of the Sundering.

name: Azsharan Trident
text: Deathrattle: Put a 'Sunken Trident' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Nevermind the barnacles! A well-crafted weapon is eternally useful.

name: Bone Glaive
text: Battlecry: Dredge.
flavor: Resourceful Demon Hunters find a use for every part of the Demon.

name: Gone Fishin'
text: Dredge. Combo: Draw a card.
flavor: Rogues want me Fish fear me

name: Blackscale Brute
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, summon a 5/6 Naga with Rush.
flavor: Black, the scales of angry Naga! Red, the flames of Azshari's past!

name: Azsharan Sentinel
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Put a 'Sunken Sentinel' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: For some, the Sundering was the collapse of civilization. For others, it was a great core workout.

name: Redgill Razorjaw
text: Rush
flavor: One fish, two fish, red fish replaces blue fish.

name: Azsharan Scavenger
text: Battlecry: Put a 'Sunken Scavenger' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Some local Murloc populations have adapted to survive in the harsh conditions of the ruins, much to the fascination of Sir Finley.

name: Anchored Totem
text: After you summon a 1-Cost minion, give it +2/+1.
flavor: The Naga devised the perfect retaliation to any pirates dropping anchor in their domain: vandalism.

name: Bioluminescence
text: Give your minions Spell Damage +1.
flavor: The perfect card for Spell Damage Shaman and Spelling Bee Shaman.

name: Abyssal Wave
text: Deal 4 damage to all minions. Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
flavor: Often followed up with a chasmic handshake.

name: Rock Bottom
text: Summon a 1/1 Murloc, then Dredge. If it's also a Murloc, summon one more.
flavor: I can't... *mrgglrg* understand... *mrgrllrg* your accent. *mrgrlrglr*

name: Smothering Starfish
text: Battlecry: Silence ALL other minions.
flavor: Is a sucker for small talk.

name: Azsharan Gardens
text: Give all minions in your hand +1/+1. Put a 'Sunken Gardens' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: That's not what I meant when I asked you to water the garden.

name: Security Automaton
text: After you summon a Mech, gain +1/+1.
flavor: Honestly, I feel less secure when it's around.

name: Emergency Maneuvers
text: Secret: When a friendly minion dies, summon a copy of it. It's Dormant for 1 turn.
flavor: DO A BARREL ROLL!

name: Wrathspine Enchanter
text: Battlecry: Cast a copy of a Fire, Frost, and Nature spell in your hand (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: If he could see, he might be better at targeting.

name: Schooling
text: Add three 1/1 Piranha Swarmers to your hand.
flavor: A group of Piranha are known as a Scholomance.

name: Click-Clocker
text: Divine Shield. Battlecry: Give a random Mech in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Allan please add details

name: Piranha Poacher
text: At the end of your turn, add a 1/1 Piranha Swarmer to your hand.
flavor: This snack certainly isn’t smiling back…

name: Radiance of Azshara
text: Fire Spell Damage +2 Your Nature spells cost (1) less. After you cast a Frost spell, gain 3 Armor.
flavor: Uses Arcane, Fire, and Frost magic to vanquish Queen Azshara's foes. And for her skincare routine!

name: Desecrated Graveyard
text: At the end of your turn, destroy your lowest Attack minion to summon a 4/4 Shade. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: People are dying to get in.

name: Iceblood Garrison
text: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all minions. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: On weekends, it hosts the local community theater rehearsals.

name: Blood in the Water
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Summon a 5/5 Shark with Rush.
flavor: Fish are friends, not food! Gilgoblins on the other hand…

name: Bootstrap Sunkeneer
text: Combo: Put an enemy minion on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Part of the deck, part of the crew.

name: Whirlpool
text: Destroy all minions and all copies of them (wherever they are).
flavor: In the southern hemisphere, it actually summons all minions instead.

name: Illuminate
text: Dredge. If it's a spell, reduce its Cost by (3).
flavor: BEHOLD THE GLORY OF A NEW CUP!

name: Whispers of the Deep
text: Silence a friendly minion, then deal damage equal to its Attack randomly split among all enemy minions.
flavor: And in the darkest of depths, the sailor heard a command from inside his own mind… “You will also buff my original card to 9 Mana.”

name: Handmaiden
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, draw 3 cards. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Why did she unspool the last roll of royal toilet paper?!

name: Queensguard
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each spell you've cast this turn.
flavor: Archnemesis of the Guardian of Kings.

name: Serpent Wig
text: Give a minion +1/+2. If you played a Naga while holding this, add a Serpent Wig to your hand.
flavor: Legends say that all those who look into her eyes are turned to plush.

name: Blackwater Behemoth
text: Colossal +1 Lifesteal
flavor: What's a Blackwater Behemoth's favorite meal? Fish n' Ships.

name: Pirate Admiral Hooktusk
text: Battlecry: If you've summoned 7 other Pirates this game, plunder the enemy!0 (X left!)0 (Ready!)
flavor: You win some, you ransom.

name: Selfish Shellfish
text: Deathrattle: Your opponent draws 2 cards.
flavor: Keeps any ancient book it finds all to its shelf.

name: Scalding Geyser
text: Deal 2 damage. Dredge.
flavor: ”Wow, what’s that land formation called?” “It s’cald a Geyser.”

name: Piranha Swarmer
text: Rush After you summon a Piranha Swarmer, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: One Fish, Two Fish. Less Fish? You wish.

name: Swiftscale Trickster
text: Battlecry: Your next spell this turn costs (0).
flavor: If you play your cards fast enough, who's to say how much they cost?

name: Crabatoa
text: Colossal +2 Your Crabatoa Claws have +2 Attack.
flavor: This giant crab loves to sink entire naval fleets, but it'll settle for a single dinghy in a pinch.

name: Field of Strife
text: Your minions have +1 Attack. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: I heard it's lovely there around this time of year.

name: Glugg the Gulper
text: Colossal +3 After a friendly minion dies, gain its original stats.
flavor: Food can be scarce in the Abyssal Depths, leading its top predators to pursue any potential source of sustenance. Even extra crunchy ones.

name: Stormpike Aid Station
text: At the end of your turn, give your minions +2 Health. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Known by some as the “Stormpike Naptime Lounge.”

name: Treasure Guard
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Draw a card.
flavor: The real treasure was the Naga we met along the way.

name: Reefwalker
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Piranha Swarmer.
flavor: A gentle giant with some not-so-gentle friends.

name: Forged in Flame
text: Destroy your weapon, then draw cards equal to its Attack.
flavor: Don't worry, your wounds are self-cauterizing!

name: From the Depths
text: Reduce the Cost of the bottom five cards in your deck by (3), then Dredge.
flavor: "This is why I'm afraid of the deep end of the pool."

name: Guard the City
text: Gain 3 Armor. Summon a 2/3 Naga with Taunt.
flavor: At thousands of feet below the surface, it's a pretty high-pressure job.

name: Obsidiansmith
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a minion or a weapon, give it +1/+1.
flavor: Was able to produce more effective weapons than his predecessor, Kelpsmith.

name: Lady Ashvane
text: Battlecry: Give all weapons in your hand, deck, and battlefield +1/+1.
flavor: This is your brain on Azerite.

name: School Teacher
text: Battlecry: Add a 1/1 Nagaling to your hand. Discover a spell that costs (3) or less to teach it.
flavor: She also tutors 3 Piranha Swarmers on her off hours.

name: The Fires of Zin-Azshari
text: Replace your deck with minions that cost (5) or more. They cost (5).
flavor: One heck of a hot tub.

name: Rainbow Glowscale
text: Spell Damage +1
flavor: She prefers saying that she has Arcane, Fel, Fire, Frost, Holy, Nature, and Shadow Spell Damage +1.

name: Mecha-Shark
text: After you summon a Mech, deal 3 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: "Why didn't you just build a normal submarine. Only you can fit inside" "WhY DiDn'T YoU JuSt BuIlD anormalsub-WHY DO YOU THINK WREZIG!! If you can build a freaking Mecha-Shark, then you build a freaking Mecha-Shark!"

name: Seafloor Gateway
text: Draw a Mech. Reduce the Cost of Mechs in your hand by (1).
flavor: It's all about e-fish-ency.

name: Volcanomancy
text: Choose a minion. When it dies, deal 3 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Do it again, this time with Pompeii and circumstance.

name: Azsharan Defector
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Put a 'Sunken Defector' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: "I've got a sinking feeling about this evil Queen."

name: Dun Baldar Bridge
text: After you summon a minion, give it +2/+2. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: At least there's no fall damage in Hearthstone.

name: Saidan the Scarlet
text: Rush. Whenever this minion gains Attack or Health, double that amount (wherever this is).
flavor: An orc mage accidentally kited him all the way from Stratholme.

name: Azsharan Saber
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Put a 'Sunken Saber' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Even in ancient times, the Night Elves were committed cat people.

name: Urchin Spines
text: Your spells this turn are Poisonous.
flavor: I shouldn't have licked that.

name: Queen Azshara
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, choose an Ancient Relic. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Hobbies include: Ordering subjects around, making deals with old gods, and taking long walks under the beach.

name: Spellcoiler
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, Discover a spell.
flavor: "Look, I know plenty of spells. I just need to see one first is all."

name: Trench Surveyor
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a Mech, draw it.
flavor: Liquid cooled.

name: Azsharan Mooncatcher
text: Divine Shield. Battlecry: Put a 'Sunken Mooncatcher' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: The light of Elune faded from the ruins of Zin-Azshari, but not its treasures.

name: Naga's Pride
text: Summon two 2/2 Lionfish. If you played a Naga while holding this, give them +1/+1.
flavor: Lionfish, Naga, and Spears, oh my!

name: Gifts of Azshara
text: Draw a card. If you played a Naga while holding this, do it again.
flavor: Barber: What do you want? Naga: You ever have a thirst for arcane power? Barber: Say no more.

name: Stormcoil Mothership
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon two random Mechs that cost (3) or less.
flavor: Has been known to abduct sea cows and leave kelp circles.

name: Seascout Operator
text: Battlecry: If you control a Mech, summon two 2/1 Mechafish.
flavor: The Mechafish are actually totally autonomous. We gave her a fake control pad, as a joke.

name: Hydralodon
text: Colossal +2 Battlecry: Give your Hydralodon Heads Rush.
flavor: Deep beneath the waves, this hydra grew to incredible size based on a steady diet of literally anything that crossed its path.

name: Pelican Diver
text: Dormant for 1 turn. Rush
flavor: The pelican’s beak is so big, some Colossal minions can even fit inside!* *This is a lie.

name: Coral Keeper
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/3 Elemental for each spell school you've cast this game.
flavor: This here is Carl. They're in charge of these elementals. Not all of them get along, so sometimes Carl corrals the quarreling coral.

name: Predation
text: Deal 2 damage. Costs (0) if you played a Naga while holding this.
flavor: No need to worry! The squid is actually being sent to a nice kelp farm upstate.

name: Ini Stormcoil
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Mech. Summon a copy of it with Rush, Windfury, and Divine Shield.
flavor: Before setting her sights on exploration, Ini was known for many inventions, such as the airborne breadmaking dirigible, the hypersprocket 200X zoom binoculars, and jobes (jean robes).

name: Holy Maki Roll
text: Restore 2 Health. Repeatable this turn.
flavor: If you use all 10 mana, that's called the 'Lunch Special.'

name: Myrmidon
text: After you cast a spell on this minion, draw a card.
flavor: He didn't have time to Myrmidon the other half of his armor before combat started.

name: Bubblebot
text: Battlecry: Give your other Mechs Divine Shield and Taunt.
flavor: Bubblebot, bubble bubble bubblebot.

name: Shimmering Sunfish
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Holy spell, gain Taunt and Divine Shield.
flavor: Just keep shimmering, just keep shimmering.

name: The Garden's Grace
text: Give a minion +4/+4 and Divine Shield. Costs (1) less for each Mana you've spent on Holy spells this game.
flavor: The perfect place to hold Conchella.

name: Sira'kess Cultist
text: Battlecry: Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
flavor: "Sira'kess, she's the best! Puts her followers to the test.

name: Dragged Below
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
flavor: I know this is a frustrating situation you’re in, Captain, but there’s no need to curse.

name: Chum Bucket
text: Give all Murlocs in your hand +1/+1. Repeat for each Murloc you control.
flavor: Time to go in for the krill.

name: Herald of Shadows
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Shadow spell while holding this, steal 2 Health from a minion.
flavor: “IT’S NOT A PHASE, MOM!”

name: Za'qul
text: Your Abyssal Curses heal you for the damage they deal. Battlecry: Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
flavor: Everything’s going exzaq’ully to plan.

name: Axe Berserker
text: Rush. Honorable Kill: Draw a weapon.
flavor: All the body spray went to her head.

name: Flipper Friends
text: Choose One - Summon a 6/6 Orca with Taunt; or six 1/1 Otters with Rush.
flavor: Despite the harsh conditions, friends can still be found under the sea.

name: Seaweed Strike
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. If you played a Naga while holding this, also give your hero +4 Attack this turn.
flavor: Even as mechs, fish will still end up wrapped in seaweed.

name: Green-Thumb Gardener
text: Battlecry: Refresh empty Mana Crystals equal to the Cost of the highest Cost spell in your hand.
flavor: Sometimes all a plant needs is, like, A LOT of water.

name: Bottomfeeder
text: Deathrattle: Add a Bottomfeeder to the bottom of your deck with permanent +2/+2.
flavor: Someone keeps adding fish to my deck, and I'm going to get to the bottom of it.

name: Miracle Growth
text: Draw 3 cards. Summon a Plant with Taunt and stats equal to your hand size.
flavor: I’ve got NO idea what’s in that fertilizer.

name: Frostwolf Kennels
text: At the end of your turn, summon a 2/2 Wolf with Stealth. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: The 1 reason Alliance members defect to the Horde is to adopt a cute frostwolf puppy.

name: Dozing Kelpkeeper
text: Rush. Starts Dormant. After you've cast 5 Mana worth of spells, awaken.
flavor: *Yaaaaawn* wake me up in another 5 Mana.

name: Hedra the Heretic
text: Battlecry: For each spell you've cast while holding this, summon a minion of that spell's Cost.
flavor: Hedra was cast out millennia ago for her divisive opinions among the Naga, such as "Turning into evil underwater serpent people was bad, actually."

name: Wayward Sage
text: Outcast: Reduce the Cost of the left and right-most cards in your hand by (1).
flavor: Carry on my wayward sage. There'll be peace and no more rage.

name: Lady S'theno
text: Immune while attacking. After you cast a spell, attack the lowest Health enemy.
flavor: Only a S'theno deals in absolutes.

name: Xhilag of the Abyss
text: Colossal +4 At the start of your turn, increase the damage of Xhilag's Stalks by 1.
flavor: When ancient heroes drove a felhunter into the sea, they thought it was the end. But for Xhilag, it was only the beginning...

name: Aquatic Form
text: Dredge. If you have the Mana to play the card this turn, draw it.
flavor: How long can YOU hold your breath underwater?

name: Slithering Deathscale
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, deal 3 damage to all enemies. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Colossal minions know her better as Slithering Damagescale.

name: Helmet Hermit
text: Can't attack.
flavor: I’d avoid asking if it wants to join the battle. It’s been pretty crabby lately.

name: Amalgam of the Deep
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly minion. Discover a minion of the same minion type.
flavor: Most explorers call it a success to find just one new species. Imagine Finley's excitement when he identified ten at once!

name: Twin-fin Fin Twin
text: Rush. Battlecry: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: They call him Murloc Joe, winner of the Big M Memorial Surf Off Competition.

name: Trenchstalker
text: Battlecry: Attack three different random enemies.
flavor: Cooler heads prevail.

name: Gigafin
text: Colossal +1. Battlecry: Devour all enemy minions. Deathrattle: Spit them back out.
flavor: How much storage does Gigafin's Maw have? About a giga bite.

name: Harpoon Gun
text: After your hero attacks, Dredge. If it's a Beast, reduce its Cost by (2).
flavor: Get ooooover here!

name: Twinbow Terrorcoil
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, your next spell casts twice.
flavor: Two shots. Two kills.

name: Conch's Call
text: Draw a Naga and a spell.
flavor: All hail the magic conch!

name: Raj Naz'jan
text: After you cast a spell, deal damage equal to its Cost to the enemy Hero.
flavor: When you play the Coin, he deals emotional damage.

name: Filletfighter
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage.
flavor: "What do you mean this isn't the meal you asked for?! I made you a Fillet Minion!"

name: Nellie, the Great Thresher
text: Colossal +1 Battlecry: Discover 3 Pirates to crew Nellie's Ship!
flavor: Not to be mistaken for her freshwater cousin, Nessie, this massive creature was harnessed to carry Hooktusk's favorite ship.

name: Ambassador Faelin
text: Battlecry: Put 3 Colossal minions on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: For thousands of years, Faelin has longed to return to his homeland. Will Zin-Azshari be as he hopes, or are the secrets of the deep better left forgotten?

name: Disarming Elemental
text: Battlecry: Dredge for your opponent. Set its Cost to (6).
flavor: "You can have these back when you learn to play nice."

name: Topple the Idol
text: Dredge. Reveal it and deal damage equal to its Cost to all minions.
flavor: No Old Gods or Kings, only Naga.

name: Fossil Fanatic
text: After your hero attacks, draw a Fel spell.
flavor: Praise Lord Helix!

name: Herald of Chaos
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: If you've cast a Fel spell while holding this, gain Rush.
flavor: They used to be called the Heralds of Order before all of this silly Sundering nonsense.

name: Submerged Spacerock
text: Deathrattle: Add two Arcane Mage spells to your hand. They are Temporary.
flavor: Time for some out of this world RNG.

name: Polymorph: Jellyfish
text: Transform a minion into a 4/1 Jellyfish with Spell Damage +2.
flavor: While Ini’s first use of the Spontaneous Gelatin Transmalgamizer may have gotten her banned from the Gnomish Cooking Convention, she’s never one to throw away a new invention.

name: Spirit of the Tides
text: If you have any unspent Mana at the end of your turn, gain +1/+2.
flavor: Cleans the ocean better than any store-brand competitor - guaranteed or your Mana back!

name: Herald of Nature
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Nature spell while holding this, give your other minions +1/+1.
flavor: A mother of plants in mother of pearl.

name: Snapdragon
text: Battlecry: Give all Battlecry minions in your deck +1/+1.
flavor: Good synergy with Crackledragon, not so much with Popdragon.

name: Ozumat
text: Colossal +6 Deathrattle: For each of Ozumat's Tentacles, destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Deathrattle: You'll be octo-sorry.

name: Neptulon the Tidehunter
text: Colossal +2, Rush, Windfury Whenever Neptulon attacks, if you control any Hands, they attack instead.
flavor: Neptulon, tired of filling hands, is now throwing hands.

name: Tidelost Burrower
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a Murloc, summon a 2/2 copy of it.
flavor: Burrowing may not be for everyone, but I dig it.

name: Clownfish
text: Battlecry: Your next two Murlocs cost (2) less.
flavor: His jokes are hilarious if you know Nerglish.

name: Command of Neptulon
text: Summon two 5/4 Elementals with Rush. Overload: (1)
flavor: "REVENANT TO F6. CHECKMATE, OZUMAT!"

name: Igneous Lavagorger
text: Taunt Battlecry: Dredge. Gain Armor equal to its Cost.
flavor: Lava shark, doo doo doo doo doo doo.

name: Clash of the Colossals
text: Add a random Colossal minion to both players' hands. Yours costs (2) less.
flavor: Don’t let this distract you from the fact that in 1998, Ozumat threw Neptulon off Shell in a Cell, and plummeted 16 fathoms through an announcer’s table.

name: Tidal Revenant
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage. Gain 8 Armor.
flavor: A big minion that clears the board and gains Armor? Wow, Warrior is really in their element now.

name: Immolate
text: Light every card in the opponent's hand on fire. In 3 turns, any still in hand are destroyed!
flavor: "Well if you cared about those cards so much, why didn't you play them?"

name: Commander Ulthok
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's cards cost Health instead of Mana next turn.
flavor: He likes to spend his free time in his garden, growing Bloodradish, Bloodcabbage, and his favorite, Bloodbloom.

name: Suspicious Alchemist
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: Side effects may include feeling totally fine! Don't even worry about it.

name: Scuttlebutt Ghoul
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you control a Secret, summon a copy of this.
flavor: No 'if's, 'and's, or 'scuttlebutt's'!

name: Dispossessed Soul
text: Battlecry: If you control a location, Discover a copy of a card in your deck.
flavor: I'm afraid it came as a great shock to her when she died.

name: Sire Denathrius
text: Lifesteal. Battlecry: Deal 5 damage amongst enemies. Endlessly Infuse (2): Deal 1 more.
flavor: History has a way of altering villains so that we can no longer see ourselves in them. Unfortunately for the Venthyr, they all look like Sire Denathrius.

name: Suspicious Pirate
text: Battlecry: Discover a weapon. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: EVERY party should be a costume party.

name: Suspicious Usher
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: "Oh please, let me take your jacket, luggage, and absurdly large shoulder pads."

name: Forsaken Lieutenant
text: Stealth. After you play a Deathrattle minion, become a 2/2 copy of it with Rush.
flavor: WE didn’t forsake him. He CHOSE to defend a tower against the entire Alliance front line by himself.

name: Moonbeam
text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy, twice.
flavor: The light of the moon may have disappeared from Zin-Azshari after the Sundering, but not its power.

name: K9-0tron
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a 1-Cost minion, summon it.
flavor: You merely adopted the Battlegrounds. I was born in it. Molded by it.

name: Ancient Krakenbane
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, deal 5 damage. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: "Call me Fishmael."

name: Shellshot
text: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion. Repeat this with 1 less damage.
flavor: Precision over accuracy.

name: Radar Detector
text: Scan the bottom 5 cards of your deck. Draw any Mechs found this way, then shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Yup! I definitely don't know how to read radar."

name: Lightray
text: Taunt Costs (1) less for each Paladin card you've played this game.
flavor: Lightrays, much like rays of light, tend to be seen closer to the surface.

name: Shattershambler
text: Battlecry: Your next Deathrattle minion costs (1) less, but immediately dies when played.
flavor: Someone didn’t realize the ‘cold, black heart’ thing was supposed to be a metaphor.

name: Inkveil Ambusher
text: Stealth Has +3 Attack and Immune while attacking.
flavor: You’ve got it wrong. She releases ink when you’re scared.

name: Herald of Light
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Holy spell while holding this, restore 6 Health to all friendly characters.
flavor: Wake up! No sleeping in with the fishes!

name: Tome Tampering
text: Shuffle 1-Cost copies of cards in your hand into your deck, then discard your hand.
flavor: An overdue book calls for a do-over.

name: Suffocating Shadows
text: When you play or discard this, destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: "Reading is good for you," they said.

name: Bloodscent Vilefin
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a Murloc, change its Cost to Health instead of Mana.
flavor: Tired of eating Jellyfish and Peanut Butter fish, it’s moved on to more gruesome meals.

name: Creepy Painting
text: After another minion dies, become a copy of it.
flavor: I do not like this painting, Harth. Its smug aura mocks me.

name: Carving Chisel
text: After your hero attacks, summon a random basic Totem.
flavor: Look at your stone. Visualize the totem within. Then gently...

name: Convincing Disguise
text: Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (2) more. Infuse (4): Transform all friendly minions instead.
flavor: Okay gang, let's see who's really under the mask… *gasp* Old Man Bru'kan!?

name: The Stonewright
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Totems have +2 Attack.
flavor: She wrights stone better than she reads it.

name: Muck Pools
text: Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (1) more.
flavor: Making a dredger is easier than you'd think. You don't need to worry about mucking it up!

name: Primordial Wave
text: Transform enemy minions into ones that cost (1) less and friendly minions into ones that cost (1) more.
flavor: A primordial hello to you too!

name: Theotar, the Mad Duke
text: Battlecry: Discover a card in each player's hand and swap them.
flavor: "I'm afraid you've gone mad! You're entirely bonkers. But I'll tell you a secret. All the best souls are."

name: Baroness Vashj
text: If this would transform into a minion, summon that minion instead.
flavor: Vashj was supposed to make an appearance in "The Sunken City," but after a freak accident in "Ashes of Outland," she ended up here.

name: Azsharan Sweeper
text: Battlecry: Put a 'Sunken Sweeper' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: The enchanted objects of Zin-Azshari have extremely long warranties.

name: Seafloor Savior
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a minion, give it this minion's Attack and Health.
flavor: "TURTLE PROCURED. ADMINISTRATING BANDAGES AND KISSES. BOO BOO MUST BE ELIMINATED."

name: Framester
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 3 'Framed' cards into the opponent's deck. When drawn, they Overload for (2).
flavor: "Who put these beans in my pocket?!" -Man With Beans in Pocket

name: Impending Catastrophe
text: Draw a card. Repeat for each Imp you control.
flavor: The imps end you, and the cats... well, they astrophe.

name: Mischievous Imp
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this. Infuse (3): Summon two copies instead.
flavor: Why is it when something happens, it is always you three?

name: Flustered Librarian
text: Has +1 Attack for each Imp you control.
flavor: A fairly sIMPle card.

name: Double Cross
text: Secret: When your opponent spends all their Mana, draw two cards.
flavor: Valeera revealed herself to be a double agent. At which point Maiev felt comfortable revealing that she also was a double agent. And then Scabbs announced to everybody that - get this - he was a double agent.

name: Private Eye
text: Battlecry: Cast a Secret from your deck. Combo: Cast 2 instead.
flavor: Eye see what you did there.

name: Sticky Situation
text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a 3/4 Spider with Stealth.
flavor: "Now this is what I'd call..." "...just shut up."

name: Kidnap
text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, stuff it in a 0/4 Sack.
flavor: Check your coat, but don't check the coat closet.

name: Halkias
text: Stealth. Deathrattle: Store Halkias's soul inside of a friendly Secret. It resummons Halkias when triggered.
flavor: Everybody tough until the sinstones start walking.

name: Cutlass Courier
text: After your hero attacks, draw a Pirate.
flavor: It may be a cutlass, but you can cut lads with it too.

name: Azsharan Scroll
text: Discover a Fire, Frost or Nature spell. Put a 'Sunken Scroll' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Kids these days are always scrolling on their tomes.

name: Swordfish
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a Pirate, give this weapon and the Pirate +2 Attack.
flavor: While you were partying, I studied the fish.

name: Crazed Wretch
text: Has +2 Attack and Charge while damaged.
flavor: Enrage is all the rage.

name: Conqueror's Banner
text: Reveal a card from each player's deck, three times. Draw any of yours that cost more.
flavor: Olgra, I love your new tapestry! Where did you get it?

name: Mysterious Visitor
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of cards copied from your opponent by (2).
flavor: Dave, we can tell this letter is fake - it's in your handwriting. And take off that stupid hood, you're embarrassing us.

name: Partner in Crime
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this minion at the end of your turn.
flavor: "You know what we need? Some rope." "That's stupid. Name one thing you'd need a rope for."

name: Boon of the Ascended
text: Give a minion +2 Health. Summon a Kyrian with its stats and Taunt.
flavor: Ascension is not some external power granted to you, it is the power you find within yourself.

name: The Light! It Burns!
text: Deal damage to a minion equal to its Attack.
flavor: Wait, if you're over there, then who's messing with the lights?!

name: Pelagos
text: After you cast a spell on a friendly minion, set its Attack and Health to the higher of the two.
flavor: He's a great judge of character.

name: Sinrunner
text: Deathrattle: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Blanchy was said to be an affectionate and well-behaved horse in life. How she ended up in Revendreth? We're too afraid to ask.

name: Imbued Axe
text: After your hero attacks, give your damaged minions +1/+2. Infuse (2): +2/+2 instead.
flavor: Technically it's a Yet-to-be-Imbued Axe.

name: Decimator Olgra
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each damaged minion, then attack all enemies.
flavor: FOUND HER!

name: Party Favor Totem
text: At the end of your turn, summon a random basic Totem. Infuse (2): Summon two instead.
flavor: It's the gift (totem) that keeps on giving (totems)!

name: Identity Theft
text: Discover a copy of a card from your opponent's hand and deck.
flavor: Identity theft is not a joke, Jim!

name: Clean the Scene
text: Destroy all minions with 3 or less Attack. Infuse (3): 6 or less.
flavor: Not even the holy Light can get anima out of white silk.

name: Azsharan Ritual
text: Silence a minion and summon a copy of it. Put a 'Sunken Ritual' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: The harmonious silence surrounding the ritual was unceremoniously BROKEN when HAROLD began eating stale potato chips.

name: Crud Caretaker
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/5 Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: All it takes is a little love and a LOT of junk!

name: Artificer Xy'mox
text: Battlecry: Discover and cast a Relic. Infuse (5): Cast all three instead.
flavor: "The anticipation to use this relic is killing me! Though, it will more likely kill you."

name: Incarceration
text: Choose a minion. It goes Dormant for 3 turns.
flavor: To Blizzard jail with you!

name: Natural Causes
text: Deal 2 damage. Summon a 2/2 Treant.
flavor: What if the suspect was framed? What if the murder weapon was... a plant?

name: Maze Guide
text: Battlecry: Summon a random 2-Cost minion.
flavor: "And if you look to your left, you'll see an even larger statue of Sire Denathrius!"

name: Death Blossom Whomper
text: Battlecry: Draw a Deathrattle minion and gain its Deathrattle.
flavor: We call her Audrey II. She was named after her mother.

name: Door of Shadows
text: Draw a spell. Infuse (2): Add a Temporary copy of it to your hand.
flavor: Upon arrival, please ring the doorbell of shadows, and wipe your shoes on the doormat of shadows before entering.

name: Serrated Bone Spike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, your next card this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: Draka, in an attempt to help, threw them a bone.

name: Necrolord Draka
text: Battlecry: Equip a 1/3 Dagger. (+1 Attack for each other card you played this turn, up to 10!)
flavor: We originally planned on giving Rogue a Legendary minion called "The Moon", but SOMEONE jumped in the frame.

name: Nightshade Bud
text: Choose One - Discover a minion from your deck to summon; or a spell to cast.
flavor: It actually thrives in partial sunlight.

name: Commander Sivara
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, add those spells back to your hand. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: With six legs, gills, and an impressive array of magic, Sivara is an all-terrain-spellcaster.

name: Relic Vault
text: The next Relic you play this turn casts twice.
flavor: Holds Sire Denathrius' most prized possession - his teddy bear, Jeremy Bearimy.

name: Relic of Phantasms
text: Summon two 1/1 Spirits. Improve your future Relics.
flavor: Xy'mox chuckled. "You mean the Chaos Emerald?"

name: Solid Alibi
text: Until your next turn, your hero can only take 1 damage at a time.
flavor: That pillow knows too much…

name: Planted Evidence
text: Discover a spell. It costs (2) less this turn.
flavor: So you're telling me this wasn't Natural Causes?

name: Cold Case
text: Summon two 2/2 Volatile Skeletons. Gain 4 Armor.
flavor: And that's why you keep your skeletons in your closet instead of your freezer.

name: Topior the Shrubbagazzor
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, after you cast a Nature spell, summon a 3/3 Whelp with Rush.
flavor: They got a dragon that burns 1000 gallons of anima a week.

name: Remornia, Living Blade
text: Rush After this attacks, equip it.
flavor: Was it the lead pipe... the candlestick... or the unhinged, sentient, bloodthirsty sword?

name: Sketchy Stranger
text: Battlecry: Discover a Secret from another class.
flavor: More of a 'Painted Stranger' if you ask me.

name: Widowbloom Seedsman
text: Battlecry: Draw a Nature spell. Gain an empty Mana Crystal.
flavor: Sometimes a blue thumb is better than a green one.

name: Steamcleaner
text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
flavor: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!

name: Muckborn Servant
text: Taunt Battlecry: Discover a Paladin card.
flavor: Party guests never tip as well as the patrons in Bob's tavern.

name: Service Bell
text: Discover a Class card from your deck and draw all copies of it.
flavor: The bell tolls for us! Waiter, we need more water!

name: Divine Toll
text: Shoot 5 rays at random minions. They give friendly minions +2/+2, and deal 2 damage to enemy minions.
flavor: Never send to know for whom the bell tolls.

name: The Countess
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, add 3 Legendary Invitations to your hand.
flavor: 3 Legendary Invitations, AH AH AH!

name: Sinful Brand
text: Brand an enemy minion. Whenever it takes damage, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: My brand!

name: Kotori Lightblade
text: After you cast a Holy spell on this, cast it again on another friendly minion.
flavor: You need healing.

name: Dispose of Evidence
text: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Pick from 3 cards in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
flavor: Just because you did it doesn't mean you have to be guilty.

name: Relic of Dimensions
text: Draw two cards and reduce their Cost by (1). Improve your future Relics.
flavor: A glaive is a glaive, but a mystery box could be anything! It could even be a glaive!

name: Magnifying Glaive
text: After your hero attacks, draw until you have 3 cards.
flavor: Vengeance!

name: Kryxis the Voracious
text: Battlecry: Discard your hand. Deathrattle: Draw 3 cards.
flavor: Tried intermittent fasting. It didn't stick.

name: Muck Plumber
text: ALL minions cost (2) more.
flavor: If you drink muck, you go to the Maw before you die.

name: Anima Extractor
text: Whenever a friendly minion takes damage, give a random minion in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: After we are done you're welcome to help yourself to cookies and apple juice. Thank you for your donation!

name: Sinful Sous Chef
