text: Deathrattle: Add 2 Silver Hand Recruits to your hand.
flavor: If this dinner party goes well, she thinks she has a good shot at being on Fel's Kitchen.

name: Order in the Court
text: Reorder your deck from highest Cost to lowest Cost. Draw a card.
flavor: "I have nothing BUT contempt for this court!"

name: Jury Duty
text: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits. Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1/+1.
flavor: The most criminal thing about paladins is that they actually like jury duty.

name: Stewart the Steward
text: Deathrattle: Give the next Silver Hand Recruit you summon +3/+3 and this Deathrattle.
flavor: How many bites does it take to get the center of an hors d'oeuvre?

name: Bibliomite
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
flavor: He did NOT want to cast a spell.

name: Priest of the Deceased
text: Taunt Infuse (3): Gain +2/+2.
flavor: "Funnel cakes? I haven't had those in years…"

name: Murlocula
text: Lifesteal Infuse (4): This costs (0).
flavor: The best part of Murlocula is when he said "IT'S MRRGLIN' TIME" and totally mrrgled those guys.

name: Buffet Biggun
text: Battlecry: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits. Infuse (3): Give them +2 Attack and Divine Shield.
flavor: "Look, I just want to know what kind of monster put raisins in this."

name: Frostmourne
text: Deathrattle: Summon every minion killed by this weapon.
flavor: Death Nights, Frost Morn, what's next - Blood Noon?

name: Hedge Maze
text: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle.
flavor: If you keep seeing a statue of the Sire, you’re not going in circles. There’s just so many of them.

name: Burden of Pride
text: Summon three 1/3 Jailers with Taunt. If you have 20 or less Health, give them +1/+1.
flavor: A group of burdens is called a pride.

name: Plot of Sin
text: Summon two 2/2 Treants. Infuse (5): Two 5/5 Ancients instead.
flavor: It's a great plot, but it's riddled with holes.

name: Riot!
text: Your minions can't be reduced below 1 Health this turn. They each attack a random enemy minion.
flavor: No, Blizzard!

name: Frenzied Fangs
text: Summon two 2/1 Bats. Infuse (3): Give them +1/+2.
flavor: That's one stylish bat.

name: Roosting Gargoyle
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Beast +2 Attack.
flavor: Jalapeñas!

name: Stonebound Gargon
text: Rush Infuse (3): Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: Really good at "stay."

name: Huntsman Altimor
text: Battlecry: Summon a Gargon Companion. Infuse (X): Summon another. Infuse (X): And another!
flavor: He loves all his Gargons equally. (Hecutis is his favorite and it's not close.)

name: Batty Guest
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/1 Bat.
flavor: His favorite food is chocolate cereal.

name: Ghastly Gravedigger
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, choose a card in your opponent's hand to shuffle into their deck.
flavor: Some people take their secrets to the grave.

name: Soulbreaker
text: After your hero attacks and kills a minion, gain 2 Corpses.
flavor: Two for one special!

name: Howling Blast
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy and Freeze it. Deal 1 damage to all other enemies.
flavor: For Death Knights, yelling really loudly is a valid attack strategy.

name: Plague Strike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, summon a 2/2 Zombie with Rush.
flavor: Not wanting to infect anyone with his cold, the Death Knight politely coughed into his shoulder.

name: Death Strike
text: Lifesteal Deal 6 damage to a minion.
flavor: A little embarrassing when used on large minions.

name: Frost Strike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, Discover a Frost Rune card.
flavor: Anyone up for some frost bowling?

name: Shatterskin Gargoyle
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Don't worry, this one's just a statue.

name: Corpse Explosion
text: Detonate a Corpse to deal 1 damage to all minions. If any are still alive, repeat this.
flavor: What? It's not like they were using them anymore.

name: Icy Touch
text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy and Freeze it.
flavor: Vibe check.

name: Horn of Winter
text: Refresh 2 Mana Crystals.
flavor: Much better than the Horn of Loseter.

name: Anti-Magic Shell
text: Give your minions +1/+1 and Elusive.
flavor: Using a spell to counter magic - a bit hypocritical don't you think?

name: Vampiric Blood
text: Give your hero +5 Health. Spend 3 Corpses to gain 5 more and draw a card.
flavor: BLEH, BLEH BLEH!

name: Unholy Frenzy
text: Choose an enemy minion. Your minions attack it. Resummon any that die.
flavor: GROUP HUG!

name: Dark Transformation
text: Transform an Undead into a 4/5 Undead Monstrosity with Rush.
flavor: The Northrend Arm Wrestling Championship just found its new champion.

name: Army of the Dead
text: Raise up to 5 Corpses as 2/2 Risen Ghouls with Rush.
flavor: Yesterday's army, today.

name: Battlefield Necromancer
text: At the end of your turn, raise a Corpse as a 1/3 Risen Footman with Taunt.
flavor: Coming soon: the Hand Necromancer and the Deck Necromancer.

name: Nerubian Swarmguard
text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon two copies of this minion.
flavor: How long can this go on? Apparently even in death.

name: Frostwyrm's Fury
text: Deal 5 damage. Freeze all enemy minions. Summon a 5/5 Frostwyrm.
flavor: Terrible destruction, but minty fresh breath!

name: Hematurge
text: Battlecry: Spend a Corpse to Discover a Blood Rune card.
flavor: She's here to PUMP! YOU UP!

name: Corrupted Ashbringer
text: Lifesteal
flavor: Put your faith in the blight!

name: Imp King Rafaam
text: Battlecry: Resurrect four friendly Imps. Infuse (5): Give your Imps +2/+2.
flavor: Not even death can stop Rafaam from pursuing a life of crime.

name: Chatty Bartender
text: At the end of your turn, if you control a Secret, deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: "So a Venthyr, an Old God, and a Tauren walk into a bar…"

name: Dredger Staff
text: Battlecry: Give minions in your hand +1 Health.
flavor: The dredger staff held the dredger knife and said, "Dredger bow before the Sire!"

name: Ashen Elemental
text: Battlecry: Whenever your opponent draws a card next turn, they take 2 damage.
flavor: "The castle was nice but the fireplaces were too small - 2/5 stars"

name: Sesselie of the Fae Court
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Draw a minion. Reduce its Cost by (8).
flavor: They claim they're from the Fae Court, but that might be a Fae Kout.

name: Elitist Snob
text: Battlecry: For each Paladin card in your hand, randomly gain Divine Shield, Lifesteal, Rush, or Taunt.
flavor: "I heard the Sire invited a Murloc! How dreadful!"

name: Kel'Thuzad, the Inevitable
text: Battlecry: Resurrect your Volatile Skeletons. Any that can't fit on the battlefield instantly explode! 0
flavor: Looks like Kel'Thuzad is borrowing some of Mr. Bigglesworth's nine lives.

name: Orion, Mansion Manager
text: After a friendly Secret is revealed, cast a different Mage Secret and gain +2/+2.
flavor: The secrets of the universe are vast... and will be revealed sometime later this game.

name: The Harvester of Envy
text: After you play a card copied from the opponent, steal the original.
flavor: "Ah, permission shmermission! You can borrow anything you want, anytime, as long as if you give it back before it's missed. Everyone knows that! Right?"

name: Spirit Poacher
text: Battlecry: Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: Always poach from your local spirit shelter.

name: Wild Spirits
text: Summon two different Dormant Wildseeds. Make your Wildseeds awaken 1 turn sooner.
flavor: Wait, this card just released! It should be Standard Spirits!

name: Castle Kennels
text: Give a friendly minion +2 Attack. If it's a Beast, give it Rush.
flavor: Play dead! Oh…

name: Ara'lon
text: Battlecry: Summon one of each Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: If I had a nickel for every time a Hunter Legendary minion in Castle Nathria summoned three different companions, I'd have two nickels - which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice.

name: Stag Charge
text: Deal 3 damage. Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: Stag! You’re it!

name: Relic of Extinction
text: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion, twice. Improve your future Relics.
flavor: Faster than an asteroid, and just as effective.

name: Vengeful Visage
text: Secret: After an enemy minion attacks your hero, summon a copy of it to attack the enemy hero.
flavor: The mirror shows us nothing less than the deepest, darkest desire of our hearts: to go face.

name: Convoke the Spirits
text: Cast 8 random Druid spells (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: The spirits prefer to convoke when there's some hot gossip to discuss.

name: Gigantotem
text: Costs (1) less for each Totem you've summoned this game.
flavor: Totem Golem's uncle, gone too soon.

name: Sinstone Totem
text: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Health.
flavor: This one's heavier than the wooden totems. Mostly from the weight of your sins.

name: Party Crasher
text: Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion. Throw a random minion from your hand at it.
flavor: "Do you ever wonder why you don't get invited anywhere?" "… no, not really."

name: Infected Peasant
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Undead Peasant.
flavor: The peasants are revolting!

name: Deathchiller
text: After you cast a spell, deal 1 damage to two random enemies.
flavor: Man, death is like the most chill state... you've got nothing to do but relax.

name: Shadow Waltz
text: Summon a 3/5 Shadow with Taunt. If a minion died this turn, summon another.
flavor: They're dancing to one of Rin's demonic symphonies. Her music might not be famous now, but just you wait!

name: Lady Darkvein
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Shades. Each gains a Deathrattle to cast your last Shadow spell.
flavor: You're so vein. I bet you think this flavor text is about you.

name: Shadowborn
text: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of the highest Cost Shadow spell in your hand by (3).
flavor: You merely adopted the shadows; I was born in them!

name: Vile Library
text: Give a friendly minion +1/+1. Repeat for each Imp you control.
flavor: What type of vial library has 0 vials in it!?

name: Deathborne
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton for each killed.
flavor: Kel'Thuzad thinks adding a silent 'e' at the end of words makes them sound cooler.

name: Anonymous Informant
text: Battlecry: The next Secret you play costs (0).
flavor: It turns out she wasn't so great at keeping secrets after all.

name: Asphyxiate
text: Destroy the highest Attack enemy minion.
flavor: I find your abundance of Attack disturbing.

name: Criminal Lineup
text: Choose a friendly minion. Summon 3 copies of it. Overload: (2)
flavor: Number 1, could you please sing the opening to "I Want It That Way"?

name: Stoneborn General
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon an 8/8 Gravewing with Rush.
flavor: Leads with an iron fist and a stony demeanor.

name: Invitation Courier
text: After a card is added to your hand from another class, copy it.
flavor: Sending mail via steward is soooo old school.

name: Imp-oster
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Imp. Transform into a copy of it.
flavor: There is an imposter among us.

name: Arson Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after your hero takes damage.
flavor: We didn't start the fire!

name: Habeas Corpses
text: Discover a friendly minion to resurrect and give it Rush. It dies at the end of turn.
flavor: Whoops, typo!

name: Totemic Evidence
text: Choose a basic Totem and summon it. Infuse (3 Totems): Summon all 4 instead.
flavor: Every totem is evidence of a tree's murder.

name: Soul Seeker
text: Battlecry: Swap this with a random minion from your opponent's deck.
flavor: The Soul Seeker's job is to look for a snitch.

name: Objection!
text: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion, Counter it.
flavor: "Sire, this is a Sindy's."

name: Sightless Magistrate
text: Battlecry: Both players draw until they have 5 cards.
flavor: Does "Justice is Blind" still apply with Spectral Sight?

name: Shadehound
text: Whenever this attacks, give your other Beasts +2/+2. Infuse (3 Beasts): Gain Rush.
flavor: This Shadehound wasn't just a good boy. He was the best.

name: Motion Denied
text: Secret: After your opponent plays three cards in a turn, deal 6 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: DO NOT PASS GO. DO NOT COLLECT 200 GOLD.

name: Defense Attorney Nathanos
text: Battlecry: Discover a friendly Deathrattle minion that died this game. Gain its Deathrattle and then trigger it.
flavor: "Your Honor, my client was simply trying a new tree trimming technique!"

name: Bog Beast
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/4 Muckmare with Taunt.
flavor: I'm sure at least one of those bones is from an actual beast.

name: Stoneborn Accuser
text: Infuse (5): Gain "Battlecry: Deal 5 damage."
flavor: "I SAW THEM VENT, I SWEAR!"

name: Red Herring
text: Taunt Your non-Red Herring minions have Stealth.
flavor: He's got gill-ty written all over him!

name: Masked Reveler
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 copy of another minion in your deck.
flavor: "It's party time! P-A-R-T-Why? Because I gotta!"

name: Crooked Cook
text: At the end of your turn, if you dealt 3 or more damage to the enemy hero, draw a card.
flavor: There are many things not called poison which can kill a man. But in this case, it is poison.

name: Insatiable Devourer
text: Battlecry: Devour an enemy minion and gain its stats. Infuse (5): And its neighbors.
flavor: You're not you when you're anima-starved.

name: All Fel Breaks Loose
text: Summon a friendly Demon that died this game. Infuse (3 Demons): Summon three instead.
flavor: Maybe we should have made the bars closer together…

name: Life Sentence
text: Remove a minion from the game.
flavor: Also sentenced to laugh and love.

name: Prosecutor Mel'tranix
text: Battlecry: Your opponent can only play their left- and right-most cards on their next turn.
flavor: "Your Honor. The Defense isn't a clown, he's the whole circus."

name: Class Action Lawyer
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, set a minion's stats to 1/1.
flavor: "Have you or a loved one ever been injured in a Consecration?"

name: Perjury
text: Secret: When your turn starts, Discover and cast a Secret from another class.
flavor: By Liar be Perjured!

name: Murder Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after another enemy minion dies.
flavor: Quote From Man Murdered: "What are you gonna do, murder me?"

name: Scribbling Stenographer
text: Rush. Costs (1) less for each card you've played this turn.
flavor: A truly staggering 180 scribbles per minute!

name: Clear Conscience
text: Give a friendly minion +2/+3 and "Elusive on your opponent's turn."
flavor: Do you swear to give the buff, the whole buff, and nothing but the buff, so help you Kyrestia?

name: Promotion
text: Give a Silver Hand Recruit +3/+3 and Taunt.
flavor: And with the new title of 'Golden Hand Recruit', you also get a pay raise!

name: Incriminating Psychic
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Copy two random cards from your opponent's hand.
flavor: Good news: He knows Kazakus's secret identity! Bad news: Now he's here.

name: Theft Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after you play a card copied from the opponent.
flavor: Honey, where are my paaaaaaants?

name: Dew Process
text: For the rest of the game, players draw an extra card at the start of their turn.
flavor: All part of dewing your dew diligence.

name: Attorney-at-Maw
text: Choose One - Silence a minion; or Give a minion Immune this turn.
flavor: When the going gets tough, you don't want a criminal lawyer... you want a criminal lawyer...

name: Prince Renathal
text: Your deck size and starting Health are 40.
flavor: A lot of kids go through a rebellious phase, but Prince Renathal's was a bit extreme.

name: Call to the Stand
text: Your opponent summons a random minion from their hand.
flavor: Don't worry, there is a chair for you to sit in. It's very misleading.

name: Mawsworn Bailiff
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you have 4 or more Armor, gain +4/+4.
flavor: Bailiff, bring in the dancing lobsters!

name: Weapons Expert
text: Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, give it +1/+1. Otherwise, draw a weapon.
flavor: "Yes, Your Honor, this appears to be some sort of blade."

name: Torghast Custodian
text: Battlecry: For each enemy minion, randomly gain Rush, Divine Shield, or Windfury.
flavor: Why is it a common? Well we couldn't make it a LEGendary minion!

name: Afterlife Attendant
text: Your Infuse cards also Infuse while in your deck.
flavor: AH! Wrist cramp!

name: Tight-Lipped Witness
text: Secrets can't be revealed.
flavor: People keep asking for her award-winning vegetarian chili recipe, but she just can't spill the beans.

name: Sylvanas, the Accused
text: Battlecry: Destroy an enemy minion. Infuse (7): Take control of it instead.
flavor: Turns into 'Sylvanas, the Infused'.

name: The Jailer
text: Battlecry: Destroy your deck. This minion gains Immune.
flavor: At one point, The Jailer served as Arbiter over the souls of the Shadowlands. He was the epitome of an unbiased, righteous judge of character. WAS.

name: Forensic Duster
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's minions cost (1) more next turn.
flavor: He had plenty of experience with dusting things from his time as a butler, so when a murder was committed he saw a real job opportunity!

name: Street Sweeper
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all other minions.
flavor: The sweeper hit of the set.

name: Sinfueled Golem
text: Infuse (3): Gain stats equal to the Attack of the minions that Infused this.
flavor: That poor golem is going to be stuck as a guard forever. He can never get a head!

name: Famished Fool
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. Infuse (4): Draw 3 instead.
flavor: He's not hungry for food, he's starving for attention!

name: Kael'thas Sinstrider
text: Every third minion you play each turn costs (0).
flavor: You heard about Kael'thas? That's messed up, right?

name: Murloc Holmes
text: Battlecry: Solve 3 Clues about your opponent's cards to get copies of them.
flavor: When you have eliminated the imfroggable, whatever remains, however uncroakable, must be the truth.

name: Reflecto Engineer
text: Battlecry: Swap the Attack and Health of all minions in both players' hands.
flavor: The whole thing's based on the Rubber-Glue Phenomenon.

name: Demolition Renovator
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Destroy an enemy location.
flavor: "Look, the Sire said he wanted something more open concept..."

name: Dinner Performer
text: Battlecry: Summon a random minion from your deck that you can afford to play.
flavor: BANG!

name: Ymirjar Frostbreaker
text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Attack for each Frost spell in your hand.
flavor: Also gains +1 Attack for each time your opponent mispronounces his name.

name: Brittleskin Zombie
text: Deathrattle: If it's your opponent's turn, deal 3 damage to them.
flavor: I was born with glass bones and paper skin.

name: Necrotic Mortician
text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, Discover an Unholy Rune card.
flavor: Her hair, just like her name, is full of 'tic's.

name: Incorporeal Corporal
text: After this minion attacks, destroy it.
flavor: You won't believe how long this was called "Incorporal Corporeal"…

name: Tomb Guardians
text: Summon two 2/2 Zombies with Taunt. Spend 4 Corpses to give them Reborn.
flavor: An absolute thriller.

name: Drakkari Embalmer
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Undead Reborn.
flavor: A troll in life, death, and online forums.

name: Meat Grinder
text: Battlecry: Shred a random minion in your deck to gain 4 Corpses.
flavor: After the Horde and Alliance sieged Icecrown Citadel, they took these back to use in their delis.

name: Acolyte of Death
text: After a friendly Undead dies, draw a card.
flavor: "I see dead people. A LOT of dead people."

name: The Scourge
text: Fill your board with random Undead.
flavor: “You speak of justice? Of cowardice? I will show you the justice of the grave and the true meaning of fear.”

name: Bone Flinger
text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, deal 2 damage.
flavor: It’s the scourge bringing, plague slinging, bone flinging basher!

name: Immortalized in Stone
text: Summon a 4/8, 2/4, and 1/2 Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: They all secretly have 'Deathrattle: Become very mortalized.'

name: Front Lines
text: Summon a minion from each player's deck. Repeat until either side of the battlefield is full.
flavor: With the line in the sand crossed, the battle for the Throne of Tides had begun.

name: Switcheroo
text: Draw 2 minions. Swap their Health.
flavor: Would you rather fight one Whale-sized Goldfish, or 100 Goldfish-sized Whales?

name: Drown
text: Put an enemy minion on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: If you play it on a Naga, they drown in their sorrows instead.

name: Jackpot!
text: Add two random spells from other classes that cost (5) or more to your hand.
flavor: Find someone who looks at you the way Hooktusk looks at loot.

name: Scourge Rager
text: Reborn Battlecry: Die.
flavor: Why's he so mad? Well you'd be mad too if you were created as a joke!

name: Alexandros Mograine
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, deal 3 damage to your opponent at the end of your turns.
flavor: Mo' graine, mo' problems.

name: Grave Strength
text: Give your minions +1 Attack. Spend 5 Corpses to give them +3 instead.
flavor: They're just standing there… MENACINGLY!

name: Chillfallen Baron
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Draw a card.
flavor: He hates when people call 60 degree weather cold.

name: Remorseless Winter
text: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Draw a card.
flavor: In the Badlands, this is a Rare.

name: Vicious Bloodworm
text: Battlecry: Give a minion in your hand Attack equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: Not to be confused with the Viscous Bloodworm.

name: Blood Tap
text: Give all minions in your hand +1/+1. Spend 2 Corpses to give them +1/+1 more.
flavor: Come join us in the tavern! We have whatever you're drinking on tap. Yes, even that.

name: Lady Deathwhisper
text: Deathrattle: Copy all Frost spells in your hand.
flavor: "Psst... Omelette death fromage."

name: Body Bagger
text: Battlecry: Gain a Corpse.
flavor: Gotta get that bag.

name: Gnome Muncher
text: Taunt, Lifesteal At the end of your turn, attack the lowest Health enemy.
flavor: Gnom gnom gnom.

name: Corpse Bride
text: Battlecry: Spend up to 10 Corpses to summon a Risen Groom with Taunt and that much Attack and Health.
flavor: Until undeath do us part.

name: Marrow Manipulator
text: Battlecry: Spend up to 5 Corpses. Deal 2 damage to a random enemy for each.
flavor: Also buffs your Calcium by 1000mg.

name: Boneguard Commander
text: Taunt Battlecry: Raise up to 6 Corpses as 1/3 Risen Footmen with Taunt.
flavor: Commander? In Hearthstone!? FINALLY!

name: Blood Boil

name: Great Hall

name: Conjured Arrow
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Manathirst (6): Draw that many cards.
flavor: We just call them "cursors".

name: Animate Dead
text: Resurrect a friendly minion that costs (3) or less.

name: Bonecaller

name: Volatile Skeleton
text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.

name: Crystalsmith Cultist
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Shadow spell, gain +1/+1.

text: Rush, Windfury After this attacks and kills a minion, resurrect it on your side.
flavor: Overlord: (1)

name: Umbral Geist

name: Vengeful Walloper
text: Rush. Costs (1) less for each Outcast card you've played this game.

name: Souleater's Scythe
text: Start of Game: Consume 3 different minions in your deck. Leave behind Souls that Discover them.

name: Walking Dead

text: Rush Battlecry: Discard 2 cards.

name: Scourge Tamer
text: Battlecry: Craft a custom Zombeast.

name: Shallow Grave

text: Rush Elusive Taunt

name: Blazing Power

name: Sunfury Champion

name: Unliving Champion
text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, summon two 3/2 Zombies.

text: Deal 2 damage. Manathirst (8): Deal 3 damage instead.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Battlecry: Double the stats of all minions in your deck.

name: Embers of Strength

name: Spectral Trainee

name: Whirlweaver

name: Blazing Transmutation

name: Cold Storage

name: Life from Death

name: Rake

name: ZOMBEEEES!!!

name: Tenacious San'layn

name: Crystal Broker

flavor: This HAS to be worth more dust, right?

name: The Purator
text: Taunt Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, draw a minion of each minion type.
flavor: With the rise of the undead, the Curator sees it as his duty to take care of them.

name: Shambling Chow
text: Rush Deathrattle: Deal 4 damage to your hero.
flavor: And step, and shamble, and step, and flip the hair!

name: Calamity's Grasp
text: Deathrattle: Add a random Outcast card to your hand.
flavor: Kel'Thuzad's personal fidget spinner.

name: Felscale Evoker
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, summon a different Demon from your deck. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: So it’s a demon and a naga, but NOT a dragon?

name: Fleshshaper
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you have 5 or more Armor, summon a copy of this.
flavor: Even THIS is better than paper straws.

name: Hookfist-3000
text: After your hero attacks, gain 4 Armor and draw a card.
flavor: But wait! There's more!

name: Training Session
text: Discover a Taunt minion. If you play it this turn, repeat this.
flavor: Instructor Razuvious's training turns the Scourge's Death Knights into hardened killing machines. His merciless routines focus on breaking down his underlings until they build up a resistance to his strength.

name: Thaddius, Monstrosity
text: Taunt. Your odd-Cost cards cost (2) less. (Swaps polarity each turn!)
flavor: Feugen is positive that Thaddius will see play, but Stalagg seems negative about it.

name: Rivendare, Warrider
text: Deathrattle: Shuffle the other 3 Horsemen into your deck.
flavor: More like the 4 Horsemen of the "Can't Get Here On Time."

name: Thassarian
text: Reborn Battlecry and Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: A natural born leader. And an unnatural reborn leader.

name: Blightfang
text: Battlecry: Infect all enemy minions. When they die, you summon a 2/2 Zombie with Taunt.
flavor: THE GIANT ENEMY SPIDER!

name: Suspicious Peddler
text: Battlecry: Discover a 1-Cost card. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: The best snake oil this side of Azeroth.

name: Hawkstrider Rancher
text: Whenever you play a minion, give it +1/+1 and "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Hawkstrider."
flavor: I prefer the Hawkstrider Nacho Cheeser.

name: Mistake
text: This has all minion types.
flavor: We like to think of it as a happy accident.

name: Rimescale Siren
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, Freeze 3 random enemy minions. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: She will freeze the Scourge dead in their tracks.

name: Construct Quarter
text: Destroy a friendly minion to summon a 4/5 Undead with Rush.
flavor: It's not alive! IT'S NOT ALIIIIIVE!!!

name: Frost Queen Sindragosa
text: Colossal +2 After an enemy minion is Frozen, destroy it.
flavor: With her final breath, Sindragosa cursed her consort and all who abandoned her to die in Icecrown. When she was reborn by the hands of the Lich King, her first freezing exhale wrought only pain.

name: Guitar Soloist
text: Battlecry: If you control no other minions, draw a spell, a minion, and a weapon.
flavor: She is the hero of the guitar. The guitar hero. Trademark.

name: Harmonica Soloist
text: Battlecry: If you control no other minions, Discover and cast a Secret.
flavor: A magician never reveals their Secrets. A musician on the other hand...

name: Keyboard Soloist
text: Battlecry: If you control no other minions, summon two 1/2 Amps with Spell Damage +1.
flavor: Give her a hand, everybody! Or maybe 4!

name: Opera Soloist
text: Battlecry: If you control no other minions, deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: It ain't over until the imp mother sings.

name: Drum Soloist
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you control no other minions, gain +2/+2 and Rush.
flavor: "Was I rushin' or was I dragon?"

name: Harmonic Hip Hop
text: Deal 1 damage. Give your weapon +3 Attack. (Swaps each turn.)
flavor: I can name four things that rhyme with 'orange': Four inch, Door hinge, Syringe, and uh… Shmorange.

name: Harmonic Disco
text: Discover a 5-Cost minion. Summon it with +1/+1. (Swaps each turn.)
flavor: "Worry not, festival patrons! A disco is hardly any means for panic!"

name: Rolling Stone
text: Rush Battlecry: If the last card you played costs (1), gain +1/+1.
flavor: Sadly, the mariachi band it used to play in gathers no más.

name: Ritual of Doom
text: Destroy a friendly minion. If you had 5 or more, summon a 5/5 Demon.
flavor: "Who wants to sing the Doom song?!"

name: War Cache
text: Add a random Warrior minion, spell, and weapon to your hand.
flavor: It's much tidier than Illidan's storage locker.

name: Nordrassil Druid
text: Battlecry: The next spell you cast this turn costs (3) less.
flavor: The World Tree Nordrassil provides life-giving energy to the world--and excellent mana savings.

name: Crimson Clergy
text: Overheal: Draw a card.
flavor: He won't drop the ball.

name: Enslaved Fel Lord
text: Taunt. Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: He's not really chained up. He just wears that to scare the imps when they get too unruly.

name: Pursuit of Justice
text: Give +1 Attack to Silver Hand Recruits you summon this game.
flavor: "Is this about justice or just us?"

name: Warsong Outrider
text: Rush
flavor: When it comes to the Warsong clan, outriders are the insiders.

name: Lost Exarch
text: Deathrattle: Spend all your Mana. Summon that many 2/2 Zombies with Rush.
flavor: She resisted the temptation of the Burning Legion's power only to fall victim to the Scourge.

name: Record Scratcher
text: Deathrattle: Refresh 1 Mana Crystal. (Play Combo cards while equipped to improve!)
flavor: A Rogue's favorite audio sample is an orchestral stab.

name: Kodohide Drumkit
text: Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all minions. (Gain Armor while equipped to improve!)
flavor: Stolen from a druidic drum circle, now destined to make music that is actually good.

name: Shadow Chord: Distort
text: Give a minion -5/-5. If it has 0 Attack, destroy it.
flavor: For some unknown reason, using distortion intentionally in your music will attract hundreds of geckos to your location.

name: Cosmic Keyboard
text: After you cast a spell, summon an Elemental with stats equal to its Cost. Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: Mine is signed by Algalon himself.

name: Baritone Imp
text: Battlecry: Take Fatigue damage. Gain that much Attack and Health.
flavor: He used to be an epic sax guy, but now he's just a common.

name: Crescendo
text: Take Fatigue damage. Deal that much damage to all enemies.
flavor: The more you flail your arms, the better the orchestra plays! Yup, that's definitely how it works.

name: Instrument Smasher
text: Whenever your weapon is destroyed, equip a random Demon Hunter weapon.
flavor: Guitar? Nah, she plays percussion.

name: Crazed Conductor
text: Battlecry: Take Fatigue damage. Summon that many 3/3 Imps.
flavor: "The Twisting Nether is singing to me… WHAT IS THAT MELODY!?"

name: Rin, Orchestrator of Doom
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Both players draw 2 cards, discard 2 cards, and destroy the top 2 cards of their deck.
flavor: Rin's orchestra is the best of the best. When your replacement is just one summoning away, you have to play perfectly.

name: Screaming Banshee
text: Lifesteal After your hero gains Health, summon a Soul with that much Attack and Health.
flavor: Her singing will be sure to wake you up (wake you up inside).

name: Death Metal Knight
text: Taunt Costs Health instead of Mana if your hero was healed this turn.
flavor: He prefers listening to bands dead rather than live.

name: Cage Head
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 9/9 Blight Boar with Charge and Taunt.
flavor: You get your head stuck in a cage ONCE, and all of a sudden you've got a new nickname.

name: Glaivetar
text: Deathrattle: Draw 1 card. (Play Outcast cards while equipped to improve!)
flavor: Might need tuning, I think it's a bit sharp.

name: Lightshow
text: Shoot 2 beams at enemies that each deal 2 damage. Your future Lightshows shoot one more beam.
flavor: Always remember P.L.U.R.: Peace, Laser-beams, Unity, Respect.

name: Power Slider
text: Rush. Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each minion of a different type you've played this game.
flavor: There's a huge difference between a battle-axe and an axe-guitar. One is for combat, and the other is for combat AND rocking out.

name: The One-Amalgam Band
text: Battlecry: Gain a random Bonus Effect for each minion of a different type you've played this game.
flavor: Why be good with ONE instrument when you can be terrible with ALL of them!!!

name: Beatboxer
text: Combo: Deal 4 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: "ERROR. CANNOT COMPUTE 'NO PUNCHING ALLOWED DURING MUSICAL PERFORMANCE'."

name: Rhyme Spinner
text: Rush Combo: Gain +1/+1 for each other Combo card you've played this game.
flavor: For ONCE we're not talking about ice!

name: Mixtape
text: Discover a copy of a card your opponent played this game.
flavor: That tape has got poetry and clarinet on it, Garona. POETRY. AND CLARINET.

name: Mic Drop
text: Draw 2 cards. Finale: Give your weapon +2 Attack.
flavor: The perfect card to play after emoting.

name: Breakdance
text: Return a friendly minion to your hand. Summon a Dancer with its stats and Rush.
flavor: "Commander! Uhh... I'm... Pretty sure we just got served? I'm not really trained for this."

name: Rewind
text: Discover a copy of another spell you've cast this game.
flavor: If you don't find the spell you want, just cast this one more time and see if you get lucky.

name: Disc Jockey
text: Combo: Add a random Combo card to your hand.
flavor: Hype coefficient insufficient.

name: MC Blingtron
text: Battlecry: Both players equip 1/2 Microphones. Your opponent's increases all damage they take by 1!
flavor: If this is the outcome of the robot uprising, then sign me up!

name: Bounce Around (ft. Garona)
text: Return all friendly minions to your hand. They cost (1) this turn.
flavor: Another one.

name: Snakebite
text: Rush Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each minion that died this turn.
flavor: Don't look her in the eyes or you'll turn to ROCK!

name: SECURITY!!
text: Summon two 1/1 Illidari with Rush. Outcast: Summon one more.
flavor: Check all of the boxes that contain VENGEANCE to play this card.

name: Going Down Swinging
text: Give your hero +2 Attack and Immune this turn, then attack each enemy minion.
flavor: Halveria was outcast from Gilneas for being too edgy, which she sees as an achievement.

name: Mind Eater
text: Deathrattle: Add a copy of a card in your opponent's deck to your hand.
flavor: Watch out brain, she'll chew you up! She's a Mind Eater!

name: Mosh Pit
text: Spend 3 Corpses to give a friendly minion Reborn.
flavor: Let the Corpses hit the floor!

name: Holotechnician
text: After ANY minion takes exactly 1 damage, destroy it.
flavor: Ironically, operating the spotlight comes with very little recognition.

name: Blackrock 'n' Roll
text: Give all minions in your deck Attack and Health equal to their Cost.
flavor: Thank goodness it's not called Black-ska Mountain.

name: Idol's Adoration
text: Your Hero Power costs (0). After you use it, lose 1 Durability.
flavor: That is a mic, not a door.

name: Harmonic Pop
text: Deal 3 damage to all minions. Summon a 6/6 Popstar. (Swaps each turn.)
flavor: Here with supporting vocals: Snap and Crackle!

name: Fight Over Me
text: Choose two enemy minions. They fight! Add copies of any that die to your hand.
flavor: And you thought the battles between the Alliance and Horde got ugly…

name: Disco Maul
text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion +1/+1. (Play minions while equipped to improve!)
flavor: Nah, dis go face.

name: Boogie Down
text: Summon two 1-Cost minions from your deck. Finale: Summon another.
flavor: Whatever you do, do NOT sashay to the right.

name: Spotlight
text: Tradeable Convert a friendly Divine Shield into a 5/5 Elemental.
flavor: Everyone's eyes are on you! Well, they're also looking at the giant Elemental that we're using as a spotlight, but mainly at you!

name: Annoy-o-Troupe
text: Taunt, Divine Shield Deathrattle: Summon three 1/2 Mechs with Taunt and Divine Shield.
flavor: Some classes get Void Lords, other classes get Annoyed Lords.

name: Jitterbug
text: Divine Shield After a friendly character loses Divine Shield, draw a card.
flavor: The only bug that was intentional.

name: Audio Medic
text: Rush Finale: Gain Lifesteal.
flavor: His performance isn't over, watch!

name: Paparazzi
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion.
flavor: When you're a Legendary minion, you get a shiny orange gem, a dragon emblem, and about 100 of these people following you everywhere.

name: Synthesize
text: Add a random 1, 2, and 3-Cost Elemental to your hand.
flavor: After the invention of elemental audio processing, Azeroth went through a major synth phase.

name: E.T.C., Band Manager
text: While building your deck, assemble a band of 3 cards. Battlecry: Discover one!
flavor: "This next band features the one and only M.C. Tech on the drums, the fungal king of the keyboard Loatheb, and the showstopping vocal chops of Spellbreaker!"

name: Jazz Bass
text: Deathrattle: Your next spell costs (1) less. (Overload while equipped to improve!)
flavor: No birds, plural, were harmed in the making of this bass.

name: Instrument Tech
text: Battlecry: Draw a weapon.
flavor: A tech card without Tradeable? CRINGE.

name: Vrykul Necrolyte
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion "Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Zombie with Rush."
flavor: If at first you don't succeed, vry, vry again.

name: Void Virtuoso
text: During your turn, your hero is Immune.
flavor: That is one interesting dress code.

name: Audio Splitter
text: Deathrattle: Copy the highest Cost spell in your hand.
flavor: "I tried to give him some constructive criticism but gosh, he really hates feedback!"

name: Lead Dancer
text: Deathrattle: Summon a minion from your deck with less Attack than this minion.
flavor: "Follow my lead!" *dies*

name: Kangor, Dancing King
text: Lifesteal Deathrattle: Swap this with a minion from your hand and give it Lifesteal.
flavor: After Dr. Boom's involvement with the League of EVIL, Kangor cut ties with the Boomsday Labs and began pursuing his true passion - DISCO!!!

name: Starlight Groove
text: Give your hero Divine Shield. For the rest of the game, playing a Holy spell refreshes it.
flavor: In space, no one can hear you groove.

name: Dreamboat
text: Battlecry: Restore 3 Health to all other friendly minions. Gain +1/+1 for each one Overhealed.
flavor: As the only member that can sing underwater, Paz saved Poison Bloom's Zin-Azshari tour from failure.

name: Heartbreaker Hedanis
text: Battlecry: Deal 4 damage to this minion. Overheal: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Hedanis has won over the hearts and minds of millions of fans all over Azeroth! Shadow magic had nothing to do with it - not that you asked or anything.

name: Love Everlasting
text: Your first spell each turn costs (2) less. Lasts until you don't play a spell on your turn.
flavor: Poison Bloom was accused of plagiarizing the "Ooh, how long can this go on (ooh yeah)" hook from an old-school musical group called The Saronite Chain Gang.

name: Mish-Mash Mosher
text: Rush After this attacks, gain +1 Attack and attack a random enemy minion.
flavor: In the pit, he feels more alive than ever.

name: Outfit Tailor
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion Attack and Health equal to this minion's.
flavor: She has this terrible habit of eating melted cheese while on the job.

name: Freebird
text: Charge Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other Freebird you've played this game.
flavor: Free!? But it costs Mana!

name: Dirge of Despair
text: Deal 3 damage to a character. If it dies, summon a Demon from your deck.
flavor: Oh, the misery!

name: Demonic Dynamics
text: Discover 2 Demons. Finale: Give them +1/+2.
flavor: The Blue Imp Group sure knows how to put on a show!

name: Felstring Harp
text: Whenever your hero would take damage on your turn, restore 2 Health instead. Lose 1 Durability.
flavor: Playing it will singe your fingers and wither your soul, but at least it never needs restringing!

name: Symphony of Sins
text: Discover and play a Movement. Shuffle the other 6 into your deck.
flavor: Makes for some killer final boss music.

name: Funkfin
text: Divine Shield Your minions with Divine Shield have +2 Attack.
flavor: Shake your groove fin!

name: Power Chord: Synchronize
text: Choose a minion. Add a copy of it to your hand. Finale: Give both +1/+2.
flavor: "It's all about you, girl On your 16,000th birthday"

name: Amplified Elekk
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Before this show can continue, we have to bass-boost the elephant in the room.

name: Audio Amplifier
text: Battlecry: Set your maximum Mana and hand size to 11.
flavor: And you thought we were putting Wildheart Guff in Core. We'd never do that! WINK WINK.

name: Heartthrob
text: Overheal: Summon a random minion with Cost equal to the amount Overhealed.
flavor: Oh no, Harth! Look out! He's here to rob you!

name: Ghost Writer
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell. Finale: Discover another.
flavor: This eccentric scribe was cursed to an afterlife of never being recognized for his talents! Muahaha!

name: Static Waveform
text: At the start of EACH turn, lose 1 Attack or Health (chosen randomly).
flavor: LET ME SEE YOU MAKE SOME NOISE!!!

name: Metrognome
text: After you play a X-Cost card, draw a X-Cost card. (Then increase!)
flavor: He's very popular on Click-Clock.

name: Arcanite Ripper
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Lifesteal Undead. (Change your Health on your turn while equipped to improve!)
flavor: A guitar with a skull - perfect for headbanging.

name: Death Growl
text: Choose a minion. Spread its Deathrattle to adjacent minions.
flavor: GRRRRR I'M SO ANGRY BECAUSE I'M DEAD!

name: Pozzik, Audio Engineer
text: Battlecry: Add two 3/3 Bots to your opponent's hand. Deathrattle: Summon them for yourself.
flavor: "I'm down here, fixin' all the Gnomish tech that breaks down mid-set while that buffoon Fizzle is up there taking pictures of the sky. YOU tell ME who's the better engineer!"

name: Harmonic Metal
text: Give 4 random minions in your hand +2/+2. (Swaps each turn.)
flavor: I have bashed together plenty of pieces of metal in my day and not ONCE has it sounded harmonic.

name: Boneshredder
text: Battlecry: Spend 5 Corpses to trigger and gain the Deathrattle of a random friendly minion that died this game.
flavor: Is that his makeup or just his natural fur pattern?

name: Thornmantle Musician
text: Finale: The next Beast you summon gets +1/+1.
flavor: She calls the hyena her "little chef". Not sure what that's about.

name: Jungle Jammer
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random 1-Cost Beast. (Cast spells while equipped to improve!)
flavor: When asked what animal they would be, people always say things like "I'd be wolf-lion hybrid mix. King of the jungle, but still sociable and ferocious." No, you'd be a rat.

name: Arrow Smith
text: After you cast a spell, deal 1 damage to the lowest Health enemy.
flavor: "What do you mean it's a violin bow!?!"

name: Mister Mukla
text: Rush. Battlecry: Fill your opponent's hand with Bananas.
flavor: Music is Mukla's escape from his anger. When he's on-stage, it's like he's a whole different gorilla… Until you boo him.

name: Worgen Roadie
text: Battlecry: Summon a 0/3 Instrument Case for your opponent. (Break it for a random weapon!)
flavor: "I asked for an instrument, and you give me a CURSED BLADE!?"

name: Concert Promo-Drake
text: Tradeable Finale: Destroy an enemy minion.
flavor: There's a reason why it's promoting the festival instead of playing in it - it's a rhyme-lost protodrake.

name: Unpopular Has-Been
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random 5-Cost minion from the past.
flavor: Oh man, she used to rock more than ANYONE back in the Year of the Kraken. I wish I could've seen her perform back then…

name: Party Animal
text: Battlecry: Give +1/+1 to each minion of a different type in your hand.
flavor: He's the wildlife of the party!

name: Cowbell Soloist
text: Battlecry: If you control no other minions, deal 2 damage.
flavor: Hot take: We need LESS cowbell. Much, much less.

name: Razorfen Rockstar
text: After you gain Armor, gain 2 more.
flavor: Quilboar feel Rock in their blood. And blood in their rocks.

name: Air Guitarist
text: Battlecry: Give your weapon +1 Durability.
flavor: Nailing that solo was a breeze.

name: Hipster
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell from your opponent's class that isn't in their deck.
flavor: Oh, so you like Hearthstone? Name every spell.

name: Altered Chord
text: Lifesteal Deal 6 damage to a minion. Costs (3) less if you're Overloaded.
flavor: I'll never understand how bands and orchestras allow musicians that just…. play... off-key. Would love opinions on this.

name: Brass Elemental
text: Rush, Divine Shield, Taunt, Windfury
flavor: You handle the water spells. It's got the earth, wind, and fire covered.

name: Saxophone Soloist
text: Battlecry: If you control no other minions, add a Saxophone Soloist to your hand.
flavor: He used to play to crowds of adoring Murlocs, but 20 years later all that's left is gigs at secluded clubs and regrets. Where did all the time go? His dreams of fame and fortune, snuffed out like the flame of a small candle in a dimly lit bar. Nothing but smoke in the wind.

name: Flowrider
text: Battlecry: If you're Overloaded, Discover a spell from your deck.
flavor: Her music sounds a lot better underwater where you can't hear it at all.

name: JIVE, INSECT!
text: Transform a minion into Ragnaros the Firelord. Overload: (2)
flavor: "WHY IS NO ONE JIVING? I SPECIFICALLY REQUESTED IT!"

name: Pyrotechnician
text: After you cast a spell, add a random Fire spell to your hand.
flavor: The difference between a pyrotechnician and a pyromaniac is a paycheck.

name: Tony, King of Piracy
text: Battlecry: Replace your deck with a copy of your opponent's. Finale: Draw a card.
flavor: Tony prefers sailing on torrents rather than streams.

name: Festival Security
text: Taunt Finale: Force all enemy minions to attack this.
flavor: "Incident in the mosh pit? Copy that, be there in a year."

name: Candleraiser
text: Divine Shield Finale: Give adjacent minions Divine Shield.
flavor: You would not believe your eyes If ten million kobold guys Lit up the world to this ogre beat

name: Crowd Surfer
text: Deathrattle: Give ANY other minion +1/+1 and this Deathrattle.
flavor: I'm pretty sure it's the band that's supposed to be crowd surfing, but you do you little dude.

name: Stereo Totem
text: At the end of your turn, give a random minion in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: Pass the ox cord!

name: Frequency Oscillator
text: Battlecry: The next Mech you play costs (1) less.
flavor: Our lawyer made us change the flavor text of this card so we wouldn't get sued.

name: Rowdy Fan
text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. It has +4 Attack while this is alive.
flavor: "This song is so good, it makes me want to PUNCH SOMEONE IN THE FACE!!"

name: Obsessive Fan
text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. It has Stealth while this is alive.
flavor: "Obsessed? No! I'm just really really really really really really really really really really into E.T.C.'s music and everything he says, does, thinks, lives, and breathes!"

name: Annoying Fan
text: Battlecry: Choose a minion. It can't attack while this is alive.
flavor: No, Annoy-o-Tron, an air horn is not an instrument.

name: Cover Artist
text: Battlecry: Transform into a 3/3 copy of a minion.
flavor: The Faceless Ones are servants of Yogg-Saron, and they feed on fear. Right now they are feeding on our fear of you realizing we copied this flavor text.

name: Merch Seller
text: At the end of your turn, put a random spell on the top of your opponent's deck.
flavor: "Sorry, we're all out of Mediums. All we've got left are Gnome, Extra Large, and Annihilan."

name: Verse Riff
text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. Gain 2 Armor. Finale: Play your last Riff.
flavor: Well anyways, here's Worgen Wall.

name: Chorus Riff
text: Draw a minion. Give it +3/+3. Finale: Play your last Riff.
flavor: What do you mean, what do you mean, I SAY WHAT DO YOU MEEEEEAN, mean, mean, meaaaaaaan this chorus is repetitive?

name: Bridge Riff
text: Summon a 3/4 Rocker with Taunt and a 4/3 with Rush. Finale: Play your last Riff.
flavor: Can be played in other places too.

name: Melomania
text: Each time you play a minion this turn, add a random Shaman spell to your hand.
flavor: I once saw a horse that had watermelons for hair. It was a melon mane, ya?!

name: Big Dreams
text: Summon the highest Cost Beast from your hand. It goes Dormant for 2 turns.
flavor: Just a small town Taunka Livin' in a lonely... waunka

name: Chill Vibes
text: Restore 8 Health. Finale: Summon a 3/3 Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: "You're listening to 47.7 Shaman FM radio. It's time to kick back, relax, and take in the music."

name: Banjosaur
text: Rush Whenever this attacks, draw a Beast and gain its stats.
flavor: You'll all be singing along once he gets to the tyranno-chorus.

name: Photographer Fizzle
text: Battlecry: Take a Snapshot of your current hand and shuffle it into your deck. (Once per game)
flavor: Look at this photograph.

name: Pack the House
text: Summon a random 6, 5, 4, and 3-Cost minion. Overload: (2)
flavor: How many Pack the Houses would a pack house if a pack could house Pack the House?

name: Inzah
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Overload cards cost (1) less.
flavor: Inzah plays the trumpet, saxophone, piano, guitar, AND bass. No wonder he's always so overloaded!

name: Roaring Applause
text: Draw a card. Repeat for each minion of a different type you control.
flavor: Please clap.

name: Sanctum Spellbender
text: Whenever your opponent targets another minion with a spell, redirect it to this.
flavor: "I'll take that... and that... aaand that."

name: Thori'belore
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Go Dormant. Cast a Fire spell to revive Thori'belore!
flavor: Mascot of QFC (Quel'Thelas Fried Chicken).

name: Drum Circle
text: Choose One - Summon five 2/2 Treants; or Give your minions +2/+4 and Taunt.
flavor: It's more of a drum pentagon, really.

name: Peaceful Piper
text: Choose One - Draw a Beast; or Discover one.
flavor: "Is there anything worth more than peace and love on the planet Azeroth?"

name: Summer Flowerchild
text: Battlecry: Draw two cards that cost (6) or more. Finale: They cost (1) less.
flavor: "Ugh, those Winter Floweradults just don't get our music."

name: Harmonic Mood
text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. Gain 4 Armor. (Swaps each turn.)

name: Manufacturing Error

name: Fairy Tale Forest
text: Draw a Battlecry minion. It costs (1) less.
flavor: Man, I wish fairy tales were real, Durg'tash the Sorcerer.

name: Nostalgic Clown
text: Miniaturize Battlecry: If you've played a higher Cost card while holding this, deal 4 damage.

name: Pop-Up Book

name: Sleet Skater
text: Miniaturize Battlecry: Freeze an enemy minion. Gain Armor equal to its Attack.

name: Frost Lich Cross-Stitch

text: Miniaturize Battlecry: Give your hero +1 Attack and Windfury this turn.

name: Factory Assemblybot

name: Wreck'em and Deck'em
text: Choose a friendly Mech. Summon a copy of it that attacks a random enemy, then dies.
flavor: ...and Check'em for any signs of life.

name: Quality Assurance
text: Draw 2 Taunt minions.
flavor: I assure you this card is quality.

name: Testing Dummy
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 8 damage randomly split among all enemy minions.

name: Inventor Boom

name: Bargain Bin Buccaneer

text: Miniaturize Taunt. Deathrattle: Summon a 4/4 Whelp with Elusive.

flavor: Get it!?! It's because dragons have hides - commonly known as scales - and this is a model of a dragon on a smaller level, also known as a scale. IT'S THE SAME WORD!

name: Plucky Paintfin
text: Poisonous Battlecry: Draw a Rush minion.

name: Treasure Distributor

name: Chalk Artist

text: Miniaturize Battlecry: Your next card this turn costs (2) less.

text: Miniaturize Rush, Lifesteal, Divine Shield

name: Wheel of DEATH!!!

name: Flickering Lightbot

name: Puppet Theatre

text: Battlecry and Spellburst: Draw a Libram.

name: Spacerock Collector

name: Libram of Clarity
text: Draw 2 minions. If this costs (0), give them +2/+1.
flavor: Ah, I get it! I should play this for 0 Mana.

name: Libram of Divinity
text: Give a minion +3/+3. If this costs (0), return this to your hand at the end of your turn.
flavor: The sacred texts!!

name: Libram of Faith
text: Summon three 3/3 Draenei with Divine Shield. If this costs (0), give them Rush.
flavor: They used to do leaps of faith until Maraad fell into the void.

name: Celestial Aura
text: While you have exactly 1 minion in play, its Attack and Health are 10. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Horse girls rise up!

name: Yrel, Beacon of Hope
text: Rush Deathrattle: Get three different Librams from an older timeline!
flavor: Yrel has a lot of overdue library books.

name: Wakener of Souls
text: Taunt, Reborn Deathrattle: Resurrect a different friendly Deathrattle minion.
flavor: The alarm again!? Wake me up in 5 more eternities.

name: Auchenai Death-Speaker
text: After another friendly minion is Reborn, summon a copy of it.
flavor: He sees no evil. He hears no evil. Eh, he speaks a little evil.

name: Exarch Maladaar
text: Battlecry: The next card you play this turn costs Corpses instead of Mana.
flavor: The Auchenai order was founded to preserve the memory of Draenei that have passed. But why stop at remembrance when they can live once more?

name: Exarch Hataaru
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell and reduce its Cost by (1). If you play it this turn, repeat this effect.
flavor: Severely outmatched by the Burning Legion, the Draenei had no hopes of survival… That changed with the invention of arkonite crystals, giving Hataaru and his Artificers new ways to empower their people.

name: Supernova
text: Fill your hand with random Fire spells. They cost (1).
flavor: People who enjoy the heat will say this looks like perfect weather.

name: Blazing Accretion
text: Battlecry: Destroy the top 3 cards of your deck. Any Fire spells or Elementals are drawn instead.
flavor: Much like the Draenei, this Elemental just wants a place to call home. Unlike the Draenei, it incinerates everything it touches.

name: Blasteroid
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 5 random Fire spells into your deck. They cost (2) less.
flavor: To infinity and... even further!

name: Voronei Recruiter
text: At the end of your turn, get a 4/4 Crewmate with a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: He has an eyepatch but isn't a Pirate. He's a Recruiter but doesn't Recruit. Smh my head.

name: The Ceaseless Expanse
text: Costs (1) less for each time a card was drawn, played, or destroyed. Battlecry: Destroy all other minions.
flavor: If you play this for its full Mana cost, you know what? You win. Good day sir!

name: Nexus-Prince Shaffar
text: Spellburst: Give a minion in your hand +3/+3 and this Spellburst (unless it already has these effects).
flavor: Whatever you do, do not give him OR his ethereal parrot a magical lamp.

name: Lumia
text: Lifesteal After a hero takes damage, they become Immune for the rest of the turn.
flavor: "What's a world soul?" "Only the most sophisticated form of life ever protected by Titans. AND it's spherical! SPHERICAL!"

name: Talgath
text: Undamaged enemy minions take double damage. Combo: Get a Backstab.
flavor: Talgath betrayed his people by accepting Sargeras's promise of power. Talgath also saw Velen's refusal of that same power as a betrayal. I'm not convinced Talgath knows what that word means.

name: Headhunt
text: Deal 2 damage. Get a 4/4 Crewmate with a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: Even though the red lenses blurred his vision and greatly inhibited his ability to make out color and detail, he looked cool as heck.

name: Warp Drive
text: Draw 2 cards. If you're building a Starship, they cost (2) less.
flavor: WARNING: SLIPSPACE RUPTURE DETECTED!

name: Saruun
text: Battlecry: Give all Elementals in your deck Fire Spell Damage +1.
flavor: BORN FROM THE HEAT DEATH OF COLLIDING SUPERNOVAS, SARUUN SEEKS TO INCINERATE ALL THAT WHICH REVOLVES AROUND THEM TO MERE ASHES AND STARDUST!!!! Which is pretty neato!

name: Solar Flare
text: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Costs (1) less for each Elemental you control.
flavor: Saruun is quite the dancer. Their pirouette is deadly.

name: Orbital Moon
text: Give a minion Taunt and Lifesteal. If you played an adjacent card this turn, also give it Reborn.
flavor: The blood moon orbits once again.

name: Ethereal Oracle
text: Spell Damage +1 Spellburst: Draw 2 spells.
flavor: I see 2 spells in my future.

name: Deep Space Curator
text: Spellburst: Get a random minion of the spell's Cost. Set its Cost to (0).
flavor: *Gestures to empty room* "...and here is my curated collection of space."

name: Suffocate
text: Destroy a minion. If you're building a Starship, also destroy a random neighbor.
flavor: He's already floating in the void of space. The shadow magic seems like overkill, idk.

name: Eredar Brute
text: Taunt, Lifesteal Costs (1) less for each enemy minion.
flavor: After a while, the glowing purple stress ball became ineffective at containing his rage.

name: Mutating Lifeform
text: After this survives damage, gain a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: Who knows how many amazing discoveries are out there!... Never mind, I'm going home.

name: Lightfused Manasaber
text: Rush Spellburst: Gain Divine Shield.
flavor: Oh no, I ran out of fused Mana!

name: Ur'zul Rager
text: Lifesteal Spellburst: Attack a random enemy minion.
flavor: The Burning Legion is host to many horrors, but a 3 Mana 5/1 is the worst of all!

name: Splitting Spacerock
text: Deathrattle: Summon two 4/4 Splitting Boulders.
flavor: Space rock. *pew* Spa ce ro ck. *pew* S p a c e r o c k.

name: Alien Encounters
text: Summon two 2/5 Beasts with Taunt. Costs (1) less for each card you Discovered this game.
flavor: Close encounters of the cuddly kind.

name: The 8 Hands From Beyond
text: Battlecry: Destroy both players' decks EXCEPT the 8 highest Cost cards in each.
flavor: It was a one-eyed, eight-handed, giant purple planet eater.

name: Space Pirate
text: Deathrattle: Your next weapon costs (1) less.
flavor: Exploring the avastness of space.

name: Star Vulpera
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Destroy an enemy Starship or Starship Piece.
flavor: He was a star before he even flew his first ship.

name: Red Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each adjacent card played while in hand.
flavor: Lots of cards get played around it, but it's the real star.

name: Perplexing Anomaly
text: Rush, Taunt, ...Stealth?
flavor: I'm so confused... this is really a headscratcher... it doesn't make any sense... why does it cost 3 Mana?

name: Assimilating Blight
text: Discover a 3-Cost Deathrattle minion. Summon it with Reborn.
flavor: Resistance is futile.

name: Kil'jaeden
text: Battlecry: Replace your deck with an endless portal of Demons. Each turn, they gain an additional +2/+2.
flavor: With complete control of the Burning Legion's forces, Kil'jaeden will stop at nothing until all of the traitorous Draenei have been squelched. *right clicks the enemy hero*

name: Eternal Layover
text: Give ALL minions Reborn, then destroy all minions.
flavor: Get away from it all! Forever.

name: Spawning Pool
text: Get a 1/1 Zergling. Deathrattle: Your Zerg minions have Rush this turn.
flavor: Looks more like a spawning hot tub to me, just based on the size.

name: Baneling Barrage
text: Get a 1/1 Baneling that explodes. If you control a Zerg minion, get another Baneling.
flavor: Banelings, banelings, banelings OHHHH!

name: Jim Raynor
text: Battlecry: Relaunch every Starship that you launched this game.
flavor: He’s lost his faith, his friends, and his beloved, but he still believes that one day, he can make things right again.

name: SCV
text: Battlecry: Your next Starship launch costs (2) less.
flavor: They're called SCVs because they're Super Cool (Very).

name: Infestor
text: Deathrattle: Your Zerg minions have +1 Attack for the rest of the game.
flavor: Even if you survive its neural parasite, you will never live it down.

name: Hive Queen
text: At the end of your turn, get a Larva that transforms into random Zerg minions.
flavor: Her favorite game is "The Floor is Larva."

name: Kerrigan, Queen of Blades
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/5 Hive Queens. Deal 3 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Betrayed by the terrans, she is determined to use the power of the zerg Swarm for her revenge.

name: Starport
text: Summon a 2/1 Starship Piece with an effect when launched.
flavor: Make sure to arrive 3 light-years early for any intergalactic flights.

name: Salvage the Bunker
text: Summon two 2/2 Marines with Taunt. Your next Starship launch costs (2) less.
flavor: You just HAD to go with the cheap sheet metal didn't you?

name: Hydralisk
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. Repeat for each other Zerg minion you control.
flavor: *tsst* *tsst* *tsst* *tsst* *tsst* *tsst*

name: Lurker
text: After a friendly minion attacks, deal 1 damage to a random enemy (or 2 if your minion is a Zerg).
flavor: Never typed in chat. Subscribed for 40 months. The perfect viewer.

name: Ultra-Capacitor
text: Starship Piece Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other friendly minion. Also triggers on launch.
flavor: If my calculations are correct, when this baby hits 88 miles per hour...

name: Zergling
text: Battlecry: Summon a 1/1 Zergling.
flavor: It's all fun and games until 8 of these show up at your door at the 2 minute mark.

name: Creep Tumor
text: Your Zerg minions have +1 Attack and Rush. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: "If you spot one of these, back away or burn it to hell. Never fight on their turf."

name: Roach
text: When you draw this, get a copy of it. Battlecry: If you control another Zerg minion, gain +1/+2.
flavor: These still aren't as bad as the ones in my old apartment complex.

name: Yamato Cannon
text: Starship Piece Battlecry: Destroy a random enemy minion. Also triggers on launch.
flavor: Ya-may-to, Ya-mah-to

name: Lock On
text: Set a minion’s Health to 1. Your next Starship launch costs (2) less.
flavor: Time to lock in. *ahem* I mean lock on.

name: Ghost
text: Stealth. Battlecry: If you're building a Starship, destroy the lowest-Cost card in your opponent's hand.
flavor: Busters!

name: Chrono Boost
text: Draw 2 Protoss cards. Summon a 3/4 Zealot with Charge.
flavor: Just think of all the tempests I can make!...Ah, who am I kidding? I'm just going to use this on probes.

name: Warp Gate
text: Your next Protoss minion costs (3) less.
flavor: This is gonna be really meta-warping.

name: Dark Templar
text: Stealth. Battlecry: Destroy an enemy minion. Play another Templar to merge into an Archon!
flavor: *stab* *stab* *stab* "Hey, where'd my SCVs go?"

name: Photon Cannon
text: Deal 3 damage. If this kills a minion, your Protoss minions cost (1) less this game.
flavor: If this card were a minion, it would have Rush.

name: Artanis
text: Battlecry: Summon two 3/4 Zealots with Charge. Your Protoss minions cost (2) less this game.
flavor: Artanis will forge a new future for the protoss, even if it means destroying everything they ever knew.

name: Construct Pylons
text: Your next Protoss card this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: You must... y'know...

name: Carrier
text: At the end of your turn, summon four 4/1 Interceptors that attack random enemies.
flavor: Yeah, my teammates always call me this.

name: Hallucination
text: Summon a copy of a friendly Protoss minion. It takes double damage.
flavor: "Protoss? In our base? I think you're seeing things."

name: Colossus
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to all enemies, twice. (Improved by Protoss spells you cast this game!)
flavor: How's the weather up there?

name: Shield Battery
text: Gain 6 Armor. Your next Protoss spell costs (2) less.
flavor: Hey Artanis, can I use your charger?

name: Aegwynn, the Guardian
text: Spell Damage +2 Deathrattle: The next minion you draw inherits these powers.
flavor: With Medivh as her son, nothing YOU do could ever disappoint her.

name: Resonance Coil
text: Deal 5 damage to a minion. Get a random Protoss spell.
flavor: This thing can snipe minions three screens away!

name: Shadowed Spirit
text: Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: They can't all be grim grinning ghosts.

name: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
text: Battlecry: Choose a character. If it's friendly, restore 8 Health. If it's an enemy, deal 8 damage.
flavor: Friendly Fire: Off

name: Ysera the Dreamer
text: Battlecry: Add one of each Dream card to your hand.
flavor: Quick! Quick! Write it down before you forget them all!

name: Heart Strike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, gain a Corpse.
flavor: Love hurts.

name: Possessifier
text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Fighters with Rush and Reborn.
flavor: Beating the best, being the best, and brainwashing the rest.

name: Runeforging
text: Draw a weapon. Spend a Corpse to reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: I swear the runes are genuine!

name: Bonedigger Geist
text: Battlecry: Spend a Corpse to gain +1/+2.
flavor: He's a grave-half-full kind of geist.

name: Defrost
text: Draw a card. Spend 2 Corpses to draw another.
flavor: Shouldn't this NOT be a Frost spell?

name: Graveyard Shift
text: Summon two 1/1 Zombies with Reborn.
flavor: "Why are we even open at night? This place is dead!"

name: Blink
text: Draw a Protoss minion. Combo: It costs (2) less.

name: Rimefang Sword
text: After your hero attacks, reduce the Cost of a spell in your hand by (1).
flavor: Those definitely don't rhyme.

name: Ymirjar Deathbringer
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Spend 3 Corpses to summon a 3/3 Risen Ymirjar with Taunt.
flavor: Purple cotton candy is the snack of choice in Ymirheim.

name: Rime Sculptor
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Rime Elementals with "Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy."
flavor: Also known as a Rapper.

name: Obliterate
text: Destroy a minion. Deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: Why is 6 afraid of 7? Because Obliterate 9!

name: Repulsive Gargantuan
text: Enemy characters can't be healed.
flavor: "EW, YUCK, GROSS, ICKY-" "Stop, you're hurting my feelings!"

name: Overseer Frigidara
text: Battlecry: Draw 2 spells. If they're both Frost spells, deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Is your refrigidarator running?

name: Patchwerk
text: Battlecry: Destroy a random minion in your opponent's hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: This card is so good, it might need patch work.

name: Lord Marrowgar
text: Battlecry: Raise ALL of your Corpses as 1/1 Risen Golems with Rush. For each that can't fit, give one +2/+2.
flavor: And now, Lord Marrowgar with the weather.

name: Mothership
text: Taunt Battlecry and Deathrattle: Get two random Protoss minions.
flavor: You talk to your mothership with that mouth!?

name: Missile Pod
text: Starship Piece Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Also triggers on launch.
flavor: Welcome to the Missile Pod, your one-stop shop for all things missile-related. Tune in each week for developments in the world of missiles.

name: Lift Off
text: Draw 2 Terran cards. Summon a 2/1 Starship Piece with an effect when launched.
flavor: It's a bird! It's a plane! It's a burning command center slowly moving to the corner of the map!

name: Concussive Shells
text: Deal 2 damage and gain 2 Armor. Your next Starship launch costs (2) less.
flavor: Zerg patients rated these a solid 7 on the pain chart.

name: Grunty
text: Battlecry: Summon four random Murlocs, then shoot them at enemy minions. (You pick the targets!)
flavor: <Mrrglglg, it's about time.>

name: Ysera, Emerald Aspect
text: Start of Game: Increase both players'maximum Mana by 5. Battlecry: Gain 3 Mana Crystals.
flavor: She was previously Yuhsera, with a ‘yuh’.

name: Hopeful Dryad
text: Battlecry: Get a random Dream card.
flavor: "I hope this dragon doesn't eat me when it grows up."

name: Emerald Skytalon
text: Rush
flavor: Sworn protectors of Ysera at the Emerald Dragonshrine, these majestic owls have been touched by the powers of the Emerald Dream, taking on an almost crystalline appearance.

name: Selective Breeder
text: Battlecry: Discover a copy of a Beast in your deck.
flavor: His ethics are top notch. Just look at that smiling kitty!

name: Verdant Dreamsaber
text: Battlecry: If this costs (3) or less, attack two random enemy minions.
flavor: Hey, at least the card frame is verdant.

name: Ohn'ahra
text: At the end of your turn, play the top 3 cards from your deck.
flavor: Revered by the tauren and centaur, Ohn’ahra’s power over wind remains an inspiration to many.

name: Shepherd's Crook
text: After your hero attacks, summon a 3/3 Sheep that's Dormant for 2 turns.
flavor: Beloved weapon of Little Bo-Sleep.

name: Nydus Worm
text: Draw two Zerg cards. They cost (1) less.
flavor: How did they fit an ultralisk in there!?

name: Forest Lord Cenarius
text: Choose Thrice - Give your other minions +1/+3; or Summon a 5/5 Ancient with Taunt.
flavor: He handpicked Malfurion, and not Illidan, to become the first druid, therefore ensuring an endless cycle of sibling rivalry.

name: Omen
text: Rush, Windfury Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all enemies. (Improves after this attacks!)
flavor: His tremendous wisdom could not survive the foul influence of the demons’ fel magic during the War of the Ancients. But his blessing from Elune did.

name: Viper
text: Battlecry: Summon a minion from your opponent's hand. Your other Zerg minions gain Reborn and attack it.
flavor: No viping!

name: Ultralisk Cavern
text: Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Deathrattle: Summon an 8/8 Ultralisk with Rush.
flavor: Don't let your ultralisk get stuck on a ramp.

name: Consume
text: Remove 1 Durability from a friendly location to restore 8 Health to your hero.
flavor: What are you looking at? This isn't a mukbang.

name: Evolution Chamber
text: Give your minions +1 Attack. Give your Zerg an extra +1/+1.
flavor: "Survival of Swarm dependent on evolution, iteration. Trust process, trust sequences. Swarm will not fail." - Abathur

name: Mutalisk
text: Also damages minions next to whomever this attacks (and the enemy hero if a neighbor is missing).
flavor: A flock of seagulls. A murder of crows. A ball of mutalisks.

name: Spine Crawler
text: Taunt. Can't attack. Has +3 Attack if you control a location.
flavor: Give him one second, he's rooting!... Ok give him one more second he's almost done!

name: Ultraviolet Breaker
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to an enemy minion. Shuffle 3 Asteroids into your deck.
flavor: You're gonna need more sunscreen. Good thing we stocked up last expansion.

name: Aessina
text: Battlecry: If 20 friendly minions have died this game, deal 20 damage split among all enemies. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: The Mother Wisp is a mysterious figure to most mortals, but to Ysera, she is a dear friend and companion.

name: Void Ray
text: Rush, Divine Shield Battlecry: If this costs (0), gain +2/+2.
flavor: Raymond just had this empty feeling.

name: Immortal
text: Taunt, Divine Shield Battlecry: Spend 4 Mana to double this minion's stats.
flavor: Hi Mortal, I'm Dad.

name: Sentry
text: Lifesteal. Deathrattle: Your Protoss minions cost (1) less this game.
flavor: Need a dispenser here!

name: High Templar
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Play another Templar to merge into an Archon!
flavor: If this job doesn't work out, I can always fall back on being a Psionic Storm Chaser.

name: Treacherous Tormentor
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion with a Dark Gift.
flavor: He's so mean, he leaves you on red.

name: Hellion
text: Your other minions have +1 Attack. (Transforms if you launched a Starship this game.)
flavor: Let's upgrade to the non-flammable tires next time.

name: Siege Tank
text: Battlecry: Deal 10 damage to a random enemy minion. (Transforms if you launched a Starship this game.)
flavor: Pretty decent as an off tank, but incredible as a main tank.

name: Thor
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage. (Transforms if you launched a Starship this game.)
flavor: "I need your clothes, your boots and your chitinous exoskeleton."

name: Creature of Madness
text: Battlecry: Discover a 3-Cost minion with a Dark Gift.
flavor: So THIS is madness!

name: Flutterwing Guardian
text: Taunt, Divine Shield Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: Flutterwing in the skyyyyy, I can go twice as highhhhhh

name: Divination
text: Destroy a friendly Wisp to draw 3 cards.
flavor: Stop! It's already dead!

name: Exotic Houndmaster
text: Battlecry: Draw a Beast. Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: "Hi lil guy! Have a bite of Green, it's good for you!"

name: Umbraclaw
text: Rush Deathrattle: Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: Umbraclaws of a feather hibernate together.

name: Resplendent Dreamweaver
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: If you've Imbued your Hero Power twice, deal 4 damage to a minion.
flavor: Have you ever had a dream that that you um you had you'd you would you could you'd do you wi you wants you you could do so you you'd do you could you you want so much you could do anything?

name: Lunarwing Messenger
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: Back in my day this is how we got friend requests.

name: Goldpetal Drake
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: All that glitters is gold... Petal. Drake.

name: Briarspawn Drake
text: At the end of your turn, attack a random enemy minion (excess damage hits the enemy hero).
flavor: Stop briarspawn-camping!

name: Clutch of Corruption
text: Choose a friendly Dragon. Summon a 0/2 Egg that hatches into a copy of it.
flavor: These eggs are no yolk!

name: Succumb to Madness
text: Discover a friendly Dragon that died this game. Resummon it.
flavor: u mad bro?

name: Darkrider
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, Discover a Dragon with a Dark Gift.
flavor: Before the corruption spread to the Emerald Dream, he was known only by this: Rider.

name: Brood Keeper
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, equip a 2/2 Sword.
flavor: Mess with the brood, and you get the dude!

name: Afflicted Devastator
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to all other friendly minions. Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.

name: Goldrinn
text: Rush Friendly Beasts deal double damage.
flavor: His relentless ferocity has made him well known among many peoples and by many names, including Lo’Gosh and the Great Wolf.

name: Beanstalk Brute
text: Battlecry: Give +4/+4 to the top 3 minions in your deck.

name: Emerald Bounty
text: Draw 2 cards. You can't play them for 2 turns.
flavor: Overgrowd: (2)

name: Merithra
text: Battlecry: Resurrect all different friendly minions that cost (8) or more.

name: Q'onzu
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell. Choose to keep it or put it on top of your opponent's deck.

name: Living Garden
text: Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power. Reduce the Cost of a minion in your hand by (1).

name: Wisprider
text: Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power, then trigger it.

name: Forbidden Shrine

name: Mythical Runebear
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If this has 4 or more Attack, summon a copy of this.

name: Wish of the New Moon

name: Ritual of the New Moon
text: Summon two random 3-Cost minions. (Cast 3 spells to summon 6-Cost minions instead.)

name: Hideous Husk

name: Rite of Atrocity

name: Infested Breath
text: Deal 2 damage. Summon a 0/2 Leech.

name: Corpse Flower

name: Nythendra

name: Selenic Drake
text: Elusive At the end of your turn, get a random Dragon.

name: Twilight Influence
text: Choose One - Destroy a minion with 3 or less Attack; or Summon a random 2-Cost minion.

name: Jumpscare!

name: Ysondre

name: Barkshield Sentinel

name: Nebula
text: Discover two 8-Cost minions to summon with Taunt and Elusive.
flavor: Do-re-mi-fa-so-ne-bu-la!

name: Tortolla
