flavor: Tortolla survived the Burning Legion’s invasion unscathed, but the Nightmare’s corruption really got under his shell.

name: Typhoon
text: Each minion gets shuffled into a random player's deck.
flavor: I gotta go Julia, we got satyrs.

name: Aspect's Embrace
text: Restore 4 Health. Draw a card. Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: For when you really need a hug. Or to Imbue your Hero Power.

name: Spirits of the Forest
text: Choose One - Summon three 2/3 Wolves with Taunt; or Summon two 4/3 Falcons with Windfury.
flavor: ...or sixteen cows.

name: Weaver of the Cycle
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, deal 3 damage.
flavor: A terror at spin class.

name: Nightmare Dragonkin
text: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of the right-most card in your hand by (2).
flavor: But what if I'm left-handed??

name: Ravenous Felhunter
text: Deathrattle: Resurrect a friendly Deathrattle minion that costs (4) or less. Summon a copy of it.
flavor: Loves soul food.

name: Ferocious Felbat
text: Deathrattle: Resurrect a different friendly Deathrattle minion that costs (5) or more. Summon a copy of it.
flavor: A tree in the hand is worth two in the Nightmare.

name: Tricky Satyr
text: Battlecry: Get a copy of the lowest Cost card in your opponent's hand.
flavor: Silly Satyr, tricks are for whelps!

name: Mimicry
text: Your opponent draws 2 cards. You get copies of them.
flavor: "Stop copying me!" "sToP cOpyInG mEE!"

name: Web of Deception
text: Return a friendly minion to your hand to summon a 4/4 Spider with Stealth.
flavor: You sit on a web of LIES!

name: Dragonscale Armaments
text: Draw a spell that started in your deck and one that didn't.
flavor: Why are dragons so good in the late game? 'Cause they scale!!!!

name: Infiltrate
text: Choose a minion. Deal 3 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Everybody get out of here! Except you. You can stay.

name: Shadowcloaked Assailant
text: Battlecry: If you're holding one of the same cards as your opponent, shuffle theirs into their deck.
flavor: "Got any Finjas?" "Go fish."

name: Barbed Thorn
text: Choose One - Gain Poisonous this turn; or Gain "Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemies."
flavor: Comes with a pack of bandages.

name: Renferal, the Malignant
text: Battlecry: Trap 1 random card in your opponent's hand for a turn. (Improved for each time you've played this.)
flavor: Go web go!

name: Ashamane
text: Battlecry: Fill your hand with copies of cards from your opponent's deck. They cost (3) less.
flavor: In ancient times, Ashamane sacrificed herself to save night elves from the Legion’s wrath. Her name is still honored among their descendants.

name: Animated Moonwell
text: After you cast a spell, gain Attack equal to its Cost.
flavor: Your spells are sure to make a splash!

name: Renewing Flames
text: Lifesteal. Deal 5 damage to the lowest Health enemy, twice.
flavor: I AM THE PHOENIX KING!!!

name: Toreth the Unbreaking
text: Divine Shield, Taunt Your Divine Shields take three hits to break.
flavor: Toreth took Bubble Hearth extra seriously.

name: Cosmic Phenomenon
text: Summon three 2/3 Elementals with Taunt. If your board is full, give your minions +1/+1.
flavor: Which one you ask? Uhh, all of them.

name: Distress Signal
text: Summon two random 2-Cost minions. Refresh 2 Mana Crystals.
flavor: HELP! HEEELP! MY OPPONENT PLAYED CARDS!

name: Moonwell
text: Deal 4 damage to all enemy characters. Restore 4 Health to all friendly characters.
flavor: Everyone always asks what the moonwell is but how come no one ever asks how well the moon is?

name: Mark of Ursol
text: Choose a minion. If it's an enemy, set its stats to 1/1. If it's friendly, set its stats to 3/3 instead.
flavor: Marko! Ursol!

name: Ursine Maul
text: After your hero attacks, draw a card.
flavor: Buy all the bears at the Ursine Mall!

name: Grim Harvest
text: Draw a card. Summon a random Dormant Dreadseed.
flavor: "Muahaha… This year's harvest was quite grim… just how I like it! Because I'm EVIL!"

name: Dreadsoul Corrupter
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Summon a random Dormant Dreadseed.
flavor: Believe it or not, Dreadsouls aren't already corrupted.

name: Defiled Spear
text: After your hero attacks an enemy, deal your hero's Attack damage to another random enemy.
flavor: TOGETHAAA

name: Reforestation
text: Choose One - Draw a spell; or Draw a minion. (Hold this for 3 turns to do both!)
flavor: ¿Porque no los dos?

name: Naralex, Herald of the Flights
text: Your first Dragon each turn costs (1).
flavor: Naptime is officially OVER!

name: Broll Bearmantle
text: After you cast a spell, summon a random Animal Companion.
flavor: That's just how he Brolls.

name: Hamuul Runetotem
text: Start of Game: If each spell in your deck is Nature, Imbue your Hero Power. Repeat this every 3 spells you cast.
flavor: Rune (Death Knight) + Totem (Shaman) = Druid??

name: Ursol
text: Battlecry: Cast the highest Cost spell from your hand as an Aura that lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Twin of Ursoc, they were inseparable until death drove Ursoc’s spirit to corruption, while Ursol’s remained at peace.

name: Illusory Greenwing
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Shuffle two 4/5 Dragons with Taunt into your deck. They're Summoned When Drawn.
flavor: "MORE LIKE, A LOSER-Y GREENWING! MUAHAHA!" - Nightmare Lord Xavius

name: Dreambound Disciple
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Your next Hero Power costs (0).
flavor: I'm not taking a nap, I'm just doing some extra studying about the Dream!

name: Photosynthesis
text: Restore 6 Health. Get 3 random Druid spells.
flavor: Nothing beats some time relaxing in the sun with a pile of good mulch.

name: Glowroot Lure
text: Taunt. Costs (1) less for each time you used your Hero Power this game.
flavor: You'd think this is a creation of the Emerald Nightmare, but you would be wrong.

name: Dreambound Raptor
text: After you play a minion, give it a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: Dream, dream, dream, dream, dream, dreeeeeeeeam.

name: Bitterbloom Knight
text: Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: Every rose has its thorn, beard, and shield.

name: Sanguine Infestation
text: Draw 2 cards. Summon two 0/2 Leeches.
flavor: Don't worry, they're prescribed leeches!

name: Morbid Swarm
text: Choose One - Summon two 1/1 Ants; or Spend 2 Corpses to deal 4 damage to a minion.
flavor: Death Knights are masters of death who use shadow magic to control swarms of... ants?

name: Rotten Apple
text: Restore 12 Health to your hero. For the next 2 turns, deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: The rotten apple doesn't fall far from the corrupted world tree.

name: Twisted Treant
text: Deathrattle: Give a random minion in each player's hand -2 Attack.
flavor: You twist me right round baby right round like a treant baby right round round round

name: Fractured Power
text: Destroy one of your Mana Crystals. In 2 turns, gain two.
flavor: Look what Warlocks need just to mimic a fraction of our power!

name: Scavenging Flytrap
text: After a minion dies, gain its Attack.
flavor: Feed me, Seymour!

name: Rotheart Dryad
text: Deathrattle: Draw a minion that costs (7) or more.
flavor: Rot through the heart and Xavius is to blame!

name: Scorching Observer
text: Rush Lifesteal
flavor: We get it, you're mad that you only have one eye. But that's no excuse to burn down the entire Emerald Dream.

name: Wallow, the Wretched
text: While this is in your hand or deck, it gains a copy of every Dark Gift given to your minions.
flavor: Their hairdo is anything BUT wretched.

name: Amphibian's Spirit
text: Give a minion +2/+2 and "Deathrattle: Give a friendly minion +2/+2 and this Deathrattle."
flavor: Look before you leap.

name: Spirit Bond
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, summon a 3/2 Wolf with Rush.
flavor: The name's Bond. Spirit Bond.

name: Grace of the Greatwolf
text: Choose One - Deal 4 damage to the enemy hero; or Summon two 3/2 Wolves with Rush.
flavor: LOOK WHAT I CAN DO!!!!

name: Horn of Plenty
text: Discover a Nature spell. It costs (2) less.
flavor: Don't be silly, there's never been a cornucopia in the art.

name: Avant-Gardening
text: Discover a Deathrattle minion with a Dark Gift.
flavor: Normal gardening is so passé.

name: Nightmare Fuel
text: Discover a copy of a minion in your opponent's deck. Combo: With a Dark Gift.
flavor: Every instance of "but not less than (1)" has been replaced with "but not more than (1)."

name: Shaladrassil
text: Get all 5 Dream cards. If you've played a higher Cost card while holding this, corrupt them!
flavor: Wow, that Nightmare-B-Gone spray really works! Too bad we didn't have enough for the whole tree.

name: Nightmare Lord Xavius
text: Battlecry: Discover a minion from your deck. Give it a Dark Gift.
flavor: Xavius will also be replacing Illidan as the Demon Hunter hero in an upcoming patch.

name: Bloodthistle Illusionist
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this. One secretly dies when it takes damage.
flavor: Some people have imaginary friends. He has an imaginary twin.

name: Harbinger of the Blighted
text: Whenever this enters your hand from the battlefield, summon two random 2-Cost minions.
flavor: The more pretentious the name, the eviler the character.

name: Malorne the Waywatcher
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary Wild God. If you've Imbued your Hero Power 4 times, set its Cost to (1).
flavor: A figure of legend and myth, Malorne is one of the oldest of the Wild Gods and father to Cenarius himself.

name: Petal Peddler
text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly Dragon +1/+1.
flavor: The Emerald Nightmare might actually be a good thing for her business.

name: Wyvern's Slumber
text: Choose One - Summon two Dormant Dreadseeds; or Deal 2 damage to all minions.
flavor: But watch, as soon as you try to go to sleep it'll be running all around the house making a bunch of noise.

name: Agamaggan
text: Battlecry: The next card you play costs your OPPONENT'S Health instead of Mana (up to 10).
flavor: Though he fell during the War of the Ancients, his legacy on Azeroth can be seen in the flourishing quilboar tribes who still worship him.

name: Sleep Paralysis
text: Choose One - Summon two 3/6 Demons with Taunt that can't attack; or Destroy an enemy minion.
flavor: The wild SPRITE is paralyzed! It can't sleep!

name: Aviana, Elune's Chosen
text: Battlecry: Start a three turn lunar cycle. When the Full Moon rises, your cards cost (1) this game.
flavor: The Mistress of Birds takes a special interest in all creatures of the sky, as well as those who have wings but have yet to fly.

name: Plucky Podling
text: If this would transform into a minion, it transforms into one that costs (2) more.
flavor: "When I grow up I wanna be a Deathwing!"

name: Archdruid of Thorns
text: Battlecry: Gain the Deathrattles of your minions that died this turn.
flavor: He EARNED that "arch" gosh dangit!

name: Daydreaming Pixie
text: At the end of your turn, get a random Nature spell.
flavor: Pixie perfect.

name: Mother Duck
text: Battlecry: Summon three 1/1 Ducklings with Rush.
flavor: Also summons a 0/0 Ugly Duckling.

name: Kaldorei Priestess
text: Battlecry: Give all enemy minions -2 Attack until your next turn. Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: Elune, I implore you... bless my game with good rng, so that I may achieve Legend with a 100% winrate.

name: Twisted Webweaver
text: Whenever you play another minion you've already played, draw a card.
flavor: This spider is so evil that it catches things in its web and EATS them!

name: Cremate
text: Discover a minion with a Dark Gift. It costs (2) less.
flavor: Cleanup on grave plot 4.

name: Frostburn Matriarch
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a minion with a Dark Gift, summon two 4/4 Dragons with Taunt.
flavor: Her frostburn is worse than her frostbite.

name: Sigil of Cinder
text: At the start of your next turn, deal 6 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: It's the emblem of fire season.

name: Felfire Blaze
text: After you cast a Fel spell, destroy this and deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Like fire, felfire, this fire in my skin.

name: Overheat
text: Give your minions +1/+1. Discard a random Nature spell to give them +1/+1 more.
flavor: "Did you bring water?" "I THOUGHT YOU WERE BRINGING THE WATER!"

name: Amirdrassil
text: Summon a 1-Cost minion. Gain 1 Armor. Draw 1 card. Refresh 1 Mana |4(Crystal, Crystals). (Improves each use!)
flavor: The spirits burned at Teldrassil shall not be forgotten. They live on within a new world tree, the Crown of Harmony.

name: Charred Chameleon
text: Battlecry: If you've used your Hero Power this turn, give a friendly minion +1/+2 and Rush.
flavor: Charma, charma, charma, charma, charma chameleon You combust and glow, you combust and glow...

name: Bursting Shot
text: Deal 2 damage to three random enemies.
flavor: And I fired! And I missed. And I fired again! And I missed again. This went on for several hours.

name: Scorching Winds
text: Deal 3 damage. Discard a random Fire spell to deal 3 more.
flavor: It's like the old saying goes: where there's smoke, there's often fire... and where there's fire, there's often more fire.

name: Smoldering Grove
text: Draw X card. (Upgrades each turn, but discards after X!)1Draw X cards. (Discards this turn!)

name: Inferno Herald
text: After you cast a Fire spell, get a random Elemental and reduce its Cost by (3).
flavor: Poor Inferno Herald, why so blue?

name: Smoldering Strength
text: Give a friendly minion +X/+X. (Upgrades each turn, but discards after X!)1Give a friendly minion +X/+X. (Discards this turn!)
flavor: You'll get it when you're smolder.

name: Smoldering Ascent
text: Deal X damage to all enemy minions. (Upgrades each turn, but discards after X!)1Deal X damage to all enemy minions. (Discards this turn!)
flavor: We all know what happens when you fly too close to the sun. But THIS is what happens when you fly straight into it.

name: Light of the New Moon
text: Give a minion +3/+3. (Cast 3 spells to return this to your hand when played.)
flavor: UM ACTUALLY THAT’S A WANING CRESCENT

name: Everburning Phoenix
text: Costs (1) less for each card you've played this turn. Deathrattle: At end of turn, get another Phoenix.
flavor: You'd be making that face too if you just got played for the sixteenth time.

name: Smoke Bomb
text: Discover a Combo, Battlecry, or Stealth minion with a Dark Gift.
flavor: Wow, this blew up.

name: Petal Picker
text: Battlecry: If you've Imbued your Hero Power twice, draw 2 cards.
flavor: She loves me... she loves me not...

name: Cindersword
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a minion with a Dark Gift, gain +3 Attack.
flavor: Where did I put de metals? It cindersword.

name: Flames of the Firelord
text: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy minion. If you're holding a card that costs (8) or more, deal 8 instead.
flavor: The Firelord has been banned from chat for flaming.

name: Shadowflame Stalker
text: Battlecry: Discover a Demon with a Dark Gift. Get a copy of it.
flavor: The purple means it's stealthy. It's stealthy fire.

name: Sporegnasher
text: Poisonous Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: The overbite of a century.

name: Keeper of Flame
text: Battlecry: Give all minions in your hand +3/+3. They are destroyed in 3 turns.
flavor: "I keep it right here. Inside my hooves."

name: Zaqali Flamemancer
text: Battlecry: If every card in your hand is of a different Cost, reduce their Costs by (2).
flavor: What's the difference between a pyromancer and a flamemancer? One knows their Greek roots, the other BURNS THEM DOWN!

name: Living Flame
text: Deathrattle: Draw a Fire spell.
flavor: "Get a load of this guy."

name: Emberscarred Whelp
text: Battlecry: Discover a 5-Cost card. Gain 1 Mana Crystal next turn only.
flavor: I LOVE YOU NOT!

name: Shadowflame Suffusion
text: Deal 2 damage. Discover a Warrior minion with a Dark Gift.
flavor: One Fire and Shadow swirl, please!

name: Volcoross
text: Rush, Taunt Battlecry: Choose to spend 10, 20, or 30 Corpses to gain that many stats.
flavor: Unholy, so hot right now.

name: Scorchreaver
text: Battlecry: Discover a Fel spell. Reduce the Cost of Fel spells in your hand by (1).
flavor: Fel from grace about 10,000 years ago.

name: Magma Hound
text: Rush. After this attacks a minion and survives, deal this minion's Attack damage split among all enemies.
flavor: Don't say T.R.E.A.T. or he'll drool lava everywhere.

name: Conflagrate
text: Deal 5 damage to a minion. Its owner draws a card.
flavor: From the ashes, a new card is drawn.

name: Emberroot Destroyer
text: Whenever your hero takes damage on your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: Under Fyrakk's assault, even those with the purest devotion to nature shall burn.

name: Dragon Turtle
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a minion with a Dark Gift, give your hero +3 Attack this turn and 6 Armor.
flavor: If you thought evil turtles that live in lava are cool, this one's also a DRAGON!

name: Fyrakk the Blazing
text: Immune to Fire spells. Battlecry: Cast 15 Mana worth of Fire spells at random enemies.
flavor: Originally devoted to snuffing out the Titans' influence, Shadowflame has twisted Fyrakk's mind into an abyss of malice. His Dreamrender now only hungers for a world of embers.

name: Tindral Sageswift
text: Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all enemies. If it's your opponent's turn, deal 4 damage instead.
flavor: He'll have you burning red.

name: Searing Reflection
text: Draw a minion. Summon an 8/8 copy of it with Divine Shield.
flavor: You never would've guessed it, but Ancients love doing the Hot Embers Challenge.

name: Merry Moonkin
text: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Armor. (Improved by Wisps you control!)
flavor: Merry Wispmas!

name: Grove Shaper
text: After you cast a Nature spell, summon a 2/2 Treant with "Deathrattle: Get a random Nature spell."
flavor: Infinite Nature spell glitch.

name: Starsurge
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion. (Improved by each friendly minion that died this game.)
flavor: "The stars urge you to DIE."

name: Curious Cumulus
text: At the end of your turn, give your hero Divine Shield.
flavor: Hole in one!

name: Evergreen Stag
text: Elusive Lifesteal Taunt
flavor: Nevergreen Stag has Enrage, Overkill, and Honorable Kill.

name: Symbiosis
text: Discover a Choose One card from another class.
flavor: It's the circle of life.

name: Alara'shi
text: Battlecry: Transform minions in your hand into random Demons. (They keep their original stats and Cost.)
flavor: It's a bird! It's a plane! It's a bear! It's a felstalker! It's a doomguard! It's an imp!

name: Critter Caretaker
text: At the end of your turn, restore 3 Health to both heroes.
flavor: She teaches all her critters two things: heel and heal.

name: Tending Dragonkin
text: Battlecry: Copy the lowest Cost Beast in your hand.
flavor: Dogs are a dragon's best friend.

name: Ashleaf Pixie
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, gain Divine Shield and Lifesteal.
flavor: Why don't you make like a burning world tree and ashleave???

name: Ursoc
text: Battlecry: Attack ALL other minions. Deathrattle: Resurrect any this killed.
flavor: The great bear lord was so mighty that the Nightmare could only corrupt his spirit, not his strength.

name: Gnawing Greenfin
text: Battlecry: Get a random Murloc.
flavor: "Are you eating bark again!?" "Gnawwwww...."

name: Tranquil Treant
text: Deathrattle: Both players gain an empty Mana Crystal.
flavor: "Cut down my trunk and make a Mana Crystal," said the tree. "Then you can ramp away... and be happy."

name: Eggbasher
text: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it +4 Attack.
flavor: We could do this the over-easy way or the over-hard way.

name: Monstrous Mosquito
text: At the end of your turn, give your other minions +1 Attack.
flavor: I know every creature is valuable in the ecosystem of life. But these guys SUCK.

name: Bonechill Stegodon
text: Deathrattle: Deal 6 damage to three random enemies.
flavor: Cold blooded. Bad to the bone. Needs a sweater.

name: Spirit Gatherer
text: Battlecry: Get a Wisp. Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: They call him the Wisp Whisperer.

name: Envoy of the Glade
text: Battlecry: Transform all Neutral cards in your deck into random Druid ones.
flavor: Announce Gladeness.

name: Ominous Nightmares
text: Choose One - Deal 1 damage to all minions; or Give a damaged minion +2/+2.
flavor: Everyone keeps talking about nightmares, but I don't see any horses?

name: Lightmender
text: Taunt. Choose One - +3 Attack and Divine Shield; or +3 Health and Lifesteal.
flavor: How many lightmenders does it take to mend a lightorb?

name: Fae Trickster
text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell that costs (5) or more.
flavor: Muahaha they'll never see this spell that costs (5) or more coming!!

name: Tormented Dreadwing
text: Deathrattle: Draw 2 Dragons. Reduce their Costs by (1).
flavor: People say you can't see clearly through corruption, but you have more eyes than ever!

name: Dreamwarden
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If there is a card in your deck that didn't start there, draw it and gain +2/+2.
flavor: This is advanced dreamcatching.

name: Aegis of Light
text: Summon a random 2-Cost minion and give it Taunt. Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: "Try scooching together! The arrows are getting through!"

name: Siphoning Growth
text: Destroy a friendly minion to gain 8 Armor.
flavor: No thanks. This one's all yours, bud.

name: Spark of Life
text: Choose One - Discover a Mage spell; or Discover a Druid spell.
flavor: Just don't spark that life too close to the World Tree.

name: Stellar Balance
text: Get a Moonfire and a Starfire. Give them Spell Damage +1.
flavor: Famously, Moonfire and Starfire are about equal in power.

name: Lie in Wait
text: Quest: Shuffle cards into your deck, 5 times. Reward: Master Dusk.
flavor: Day 2. Our first night in the Crater was a tad rough on this old shell. I can’t shake the feeling that we’re being watched. I swear I saw a glint of shining silver in the dark. I was going to ask Umbra about it at breakfast, but she never turned up.

name: High Cultist Herenn
text: Battlecry: Summon two Deathrattle minions from your deck. They fight!
flavor: "Hello." - Cultist Herenn

name: Archaios
text: Whenever another friendly minion attacks, set its Health equal to this minion's Health.
flavor: She's a health influencer.

name: Spirit of the Kaldorei
text: Taunt, Lifesteal Battlecry: If you used your Hero Power this turn, gain +3/+3.
flavor: We brought magic to this world, but destruction may take it away.

name: Avatar of Destruction
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 9 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: Master of all ONE element!

name: Ancient of Yore
text: Dormant for 2 turns. While Dormant, gain 3 Armor and draw a card at the end of your turn.
flavor: Ancient of my what?

name: Babbling Bookcase
text: Battlecry: Add 2 random Mage spells to your hand.
flavor: Babbling Bookcase is quickly becoming one of my favorite cards. It's just so positive and generous. Practically costs nothing at all at three mana you drop him on the board and that chill guy gives you two spells to use later in the game.

name: Poison Breath
text: Give a friendly Undead Poisonous.
flavor: Try not to let your breath get so bad it starts gaining Bonus Effects.

name: Twilight Mender
text: Deathrattle: Get a random Holy and Shadow spell.
flavor: The Gravedawn Glade is FULL of indecisive Priests.

name: Gravedawn Voidbulb
text: Summon a random 4-Cost minion and give it Taunt. Kindred: Do it again.
flavor: How many Gravedawns does it take to screw in a Voidbulb?

name: Gravedawn Sunbloom
text: Draw 2 cards. Kindred: This costs (2) less.
flavor: So holy it photosynthesizes itself!

name: Dive the Golakka Depths
text: Repeatable Quest: Summon 6 Murlocs. Reward: Murlocs you summon gain +1/+1.
flavor: Day 5. Elise had a hunch that the Lost City may be hidden deep beneath the Golakka Hot Springs. Niri swam down and discovered a beautiful cavern! The Murlocs may not be hiding an entrance to the city, but it seems they do have a few secrets.

name: Rockskipper
text: Battlecry: Get a 1-Cost Rock that deals 3 damage.
flavor: Don't step on a stream or you'll break your mama's spleen.

name: Hot Spring Glider
text: Battlecry: Your next Murloc costs (1) less. Kindred: And gains Divine Shield.
flavor: It's an important survival instinct to keep a low profile in Un'Goro Crater. Gargl will not survive long.

name: Steamfin Thief
text: Kindred: Summon two 1/1 Murlocs with Rush.
flavor: Dial M for Murlocs.

name: Creature of the Sacred Cave
text: At the end of your turn, recast a random Holy spell you cast this turn (targets this if possible).
flavor: Really likes being read to.

name: Dream Rager
text: Elusive
flavor: "Just try and ping me now!"

name: Dread Raptor
text: Battlecry: Draw a Deathrattle minion that costs (3) or less. Kindred: It costs (0).
flavor: "I AM THE CLAW!"

name: Reanimate the Terror
text: Quest: Spend 15 Corpses. Reward: Tyrax, Bone Terror.
flavor: Day 11. We’ve been betrayed! Umbra has been meeting secretly with the Cult of the Damned to plan a coup. She and High Cultist Herenn used shadow magic to raise an undead dinosaur army! Tortolla preserve us, the fate of the Lost City rests in our hands.

name: Paleomancy
text: Discover an Undead. Spend 5 Corpses to keep all 3 instead.
flavor: Death finds a way.

name: Crypt Map
text: Discover a Frost Rune card. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: Solving a maze is easy. Just hug the left wall and don't get eaten by dinosaurs!

name: Reanimated Pterrordax
text: Rush, Lifesteal Costs Corpses instead of Mana.
flavor: Ptruly pterrifying.

name: Hungering Ancient
text: At the end of your turn, eat a minion in your deck and gain its stats. Deathrattle: Add them to your hand.
flavor: This guy puts the horror in horrorticulture.

name: Meadowstrider
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Put a Meadowstrider on the bottom of your deck. It costs (1).
flavor: Pwease stop meadowing in my affaiws.

name: Windswept Pageturner
text: After you summon an Elemental, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: This story will blow you away.

name: Sizzling Swarm
text: Deal 3 damage. Summon that many 2/1 Sizzling Cinders.
flavor: Can someone open a window? It's a little swarm in here!

name: Volcanic Thrasher
text: Battlecry: Draw a Fire spell. Kindred: Give it Spell Damage +2.
flavor: Very friendly, but be careful when it asks to play fetch.

name: Mechanized Magma
text: Whenever you play a Fire spell, gain stats equal to its Cost.
flavor: Its volcanic strength powers its mechanical arm... and also its normal arm.

name: Conjured Bookkeeper
text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell. Kindred: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: In charge of cleaning up after the Library Rager.

name: Lava Flow
text: Deal 2 damage to the lowest Health enemy, three times. Overload: (1)
flavor: The lava must flow.

name: Spirit of the Mountain
text: Quest: Play 6 minions of unique types. Reward: Ashalon.
flavor: Day 10. A Tortollan named Bralma took Niri, Elise, and I deep into the mountain. She showed us how the Tortollans move lava up from the base of the volcano through a system of “lavaqueducts.” I was shocked to find a pack of Volcanosaurs living there!

name: Reach Equilibrium
text: Quest: Cast 6 Holy spells. Reward: Life's Breath. Quest: Cast 6 Shadow spells. Reward: Death's Touch.
flavor: Day 6. Today we found ourselves in a glade tormented by conflicting Holy and Shadow magic. At its center were two enormous Elementals, like opposite sides of the same coin. I hope one day we'll return here to see this broken place restored to peace.

name: Resuscitate
text: Resurrect a 1, 2, and 3-Cost minion. Give them Reborn.
flavor: This mud bath really does make you feel reborn.

name: Violet Treasuregill
text: Battlecry: Cast a random spell from your deck that costs (2) or less (targets this if possible).
flavor: His brother Violent was banned from the colony.

name: Gladesong Siren
text: Lifesteal Costs (1) if you've cast a Holy and Shadow spell this turn.
flavor: When she shifts into minor key she really throws the void-holy balance out of whack.

name: Glade Ecologist
text: Deathrattle: Get a 1-Cost Holy spell that gives a minion +2 or -2 Health.
flavor: The dude minored in Underfel Biology. Now that's a renaissance Tortollan!

name: Wilted Shadow
text: Lifesteal Whenever you heal an enemy, this attacks it.
flavor: The shadow shall burn you!

name: Dinositter
text: At the end of your turn, reduce the Cost of a random Beast in your hand by (1).
flavor: "You aren't leaving this log until you finish your greens."

name: Cower in Fear
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. The next Beast you play this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: Mother Duck's fourth duckling got lost in Un'Goro Crater.

name: Odd Map
text: Discover an odd-Attack Beast. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: I don't EVEN know where this goes!

name: Ravasaur Matriarch
text: Kindred: Deal damage to an enemy minion equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: The female Ravasaur is 30% larger than the male. And 100% more aggressive.

name: Story of Carnassa
text: Shuffle ten 1-Cost 3/2 Raptors into your deck with "Battlecry: Draw a card."
flavor: "... and ALL TEN Raptors were at the top of the deck!"

name: Grazing Stegodon
text: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Attack (even while in hand or deck).
flavor: He's a growing boy.:)

name: Supreme Dinomancy
text: Give +2/+2 to all Beasts in your hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: Not anyone can be a great dinomancer. But a great dinomancer can come from anywhere.

name: Wave of Tar
text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions. Enemy minions cost (2) more next turn.
flavor: "Watch out for my WAVE OF TAR!!! Just... stand still for a minute."

name: Flight of the Firehawk
text: Draw two minions of different minion types. Give them +1/+1.
flavor: Also the name of a famous Tortollan orchestral arrangement.

name: Ravenous Devilsaur
text: Battlecry: Destroy a minion. Kindred: Gain its stats.
flavor: You're not you when you're ravenous.

name: Cinderfin
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/1 Sizzling Cinder.
flavor: "Don't play with fire." "But they're my friends!"

name: Bralma Searstone
text: Your Elementals deal 1 extra damage.
flavor: She makes a mean molten lava cake.

name: Cryosleep
text: Deal 4 damage and draw a card. Kindred: Draw another.
flavor: You mad? Cryobout it.

name: TREEEES!!!
text: Choose a minion. Summon four 2/2 Treants that attack it.
flavor: Photo synth THIS, fool!

name: Story of Barnabus
text: Draw a minion. If it has 5 or more Attack, give it +5 Health and gain 5 Armor.
flavor: "Once there was a giant dinosaur. He was so giant that everyone died. The end."

name: Ravenous Flock
text: At the start of your next turn, summon three 2/1 Hatchlings.
flavor: It's a flock of screamgulls!

name: Hatchery Helper
text: Battlecry: Give your other minions with 2 or less Attack +1/+1 and Taunt.
flavor: Yeah, painting patterns on the eggs is SUPER helpful J'an.

name: Eternal Bloodpetal
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 0/1 Eternal Seedling.
flavor: The crab grass of Un'Goro.

name: Life Cycle
text: Destroy a minion. Summon a random minion of the same Cost to replace it.
flavor: It's the cyyyyyycle of liiiiiife.

name: Hybridization
text: Draw a 1, 2, 3, and 4-Cost minion. Kindred: They cost (1) less.
flavor: You take the blue flower -- the story ends, you wake up in the inn and believe whatever you want to believe. You take the red flower -- you stay in Un'Goro, and I show you how deep the Gorishi tunnel goes.

name: Skyscreamer Eggs
text: Deathrattle: Summon four 2/1 Hatchlings.
flavor: Aaaaaaaaaaahmlette

name: Restore the Wild
text: Quest: Fill your board on 3 of your turns. Reward: The Everbloom.
flavor: Day 3. We happened upon a clearing filled with dangerous Bloodpetals. As I was noting our findings, the world went dark. My vision is perfect of course, but it appeared as though a large flying shape was blocking out the sun! Confounding indeed.

name: Ready the Fleet
text: Give +1/+2 to a friendly minion and your other minions that share a type with it.
flavor: The Fleet is on fleek.

name: Submerged Map
text: Discover a Murloc. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: Sure, it leads straight to Latorvia. How long can you hold your breath?

name: Reluctant Wrangler
text: Reborn Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Undead Beast with Taunt.
flavor: "It's not that I never wanted a pet. I didn't want THIS pet."

name: The Food Chain
text: Quest: Play a 1, 3, 5, and 7-Attack Beast. Reward: Shokk.
flavor: Day 1. The search begins! I joined Elise Starseeker at the outskirts of the Crater, as well as a Tortollan named Umbra and a most curious gnome named Niri. Embarking into the jungle, we stumbled upon the largest tracks I’ve ever laid eyes on!

name: Pterrordax Egg
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Pterrordax that steals 1 Health from all other minions.
flavor: When you crack this egg, it cracks you right back.

name: Story of Galvadon
text: Give a minion three random Bonus Effects.
flavor: "...so I gave him +12 Attack and Windfury -- and you won't believe this -- he LIVED."

name: Hive Map
text: Discover a Fel spell. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: The perfect map of where to never ever ever ever ever go.

name: Fumigate
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and all others of the same minion type.
flavor: Stink bomb go!

name: Infestation
text: Get two 1-Cost Gorishi Stingers. Each one deals 2 damage and summons a 2/1 Grub with Rush.
flavor: NOT THE WASPS!

name: Silithid Queen
text: Rush Kindred: Give your hero +5 Attack this turn.
flavor: Yaaaaaaass Silithid Queen, stiiiing.

name: Merchant of Legend
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion. Shuffle the other two into your deck.
flavor: "Tortollan has knives if you have coin."

name: Cultist Map
text: Discover a card from your deck. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: Are the Shrouded Shells actually great trackers, or are the Cult of the Damned just REALLY bad about leaving secret maps lying around?

name: Neferset Weaponsmith
text: Battlecry: Get a random weapon from another class. Combo: Give it +2 Attack.
flavor: Neferset your drink on the table without a coaster.

name: Knockback
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion (improved for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck).
flavor: Every day he's scufflin'

name: Interrogation
text: Shuffle three 3/3 Ninjas with Stealth into your deck that are Summoned When Drawn.
flavor: "Spill the tea or I'll end your entire career, sis."

name: Underbrush Tracker
text: Rush Costs (1) less for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck.
flavor: An expert at tracking the elusive Adaptive Amalgam.

name: Eyes in the Sky
text: Battlecry: Look at 3 cards in your enemy's deck. Pick one to put on top.
flavor: "I got eyes on Umbra's unstoppable undead army. I'll uh... stay wayyy up here."

name: Windpeak Wyrm
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Armor. Kindred: Costs (2) less.
flavor: He's so anxious. Always winds up in knots.

name: Shellnado
text: Spend up to 5 Armor. For each spent, deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: Spin to win!

name: Enter the Lost City
text: Quest: Survive 10 turns. Reward: Latorvius, Gaze of the City.
flavor: Day 8. We’ve done it! As night fell, we came upon a brilliantly glowing tunnel guarded by two slumbering Tol’vir. With silent footsteps, we walked through and emerged into the heart of the Lost City! I’m sure my people will welcome us with open arms.

name: Platysaur
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. Deathrattle: Discard it.
flavor: "Yup yup yup!"

name: Bob the Bartender
text: Battlecry: Choose an action from the Battlegrounds!
flavor: A good bartender always knows how to stir up the conversation.

name: Tar Tyrant
text: Taunt, Lifesteal Has +6 Attack during your opponent's turn.
flavor: Why would they put a waterfall here if there wasn't something cool behind it?

name: Elise the Navigator
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with 10 cards of different Costs, craft a custom location.
flavor: "I've seen that stump before. We must be getting close!"

name: Latorvian Armorer
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion. If it dies, gain 5 Armor.
flavor: All it needs now is a nice coat of blue paint!

name: Insect Claw
text: After your hero attacks, summon a 2/1 Grub with Rush.
flavor: Get your grubby claws off me!

name: Escape the Underfel
text: Quest: Play 6 Temporary cards. Reward: Underfel Rift.
flavor: Day 7. A terrible day! The ground opened beneath us, and we fell head over shell into an accursed rift! Fel choked my keen senses, and demonic beasts emerged from the fog. Thank goodness Umbra was able to use her magic to ward them off while we escaped.

name: Caustic Fumes
text: Destroy an enemy minion. Kindred: Deal 2 damage to all minions.
flavor: If the fumes don't get them, the fumes might.

name: Fortify
text: Gain 3 Armor. Deal damage equal to your Armor to an enemy minion.
flavor: With vitamins and minerals!

name: Bloodpetal Biome
text: Discover a Temporary 1-Cost minion.
flavor: The rash doesn't FEEL temporary.

name: Torga
text: Battlecry: Draw a Kindred card and another card that activates it.
flavor: Torga was killed, eaten, used to summon the undead and then used as a loudspeaker for spirits. But at least he's got a hell of a story to tell.

name: Gorishi Wasp
text: Rush. Whenever this takes damage, get a 1-Cost Gorishi Stinger.
flavor: This card is the wasp's elbows!

name: Unleash the Colossus
text: Quest: Deal exactly 2 damage to an enemy on your turn, 12 times. Reward: Gorishi Colossus.
flavor: Day 4. I am dismayed to report that we thought we'd found a hidden entrance to the Lost City, but in fact it was a Silithid Hive! We high-tailed it out of there faster than a goblin wearing rocket boots. I am not terribly fond of bugs.

name: Story of Sulfuras
text: Swap your Hero Power to "Deal 8 damage to a random enemy." After 2 uses, swap back.
flavor: "...and there were seven minions on board, and it STILL hit the enemy hero!"

name: Endbringer Umbra
text: Battlecry: Trigger the Deathrattles of 5 friendly minions that died this game.
flavor: After many years of exile, Umbra is so close to returning to her city. When she arrives, she will make sure the Tortollans get what they deserve...

name: Stormbrewer
text: Whenever this attacks, deal 3 damage to the target first. Kindred: Gain Rush.
flavor: It was a dark and stormy Elemental...

name: Relic Miner
text: Battlecry: Destroy the top card of your deck. Discover a card of the same Rarity.
flavor: "I struck gold! NOOOOOOOO!"

name: Spelunker
text: Battlecry: Your next Temporary card costs (2) less.
flavor: Echo... echo... repeatable this turn...

name: Cursed Catacombs
text: Discover another card from your deck. Make it Temporary.
flavor: The minion is now permanently cursed. Temporarily.

name: Willful Watcher
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Destroy the top 3 cards of your deck.
flavor: I still don't know why he has a sword. Despite being in many battles, he really just watches.

name: City Defenses
text: Summon two 0/6 Security with Taunt. They gain +1 Attack when damaged.
flavor: These 0/6 Taunts have kept invaders out for centuries.

name: Stonecarver
text: At the end of your turn, give another friendly damaged minion +2/+2.
flavor: *clink* *clink* *clink* *"D'oh!"

name: Nablya, the Watcher
text: Battlecry: Summon copies of your damaged minions. Give the copies Rush.
flavor: Of course the Titans trust the Tortollans to take care of Un'Goro Crater. Nablya is just there as insurance.

name: Tyrannogill
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon three 2/1 Murlocs. Give them each a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: There's something fishy about that dinosaur...

name: Bugsquasher
text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to an enemy minion with a minion type.
flavor: The Tortollans would be nothing without their QA department.

name: Ido of the Threshfleet
text: While this is alive, you get a 2-Cost Holy spell that gives a minion +2/+2 and Divine Shield.
flavor: Ido, therefore I am.

name: Titanographer Osk
text: Gains a random Titan ability in your hand that changes each turn.
flavor: Look at this Titangraph.

name: Questing Assistant
text: Battlecry: If you played a Quest this game, deal 3 damage to an enemy minion.
flavor: Forget the Quest. Our new Quest is to make sure no harm ever comes to him.

name: Scalehide Kodo
text: Battlecry: Destroy the lowest Attack enemy minion. Kindred: The highest Attack instead.
flavor: Little Eeep and his pal Stomp are off to see the wonders of Un'Goro. First stop, Underfel!

name: The Forbidden Sequence
text: Quest: Discover 8 cards. Reward: The Origin Stone.
flavor: Day 9. We were not welcomed with open arms, but with spears! Fortunately, Chief Esho took pity on us and called off the guards. Learning of Elise's expertise, a Titanographer whisked her away to the library. Umbra disappeared in the twisting streets...

name: Scrappy Scavenger
text: Battlecry: Discover a card with Cost equal to your remaining Mana Crystals.
flavor: "One second, I'm stashing this Ultragigasaur in my little satchel."

name: Unearthed Artifacts
text: Summon a random 2-Cost minion. If you've Discovered this turn, summon a random 4-Cost minion instead.
flavor: The Tortollans live so long they're unearthing their OWN artifacts!

name: Razidir
text: Battlecry: Discard a random card from your hand. Kindred: Your opponent's hand instead.
flavor: Be prepaaaaaaaaared! (by playing a Demon or Beast the previous turn.)

name: Ancient Stegodon
text: Battlecry: Choose to gain Taunt, Poisonous, or +1/+1.
flavor: I'm 30 years old.

name: Whirling Stormdrake
text: Rush, Windfury Kindred: Gain Immune this turn.
flavor: Summons storms. Breathes fire. But first, does a sick loop-de-loop.

name: Sizzling Cinder
text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: "Hey, I'm sizzlin' here!"

name: Curious Explorer
text: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of a minion in your opponent's hand by (2).
flavor: "Wow, this flower's mouth is perfectly head-shaped."

name: Ancient Raptor
text: Battlecry: Choose to gain +3 Attack, Divine Shield, or "Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Plants."
flavor: It prefers "Experienced."

name: Mountain Map
text: Discover a minion with a type you haven't played. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: See that part at the top? That's the top.

name: Ancient Pterrordax
text: Battlecry: Choose to gain Stealth until your next turn, Elusive, or Windfury.
flavor: What's that sound? He's a terrible conductor.

name: Primal Sabretooth
text: Stealth After this attacks and kills a minion, get a copy of it.
flavor: 100 dino birds versus 1 sabretooth. Who would win?

name: Ultragigasaur
flavor: Ultrasaur for scale.

name: Stranglevine
text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion a random Bonus Effect and this Deathrattle.
flavor: "Wow, this human's head is perfectly mouth-shaped."

name: Story of Lakkari
text: At the end of your turn, discard a card and fill your board with 3/2 Imps. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Wow, the Tortollans really embellish these stories.

name: Crater Gator
text: Battlecry: Until the start of your next turn, the enemy hero can't be healed.
flavor: See ya later Crater Gator!

name: Overgrown Horror
text: Taunt Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of minions in your hand with Dark Gifts by (2).
flavor: Fetch me the garden shears. The BIG shears.

name: Primalfin Challenger
text: Battlecry: Your next Kindred triggers twice.
flavor: "MURGRGLGLLGLLRRRG!!!!!!" There were no survivors.

name: Dissolving Ooze
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly minion. Spit out the Bones of its Attack and Health into your hand.
flavor: Ooze Ooz Oo O

name: Petrified Ogre
text: Starts Dormant. While Dormant, gain +2/+2 at the start of your turn. (50% chance to awaken instead.)
flavor: First, he was afraid...

name: Tortollan Storyteller
text: At the end of your turn, give +1/+1 to each friendly minion of a different type.
flavor: "And then a turtle made it to the water!"

name: Crystal Tender
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Gain empty Mana Crystals until both players have the same Mana.
flavor: "Hands off my tendies!"

name: Marshland Thresher
text: After you cast a spell, gain Divine Shield.
flavor: "Just remember, when we pose for pictures, look very shadowy and grainy."

name: Story of the Waygate
text: Reduce the Cost of cards in your hand that didn't start in your deck by (1).
flavor: "...and then a lot of people got mad."

name: Storage Scuffle
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Costs (0) if you've Discovered this turn.
flavor: Flip and file! Mix and shuffle! Sort and swap! Do the Storage Scuffle!

name: Pterrorwing Ravager
text: Rush Kindred: Costs (2) less.
flavor: Turns out most things are skyscreamers if you drop them from high enough.

name: Whispering Stone
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get 2 random Fel spells. They cost Health instead of Mana.
flavor: shhhhhh...

name: Blob of Tar
text: Poisonous, Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Blob with Poisonous and a 2/2 Blob with Taunt.
flavor: A tar is born.

name: Tunnel Terror
text: Deathrattle: Get two random Temporary 2-Cost minions.
flavor: And a tiny soul patch to match.

name: Barricade Basher
text: Whenever you gain Armor, gain +2/+2 and attack a random enemy minion.
flavor: She's aggressively affectionate.

name: The Great Dracorex
text: Rush After this attacks an enemy minion, it damages ALL other enemy minions.
flavor: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could, you didn't stop to think if you should.

name: Bat Mask
text: Set a friendly non-Legendary minion's stats to 1/1. Fill your board with copies of it.
flavor: LURE'S EFFECT WORE OFF.

name: Devilsaur Mask
text: Set a minion's stats to 8/8. Give it Charge.
flavor: "Let's see who's under this mask… SNOWFLIPPER PENGUIN?!?!"

name: Firegill
text: Kindred: Give your other minions Rush.
flavor: Can breathe air, water, or completely ablaze.

name: Hatching Ceremony
text: At the end of your next turn, give your minions +2/+2.
flavor: Don't count your dinos before they ha- Ok...now you can count them.

name: Fire Breath
text: Deal 4 damage. Give your Elementals +1/+1.
flavor: "…let’s sit in the back row for this performance."

name: Mirrex, the Crystalline
text: While in your hand, this is a 3/4 copy of the last minion your opponent played.
flavor: Every hatching ceremony, Mirrex emerges from its cavern. If the light doesn't shine upon its reflective scales, it means there will be 6 more weeks of volcanic eruptions.

name: Crystal Tusk
text: Battlecry: Shuffle the left- most card in your hand into your deck. Deathrattle: Draw 2 cards.
flavor: I stopped watching after the third film. You said this one's about aliens?

name: Techysaurus
text: Taunt. Costs (1) less for each card you played this game that didn't start in your deck.
flavor: The field of dino prosthetics was nearly extinct before the Tortollans came around.

name: The Egg of Khelos
text: Deathrattle: Summon a slightly cracked Egg. (Break 5 times to hatch into a 20/20 Beast!)
flavor: Thousands upon thousands of years Khelos has been waiting to hatch. Hopefully you won't have to wait that long.

name: Longneck Egg
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Beast. Give your minions +1/+1.
flavor: Baby longnecks are unfortunately not called shortnecks.

name: Possessed Animancer
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random Beast from your deck. Give it Lifesteal.
flavor: I don’t know what came over me. I started drawing dinosaurs and I couldn't stop!

name: Holy Eggbearer
text: Battlecry: Draw a 0-Attack minion.
flavor: If this goes poorly, there's always a job as the Holy Breakfast Chef!

name: Asphyxiodon
text: Taunt. At the end of your turn, deal 5 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: Surgeon Tortollan's Warning: Avoid Asphyxiodon at all costs.

name: Tortotem
text: At the end of your turn, get a random minion with multiple minion types.
flavor: If you tip it over, you're cursed with 7 years of bad luck.

name: Chillspine Stegodon
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to two random enemy minions. Kindred: And Freeze them.
flavor: I'm freezin' my tail off over here!

name: Horn of Feasting
text: Summon three 2/1 Raptors with Rush. Outcast: Give them Immune while attacking this turn.
flavor: Good flavor text is a rare medium well done.

name: Skittish Saucier
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of adjacent cards in your hand by (1).
flavor: "Can I ask why this position was vacant?"

name: Diabolus Rex
text: Kindred: Deal 6 damage to your opponent's left and right-most minions.
flavor: It's got a BIG HEAD... and little arms.

name: Tribute Dance
text: Choose a minion. Choose a different minion to transform it into.
flavor: This is just a tribute.

name: Story of Umbra
text: Discover a Deathrattle minion that costs (5) or more. Summon it and trigger its Deathrattle.
flavor: "She tried to tell people about our secret city, so we kicked her out of our secret city. That'll show her!"

name: Hollow Direhorn
text: Rush After a friendly minion dies, spend 3 Corpses to gain Reborn.
flavor: I'm alive! I'm dead! I'm watching tv.

name: Soulrest Ceremony
text: Give your minions +1 Attack and Rush. They die at the end of your turn.
flavor: When you're looking for lethal, you might have to break a few eggs.

name: Herbivore Assistant
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Beast +2/+2 and Rush.
flavor: "Your afternoon is completely booked. I'm going to have to reschedule your leaf chomping to make space for your mandatory meandering."

name: Loh, the Living Legend
text: Battlecry: Your minions cost (5) this game.
flavor: Pretty spry for a 4217 year old.

name: Ambush Predators
text: Summon a 1/1 Spitter with Stealth and Poisonous. Kindred: Do it again.
flavor: Ah, no wonder YOU'RE extinct.

name: Relic of Kings
text: Discover a spell from any class that costs (8) or more. It costs (1).
flavor: "Whoa, found a big plate!"

name: Seismopod
text: Taunt, Elusive Deathrattle: Give all minions in your hand and deck +3/+3.
flavor: "Let your heart guide you. It whispers, so listen closely."

name: Ankylodon
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Summon two random 3-Cost Beasts. They attack random enemies.
flavor: Babies are known as "Break-Your-Ankles-O-Don"

name: Hero's Welcome
text: Discover a Legendary minion to summon. Set its stats to 10/10.
flavor: After Umbra's defeat, Loh had finally fulfilled his lifelong dream and was ready for a peaceful retirement in Latorvia.

name: Ritual of Life
text: Discover a 3-Cost minion. Summon a 2/3 copy of it.
flavor: Naaaaaants ingonyama bagithi baba!

name: Costume Merchant
text: Battlecry: Get a random Mask from another class. Combo: It costs (2) less.
flavor: Every fall, this tortollan rents out the abandoned shellshop.

name: Semi-Stable Portal
text: Rewind Add a random minion to your hand. It costs (3) less.
flavor: Portal technology has advanced so much! We're down to spending only 29% of GDP on upkeep.

name: Behemoth Mask
text: Set a minion's stats to 8/10 and give it Lifesteal. Force a random enemy minion to attack it.
flavor: "How many little fish does it take to change a light bulb?" "I don't know, they keep vanishing."

name: Sheep Mask
text: Set a minion's stats to 1/1 and give it "Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all minions."
flavor: Baa, Baa, Bomb Sheep

name: Beast Speaker Taka
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary Beast from any class to gain its stats. Deathrattle: Summon it.
flavor: Each year, Beast Speaker Taka kicks off the Day of Rebirth festivities, heralding the start of the dinosaur hatching season. It is a time to mourn those we have lost, and to celebrate the joy of new life in the Crater.

name: Atlasaurus
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Summon a random Taunt minion that costs (5) or more.
flavor: He's got the weight of the world on his shoulders.

name: Panther Mask
text: Set a minion's stats to 5/4 and give it Stealth. Draw 2 cards.
flavor: Every minion wants to be a cat.

name: Guard Duty
text: Summon a random 6, 4, and 2-Cost Taunt minion.
flavor: "My cousin's out fighting dragons and what do I get? Guard duty."

name: Falric
text: You gain twice as many Corpses as normal. Battlecry: Draw a card that spends Corpses.
flavor: God I freaking love pears.

name: Raptor-Nest Nurse
text: Battlecry: Get a random 1-Cost minion. Deathrattle: Get a random 1-Cost spell.
flavor: Spectacular, give me 14 of them right now.

name: Past Silvermoon
text: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy minion. Advance to the present!
flavor: For nearly seven thousand years, Silvermoon stood unblemished as the crown jewel of Quel'Thalas. But that was before the Lich King came.

name: Chrono Daggers
text: Rewind Throw 3 knives at random enemies that deal 2 damage each.
flavor: Ow. Ow. Ow. No no not again! Ow. Ow. Ow.

name: Aeon Wizard
text: Rewind Battlecry: Get 2 random spells from your class.
flavor: The odds of getting four Wheels of DEATH!!! are astronomically low. You should consider yourself lucky!

name: Portal Vanguard
text: Rewind Battlecry: Draw a random minion. Give it +2/+2.
flavor: "Not Weasel Tunneler AGAIN!"

name: Conflux Crasher
text: Rewind Battlecry: Deal 7 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Conflexing on my haters.

name: Timethief Rafaam
text: Fabled+. Your deck size is 40, but has 10 Rafaams! Battlecry: If you played the rest, destroy the enemy hero. (X left!) (Ready!)
flavor: Timethief Rafaam has recruited himself from every universe to RULE ALL OF TIME! Murozond is just a temporary obstacle…

name: Lo'Gosh, Blood Fighter
text: Fabled, Rush. Deathrattle: Summon a Blood Fighter from your hand. It gains +5/+5 and attacks a random enemy.
flavor: In the Crimson Ring they call him Lo'gosh, the Ghost Wolf. He's forgotten the time when he was called by another name: Varian Wrynn, King of Stormwind.

name: Azure Queen Sindragosa
text: Fabled If you control another Dragon, your Arcane spells cost (2) less.
flavor: Once Malygos' beloved mate, Sindragosa was among the first to suspect the corruption that had overtaken Neltharion. She came to regret not trusting her suspicions.

name: Arcane Barrage
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy and 2 damage to two other random ones.
flavor: Arrrrrr I got me cane and I'm gonna barrage you with it!

name: Opu the Unseen
text: Stealth. Battlecry, Combo, and Deathrattle: Cast 'Fan of Knives'.
flavor: This is allegedly what Opu looks like. We will confirm if we ever see him.

name: Mirror Dimension
text: Summon a 0/4 minion with Taunt. If you are holding a Dragon, summon another.
flavor: Also summons two 4/0s.

name: Bygone Doomspeaker
text: Rewind Battlecry: Both players discard a random card.
flavor: Let bygones be Doomspeakers.

name: Threshrider's Blessing
text: Give a friendly minion +4/+4 and "Deathrattle: Summon a random 4-Cost minion."
flavor: #Blessed

name: Algeth'ar Instructor
text: Spell Damage +2
flavor: For my first lesson, spell "damage."

name: Alter Time
text: Discover two Arcane spells from the past. They cost (2) less.
flavor: Spells from the past and future are adjusted for inflation.

name: Axe of the Forefathers
text: After your hero attacks, deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: ...and the axe of the beforefathers before the forefathers before him.

name: Muradin, High King
text: Fabled, Rush. Battlecry: Bring the High King's Hammer to ME! Deathrattle: Add it to your hand.
flavor: There is no story more tragic in Ironforge history than that of King Muradin slaying the corrupted Prince Arthas. The Lich King never rose to power, the Stormriders united, but the boy's death created fractures in the Alliance that would never repair.

name: Temporal Construct
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage to an enemy minion. Draw cards equal to the excess damage.
flavor: Time is a construct. Here it is.

name: Farseer Wo
text: Elusive After you cast a spell, Discover a Nature spell from the past.
flavor: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

name: Instant Multiverse
text: Rewind Summon 12 Mana worth of random minions. Overload: (3)
flavor: Well, this is orcward…

name: Anomalize
text: Summon a random 10 and 1-Cost minion. Scramble their stats.
flavor: Only nominally anomalous.

name: Crater Experiment
text: Kindred: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: Finally, a dinosaur designed by committee.

name: Precise Shot
text: Deal 3 damage. If this is EXACTLY in the center of your hand, deal 5 instead.
flavor: I never promised it would be accurate.

name: Ticking Timebomb
text: Deathrattle: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Trust me, the timer always stops at 0 seconds.

name: Epoch Stalker
text: Rush, Elusive Battlecry: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: Look out! It's at your 6 o'clock!

name: Quel'dorei Fletcher
text: Your Hero Power costs (0) while your hand has 3 or less cards.
flavor: Time flies when you're going face.

name: Ranger General Sylvanas
text: Fabled. Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. If you've played Alleria or Vereesa, repeat for each.
flavor: Whatever she would later become, no hero fought the Lich King so courageously as the Ranger General of Silvermoon.

name: Faceless Enigma
text: Battlecry: Look at 2 random Secrets. Pick one to cast for yourself. The other casts for your opponent.
flavor: I only share secrets with my most intimate friends and enemies.

name: Timelooper Toki
text: Battlecry: Get 3 random spells from the past. When you play ALL 3, get another Timelooper Toki.
flavor: Well this loop's a wash. Let's meditate until the next one.

name: Gorishi Tunneler
text: Stealth After this attacks, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: "This card is really boring." "Nah, I really dig this card."

name: Entomologist Toru
text: Battlecry: Put each minion in your hand into 0/1 Jars that cost (1). Break them to release the minions!
flavor: The lid. The lid. The lid. The lid. The lid. The lid.

name: Gladiatorial Combat
text: Summon a random minion from your deck. Summon a 5/5 Tiger with Stealth for your opponent.
flavor: I could win this fight with one head tied behind my back!

name: Heir of Hereafter
text: Taunt Battlecry: Gain +2/+2 for each damaged minion.
flavor: Heir today, heregone tomorrow.

name: Undercover Cultist
text: Taunt, Reborn Has +3 Attack while damaged.
flavor: Don't be suspicious, don't be suspicious.

name: Undefeated Champion
text: Rush. Battlecry: Fill your opponent's board with random 1-Cost minions.
flavor: Like ripe tomatoes, a temporary title at best.

name: Unleash the Crocolisks
text: Gain 10 Armor. Summon two 2/3 Beasts for your opponent.
flavor: Spare me your crocolisk tears.

name: Deathrot Maw
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a random Fel Beast.
flavor: Oh, don't worry, Deathy doesn't bite.

name: Raptor Herald
text: Rewind Battlecry: Discover a Beast with a Dark Gift. Kindred: It costs (1) less.
flavor: That meteor is getting WAY too close!

name: Krog, Crater King
text: At the end of your turn, set the Attack and Health of all enemy minions to 1.
flavor: Who died and made him King of anything?

name: Garona Halforcen
text: Fabled. Battlecry: If your opponent is holding King Llane, destroy him and cut their Health in half.
flavor: Garona made her mark that day. No longer was she simply the assassin of the Horde. She was now the liberator of the dictatorship of Lordaeron.

name: Shapeshifter
text: Each turn this is in your hand, transform into a random minion in your opponent's hand.
flavor: Square! Circle! Rhombus!

name: Gelbin of Tomorrow
text: Fabled Battlecry: Put one of each Aura from your deck into the battlefield.
flavor: In one future, Gelbin invents a way to preserve his brain in a suit of robotic armor, and leads the gnomes into a bright future powered by the Holy Light.

name: Lady Azshara
text: Fabled. Choose One - Empower Zin-Azshari; or The Well of Eternity. (The other gets destroyed!)
flavor: There was a time when Azshara was a benevolent queen to the Kaldorei. There is a timeline where she even stayed one.

name: Hardlight Protector
text: Divine Shield Battlecry: Restore 3 Health to your hero and give them Divine Shield.
flavor: Fights for a brighter tomorrow.

name: Neon Innovation
text: Discover a Paladin Mech from the past. Give it +5/+5.
flavor: "This is the third time this week you've brought Shielded Minibot to class."

name: Tankgineer
text: Divine Shield Deathrattle: Summon a 7/7 Tank with Divine Shield.
flavor: They can fix anything, as long as it's a tank.

name: Mend the Timeline
text: Rewind Get 2 random Holy spells. Restore Health to your hero equal to their Costs.
flavor: Time heals all wounds.

name: Manifested Timeways
text: Battlecry: If you control an Aura, deal 3 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Hold on, I'm manifesting my Aura.

name: Medivh the Hallowed
text: Fabled. Costs (0) if you control Karazhan. Battlecry: Silence and destroy all other minions.
flavor: In our timeline, Medivh tells himself he never had the chance to reject Sargeras' dark influence. But there's a timeline where he did.

name: Broxigar
text: Fabled, Charge Start of Game: Disappear. Kill all 4 Demons from Argus to reappear in hand.
flavor: The wound Broxigar dealt to Sargeras during his last stand is a glory no other orcish hero has ever achieved.

name: Lightning Rod
text: Deal 2 damage to a friendly minion to deal 4 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: Rodney despised his nickname, but took comfort in knowing none doubted his power.

name: Flux Revenant
text: Taunt Whenever you would damage this with a Nature spell, it gains +2/+1 instead.
flavor: "Now where did I leave that capacitor…"

name: Thunderquake
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. Get a Static Shock.
flavor: Would you like to see my muscles? Catchphrase! Catchphrase! Hammer down!

name: Stormrook
text: Whenever you would damage this with a Nature spell, summon a random 5-Cost minion instead.
flavor: A dwarf and their rook have a special bond, which cannot be broken by forge nor fire.

name: Doomsday Prepper
text: Outcast: Your hero is Immune until your next turn.
flavor: I gave up my pantry space for miscellaneous non-perishable goods. What have YOU sacrificed?

name: Perennial Serpent
text: Rush Costs (4) less if a minion is Dormant.
flavor: Given the choice, I prefer the seasonal variety of giant serpent for my garden.

name: Talanji of the Graves
text: Fabled. Battlecry: Draw Bwonsamdi (or resurrect him if he has died). Choose a Boon to give him.
flavor: In one dark timeline, Talanji was struck down and raised again as a death knight. But even death can't stop her from protecting the Zandalari.

name: Contingency
text: Draw the bottom two cards from your deck.
flavor: Straight to Plan Z!

name: Memoriam Manifest
text: Summon the highest Cost friendly Undead that died this game.
flavor: "Just let me die already!"

name: Murozond, Unbounded
text: Battlecry: At the start of your next turn, set this minion's Attack to INFINITY!
flavor: Oh yeah?? Well, next turn I hit for Infinity +1!

name: Slagclaw
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Sizzling Cinders. Kindred: Trigger your Sizzling Cinders' Deathrattles.
flavor: You can't just have the sizzle, you gotta have the cinders.

name: Timestop
text: Deal 3 damage. Freeze two random enemy minions.
flavor: A broken clock is right twice an eternity.

name: Primordial Overseer
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Nature spell while holding this, gain +1/+1 and draw a card.
flavor: In this timeline, dwarves got very creative with their totem carvings.

name: Nascent Bolt
text: Deal 5 damage to a minion. If it survives, draw 2 cards.
flavor: Let's wait until it matures into a full blast.

name: Cleansing Lightspawn
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Deal damage to an enemy minion equal to this minion's Health.
flavor: To get out the toughest stains, mix baking soda, vinegar, and the scorching rays of atonement.

name: Yesterloc
text: At the end of your turn, give your other minions +1 Health.
flavor: *nostalgic mrrgls*

name: Divine Augur
text: Battlecry: Set the Attack and Health of every minion in your hand to the higher of the two stats.
flavor: To achieve true holiness you must drill into the heart of divinity.

name: Amber Priestess
text: Taunt Battlecry: Restore Health to a character equal to this minion's Health.
flavor: "My strength is yours. And I'm YOKED!"

name: Intertwined Fate
text: Discover a copy of a card from your deck and one from your opponent's.
flavor: Just imagine… DRAGONS!

name: Cryofrozen Champion
text: Deathrattle: Get a random Legendary minion. Reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: If you keep making that face it's going to freeze like that.

name: Twilight Timehopper
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 2 Shreds of Time into your deck. When drawn, deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: Just a timehop, timeskip, and a timejump away.

name: Entropic Continuity
text: Give your minions +1/+1. Shuffle 2 Shreds of Time into your deck.
flavor: I thought I signed up to go to the Tropic Continuity...

name: Tachyon Barrage
text: Deal 6 damage split among all enemies. Shuffle 2 Shreds of Time into your deck.
flavor: Kinda tachy if you ask me.

name: Fatebreaker
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Cast a Shred of Time from your deck to gain +3/+3.
flavor: If ye had the chance to break yer fate, wooja?

name: Ruinous Velocidrake
text: Rush Battlecry: Cast a Shred of Time from your deck to summon a copy of this.
flavor: Time slows down as your Velocidrake approaches the speed of light.

name: Divergence
text: Split a random minion in your hand into two halves.
flavor: They really are my other half.

name: RAFAAM LADDER!!
text: Draw 3 cards of different Costs.
flavor: Rafaam doesn't need a ladder. Rafaam has RAFAAMS!

name: Chronogor
text: Battlecry: You draw your 2 highest Cost cards. Your opponent draws your 2 lowest Cost cards.
flavor: "I'm flight-ready!" "I'm not flight-ready!"

name: Cease to Exist
text: Rewind Silence and destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.

name: Druid of Regrowth
text: Rewind Battlecry: Cast 2 random Nature spells.
flavor: Seems cool until you realize it's an invasive species.

name: Wormhole
text: Rewind Summon a random 3-Cost Beast. It attacks a random enemy.
flavor: Worms sourced cruelty free from Gigantic Sam's Bait Shoppe.

name: Stadium Announcer
text: Rewind Battlecry: Both players equip a random weapon. Give yours +1/+1.
flavor: "ATTENTION!" "CANNONBALL!"

name: Time Machine
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get a random Rewind card.
flavor: Doc, you made a time machine... out of a refrigerator?

name: Temporal Traveler
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 4/1 Shadow that attacks a random enemy minion.
flavor: Note to past self: remember to avenge my imminent death.

name: Shadows of Yesterday
text: Rewind Summon four 3/2 Shades. They each gain two random Bonus Effects.
flavor: Our actions today haunt us tomorrow. Like choosing to Rewind.

name: Royal Informant
text: Battlecry: Look at the right- most card in your opponent's hand. Either get a copy of it or increase its Cost by (2).
flavor: "Psst... that person wearing the crown is the King."

name: Eternus
text: Battlecry: Take control of an enemy minion with this minion's Health or less.
flavor: "I can't believe Eternus would turn on us!" -Infinite Dragonflight

name: Past Conflux
text: Summon a random Dragon that costs (5) or more. Advance to the present!
flavor: For millennia, magic shrouded the Temporal Conflux and the rest of the Dragon Isles from all of Azeroth — even the dragonflights themselves.

name: Disciple of the Dove
text: Battlecry: Draw a minion. Give minions in your hand +2 Health.
flavor: She was almost a Priest of the Pigeon.

name: Deathwing the Destroyer
text: Battlecry: Destroy all other minions. Discard a card for each destroyed.
flavor: "He’s Deathwing? That one's Deathwing? You're Deathwing!? I'm DEATHWING! ARE THERE ANY OTHER DEATHWINGS I SHOULD KNOW ABOUT?"

name: Malygos the Spellweaver
text: Battlecry: Draw spells until your hand is full.
flavor: After many years, Malygos has decided mortals can use magic. ALL THE MAGIC!

name: Onyxia the Broodmother
text: At the end of each turn, fill your board with 1/1 Whelps.
flavor: Throw more dots, throw more dots, more dots, more dots!

name: Vault Breaker
text: After you Discover a card, reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: I've already told him 3 times to PUSH.

name: Story of Amara
text: Set your hero's Health to 40.
flavor: "Once upon a time... ok how about we just skip to the end?"

name: Chronological Aura
text: At the end of your turn, summon a 3/5 Dragon with Taunt. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: We need to find the missing dragon link!

name: Mister Clocksworth
text: Rewind, Rewind, Rewind Battlecry: Summon 2 random Legendary minions.
flavor: "Hey Mister, what're your clocks worth?" "Depends on the hour, my boy."

name: Deja Vu
text: Discover a copy of a card in your opponent's hand.
flavor: "I've played this game before!"

name: Storm the Gates
text: Sidequest: Play 3 Beasts or Undead. Reward: Craft a custom Zombeast. It costs (3) less.
flavor: Have fun storming the Lost City!

name: Staff of the Endbringer
text: Deathrattle: Destroy all minions.
flavor: Finally, the loot I wanted off the boss! Too bad I'm on an alt...

name: Waveshaping
text: Discover a card from your deck. The others get put on the bottom.
flavor: I wave in squares.

name: Ebb and Flow
text: Deal 3 damage. If you played a minion while holding this, gain 5 Armor.
flavor: Go with the Ebb.

name: Endangered Dodo
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you have 10 or less Health, gain +5/+5 and summon a copy of this.
flavor: The reports of my imminent demise have been greatly exagger-

name: Highborne Mentor
text: Battlecry: Get a 2/2 Pupil. Discover a spell that costs (7) or more from the past to teach it.
flavor: Always gives pop quizzes about the most obscure subjects.

name: Krona, Keeper of Eons
text: Taunt Battlecry: Set the Costs of the bottom 5 cards of your deck to (1).
flavor: We spent an eon deciding what flavor text to put here.

name: The Fins Beyond Time
text: Battlecry: Replace your hand with your starting hand. Swap back at the end of your turn.
flavor: Cards? Where we're going we don't need cards.

name: Fading Memory
text: Deathrattle: Get a random 5-Cost minion from the past.
flavor: I had the best idea for flavor text! …what was it again?

name: Futuristic Forefather
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Look at 3 cards. Guess which one is in your opponent's hand to gain +4 Health.
flavor: Be careful or else you'll end up your own forefather.

name: Arrow Retriever
text: Battlecry: Draw until you have 3 cards.
flavor: And he'll never tell how many times you missed.

name: Troubled Double
text: Stealth Combo: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: "Concede now!" "Or prepare to fight!"

name: Flashback
text: Summon two random 1-Cost minions from the past. Combo: With +1 Attack.
flavor: Brings me back. To the card I played right before this.

name: King Maluk
text: Battlecry: Discard your hand. Get an Infinite Banana.
flavor: Discard hand. Return to Monke.

name: Dethrone
text: Destroy a minion. Combo: Summon a random 8-Cost minion.
flavor: and decrown are mine!

name: Time Adm'ral Hooktail
text: Battlecry: Summon a 0/8 Chest for your opponent. It's FULL of Coins!
flavor: A pirate dragon's favorite workout? Treasure chest day.

name: Chrono-Lord Epoch
text: Battlecry: Destroy all minions that your opponent played last turn.
flavor: Epoch? But he's Legendary!

name: PMM Infinitizer
text: Battlecry: Set a friendly minion's Attack and Health to 8. It can't attack heroes this turn.
flavor: Nobody knows what PMM stands for.

name: Past Gnomeregan
text: Give a minion +2/+1. Advance to the present!
flavor: Before the trogg invasion, Gnomeregan was a thriving, high-tech metropolis.

name: For Glory!
text: Draw 2 cards. Costs (1) less for each minion your opponent controls.
flavor: It turns out they WERE entertained.

name: Slow Motion
text: Your opponent's cards cost (1) more next turn.
flavor: You are now playing in Tortollan Mode.

name: Soldier of the Bronze
text: Taunt Battlecry: Double this minion's Health.
flavor: This is what a century of bronzer does to you.

name: Whelp of the Infinite
text: Poisonous Reborn
flavor: .eip eituc a tahW

name: Cyborg Patriarch
text: Dormant for 3 turns. Taunt
flavor: We have the technology. We have the bananas. We can rebuild him.

name: Devious Coyote
text: Stealth. Costs (1) less for each time the enemy hero took damage this turn.
flavor: Something's fishy about this.

name: Clockwork Rager
text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Health for each turn you've taken this game. ( turns)
flavor: "BY MY CALCULATIONS YOU ARE TWO MINUTES LATE!!!"

name: Aeon Rend
text: Rewind Deal 4 damage to two random enemies.
flavor: Rewinding just to miss lethal again is soooo Illidan.

name: Dangerous Variant
text: At the start of your turn, transform into a random 5-Cost minion.
flavor: I prefer to think of myself as the improved variant.

name: Sentient Hourglass
text: Rush After this minion survives damage, swap its stats.
flavor: Everyone asks, "What is the time?" but never "How is the time?"

name: Soldier of the Infinite
text: Rush Battlecry: Double this minion's Attack.
flavor: This is what a century of infinitizer does to you.

name: Amber Warden
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a random minion from the past.
flavor: For Amber Warden, this was the most important moment in their life. For me, it was turn eight.

name: Sandmaw
flavor: Its favorite flavor: vanilla.

name: Time Skipper
text: At the end of each player's turn, give them a Coin.
flavor: Eh, I'm fast forwarding this century, I don't think anything interesting happens.

name: Unknown Voyager
text: After this survives damage, transform into a random 7-Cost minion.
flavor: If you think about it, we're all time travelers from the past.

name: Whelp of the Bronze
text: Lifesteal Divine Shield
flavor: What a cutie pie.

name: Wizened Truthseeker
text: Battlecry: Set the Cost of every card in both player's hands back to their original Costs.
flavor: All his stories start with "Back in my day..."

name: Paltry Flutterwing
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random 2-Cost minion that is Dormant for 2 turns.
flavor: Beware! The Flutterwing Effect is even more dangerous.

name: Living Paradox
text: Elusive Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Living Paradoxes with Elusive.
flavor: We just need to find the right clone to pin this all on.

name: Precursory Strike
text: Deal 3 damage. If you're holding a minion that costs (5) or more, draw a minion.
flavor: Three Precursory Strikes and you're out before you even get to the plate.

name: Quantum Destabilizer
text: This minion takes double damage from all sources.
flavor: No fair! You changed the outcome by measuring it!

name: Timeless Causality
text: Battlecry: Reverse the order of your deck.
flavor: Never confuse Timeless Correlation with Timeless Causality.

name: Chronicle Keeper
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, gain Taunt and Divine Shield.
flavor: No retcon required!

name: Timelord Nozdormu
text: Dormant for 5 turns. Rush. After you play a card from the newest expansion, awaken 1 turn sooner.
flavor: We tried Dormant for 15 seconds, but that was a bit too quick.

name: Chrono-Lord Deios
text: Your Battlecries, Deathrattles, Hero Power, and end of turn effects trigger twice.
flavor: Deiiiiios. Deiiii eiiii eiii os.

name: Timeway Warden
text: Battlecry: Imprison an enemy minion. It goes Dormant for 10,000 turns. Deathrattle: Awaken it.
flavor: You can get some turns reduced for good behavior.

name: Hounds of Fury
text: Summon two 3/2 Demons. If your deck has no minions, they attack the lowest Health enemy.
flavor: No, you can't pet the dogs.

name: Time-Lost Glaive
text: Deathrattle: Get a random Demon from the past.
flavor: Oh, that's when I left it!

name: The Eternal Hold
text: Discover any Demon that costs (5) or more. If your deck has no minions, your next one costs (1).
flavor: "...stay on the line, our customer service representative will speak with you soon..."

name: Husk, Eternal Reaper
text: Battlecry: Give your hero "Deathrattle: Spend up to 20 Corpses to resurrect with that much Health."
flavor: It is to Husk's eternal amusement that the second life is often wasted.

name: Power Word: Barrier
text: Give a character Divine Shield. Give minions in your hand +2 Health.
flavor: Nothing says teamwork like hiding under a yellow bubble and pretending mechanics don't exist.

name: Blood Draw
text: Discover a spell. This costs Health instead of Mana.
flavor: Comes with some moonberry juice so you don't pass out.

name: Forgotten Millennium
text: Fill your hand with random Undead. They cost Health instead of Mana this turn.
flavor: We don't talk about it.

name: Liferender
text: Battlecry: If your hero's Health changed this turn, deal 6 damage to an enemy minion.
flavor: Redirect your pain into a healthier outlet: your opponent.

name: Chronochiller
text: You no longer draw a card at the start of your turn.
flavor: Time always seems to pass quickly when you just want to chill.

name: Static Shock
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion. Give your hero +1 Attack this turn.
flavor: Spent hours shuffling his feet on the rug before going into battle.

name: Solitude
text: Discover 2 minions. If your deck has no minions, reduce the Cost of any in your hand by (2).
flavor: Me time.

name: Lasting Legacy
text: Give your hero +4 Attack this turn. If your deck has no minions, give any in hand +4 Attack.
flavor: My father had +4 Attack and his father before him had +4 Attack.

name: City Chief Esho
text: Battlecry: If every minion in your deck shares a minion type, give your other minions +2/+2 (wherever they are).
flavor: "Let me esho you around!"

name: Niri of the Crater
text: Whenever you play a 1-Cost minion, double its stats. Whenever you cast a 1-Cost spell, cast it twice.
flavor: Niri, Niri, Niri of the Crater, strong as they can be! HAAAAAEEHOOOOHEHOOOEAAAAAAAA!!!! Watch out for that tree!

name: Hourglass Attendant
text: Divine Shield At the end of your turn, give all minions in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: Works hard to maintain his hourglass figure.

name: Wicked Blightspawn
text: Reborn. Deathrattle: Equip a 1/2 Dagger. If you already have a weapon equipped, give it +2 Attack instead.
flavor: We had to split this minion's Deathrattle into two parts.

name: Remnant of Rage
text: Costs (1) less for each minion that died this turn. Battlecry: Draw 2 cards.
flavor: Never go to dead angry.

name: Bygone Echoes

name: Chronoclaws

name: Omen of the End

name: Morchie

name: Endtime Murozond
text: Battlecry: Fill your board with random Dragons. Fully heal your hero. Skip your next turn.
flavor: Backed into a corner, Murozond has summoned Dragons from all timelines in his final hour. But the worst is yet to come...

name: Untimely Death

name: Finality

name: Jagged Edge of Time
text: Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power.
flavor: The passage of time is not always smooth.

name: Kaldorei Cultivator
text: Battlecry: Discover 2 Beasts. Put them on the bottom of your deck with +5/+5.
flavor: It's a bad sign when they float to the top of your deck.

name: Misplaced Pyromancer
