name: Chromie
text: Deathrattle: Draw another copy of cards you've played this game. ( cards)
flavor: Chromie searched far and wide, but there just wasn’t a group of heroes with the strength to take down Murozond. In this timeline, at least…

name: Sands of Time
text: Rewind Discover a spell from ANY class. (Or just your class after you Rewind!)
flavor: Perfect for seasoning your thymelines.

name: Runi, Temporal Guardian
text: Battlecry: Send all minions in your hand 2 turns into the future. They return with +5/+5.
flavor: In her timeline, Runi stood as the last living Paladin and assumed the mantle of Temporal Guardian. Blessed by Mi'da, she now commands the power to guide the threads of fate, placing them precisely where and when they are needed.

name: Supply Run

flavor: DrakeDash was key in delivering victory against Al'Akir.

name: Noxious Cadaver
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to an enemy and your hero.

flavor: Oh, don’t mind the smell. They're just aged!

name: Cloud Serpent
text: Battlecry: Get a copy of another Elemental or Dragon in your hand.
flavor: Cloudy with a chance of Quest Rewards.

name: Chromatus
text: Colossal +4 Taunt, Lifesteal, Elusive, Divine Shield
flavor: In our timeline, Nefarius never achieved his dream of combining the power of all five dragonflights into a single ultimate dragon. But Murozond found the timeline where he did.

name: Spellweaver's Brilliance

text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, refresh 2 Mana Crystals.

name: Archmage Kalec
text: Battlecry: Give all spells in your hand and deck Spell Damage +1.
flavor: Kalec comes, Kalec goes.

name: Warmaster Blackhorn
text: Battlecry: Destroy all cards that cost (2) or less in both players' decks.
flavor: The brave warrior who finally defeats Warmaster Blackhorn, once and for all, will be bestowed with the most prestigious title in the land: Cowtipper.

name: Sheltered Survivor
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to shuffle into your deck. Draw a card.
flavor: "Go! You'll be safe in the deck!" "NO MORE TICKETS!"

name: Envoy of the End
text: Taunt Battlecry: Herald X.
flavor: The Aspects tried so hard and got so far. But in the end, it didn't even matter.

name: Drakeadon Mongrel
text: Deathrattle: Summon two random 4-Cost minions.
flavor: One head always tells the truth, the other always fries.

name: Stormbinder
text: Deathrattle: Unlock your Overloaded Mana Crystals. Overload: (3)
flavor: Random Orc looking out at rain: "Well, you can't change the weather." Stormbinder: "Hold my totem."

name: Shadowsworn Disciple
text: Battlecry: Herald X. Deathrattle: Restore 3 Health to your hero.
flavor: By the void! That's a coin in the swear chalice.

name: Ocular Occultist
text: Taunt Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to discard.
flavor: Which looks better to discard: Number 1? Or number 2? Back to number 1? And number 2.

name: Eldritch Tentacles
text: Deal 3 damage to all minions. Repeat this with 1 less damage.

name: Shrine of Twilight
text: Herald X. Draw a card.
flavor: This is where Cho'gall puts all his Old God merch.

name: Duke of Below
text: Rush Has +2/+2 for each card you've discarded this game.
flavor: Oh come on, we can't ALL have the Duke.

name: Maloriak
text: After you discard a minion, summon a copy of it.

name: The Black Blood

name: Ruby Sanctum

name: Armored Bloodletter

name: Command Claw
text: After your hero attacks, give a random friendly minion +2 Attack.

name: Chromatic Broodmother
text: Rush Whenever this attacks, refresh Mana Crystals equal to this minion's Attack.

name: Victor Nefarius
text: Battlecry: Craft a custom Undead Dragon. If you're holding a Dragon, reduce the Creation's Cost by (3).

name: Mend
text: Restore a minion to full Health. Draw a card.

text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Summon a random 4-Cost minion."

text: Elusive

name: Skywall Sentinel
text: Taunt Battlecry: Herald X.

name: Tol'vir Carver
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand. At the start of your turns, reduce its Cost by (1).

name: Wickerfang
text: Colossal +4 After one of Wickerfang's Legs gains stats, this gains them too.

name: Flash Flood

name: Muradin's Last Stand
text: Draw 2 cards. Costs (1) less for each time a friendly character attacked this game.

name: Ceremonial Clash
text: Summon a random 3, 2, and 1-Cost minion. Overload: (1)

name: Morchok

name: Cataclysmic War Axe

name: Decimation
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. (Improved for each minion on the battlefield.)

name: Agent of the Old Ones

name: Twilight Mistress
text: Battlecry: Return all enemy minions to their owner's hand.

name: Stolen Power

name: Garona's Last Stand

name: Inspiring Maul
text: Deathrattle: Trigger a random friendly minion's end of turn effect.

name: Nozdormu, Bronze Aspect

name: Spearheart Sentry
text: At the end of your turn, get a random Holy spell. Reduce its Cost by (3).

name: Scalebreaker Bulwark
text: At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to all enemies.

name: Bronze Keeper

name: Chamber of Aspects

name: Selfless Protector

name: Battlefield Blaster
text: Battlecry: Choose a spell in your hand to give Spell Damage +1.

name: Twilight Egg

name: Flight Maneuvers

name: Alexstrasza, Guardian of Life
text: Battlecry: Set your remaining Health to 15. When you reach full Health, deal 15 damage to your opponent.

name: Vyranoth

name: Searing Fissure
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. Give your hero +3 Attack this turn.

name: Erupting Volcano

name: Torch

name: Destructive Blaze

name: Daze

name: Commander Geddon

flavor: TWO THIRDS WILL BURN!!

name: Iso'rath
text: Battlecry: Devour 2 random cards from the opponent's hand, then go Dormant for 2 turns. Deathrattle: Return them.

name: Unstable Spellcaster
text: Spell Damage +1 Battlecry: If you dealt damage with a spell this turn, summon a copy of this.
flavor: 1, 2, 3, 4, I declare a spell war.

name: Lo'Gosh's Last Stand
text: Give a minion "Deathrattle: Summon a random minion from your hand."
flavor: As the Cataclysm loomed, Lo'Gosh and his friends fought side by side for the fate of Azeroth as valiantly as they once fought to entertain the crowds in the Crimson Ring.

name: Frostbitten Imp
text: Battlecry: Freeze this.
flavor: '"I'll g-g-g-g-get r-r-r-r-right on it!"

name: Survivalist
text: Has Immune while you control no other minions.
flavor: "Go - save yourself and your ranking!"

name: Shadowed Informant

name: Genn, Cursed King

name: Winterspring Whelp
text: Battlecry: Discover a 1-Cost spell from any class.
flavor: It's important to explore other classes while learning to spread your wings!

name: Gelbin's Triumph

flavor: Lord Victor Nefarius fancied himself Azeroth's greatest inventor, but Gelbin showed him what true innovation can do!

name: Sleet Storm
text: Deal 2 damage. Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: Pocket snow!

name: Welcome Home!
text: Reopen a location. Give it "Deathrattle: Summon a random 3-Cost minion."
flavor: Kick off your boots, light the hearth, and deal a fresh hand!

name: Raincaller
text: The first time you deal damage with a spell each turn, gain +2 Attack.
flavor: I bless the rains down in Nazjatar...

name: Cleansing Cleric
text: Battlecry: Your healing effects restore 2 more Health this game.
flavor: Ah yes. Your "healing" effects. Sure thing.

name: Gronn Giant
text: This minion's Cost is reduced by the Cost of the last card you played.
flavor: This card has really gronn on me.

name: Ash Worm
text: Starts Dormant. When your board is full, awaken.
flavor: Would you still love me if I were an Ash Worm?

name: Wizened Wildspeaker
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you didn't play a minion last turn, refresh 3 Mana Crystals.
flavor: He's not old, he's "Wizened".

name: Heartroot Stones
text: Draw a card and gain 3 Armor. If you didn't play a minion last turn, do it again.
flavor: Heartrootstone: Heroes of Woodcraft

name: Seeding Dragon
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get a random Dragon. It costs (2) less.
flavor: Seeding support for a future "Unicorn Druid".

name: Tranquil Clearing
text: Give a minion +2 Health and Taunt. It falls asleep until the end of your next turn.
flavor: A great spot to reflect on your journey to becoming the best.

name: Lifebloom
text: Restore 8 Health to all friendly characters. Summon two random 8-Cost minions.
flavor: It's the 'bolg necessities.

name: Tame Pet
text: Replace your future Animal Companions with random Beasts that cost (1) more. Draw a card.
flavor: Finally, it's never Huffer.

name: Spiritspeaker
text: Battlecry: Choose an Animal Companion to summon.
flavor: "What did the spirit say?" "Caaaw!"

name: Wasteland Vanguard
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage split among all enemies. If any die, deal 3 more.
flavor: Slimy yet satisfying.

name: Migrating Elekk
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Replace your future Animal Companions with random Beasts that cost (1) more.
flavor: Great herds of these travel across the plains every few expansions, signifying the return of the hunter meta.

name: Talya Earthstrider
text: Battlecry: Your cards that summon Animal Companions summon 1 more this game.
flavor: She's a cat lady... and an Elekk lady... and an Ultrasaur lady.

name: Bashana Runetotem
text: Battlecry: Get three 2/2 Treants. Carve 12 Mana worth of Nature spells into them.
flavor: "Who carved their name into my totems and RUNED them?!"

name: Bursting Leyline
text: Deal X damage to a random enemy minion. Excess damage hits the enemy hero.
flavor: When you gotta go, you gotta go.

name: Ley Walker
text: Battlecry: Your Leylines cost (1) less this game. Deathrattle: Get a random Leyline.
flavor: Ley! I'm walkin' here!

name: Crystallized Leyline
text: Summon a random X-Cost minion.
flavor: This crystal has healing properties.... and this crystal summons an army of minions.

name: Surge Needle
text: Battlecry: Your Leylines trigger an additional time this game.
flavor: Scalpel... Tweezers... Surge Needle... I said Surge Needle!

name: Leyline Nexus
text: Draw a card. It costs (X) less.
flavor: Sometimes I just paint purple lines on the ground and call it a Leyline.

name: Nurturing Nature
text: Give a friendly Beast +2/+2. Give a random Beast in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: Which got buffed first, the chicken or the egg?

name: Roam Free
text: Replace your future Animal Companions with random Beasts that cost (2) more. Choose one to summon.
flavor: I want... to... Roam Free!

name: The Arcanomicon
text: Get all 3 Leylines. Choose an upgrade for your Leylines.
flavor: Pondering my Orb.

name: Mystic Runesaber
text: Elusive Battlecry: Increase the effects of your Leylines by 1 this game.
flavor: And the cat came back, the very next ley.

name: Dread Leviathan
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion to steal 3 Health from, three times.
flavor: But Leviathans are traditionally so unthreatening!

name: Experimental Animation
text: Herald X. Deal 4 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: What if we tried 23 frames per second to make it look really weird?

name: Gruesome Nightmare
text: Battlecry: Give a minion in your hand or battlefield Attack equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: Faces only a broodmother could love.

name: Maniacal Follower
text: Stealth Deathrattle: Herald X.
flavor: The person 2ft behind you with the 10,000 Watt headlights.

name: Scorching Ravager
text: Battlecry: Herald X. Give the Soldier Rush.
flavor: I'd be scorching too if I were standing in lava.

name: Medivh's Triumph
text: Deal 4 damage to all minions. Costs (1) if you control a Legendary card.
flavor: His long struggle against Sargeras' temptations taught this Medivh an understanding of true darkness – but along with that came an unprecedented mastery of the Light.

name: Obsessive Technician
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Herald X.
flavor: If I just run every tech card there's no way I'll lose!

name: Malevolent Mutant
text: Battlecry: Choose a Fel spell in your hand. Get a copy of it.
flavor: No more mister nice naguy.

name: Rite of Twilight
text: Herald X. Combo: Deal 3 damage.
flavor: Two rites definitely make a wrong.

name: Chaos Supplicant
text: After you cast a spell, cast a random spell of the same Cost from another class.
flavor: Witness him on one knee, begging RNG to work in his favor.

name: Brash Battlemaster
text: Rush Deathrattle: Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1 Attack this game.
flavor: Bold and brash, his enemies belong in the trash.

name: Resilient Savior
text: Divine Shield After this loses Divine Shield, give your Silver Hand Recruits +1 Health this game.
flavor: Congratulations you're being rescued! Please do not resist.

name: Convalescence
text: Summon two X Silver Hand Recruits with Divine Shield.
flavor: Get WELL MET soon!

name: Emboldening Blade
text: Battlecry: Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1/+1 this game.
flavor: Blade

name: Arator the Redeemer
text: Battlecry: Double the stats of all friendly Silver Hand Recruits and give them Taunt.
flavor: What an upbeat guy! I'm sure nothing will ever change that.

name: Charity
text: Get copies of all friendly minions that died this turn. Give them +3/+3.
flavor: I am donating these minions... to myself!

name: Scaled Lancer
text: All enemy minions have Taunt.
flavor: And when everyone has Taunt... nobody does.

name: Gemstone Hoarder
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to discard. Deathrattle: Get it back. It costs (1) less.
flavor: Two gems per day wasn't enough.

name: Vulcanos
text: Colossal +2 At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Determined to see Azeroth aflame, Ragnaros awakened a living volcano to send rivers of lava across the Barrens.

name: War'loc
text: Battlecry: Your next Murloc that costs (3) or less costs Health instead of Mana.
flavor: Your mrrggl shall be mine!!!!!!!

name: Sandfury Aura
text: Your minions' end of turn effects trigger twice. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Sand always messes up the flow of time when it gets stuck in my watch.

name: Arcane Flow
text: Shatter Deal 4 damage. Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Super excited to combo this with ERROR MISPLACED CARD

name: Faceless Replicator
text: Elusive Deathrattle: Transform the minion that killed this into a Faceless Replicator.
flavor: I am thou, thou art I...

name: Stickybomb Saboteur
text: Battlecry: Give your opponent a 2-Cost Sabotage. Cards next to it cost (1) more.
flavor: Her over-attachment to her work proved fatal.

name: Sindragosa's Triumph
text: Deal 8 damage to a minion. Reduce the Cost of a random card in your hand by the excess damage.
flavor: When Sindragosa and her beloved fight side by side, nothing can stand in their way.

name: Conjuration Specialist
text: Battlecry: Choose a spell in your hand. Split it into two random spells of the same Cost.
flavor: Specialist is a very polite way of saying she only knows one spell.

name: Cultivating Sprite
text: Battlecry: Get a 3-Cost Bulb that casts three random 1-Cost spells. It upgrades each turn.
flavor: Specializes in cultivating cranberries.

name: Sewer Imp
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Honestly compared to the prison this is actually an improvement.

name: Violet Punisher
text: Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion. Steal its Bonus Effects and gain +1/+1 for each stolen.
flavor: Bad news for your flower garden.

name: Moragg
text: Prepare. Deathrattle: Summon a random Demon from your deck. Give it "Deathrattle: Summon Moragg."
flavor: The key to a good escape plan, is to just have all of them.

name: Tunneling Geomancer
text: Prepare Spell Damage +1
flavor: I SEES THE LIGHT! Oh wait it's just candle...

name: Defias Wannabe
text: Prepare Combo: Gain +1/+1 for each other card played this turn.
flavor: A candle on top of your head does NOT help with being stealthy.

name: Soothsayer
text: Prepare, Taunt Deathrattle: Restore 6 Health to your hero. Summon a random 6-Cost minion.
flavor: "Sooth. Sooth....Sooth. Am I doing it right?"

name: Hold Them Off!
text: Prepare Give a minion +5/+5 and Lifesteal.
flavor: I've Prepared for this moment my whole life sentence.

name: Ragnaros, the Great Fire
text: Colossal +2 At the end of your turn, trigger your minions' Deathrattles.
flavor: The Lord of Flame was all too ready to throw in his lot with Deathwing if it meant the chance to watch all Azeroth burn.

name: Azshara, Ocean Lord
text: Colossal +2 Your hero has Windfury.
flavor: Azshara has never been one to acknowledge any higher power than herself – not even Deathwing. But she's not averse to making deals.

name: Arisen Onyxia
text: Colossal +2. When your hero would lose Health on your turn, gain that much max Health instead.
flavor: Onyxia's dear brother has raised her from the grave. Don't expect her to be grateful.

name: Vanessa the Ringleader
text: Prepare After you play a card, get a random Battlecry minion. It costs (2) less.
flavor: You'd need at least a dozen cards doing a combination of combos. Off the top of my head, I'd say you're looking at a Gallywix, a Hooktusk, a Dungar, two Cho'galls and a Babbling Book... not to mention the biggest Questing Adventurer, ever.

name: Cho'gall, Mastermind
text: Colossal +2 Your Arms and Soldiers destroy minions in the enemy's deck instead.
flavor: Once a servant of the Old Gods, Cho'gall believes he has become a god, worthy to stand beside them.

name: Al'Akir, Lord of Storms
text: Colossal +2, Rush, Windfury Battlecry: Get 2 minions with Cost equal to this minion's Attack. They cost (1).
flavor: Seduced by Deathwing's promises of freedom and power, the Windlord summoned massive storms over Uldum as he led his forces to assault the Titans' strongholds.

name: Sinestra
text: Colossal +2 Your spells from other classes cast twice.
flavor: Though she holds no love for her former spouse, Sinestra is willing to work with him if it means her Twilight brood can finally inherit what remains of Azeroth.

name: V'ama, Looming Death
text: Battlecry: Destroy all non-Paladin minions.
flavor: BE NOT AFRAID

name: Deathwing, Worldbreaker
text: Battlecry: Choose X Cataclysm to unleash! Herald twice to upgrade.Battlecry: Choose X |4(Cataclysm,Cataclysms) to unleash! Herald once to upgrade.Battlecry: Choose X |4(Cataclysm,Cataclysms) to unleash!
flavor: Having destroyed Azeroth in his own timeline, Deathwing plans to do the same to our world, and the next, until nothing is left.

name: Nab
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, shuffle a copy of it into your deck that costs (2).
flavor: "Wait Rogue is meta?" "Always has been..."

name: Escape Artist
text: After this attacks and survives, draw a card and escape the game!
flavor: For my next trick I need a volunteer. Please inspect the battlefield and ensure there are no trap doors or otherwise concealed exits.

name: Vigilant Sentry
text: Taunt Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, summon two Vigilant Sentries.
flavor: Now all of Dalaran knows you're here.

name: Warptooth
text: Charge. If four friendly characters take damage on one of your turns, summon this from hand or deck.
flavor: Warptooth's life of crime can be directly linked back to a botched wisdom tooth operation.

name: Ancient Augur
text: Battlecry: Look at 3 cards in your opponent's hand and secretly choose one. Deathrattle: Discard it.
flavor: "If you let me out I'll tell you what the next Hearthstone expansion is."

name: Scramble for Gear
text: Gain 2 Armor. Shuffle five Gear spells into your deck that give 2 Armor when drawn.
flavor: Trying to get a toddler ready to leave the house.

name: Defias Smuggler
text: Prepare. Battlecry: Give a friendly minion +2 Attack and Rush.
flavor: Must have been the wind.

name: Demonic Confinement
text: Make a minion go Dormant for 2 turns. If it’s a friendly Demon, give it +3/+3 instead.
flavor: If he fits, he sits

name: Imp Gang Stooge
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Put two 8/8 Demons with Taunt and Lifesteal on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Bah! What does that Demon know anyways? Huh, what's wrong? She's right behind me isn't she...

name: IMPFERNAL!
text: Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to all other characters. (Also triggers in hand or deck.)
flavor: What the heck is this? Straight to jail.

name: Sewer Swimmer
text: Prepare Battlecry: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle.
flavor: It's Sewer Swimmer Saturday!

name: Slice and Dice
text: Replay all other cards played this turn (targeting enemies if possible). End your turn.
flavor: It Preps, it Shivs, it Fans, it wins! Slice and Dice does it all!

name: Picklock
text: All numbers on this card equal your remaining Mana. Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to an enemy minion.
flavor: Call me derivative because I'm always on curve!

name: Alarm-o-Matic
text: At the start of your turn, swap this minion with a random one in your opponent's hand.
flavor: Weeee woooo... weeee woooo... WEE WOO! WEE WOO! WEE WOO!

name: Blackpaw's Whip
text: Costs (1) less for each Coin you're holding. Deathrattle: Draw a card.
flavor: Coin-Whip-Concede.

name: Aya, Lotus Kingpin
text: You always go second. Battlecry: Pick an upgraded counterfeit to replace your Coins this game. Get 3.
flavor: If there's one thing the leader of the Jade Lotus learned back in Gadgetzan, it’s that there is no honor among thieves. And yet here she finds herself again - working with backstabbers no better than Kazakus.

name: Spiteful Chef
text: Battlecry: Summon a 2-Cost Taunt minion. If you have 10 or more Mana, summon a 6-Cost instead.
flavor: All I said was that it needed a touch more salt!

name: Smuggled Shovel
text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell that didn't start in your deck.
flavor: I am a rat and I'm digging a hole. Diggy diggy hole, diggy diggy hole!

name: King of the Underbelly
text: While building your deck, pick 3 contraband Beasts. Battlecry: Discover one. It costs (3) less.
flavor: After being RUDELY expunged from Stormwind’s sewers, the Rat King declared himself sovereign of Dalaran’s Underbelly. And how convenient for Vanessa and her crew - his smuggling tunnels run right into the Violet Hold…

name: Chainbreaker Hogger
text: Taunt Start of Game: Duplicate all other Legendary cards in your deck.
flavor: Inmate Intake 031306. Reason for arrest: Ate too many noobs.

name: Chef Neth'rek
text: Start of Game: If your deck only has cards that cost (3) or less, set your Mana to 10 after five turns!
flavor: Neth’rek was the leader of a small Nerubian settlement - but that was before the Lich King came. Appearing content with her life as head chef, the wardens have forgotten to see her as a threat…

name: Noxious Bribe
text: Discover a Choose One card. It has both effects combined. Give your opponent a plain copy.
flavor: "I baked you a pie!" "Oh boy what flavor?" "SPIE-DER FLAVORED!"

name: Azalina Soulsever
text: Your starting Health is 40. Your deck is 20 cards, plus 20 copied from your enemy. Battlecry: Draw until your hand is full.
flavor: The vengeful spirit’s reign of terror in the Witchwood has come to an end. But more and more of Azalina’s whispers have been escaping her cage. How many guards are under her spell? Only one thing is certain: any deal Vanessa strikes with her will come at a cost...

name: Gullible Guard
text: Deathrattle: You can say Sorry this game.
flavor: Ohhhh you're a guard who left their gear at home? I am SO sorry, I thought for a moment you were a prisoner trying to escape!

name: Rioter
text: After a friendly minion survives damage, give it +1 Attack.
flavor: YOU NO THROW CANDLE!!!

name: Deadly Bribe
text: Destroy a minion and give your opponent a Coin. Combo: You get one too.
flavor: A cut of the cut for the cut.

name: Thief's Tools
text: Get two random 4-Cost spells. Reduce their Costs by (2).
flavor: Aya keeps her stash hidden behind a Poison Bloom poster in her cell.

name: Crowd Control
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions, twice. If your deck has 25 or more cards, this costs (2) less.
flavor: What type? Stun? Sleep? Sheep?

name: Scrappy Defender
text: Taunt Has +5 Attack if your deck has 25 or more cards.
flavor: What a gentle-ogre! Always gets the door for others.

name: Contraband Wands
text: Get 3 Arcane Missiles.
flavor: The cake is a lie.

name: Bootleg Alchemist
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand. Transform it into a spell that costs (5) more (keeps its original Cost).
flavor: Careful! This potion has a bit of a KICK to it!

name: Mystic Misdirection
text: Secret: When an enemy minion attacks, transform it into a 1/1 Sheep.
flavor: "Knock knock." "Who's there?" "Distracting Sheep." "Distracting sheep wh- BAAAHHHH!"

name: The Skeleton Key
text: Discover a spell, or refresh your options (20% chance to take 5 damage each refresh!)
flavor: The skeleton belongs to the person who last tried to use it.

name: Mind Sweeper
text: Battlecry: If you played a copy of an opponent's card while holding this, deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.

name: Unshackle Soul
text: Destroy a minion. If you played a copy of an opponent's card while holding this, this costs (1).
flavor: Hit the road, shackle, and don't you come back no more.

name: Godfrey the Betrayer
text: Start of Game: Overdrawn cards return to your hand when you have space. They cost (1) less.
flavor: Hunted down and cornered in Shadowfang Keep, Godfrey was left with no choice but to go quietly. But before his time is up, that monster, Crowley, will get what’s coming to him.

name: Enthralled Shade
text: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of cards in your hand that were copied from your opponent by (1).
flavor: She's a priest main at heart, but is fascinated by the other classes' cards.

name: Annihilation
text: Destroy all minions. Summon any Demons in the bottom 3 cards of your deck.
flavor: This is the Annihilation. This is the Annihilation now!

name: Spire of Solitude
text: Summon a Demon with stats equal to your hand size. It attacks a random enemy minion.
flavor: Ah, an introvert's dream!

name: Caged Cranium
text: Taunt Battlecry: Gain +1 Health for each card in your hand.
flavor: "NYEH HEH HEH!"

name: Rampaging Hound
text: Prepare Battlecry: Force all enemy minions to attack this.
flavor: Made you over-extend!

name: Widow's Bite
text: Give your hero +1 Attack this turn. Gain 1 Armor. Add "Widow's Feast" to your hand.
flavor: Spider Bake Sale. All proceeds go to real spiders.

name: Lethal Recipe
text: Draw 2 minions. If you have 10 or more Mana, give them +3/+3.
flavor: Sauce?

name: Black Market Auctioneer
text: Prepare Whenever you cast a spell, draw a card.
flavor: I got the best steals anywhere!

name: Irida Sinseeker
text: Lifesteal. Battlecry: Send your deck to the Void, except 1 card. At the start of your turns, get two cards from the Void.
flavor: Day 7902. I am not alone anymore. Tras’tath can help me… give Irida the strength she needs… Irida. That was my name, but it sounds so strange to me now. The walls won’t stop whispering. They won’t stop they won’t stop they won’t stop

name: Lotus Bookie
text: Deathrattle: Get a Coin.
flavor: He skims a bit from the top. It's just his nature.

name: Tras'tath, Soul Parasite
text: Prepare, Rush After you summon a Demon, gain its stats.
flavor: Tras'tath did some deep soul searching before they found Irida.

name: Spider Rider
text: After your hero attacks, draw a card.
flavor: SPIDER JOCKEY

name: Staff of Trickery
text: After your hero attacks, Discover a Druid card. Reduce its Cost by your hero's Attack.
flavor: It's tricky to get a 'vate, to get a 'vate that's not too late - it's tricky!

name: Tower of Ghouls
text: After this minion takes damage, summon two 1/1 Frail Ghouls.
flavor: Once in a while a group of Frail Ghouls will try to escape their end of turn fate.

name: Tricksy Improviser
text: Prepare Battlecry: If you've cast a spell this turn, cast two random Mage Secrets.
flavor: Welcome to Dalaran, where the spells are made up and the points don't matter!

name: Drink Blood
text: Lifesteal Deal 3 damage to a minion. Refresh your Hero Power.
flavor: Good news! We've lowered your blood pressure!

name: Disguised Doctor
text: Can be played on either side. Deathrattle: Shuffle 4 Blights into your deck that deal 2 damage when drawn.
flavor: The doctor is in... disguise!

name: The Living Plague
text: Charge. Instead of damaging heroes, this shuffles that many Blights into their deck that deal 2 damage when drawn.
flavor: "I'm actually a nice guy when you get to know me." - The Living Plague

name: Sawbones
text: Prepare. Battlecry: Destroy all your other minions. Draw a card and refresh a Mana for each one destroyed.
flavor: Sawbones saw bones to bone saw.

name: Bone Flurry
text: Deal 3 damage randomly split among enemies. If a friendly minion died this turn, deal 3 more.
flavor: Go! Fetch!

name: Dig for Freedom
text: Give a friendly minion "Deathrattle: Summon two random 4-Cost minions."
flavor: He crawled through a tunnel of filth, only to come out clean on the other side.

name: Underbelly Network
text: Summon a 2/1 Rat with "Deathrattle: Draw a card."
flavor: Mind if I roll cheese?

name: Guard Dog
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random 1-Cost Deathrattle minion.
flavor: Updog

name: Jailhouse Manastorm
text: Battlecry: After you cast a spell this game, summon a random minion of the same Cost.
flavor: “Millhouse Manastorm, I'm coming for you!” His wife’s words haunted him ever since she escaped from Violet Hold. One night, he heard a strange ZAP! as he stepped through a portal, and found himself nearly a decade in the past - Millificent’s cold cell waiting for him.

name: Breakout Architect
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell that costs (5) or more. It casts twice when played.
flavor: Oh nah, these aren't maps! It's... uh... just arcane hopscotch!

name: Spire Security
text: Battlecry: Reveal a spell in your deck. If it costs (5) or more, deal 5 damage split among enemy minions.
flavor: One does not simply walk out of The Violet Hold. Its gates are guarded by more than just Boulderfist Ogres. There is evil there that does not sleep, and Spire Security's great eye is ever watchful.

name: Cold Snap
text: Freeze an enemy. Get a random Frost spell.
flavor: Oh snappers!

name: Blood Doctor Thal'ena
text: Battlecry: Get a second Hero Power that costs Corpses.
flavor: Blood-Princess Thal’ena has been imprisoned for longer than the archmages can remember. Posing as the prison’s doctor, Thal’ena is not content to sate her hunger. Locked in her lab, she is creating something terrifying…

name: Molten Gold
text: Deal 4 damage. (Cast 3 spells to turn into a minion!)
flavor: Looks like it's time for a little PAYBACK!

name: Gallagio Goon
text: After you play a Battlecry minion, give it +1/+1.
flavor: Sure the knuckle dusters are kind of redundant but look how cool they look!

name: Frostshatter
text: Freeze an enemy. Draw 2 cards. (Cast 3 spells to turn into a minion!)
flavor: "WHERE IS MY SUPER SUIT?!"

name: Stormfury
text: Lifesteal. Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions. (Cast 3 spells to turn into a minion!)
flavor: UNLIMITED POWER!!!

name: Hexmarshal
text: Battlecry: Get a random spell that costs (5) or more. If your deck started with no spells, it costs (5) less.
flavor: When you just put the prisoners in their cells and they're escaping again!

name: Mug'Zee
text: Start of Game: If your deck has no other minions, get Mug's Hero Power. If it has no spells, get Zee's!
flavor: Before he hit the big time at The Gallagio, Mug’Zee did a bit of work for the cartels back in Gadgetzan. Let’s just say he won’t be going back.

name: Beast Tripwire
text: Summon a random 5-Cost Beast. Shuffle 2 spells into your deck that do it again when drawn.
flavor: And it was at that moment, she knew, she tripped up.

name: Black Market Overseer
text: Whenever you play a Deathrattle minion, give it Rush.
flavor: Do you have an account with the black market? If you sign up now you'll get 20% off your first crate of stolen goods!

name: Arcane Tripwire
text: Deal 4 damage split among all enemies. Shuffle 2 spells into your deck that do it again when drawn.
flavor: What a Long, Strange Trip It's Been

name: R4T-C4TCH3R
text: Battlecry: Copy all spells in your deck. Deathrattle: Draw one.
flavor: He's gonna c4tch y4, c4tch y4, c4tch y4, c4tch y4.

name: Activated Golem
text: At the end of each turn, gain Reborn.
flavor: First we're going to raise our right arm as high as we can. This will help activate our core.

name: The Unseen Atlas
text: Draw 3 cards. Costs (1) less for each card in your hand.
flavor: Are you sure? I can see it right there.

name: Shadow Rounds
text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion. If it dies, cast this on another random enemy minion.
flavor: This rounds on you, and you, AND YOU!

name: Reckless Detective
text: Rush. Deathrattle: Get Detective's Clothes that give +4/+4 and Rush.
flavor: I was so close to solving the case. And that's when it hit me- a tentacle in the back of the head...

name: Karov the Broken
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get three 1/1 copies of random Legendary minions. They cost (1).
flavor: Karov didn't care - Old God's corruption was a small price to pay for getting swole.

name: Zuramat's Prison
text: Choose a card to discard to summon a 5/5 Taunt. Deathrattle: Free Zuramat who plays one each turn!
flavor: WETVAC MODE ACTIVATE!

name: Corpse Cannon
